abandon.example: They had to abandon the old car by the road.
abandon.exampleZh: 他们不得不把那辆旧车丢弃在路边。

abbreviation.example: The abbreviation for that long word is easy to remember.
abbreviation.exampleZh: 那个长单词的缩写很容易记住。

abdomen.example: The doctor pressed gently on his abdomen to check for any pain.
abdomen.exampleZh: 医生轻轻按压他的腹部，检查是否有疼痛。

abide.example: We must abide by the rules of the game at all times.
abide.exampleZh: 我们必须始终遵守游戏规则。

ability.example: She has the ability to learn new languages very quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有很快学会新语言的能力。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for him to be late for work twice in one week.
abnormal.exampleZh: 他一周内上班迟到两次是不正常的。

aboard.example: All passengers must be aboard the plane before it leaves.
aboard.exampleZh: 所有乘客必须在飞机起飞前登机。

abolish.example: The country decided to abolish the old law last year.
abolish.exampleZh: 这个国家去年决定废除那条旧法律。

abolition.example: The abolition of slavery was a long and difficult struggle.
abolition.exampleZh: 废除奴隶制是一场漫长而艰难的斗争。

abortion.example: She had an abortion after talking with her doctor about the risks.
abortion.exampleZh: 她和医生讨论了风险之后做了流产。

about.example: We talked about the new project for about an hour.
about.exampleZh: 我们谈论这个新项目谈了大约一个小时。

above.example: The plane flew above the clouds for two hours.
above.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方飞了两个小时。

abroad.example: She wants to study abroad after she finishes school this year.
abroad.exampleZh: 她想今年完成学业后到国外留学。

abrupt.example: The abrupt change in weather surprised everyone at the picnic.
abrupt.exampleZh: 天气的突然变化让野餐上的每个人都感到意外。

absence.example: His absence from the meeting made everyone wonder where he was.
absence.exampleZh: 他缺席会议，让大家都不知道他去了哪里。

absent.example: He was absent from school yesterday because he had a bad cold.
absent.exampleZh: 他昨天因为重感冒没去上学。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对这个国家的每个人拥有绝对的权力。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water and nutrients from the soil through their roots.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过根从土壤中吸收水分和养分。

abstain.example: The doctor told him to abstain from alcohol for a month.

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract, so please give me a simple example.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个想法太抽象了，所以请给我一个简单的例子。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for our own bad planning.
absurd.exampleZh: 把我们自己糟糕的规划归咎于天气是荒谬的。

absurdity.example: The absurdity of his plan made everyone laugh out loud.
absurdity.exampleZh: 他计划中的荒谬之处让大家都大笑起来。

abundance.example: There is an abundance of fresh fruit in the market this summer.
abundance.exampleZh: 今年夏天市场上新鲜水果很丰富。

abundant.example: This area has abundant water and rich soil for farming.
abundant.exampleZh: 这个地区有丰富的水源和肥沃的土壤适合耕种。

abuse.example: Many people abuse their power and treat others badly.
abuse.exampleZh: 许多人滥用权力，并且恶劣对待他人。

academia.example: She has spent her whole life working in academia as a teacher and researcher.
academia.exampleZh: 她一生都在学术界工作，既是教师也是研究者。

academic.example: She has a strong academic background and teaches at a famous college.
academic.exampleZh: 她有很强的学术背景，并在一所著名学院任教。

academy.example: She studies music at a famous academy in our city.
academy.exampleZh: 她在我们城市一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: New machines help us accelerate the work and save a lot of time.
accelerate.exampleZh: 新机器帮助我们加快工作速度，节省大量时间。

accent.example: She speaks English with a strong French accent that is easy to notice.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带着很重的法国口音，很容易听出来。

accept.example: I accept your kind offer and thank you very much.
accept.exampleZh: 我接受你的好意，非常感谢。

acceptable.example: The food at the hotel was simple but completely acceptable to everyone.
acceptable.exampleZh: 酒店的食物虽然简单，但大家都能接受。

acceptance.example: Her acceptance of the new job surprised all of us.
acceptance.exampleZh: 她接受了这份新工作，这让我们所有人都感到意外。

access.example: Students can get access to the library computers after six in the evening.
access.exampleZh: 学生们晚上六点以后可以使用图书馆的电脑。

accessible.example: The library is accessible to everyone, and the books are easy to read.
accessible.exampleZh: 图书馆对所有人开放，而且那些书都很容易读懂。

accessory.example: She bought a new phone and a small accessory for it.
accessory.exampleZh: 她买了一部新手机和一个配套的小配件。

accident.example: I broke my arm in a bike accident last summer.
accident.exampleZh: 去年夏天我在一次自行车事故中摔断了胳膊。

accidental.example: The fire was accidental, so no one was blamed for it.
accidental.exampleZh: 这场火灾是意外发生的，所以没有人因此受到责备。

acclaim.example: The new film won great acclaim from critics and audiences alike.
acclaim.exampleZh: 这部新电影赢得了评论家和观众的一致称赞。

accommodate.example: Our new classroom can accommodate forty students comfortably.
accommodate.exampleZh: 我们的新教室可以舒适地容纳四十名学生。

accommodation.example: We found cheap accommodation near the train station for two nights.
accommodation.exampleZh: 我们在火车站附近找到了便宜的住宿，住了两晚。

accompaniment.example: Soft music was a pleasant accompaniment to our quiet dinner.
accompaniment.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐是我们安静晚餐的愉快伴奏。

accompany.example: My mother will accompany me to the hospital this afternoon.
accompany.exampleZh: 我妈妈今天下午会陪我去医院。

accomplice.example: The police caught the thief and his accomplice near the bank.
accomplice.exampleZh: 警察在银行附近抓住了小偷和他的同谋。

accomplish.example: She worked hard and accomplished her goal in just one year.
accomplish.exampleZh: 她努力工作，仅用一年就实现了自己的目标。

accord.example: The two countries signed a peace accord after a long talk.
accord.exampleZh: 两国在长时间会谈后签署了一项和平协议。

accordance.example: Everything was done in accordance with the rules of the school.
accordance.exampleZh: 一切都按照学校的规则来做。

accordingly.example: The weather got cold, so accordingly we bought warmer clothes for the trip.
accordingly.exampleZh: 天气变冷了，因此我们为这次旅行买了更保暖的衣服。

account.example: Please check your bank account and tell me the exact balance.
account.exampleZh: 请查看你的银行账户，告诉我确切的余额。

accounting.example: She studies accounting at college because she wants to work with numbers.
accounting.exampleZh: 她在大学学习会计，因为她想从事与数字打交道的工作。

accrue.example: Small interest payments accrue on the savings account every month.
accrue.exampleZh: 储蓄账户每个月都会累积一点利息。

accumulate.example: Dust will accumulate on the shelves if you do not clean them often.
accumulate.exampleZh: 如果你不经常打扫，灰尘就会在架子上积聚。

accumulation.example: The accumulation of small daily efforts leads to big changes over time.
accumulation.exampleZh: 每天小小努力的积累会随着时间带来巨大的变化。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this weather report is not always very good.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这份天气预报的准确性并不总是很高。

accurate.example: Her report gives an accurate picture of the problem.
accurate.exampleZh: 她的报告准确地描述了这个问题。

accuse.example: They accuse him of stealing money from the shop.
accuse.exampleZh: 他们控告他从商店里偷钱。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to getting up early every day.

ache.example: I have an ache in my back after sitting all day.
ache.exampleZh: 坐了一整天后，我的背部感到疼痛。

achieve.example: She worked hard every day to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

achievement.example: Winning the game was a great achievement for our young team.
achievement.exampleZh: 赢得这场比赛对我们这支年轻的队伍来说是一项巨大的成就。

acid.example: The acid in the lemon makes the soup taste a little sour.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬里的酸让这汤尝起来有点酸。

acknowledge.example: She did not acknowledge my email, so I called her again.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 她没有告知收到我的邮件，所以我又给她打了电话。

acoustic.example: The acoustic guitar sounds warm and soft in this small room.
acoustic.exampleZh: 这把原声吉他在这间小房间里听起来温暖而柔和。

acquaintance.example: She is an old acquaintance of my mother and often visits us.
acquaintance.exampleZh: 她是我母亲的老熟人，经常来看我们。

acquire.example: She acquired a lot of new skills during her first year at work.
acquire.exampleZh: 她在工作的第一年里学到了很多新技能。

acquisition.example: The museum announced the acquisition of two ancient paintings last week.
acquisition.exampleZh: 博物馆上周宣布收购了两幅古画。

acquit.example: The jury decided to acquit the young man because there was no evidence.
acquit.exampleZh: 陪审团决定宣判这个年轻人无罪，因为没有证据。

acre.example: My uncle owns a small farm of about twenty acres.
acre.exampleZh: 我叔叔拥有一个约二十英亩的小农场。

acrobat.example: The acrobat jumped high in the air and landed on her hands.
acrobat.exampleZh: 杂技演员高高跃入空中，然后双手着地。

across.example: She walked across the street to meet her old friend.
across.exampleZh: 她穿过街道去见她的一位老朋友。

act.example: We must act now to protect the forest and the animals living there.
act.exampleZh: 我们现在必须采取行动，保护森林和生活在其中的动物。

action.example: We must take action now to protect the river near our town.
action.exampleZh: 我们现在必须采取行动保护我们镇附近的河流。

activate.example: Please press this button to activate the new machine.
activate.exampleZh: 请按这个按钮来激活这台新机器。

activation.example: The new update causes activation of the app when you open the file.
activation.exampleZh: 当你打开文件时，新的更新会触发该应用的激活。

active.example: She stays active by walking to school every day.
active.exampleZh: 她每天步行上学，保持活跃。

activity.example: My favorite activity on weekends is riding a bike in the park.
activity.exampleZh: 我周末最喜欢的活动是在公园骑自行车。

actor.example: The actor gave a wonderful performance in the new film last night.
actor.exampleZh: 这位演员昨晚在那部新电影中献上了一场精彩的表演。

actual.example: The actual cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
actual.exampleZh: 这次旅行的实际费用比我们预期的要高。

acute.example: She felt acute pain in her back after the long run.
acute.exampleZh: 长跑之后，她的背部感到剧烈疼痛。

adapt.example: It takes time to adapt to a new school and make friends.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校并交到朋友需要时间。

adaptability.example: The adaptability of young children helps them learn new things quickly.
adaptability.exampleZh: 幼儿的适应性强，能帮助他们很快学会新事物。

adaptation.example: The film is a good adaptation of a famous old novel.
adaptation.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部著名旧小说的优秀改编本。

add.example: Please add some sugar to my tea.
add.exampleZh: 请给我的茶里加一些糖。

addict.example: My brother is a video game addict and plays every night.
addict.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个游戏迷，每天晚上都玩。

addiction.example: His addiction to video games made him forget his homework every night.
addiction.exampleZh: 他对电子游戏的上瘾让他每晚都忘记做作业。

addition.example: In addition to the low price, this phone has a very good camera.
addition.exampleZh: 除了价格低，这部手机还有一个非常好的摄像头。

additional.example: We need to pay an additional fee for the extra bag.
additional.exampleZh: 我们需要为额外的行李支付附加费用。

address.example: Please write your address on this form before you leave.
address.exampleZh: 离开前请把你的地址写在这张表格上。

adept.example: She is very adept at solving difficult math problems quickly.
adept.exampleZh: 她非常擅长快速解决数学难题。

adequate.example: His training was adequate for the simple job, so he started work on Monday.
adequate.exampleZh: 他的训练对于这份简单的工作来说足够了，所以他周一开始上班。

adhere.example: Small pieces of dust can adhere to the screen if you do not clean it.
adhere.exampleZh: 如果不清洁屏幕，小灰尘颗粒就会黏附在上面。

adherence.example: Strict adherence to the safety rules keeps all workers safe.
adherence.exampleZh: 严格遵守安全规则能保障所有工人的安全。

adhesive.example: This strong adhesive holds the two pieces of wood together very well.
adhesive.exampleZh: 这种强力黏合剂把两块木头牢牢粘在一起。

adjacent.example: Our new house is adjacent to a small park and a school.
adjacent.exampleZh: 我们的新房子紧邻一个小公园和一所学校。

adjective.example: In this sentence, the word happy is an adjective.
adjective.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，happy 这个词是形容词。

adjoin.example: The small garden adjoins the old house where my grandparents lived.
adjoin.exampleZh: 这个小花园毗邻我祖父母住过的那座老房子。

adjourn.example: The judge decided to adjourn the meeting until next Monday morning.
adjourn.exampleZh: 法官决定将会议延期到下周一上午。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair to make it more comfortable.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调整这把椅子，让它更舒服一些。

adjustment.example: This small adjustment to the plan will help us save time.
adjustment.exampleZh: 对计划做这个小小的调整将帮助我们节省时间。

administer.example: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient this morning.
administer.exampleZh: 护士今天早上会给病人用药。

administration.example: The new manager is in charge of the administration of the whole company.
administration.exampleZh: 新经理负责整个公司的管理工作。

administrative.example: She has an administrative job in the school office.
administrative.exampleZh: 她在学校办公室做一份行政工作。

admirable.example: Her hard work and kind heart make her an admirable person.
admirable.exampleZh: 她的勤奋和善良使她成为一个令人钦佩的人。

admiration.example: I have great admiration for my teacher because she always helps us.
admiration.exampleZh: 我非常钦佩我的老师，因为她总是帮助我们。

admire.example: I admire my teacher because she is kind and patient with everyone.
admire.exampleZh: 我钦佩我的老师，因为她对每个人都很友善、很有耐心。

admission.example: The admission fee for the museum is five dollars per person.
admission.exampleZh: 博物馆的入场费是每人五美元。

admit.example: I admit that I made a mistake yesterday.
admit.exampleZh: 我承认我昨天犯了一个错误。

adolescent.example: Many adolescents need more sleep because their bodies are changing fast.
adolescent.exampleZh: 许多青少年需要更多睡眠，因为他们的身体正在快速变化。

adopt.example: The school decided to adopt a new plan for healthier lunches.
adopt.exampleZh: 学校决定采纳一项让午餐更健康的新方案。

adoption.example: The adoption of this new method helped the team save time.
adoption.exampleZh: 采用这种新方法帮助团队节省了时间。

adore.example: Many young fans adore the singer and travel to every concert.
adore.exampleZh: 许多年轻歌迷崇拜这位歌手，还会赶赴每一场演唱会。

adorn.example: She likes to adorn her room with small flowers and old photos.
adorn.exampleZh: 她喜欢用小鲜花和旧照片装饰自己的房间。

adult.example: Every adult must show an ID card before entering the building.
adult.exampleZh: 每个成年人在进入大楼前都必须出示身份证。

advance.example: Please advance the meeting by one hour so everyone can attend.
advance.exampleZh: 请把会议提前一小时，这样每个人都能参加。

advanced.example: This school uses advanced technology to help students learn faster.
advanced.exampleZh: 这所学校使用先进的技术来帮助学生更快地学习。

advancement.example: Her hard work led to real advancement in her career.
advancement.exampleZh: 她的努力为她的事业带来了真正的进步。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living near the office is that I can walk to work.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在办公室附近的一个很大优势是我可以走路去上班。

advent.example: The advent of the internet has changed how we live and work.
advent.exampleZh: 互联网的出现改变了我们的生活和工作方式。

adventure.example: The trip to the mountains was a great adventure for the children.
adventure.exampleZh: 这次山区之行对孩子们来说是一次了不起的冒险。

adventurous.example: My adventurous sister loves to travel alone in strange countries.
adventurous.exampleZh: 我爱冒险的姐姐喜欢独自在陌生的国家旅行。

adverse.example: Bad weather had an adverse effect on our travel plans.
adverse.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气对我们的旅行计划产生了不利影响。

advertise.example: The small shop uses social media to advertise its new products.
advertise.exampleZh: 这家小店利用社交媒体为新产品做广告。

advertisement.example: I saw a funny advertisement for a new phone on TV last night.
advertisement.exampleZh: 我昨晚在电视上看到一个有趣的新手机广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about learning English.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于学习英语的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to drink water before you run in hot weather.
advisable.exampleZh: 在炎热的天气里跑步前喝水是可取的。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor before the pain gets worse.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你在疼痛加重之前去看医生。

advocacy.example: Her advocacy for clean water helped many small villages get safe drinking water.
advocacy.exampleZh: 她对清洁用水的提倡帮助许多小村庄获得了安全的饮用水。

advocate.example: Many teachers advocate reading aloud every day to help young students learn faster.
advocate.exampleZh: 许多老师提倡每天大声朗读，以帮助年幼的学生学得更快。

aerial.example: The bird made a quick aerial turn above the tall trees.
aerial.exampleZh: 那只鸟在高大的树木上方做了个快速的空中转向。

aesthetic.example: The garden has a simple aesthetic beauty that many people enjoy.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 这座花园有一种简单而赏心悦目的美学美感，很多人很喜欢。

aesthetically.example: The new library is aesthetically pleasing, with bright rooms and simple furniture.
aesthetically.exampleZh: 新图书馆在审美上令人愉悦，房间明亮，家具简洁。

affair.example: The party was a simple family affair with good food and music.
affair.exampleZh: 这次聚会是一次简单的家庭活动，有好吃的食物和音乐。

affect.example: The bad weather can affect the health of old people.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣天气会影响老年人的健康。

affection.example: She feels deep affection for her old teacher and visits her often.
affection.exampleZh: 她对年迈的老师怀有深厚的感情，经常去看望她。

affiliate.example: This small clinic is an affiliate of the city hospital.
affiliate.exampleZh: 这家小诊所是市医院的附属机构。

affirm.example: The manager affirmed that the new plan would start next week.
affirm.exampleZh: 经理确认新计划将于下周开始。

affirmative.example: She gave an affirmative answer to my question.
affirmative.exampleZh: 她对我的问题给出了肯定的回答。

afflict.example: The old man is afflicted with a serious illness that keeps him at home.
afflict.exampleZh: 这位老人饱受重病折磨，只能待在家里。

affluent.example: The affluent family lives in a big house near the park.
affluent.exampleZh: 这个富裕的家庭住在公园附近的一栋大房子里。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year, so we will wait.
afford.exampleZh: 今年我们买不起新车，所以我们会再等等。

affordable.example: This small apartment is affordable for young people who just started working.
affordable.exampleZh: 这间小公寓对刚参加工作的年轻人来说是负担得起的。

afraid.example: The little boy is afraid of the dark and always calls his mother.
afraid.exampleZh: 小男孩怕黑，总是叫妈妈。

after.example: We went for a walk after dinner and then watched a movie.
after.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们去散步，然后看了一部电影。

aftermath.example: In the aftermath of the storm, many families lost their homes.
aftermath.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，许多家庭失去了家园。

afternoon.example: We often go for a walk in the park in the afternoon.
afternoon.exampleZh: 我们经常在下午去公园散步。

afterward.example: We had dinner and afterward walked home together.
afterward.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，后来一起走回了家。

again.example: Please read the question again before you write your answer.
again.exampleZh: 请在你写答案之前再读一遍这个问题。

against.example: Most people in the town voted against the new plan.
against.exampleZh: 镇上大多数人都投票反对这个新计划。

age.example: At the age of ten, she learned to swim in the river.
age.exampleZh: 十岁那年，她学会了在河里游泳。

aged.example: My aged grandfather still walks in the park every morning.
aged.exampleZh: 我年迈的祖父每天早上仍在公园里散步。

agency.example: She found a job through an agency in the city center.

alcohol.exampleZh: 他从不喝酒，因为他想保持健康并保持头脑清醒。

alien.exampleZh: 这个小男孩认为他的新老师是来自太空的外星人。

alienate.exampleZh: 他不断的批评开始使他最亲近的朋友和同事疏远。

alienation.exampleZh: 他长久的沉默使他与老朋友们产生了深深的疏远。

alignment.exampleZh: 两个团队紧密结盟，以按时完成项目。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive and gives us shade in summer.
alive.exampleZh: 那棵老树仍然活着，夏天为我们遮阴。

all.exampleZh: 我们工作了一整天，天黑前完成了这项工作。

allegation.example: The police are investigating an allegation that he took money from the company.

allege.exampleZh: 报纸声称那位经理拿了公司的钱。

allergy.example: My sister has a serious allergy to peanuts and always avoids them.

alleviate.exampleZh: 这种新药有助于减轻她手术后的疼痛。

allowance.example: My parents give me a small allowance every week for school supplies.
allowance.exampleZh: 父母每周给我一点零用钱买学习用品。

alloy.example: This alloy is strong and does not rust easily.
alloy.exampleZh: 这种合金很坚固，而且不容易生锈。

ally.example: The small country became a strong ally of its neighbor during the war.
ally.exampleZh: 这个小国在战争期间成了邻国的强大盟友。

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning because I woke up late.

alone.exampleZh: 她独自生活，但她从不真正感到孤独。

alongside.exampleZh: 她把自行车停在旧墙旁边，然后等我。

aloud.exampleZh: 她把信大声读出来，好让房间里的每个人都能听见。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they learn to read simple words.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习阅读简单单词之前先学字母表。

also.exampleZh: 她喜欢音乐，也喜欢唱老歌。

alteration.exampleZh: 裁缝对我的夹克做了一处小改动，让它更合身。

alternate.exampleZh: 昼夜交替，季节也以规律的方式变化。

alternative.exampleZh: 我们别无选择，只能等下一班公交车。

ambiguity.exampleZh: 他回答中的模棱两可让每个人都不清楚真正的计划是什么。

amendment.exampleZh: 新的修正案将保护工人免受不公平对待。

amount.exampleZh: 植物要长得好需要大量的水。

amuse.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑逗乐了生日聚会上的所有孩子。

analogy.exampleZh: 老师常用类比来向学生解释难懂的概念。

analyse.exampleZh: 科学家在得出任何结论之前会仔细分析这些数据。

analysis.exampleZh: 老师让我们写一篇关于这个故事的简短分析。

anecdote.exampleZh: 我祖父经常讲起他第一天上班时的一件趣事。

angry.exampleZh: 我打碎爸爸最喜欢的杯子时，他非常生气。

antenna.exampleZh: 这只昆虫用触角在黑暗中寻找食物。

anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预期假期前会是很忙的一周。

anticipation.exampleZh: 昨晚音乐会开始前，人们满怀期待。

anxious.exampleZh: 她对考试感到焦虑，但也渴望早点考完。

anyone.exampleZh: 任何人只要稍加练习都能学会做饭。

apart.exampleZh: 这两栋房子在同一条安静的街道上相隔十米。

apologize.exampleZh: 你应该为没问一声就拿走你姐姐的书而向她道歉。

apology.exampleZh: 她因为开会迟到向我诚恳地道了歉。

approve.exampleZh: 我父母赞成我明年出国留学的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is about two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大约费用是两百美元左右。

apron.example: My mother wears a white apron when she cooks dinner.
apron.exampleZh: 我妈妈做晚饭时会穿一条白色的围裙。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary rule that nobody in the class could understand.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师定了一条班里没人能理解的武断规定。

arc.example: The rainbow made a bright arc across the sky after the rain.
arc.exampleZh: 雨后的彩虹在天空划出一道明亮的弧。

arch.example: We walked through the stone arch into the old garden.
arch.exampleZh: 我们穿过石拱门，走进了那座古老的花园。

architect.example: My uncle is an architect who designs beautiful houses and schools.
architect.exampleZh: 我叔叔是一名建筑师，设计漂亮的房屋和学校。

architecture.example: I like the old architecture of this small town.
architecture.exampleZh: 我喜欢这座小镇古老的建筑风格。

archive.example: I saved the old photos in our family archive.
archive.exampleZh: 我把旧照片保存在我们家的档案里。

arctic.example: The arctic winter here is long, and the wind feels very cold.
arctic.exampleZh: 这里的北极冬季很漫长，风也感觉非常寒冷。

area.example: This area of the city is very quiet at night.
area.exampleZh: 城市的这个地区晚上很安静。

argue.example: They often argue about small things at the dinner table.
argue.exampleZh: 他们经常在餐桌上为小事争论。

argument.example: We had a long argument about who should pay for dinner.
argument.exampleZh: 我们就谁该付晚餐的钱争论了很久。

arise.example: Many problems arise when people do not talk to each other.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们彼此不交流时，许多问题就会出现。

arithmetic.example: My daughter is good at arithmetic and solves math problems quickly.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 我女儿擅长算术，解题很快。

arm.example: The young soldier hurt his arm while carrying a heavy weapon.
arm.exampleZh: 那名年轻士兵在搬运重武器时伤了手臂。

army.example: A large army marched through the city and everyone came out to watch.
army.exampleZh: 一支大批军队穿过城市，所有人都出来观看。

around.example: The children sat around the table and shared a big pizza.
around.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在桌旁，分享着一个大披萨。

arrange.example: She will arrange the chairs and tables before the meeting starts.
arrange.exampleZh: 她会在会议开始前把桌椅摆放好。

arrangement.example: The arrangement of the chairs in the room looks very nice.
arrangement.exampleZh: 房间里椅子的布置看起来很不错。

array.example: The store has a wide array of fresh fruit for sale.
array.exampleZh: 这家店有一系列新鲜水果出售。

arrest.example: The police arrested the thief and his arrest surprised the whole town.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察逮捕了那个小偷，他的被捕让整个镇子都很惊讶。

arrival.example: Our arrival at the airport was delayed by two hours.
arrival.exampleZh: 我们到达机场的时间晚了两个小时。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the airport before the plane leaves.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们会在飞机起飞前到达机场。

arrow.example: He shot an arrow at the target and hit it.
arrow.exampleZh: 他朝靶子射了一箭，射中了。

art.example: She wants to study art in a big city.
art.exampleZh: 她想在一座大城市里学习艺术。

artery.example: The doctor said the blood was flowing through a main artery in his leg.
artery.exampleZh: 医生说血液正流经他腿上的一条主要动脉。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the newspaper today.
article.exampleZh: 我今天在报纸上读了一篇关于健康食品的有趣文章。

artificial.example: This drink has no artificial colors or sugar in it.
artificial.exampleZh: 这种饮料里没有人工色素和糖。

artist.example: The artist draws a picture of the sea every morning.
artist.exampleZh: 这位艺术家每天早上都画一幅大海的画。

artistic.example: She has a very artistic mind and loves to paint.
artistic.exampleZh: 她有很强的艺术头脑，喜欢画画。

as.example: She works as a teacher, and she sings as she walks home.
as.exampleZh: 她当老师，一边走回家一边唱歌。

ascend.example: We watched the smoke ascend slowly into the clear blue sky.
ascend.exampleZh: 我们看着烟雾缓缓升入晴朗的蓝天。

ash.example: The fire burned down and left only cold ash in the stove.
ash.exampleZh: 火熄灭后，炉子里只剩下冰冷的灰烬。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed after she lied to her best friend.
ashamed.exampleZh: 她对最好的朋友撒谎后感到羞愧。

ashore.example: After a long trip at sea, the sailors were glad to be ashore.
ashore.exampleZh: 经过漫长的海上航行，水手们很高兴能上岸。

aside.example: She stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 她往旁边让了一步，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: You can ask your teacher for help after class.
ask.exampleZh: 你可以在课后向老师求助。

aspect.example: One important aspect of learning English is practicing a little every day.
aspect.exampleZh: 学习英语的一个重要方面是每天练习一点。

aspiration.example: Her aspiration is to become a doctor and help people in small towns.
aspiration.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助小城镇的人们。

aspire.example: Many young people aspire to work in big cities.
aspire.exampleZh: 许多年轻人渴望在大城市工作。

aspirin.example: The doctor told me to take aspirin for my headache.
aspirin.exampleZh: 医生让我吃阿司匹林来缓解头痛。

assault.example: The soldiers were hurt in a sudden assault on the camp last night.
assault.exampleZh: 士兵们在昨晚营地遭到的一次突然袭击中受伤。

assemble.example: The workers assemble the new machines in the large factory every morning.
assemble.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上在大型工厂里装配新机器。

assembly.example: The workers finished the assembly of the new machine before noon.
assembly.exampleZh: 工人们在中午前完成了新机器的装配。

assert.example: She asserted that the plan would work, but few people agreed.
assert.exampleZh: 她断言这个计划会奏效，但很少有人同意。

assertive.example: She is assertive in meetings and always says what she thinks.
assertive.exampleZh: 她在会议上很坚定自信，总是说出自己的想法。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' progress through tests and daily class work.
assess.exampleZh: 老师通过考试和日常课堂作业来评估学生的进步。

assessment.example: The teacher gave us a short assessment of our reading skills.
assessment.exampleZh: 老师对我们的阅读能力做了一次简短的评估。

asset.example: Her patience is a great asset in this job.
asset.exampleZh: 她的耐心在这份工作中是一大优点。

assign.example: The teacher will assign each student a simple task today.
assign.exampleZh: 老师今天会给每个学生分配一项简单的任务。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a math assignment to finish before Friday.
assignment.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一份要在周五前完成的数学作业。

assist.example: She asked her friend to assist with the heavy boxes.
assist.exampleZh: 她请朋友帮忙搬那些沉重的箱子。

assistance.example: She asked her teacher for assistance with the difficult homework.
assistance.exampleZh: 她向老师求助完成那道难题的作业。

assistant.example: She asked her new assistant to answer all the emails today.
assistant.exampleZh: 她让她的新助手今天回复所有的电子邮件。

associate.example: I always associate this song with my happy school days, and my colleagues do too.
associate.exampleZh: 我总是把这首歌和快乐的校园时光联系在一起，我的同事也是如此。

association.example: He is a member of our local sports association.
association.exampleZh: 他是我们当地体育协会的一名成员。

assume.example: I assume you will come to the meeting tomorrow morning.
assume.exampleZh: 我假定你明天上午会来参加会议。

assumption.example: We made a wrong assumption about the test date.
assumption.exampleZh: 我们对考试日期做了一个错误的假设。

assurance.example: She gave me her assurance that the work would be finished today.
assurance.exampleZh: 她向我保证这项工作今天会完成。

assure.example: I assure you that this plan will help us save time.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证，这个计划会帮助我们节省时间。

asthma.example: My brother has asthma, so he cannot run very fast.
asthma.exampleZh: 我弟弟患有哮喘，所以他跑不快。

astronaut.example: The astronaut looked at the Earth from the window of the space station.
astronaut.exampleZh: 宇航员从空间站的窗户看着地球。

astronomy.example: My sister studies astronomy at the university and loves looking at the stars.
astronomy.exampleZh: 我姐姐在大学学习天文学，她喜欢观察星星。

at.example: She is waiting for you at the bus stop.

athlete.example: The young athlete trains hard every day because she wants to win a gold medal.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员每天刻苦训练，因为她想赢得一枚金牌。

athletic.example: My brother is very athletic and plays three sports at school.
athletic.exampleZh: 我哥哥非常健壮，在学校参加三项运动。

athletics.example: She loves athletics and runs every morning before school.
athletics.exampleZh: 她热爱田径运动，每天早上上学前都去跑步。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere at night.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅晚上有一种温暖友好的气氛。

atom.example: An atom is the smallest part of a substance that still keeps its properties.
atom.exampleZh: 原子是物质中仍能保持其性质的最小部分。

atomic.example: Scientists study the atomic structure of matter in the laboratory.
atomic.exampleZh: 科学家在实验室里研究物质的原子结构。

attach.example: Please attach the photo to your email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 请在发送邮件前把照片附上。

attachment.example: I sent the email with a large attachment and she opened it right away.
attachment.exampleZh: 我发了一封带大附件的邮件，她马上就打开了。

attack.example: The dog may attack strangers, so keep the gate closed.
attack.exampleZh: 这只狗可能会攻击陌生人，所以请把大门关好。

attain.example: She worked hard for many years and finally attained her goal.
attain.exampleZh: 她努力了很多年，终于达到了自己的目标。

attainment.example: The attainment of her dream took many years of hard work.
attainment.exampleZh: 实现她的梦想花费了多年的努力。

attempt.example: Their first attempt to fix the old car failed, so they tried again.
attempt.exampleZh: 他们第一次修理那辆旧车的尝试失败了，所以他们又试了一次。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow and take care of the notes.
attend.exampleZh: 我明天将出席会议并负责记录。

attendance.example: Her attendance at every meeting shows how much she cares about the project.
attendance.exampleZh: 她每次都出席会议，这表明她非常在意这个项目。

attention.example: Please pay attention to the teacher during class.
attention.exampleZh: 上课时请注意听老师讲。

attitude.example: His positive attitude helps him make friends at his new school.
attitude.exampleZh: 他积极的态度帮助他在新学校交到朋友。

attorney.example: The attorney asked my brother a few simple questions about the accident.
attorney.exampleZh: 律师就那起事故问了我哥哥几个简单的问题。

attract.example: The new museum attracts many visitors every year.
attract.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆每年吸引许多游客。

attraction.example: The old castle is a famous attraction for visitors to this small town.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡是游客来到这个小镇必看的著名景点。

attractive.example: The small garden is very attractive in spring.
attractive.exampleZh: 这个小花园在春天非常迷人。

attribute.example: We attribute his success to hard work, not luck.
attribute.exampleZh: 我们把他的成功归因于努力，而不是运气。

auction.example: They sold the old painting at an auction last Sunday.
auction.exampleZh: 他们上周日在一场拍卖会上卖掉了那幅旧画。

audience.example: The audience clapped loudly after the singer finished her last song.
audience.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众热烈鼓掌。

audio.example: The audio quality of this small speaker is very good.
audio.exampleZh: 这个小音箱的音质非常好。

audit.example: The company will audit its accounts before the end of this year.
audit.exampleZh: 公司将在今年年底前审计其账目。

august.example: We plan to visit our grandparents in August this year.
august.exampleZh: 我们计划今年八月去看望祖父母。

aunt.example: My aunt makes very good cakes for us every Sunday.
aunt.exampleZh: 我姑母每个星期天都给我们做好吃的蛋糕。

authentic.example: This bag is authentic and costs much more than the cheap copy.
authentic.exampleZh: 这个包是正品，比那个便宜的仿制品贵得多。

author.example: The author wrote a short book about life in a small town.
author.exampleZh: 这位作者写了一本关于小镇生活的短书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地当局负责保持街道的清洁与安全。

auto.example: I parked my auto in front of the small shop.
auto.exampleZh: 我把我的汽车停在那家小店前面。

automatic.example: The door is automatic, so it opens when you walk near it.
automatic.exampleZh: 这扇门是自动的，所以当你走近时它就会打开。

automobile.example: He drives an old automobile to work every day.
automobile.exampleZh: 他每天开一辆旧汽车去上班。

autonomous.example: The small island became an autonomous region after many years of talks.
autonomous.exampleZh: 经过多年谈判，这个小岛成为了一个自治区。

autonomy.example: The small island has full autonomy over its own laws and taxes.
autonomy.exampleZh: 这个小岛在自己的法律和税收方面拥有完全的自治权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and yellow in autumn.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶会变成红色和黄色。

auxiliary.example: This auxiliary tool helps us finish the work much faster.
auxiliary.exampleZh: 这个辅助工具帮助我们更快地完成工作。

avail.example: His help did not avail him much in the end.
avail.exampleZh: 他的帮助最终对他没起多大作用。

available.example: The book is available in every school library.
available.exampleZh: 这本书在每所学校的图书馆里都能借到。

avenue.example: The new road is a wide avenue with many trees on both sides.
avenue.exampleZh: 这条新路是一条两旁种满树木的宽阔大道。

average.example: The average temperature here is about twenty degrees in spring.
average.exampleZh: 这里春天的平均气温大约是二十度。

aviation.example: The aviation industry has grown quickly in my country over the past ten years.
aviation.exampleZh: 过去十年里，我国的航空业发展迅速。

avoid.example: We left home early to avoid the heavy traffic.
avoid.exampleZh: 我们早早出门以避开拥堵的交通。

await.example: We await your reply before we make the final decision.
await.exampleZh: 我们等待你的回复后再做最终决定。

awake.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
awake.exampleZh: 街上吵闹的声音让我一整夜都醒着。

award.example: The school gave her an award for her hard work.
award.exampleZh: 学校因为她的努力而给她颁了一个奖。

aware.example: She was not aware of the danger on the dark road.
aware.exampleZh: 她没有意识到那条黑暗道路上的危险。

away.example: She walked away from the noisy crowd and found a quiet place.
away.exampleZh: 她离开喧闹的人群，找到了一个安静的地方。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home all day.
awful.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

awkward.example: I felt awkward when I forgot his name in front of everyone.
awkward.exampleZh: 当我在大家面前忘了他的名字时，我感到很尴尬。

axis.example: The earth turns around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
axis.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小时绕其轴线自转一周。

baby.example: The baby is sleeping in a warm bed next to her mother.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿正睡在母亲旁边的温暖的床上。

bachelor.example: My uncle is still a bachelor and lives alone in a small house.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我叔叔还是单身汉，独自住在一所小房子里。

back.example: My back hurts after I sit in the same chair all day.
back.exampleZh: 我在同一把椅子上坐了一整天，背部很疼。

background.example: His background in science helped him get the job.
background.exampleZh: 他的科学背景帮助他得到了这份工作。

backward.example: The small village is still backward in its roads and schools.
backward.exampleZh: 这个小村庄在道路和学校方面仍然很落后。

bacon.example: We had bacon and eggs for breakfast this morning.
bacon.exampleZh: 今天早上我们吃了培根和鸡蛋。

bacteria.example: Some bacteria in the water can make people sick.
bacteria.exampleZh: 水里的一些细菌会让人生病。

bacterium.example: A bacterium is a very small living thing that can make people sick.
bacterium.exampleZh: 细菌是一种非常微小的生物，能让人生病。

bad.example: The weather was bad, so we stayed at home with my little sister.
bad.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们和小妹妹待在家里。

badge.example: Every student wears a small badge on the left side of the school uniform.
badge.exampleZh: 每个学生都在校服左侧佩戴一枚小徽章。

badly.example: He badly wanted to see the film, but he lost his ticket.
badly.exampleZh: 他非常想看那部电影，但他把票弄丢了。

badminton.example: My sister and I play badminton in the park every Saturday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每周六早上在公园打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put her keys and phone in her bag.
bag.exampleZh: 她把钥匙和手机放进了她的包里。

baggage.example: I have too much baggage to carry on the train.
baggage.exampleZh: 我的行李太多了，没法带上火车。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake cookies for us on Sundays.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日为我们烘烤饼干。

bakery.example: I buy fresh bread at the bakery near my house every morning.
bakery.exampleZh: 我每天早上都在家附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

balance.example: She lost her balance and fell, but quickly stood up again.
balance.exampleZh: 她失去平衡摔倒了，但很快又站了起来。

balcony.example: She drinks coffee on the balcony every morning before work.
balcony.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都在阳台上喝咖啡。

ball.example: The children played with a red ball in the park after school.
ball.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在公园里玩一个红色的球。

ballet.example: My sister takes ballet classes every Saturday morning at the dance school.
ballet.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六上午在舞蹈学校上芭蕾舞课。

balloon.example: The little boy let the red balloon go and it flew high.
balloon.exampleZh: 小男孩松开了那个红气球，它高高地飞走了。

ballot.example: Every student put a ballot in the box to choose the new class leader.
ballot.exampleZh: 每个学生都往箱子里投了一张选票，来选出新的班长。

bamboo.example: The panda eats bamboo in the forest every day.
bamboo.exampleZh: 那只熊猫每天在森林里吃竹子。

ban.example: The school has a ban on phones during class.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。

band.example: The band played music at my school party last night.
band.exampleZh: 昨晚这支乐队在我学校的派对上演奏了音乐。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on his arm.
bandage.exampleZh: 护士在他手臂上包了一块干净的绷带。

bang.example: The door closed with a loud bang that shook the whole house.
bang.exampleZh: 门砰的一声关上，震动了整栋房子。

bank.example: I put my money in the bank near the river bank.
bank.exampleZh: 我把我的钱存进了河边的那家银行。

banker.example: My uncle is a banker and he works in a big city bank.
banker.exampleZh: 我叔叔是银行家，他在一家大城市的银行工作。

bankrupt.example: The small shop went bankrupt after a year of poor sales.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家小店在一年销售不佳后破产了。

banner.example: They hung a large banner across the street for the school festival.
banner.exampleZh: 他们为学校庆典在街道上挂起了一面大横幅。

bar.example: The new rule bars people from bringing drinks into the bar.
bar.exampleZh: 新规定禁止人们把饮料带进酒吧。

barber.example: The barber cut my hair short before the summer holiday began.
barber.exampleZh: 理发师在暑假开始前把我的头发剪短了。

bare.example: The child ran across the bare floor in his socks.
bare.exampleZh: 那个孩子只穿着袜子在光秃秃的地板上跑来跑去。

barely.example: She was so tired that she could barely keep her eyes open.
barely.exampleZh: 她太累了，几乎睁不开眼睛。

bargain.example: She loves to bargain at the market and often finds a good bargain.
bargain.exampleZh: 她喜欢在市场讨价还价，常常能淘到便宜货。

bark.example: The dog likes to bark at the tall tree's rough bark.
bark.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢对着那棵高树粗糙的树皮吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer keeps his cows and horses in the old red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫把他的奶牛和马养在那座旧的红色谷仓里。

barrel.example: He filled the barrel with rain water from the old roof.
barrel.exampleZh: 他把屋顶流下的雨水装满了那个桶。

barrier.example: The heavy rain was a barrier to our travel plans.
barrier.exampleZh: 大雨成了我们旅行计划的一个障碍。

base.example: This small town is a good base for our trip.
base.exampleZh: 这个小镇是我们旅行的良好基地。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
baseball.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六下午都和朋友们打棒球。

basement.example: We keep our old books and winter clothes in the basement.
basement.exampleZh: 我们把旧书和冬天的衣服放在地下室里。

basic.example: Learning basic math is important for children in every country.
basic.exampleZh: 学习基础数学对每个国家的孩子都很重要。

basin.example: She washed her hands in a small basin of warm water.
basin.exampleZh: 她在一个盛着温水的小盆里洗手。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of a good friendship.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a small basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的苹果放进桌上的一个小篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends after school every day.
basketball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天放学后和朋友们一起打篮球。

bat.example: A bat flew out of the dark cave and into the night sky.
bat.exampleZh: 一只蝙蝠从黑暗的洞穴里飞出来，飞进了夜空。

batch.example: The teacher gave us a new batch of books to read.
batch.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一批新书去读。

bath.example: I take a warm bath every night before I go to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: I like to bathe in the warm river near my house.
bathe.exampleZh: 我喜欢在我家附近温暖的河里洗澡。

bathroom.example: My new apartment has a small bathroom next to the kitchen.
bathroom.exampleZh: 我的新公寓里有一间小浴室，就在厨房旁边。

battery.example: My phone battery dies quickly, so I carry a charger in my bag.
battery.exampleZh: 我的手机电池掉电很快，所以我包里带着充电器。

battle.example: The soldiers won an important battle near the river last year.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们去年在河边赢得了一场重要的战斗。

bay.example: We sat on the beach and looked at the beautiful bay.
bay.exampleZh: 我们坐在海滩上，望着美丽的海湾。

be.example: She wants to be a doctor when she grows up.
be.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and looked for shells in the sand.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，在沙子里寻找贝壳。

beam.example: A bright beam of light came through the small window and lit the wooden beam.
beam.exampleZh: 一道明亮的光束从小窗户射进来，照亮了那根木梁。

bean.example: My mother cooks red bean soup for the family every winter.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈每年冬天都会给家人煮红豆汤。

bear.example: I cannot bear the noise from the busy street outside my window.
bear.exampleZh: 我无法忍受窗外繁忙街道上传来的噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and smiles at everyone.
beard.exampleZh: 我爷爷留着长长的白胡须，对每个人都微笑。

beast.example: The lion is a strong beast that lives in the wild.
beast.exampleZh: 狮子是一种生活在野外的强壮野兽。

beat.example: Our team can beat the best players in the city this year.
beat.exampleZh: 今年我们队能打败城里最好的选手。

beautiful.example: The garden looks beautiful in spring when all the flowers bloom.
beautiful.exampleZh: 春天百花盛开时，这个花园看起来很美。

beauty.example: Her kindness and beauty make everyone in the class like her.
beauty.exampleZh: 她的善良和美丽让班上每个人都喜欢她。

because.example: I stayed home because it was raining all day.
because.exampleZh: 我待在家里，因为下了一整天的雨。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor when she grows up.
become.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

bed.example: My little brother is still in bed because he is very tired today.
bed.exampleZh: 我弟弟还在床上，因为他今天很累。

bedroom.example: My bedroom is small, but it has a big window and a soft bed.
bedroom.exampleZh: 我的卧室很小，但有一扇大窗户和一张柔软的床。

bee.example: A bee is flying from flower to flower in the garden.
bee.exampleZh: 一只蜜蜂在花园里从一朵花飞到另一朵花。

beef.example: My mother makes beef soup for us every Sunday.
beef.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都给我们做牛肉汤。

beer.example: We drank cold beer and talked for hours at the small bar.
beer.exampleZh: 我们在小酒吧里喝着冰啤酒聊了好几个小时。

before.example: Wash your hands before you eat dinner with the family.
before.exampleZh: 和家人吃晚饭之前，先洗洗手。

beforehand.example: Please tell me beforehand if you cannot come to the meeting.
beforehand.exampleZh: 如果你不能来开会，请预先告诉我。

beg.example: She had to beg the manager for one more chance.
beg.exampleZh: 她不得不恳求经理再给她一次机会。

begin.example: We begin our English class at nine every morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们每天早上九点开始上英语课。

beginning.example: The beginning of the movie was slow, but it got better later.
beginning.exampleZh: 电影的开头很慢，但后来变得好看了。

behalf.example: I am speaking on behalf of my whole family today.
behalf.exampleZh: 今天我代表我们全家发言。

behave.example: The children behave very well when their teacher is in the room.
behave.exampleZh: 老师在教室里的时候，孩子们表现得很好。

behaviour.example: His behaviour in class was very good today.
behaviour.exampleZh: 他今天在课堂上的行为非常好。

behind.example: The small boy hid behind the big tree in the garden.
behind.exampleZh: 那个小男孩躲在花园里的大树后面。

being.example: Every living being needs clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
being.exampleZh: 每一个生物都需要干净的水和新鲜的空气来保持健康。

belief.example: Her belief in hard work helped her reach her goal.
belief.exampleZh: 她对努力工作的信念帮助她实现了目标。

believe.example: I believe he is a good man.

bell.example: The school bell rings at eight every morning.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃声每天早上八点响起。

belong.example: These old books belong to my grandmother, not to me.
belong.exampleZh: 这些旧书属于我祖母，不是我的。

belongings.example: She put all her belongings in a small bag and left.
belongings.exampleZh: 她把她所有的东西装进一个小包里，然后离开了。

below.example: The cat is sleeping below the table in the kitchen.
below.exampleZh: 那只猫正在厨房的桌子下面睡觉。

belt.example: He wore a brown leather belt with his dark blue jeans.
belt.exampleZh: 他穿着深蓝色牛仔裤，系着一条棕色皮带。

bench.example: I sat on a wooden bench and read my book in the sun.
bench.exampleZh: 我坐在一条木制长凳上，在阳光下看书。

bend.example: Be careful on the sharp bend after the bridge.
bend.exampleZh: 过桥后的那个急转弯处要小心。

beneath.example: The old key was hidden beneath a pile of books on the desk.
beneath.exampleZh: 那把旧钥匙藏在桌上的一堆书下面。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can bring many benefits to your health and your mood.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的健康和情绪都有很多益处。

bent.example: The old metal fence was bent after the strong wind last night.
bent.exampleZh: 昨晚大风过后，那道旧金属栅栏变弯了。

beside.example: She sat quietly beside the window and read a book all afternoon.
beside.exampleZh: 她安静地坐在窗边，整个下午都在看书。

besides.example: Besides English, she also teaches French and Spanish at our school.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还在我们学校教法语和西班牙语。

best.example: This is the best cake I have ever eaten in my life.
best.exampleZh: 这是我一生中吃过的最好的蛋糕。

bet.example: I bet ten dollars that our team will win the game today.
bet.exampleZh: 我打赌十美元我们队会赢下今天的比赛。

betray.example: I will never betray my best friend's trust.
betray.exampleZh: 我永远不会背叛我最好朋友的信任。

betrayal.example: She felt a deep betrayal when her best friend lied to her.
betrayal.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友对她撒谎时，她感到了深深的背叛。

better.example: Practice makes your English better, so try to read and speak every day.
better.exampleZh: 练习让你的英语更好，所以试着每天阅读和开口说。

between.example: The bank is between the school and the small park.
between.exampleZh: 银行在学校和小公园之间。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond those green hills and the wide river.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于那些青山和宽阔河流的另一边。

bias.example: The new rule may show a bias against small businesses.
bias.exampleZh: 这项新规定可能对小企业表现出偏见。

bible.example: The old book on the shelf is a family bible.
bible.exampleZh: 书架上那本旧书是一本家庭圣经。

bicycle.example: My father bought me a new bicycle for my birthday last week.
bicycle.exampleZh: 上周我生日时，爸爸给我买了一辆新自行车。

bid.example: Our company made a low bid for the new bridge project last week.
bid.exampleZh: 我们公司上周为这个新桥梁项目报了一个较低的投标价。

big.example: This is a big city with many parks and busy streets.
big.exampleZh: 这是一个有很多公园和繁忙街道的大城市。

bill.example: The waiter brought the bill after we finished our dinner.
bill.exampleZh: 我们吃完晚餐后，服务员拿来了账单。

billion.example: The company is worth more than one billion dollars today.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司如今价值超过十亿美元。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottles in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进门口附近的垃圾箱里。

binary.example: A computer stores all data in a binary system of zeros and ones.
binary.exampleZh: 计算机用由零和一组成的二进制系统存储所有数据。

bind.example: We bind the old books together with a strong rope.
bind.exampleZh: 我们用一根结实的绳子把这些旧书捆在一起。

biological.example: The biological differences between the two plants are easy to see.
biological.exampleZh: 这两种植物之间的生物差异很容易看出来。

biology.example: She studies biology at school and wants to learn about plants and animals.
biology.exampleZh: 她在学校学习生物学，想了解植物和动物。

bird.example: A small bird is singing in the tree outside my window.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我窗外的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last spring.
birth.exampleZh: 去年春天她生下了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My birthday is in May, and my family always eats cake together.
birthday.exampleZh: 我的生日在五月，家人总会一起吃蛋糕。

birthplace.example: This small town is the birthplace of my mother.
birthplace.exampleZh: 这个小镇是我母亲的出生地。

biscuit.example: My little sister likes to eat a biscuit with milk after school.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢放学后配着牛奶吃一块饼干。

bishop.example: The bishop spoke kindly to the people in the small town.
bishop.exampleZh: 主教和蔼地对小镇上的人们讲话。

bit.example: I am a bit tired after the long walk home.
bit.exampleZh: 走很长的路回家后，我有点累了。

bite.example: The dog tried to bite my shoe, but I pulled it away.
bite.exampleZh: 那只狗试图咬我的鞋，但我把它拉开了。

bitter.example: The medicine was so bitter that the child refused to drink it.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药太苦了，孩子不肯喝。

bitterly.example: She cried bitterly when she heard the bad news.
bitterly.exampleZh: 听到这个坏消息时，她痛苦地哭了。

bizarre.example: The old man had a bizarre hat that made everyone laugh.
bizarre.exampleZh: 那位老人戴着一顶古怪的帽子，让大家都笑了。

black.example: She wore a black coat and carried a small black bag.
black.exampleZh: 她穿着一件黑色大衣，拎着一个小黑包。

blacksmith.example: The blacksmith made a new iron knife for the farmer.
blacksmith.exampleZh: 铁匠为农夫打了一把新铁刀。

blade.example: Be careful with that sharp blade, because it can cut your finger easily.
blade.exampleZh: 小心那片锋利的刀刃，因为它很容易割伤你的手指。

blame.example: Don't blame me for the mistake, because I was not there.
blame.exampleZh: 不要因为那个错误责备我，因为我当时不在那里。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She put a warm blanket over the baby before the long drive home.
blanket.exampleZh: 在长途开车回家之前，她给婴儿盖上了一条暖和的毛毯。

blast.example: A sudden blast of wind blew the door shut.
blast.exampleZh: 一阵突如其来的狂风把门吹得关上了。

blaze.example: The blaze spread quickly through the old wooden house last night.
blaze.exampleZh: 昨夜大火迅速蔓延到那座老木屋。

bleed.example: His hand started to bleed after he fell off the bike.
bleed.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来后，手开始流血。

blend.example: Blend the eggs and milk together, then add some sugar.
blend.exampleZh: 把鸡蛋和牛奶混合在一起，然后加一些糖。

bless.example: May God bless you and your family with good health.
bless.exampleZh: 愿上帝保佑你和你的家人身体健康。

blessing.example: Having good friends is a great blessing in my life.
blessing.exampleZh: 拥有好朋友是我人生中的一大幸事。

blind.example: The blind man walks to the shop every morning with his dog.
blind.exampleZh: 那位盲人每天早上带着他的狗走到商店。

blindness.example: His blindness did not stop him from learning to play the piano.
blindness.exampleZh: 失明并没有阻止他学习弹钢琴。

block.example: I walk two blocks to the bus stop every morning.
block.exampleZh: 我每天早上要走两个街区到公交站。

blockage.example: A blockage in the pipe stopped the water from flowing into the kitchen.
blockage.exampleZh: 管道里的堵塞使水无法流入厨房。

blood.example: The doctor said he lost a lot of blood in the accident.
blood.exampleZh: 医生说他在这场事故中失了很多血。

bloodshed.example: The war caused much bloodshed and many families lost their homes.
bloodshed.exampleZh: 这场战争造成了大量流血杀戮，许多家庭失去了家园。

bloody.example: The soldier had a bloody hand after the fight.
bloody.exampleZh: 战斗结束后，那名士兵的手流着血。

bloom.example: The red flowers in our garden bloom every spring.
bloom.exampleZh: 我们花园里的红花每年春天都会开放。

blossom.example: In spring the apple trees blossom and the whole garden looks beautiful.
blossom.exampleZh: 春天苹果树开花，整个花园看起来很美。

blow.example: The wind began to blow hard, and the news was a heavy blow to us.
blow.exampleZh: 风开始猛烈地吹，这个消息对我们是一个沉重的打击。

blue.example: She wore a blue dress and looked a little sad today.
blue.exampleZh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙，今天看起来有点忧郁。

board.example: The board will meet on Monday to discuss the new plan.
board.exampleZh: 董事会将于周一开会讨论这个新计划。

boast.example: He likes to boast about his new car to all his friends.
boast.exampleZh: 他喜欢向所有朋友吹嘘他的新车。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the river to visit our friends.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘小船渡过河去拜访朋友。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体强壮又健康。

boil.example: Please boil some water for the tea before our guests arrive.
boil.exampleZh: 客人到之前，请烧些水泡茶。

bold.example: Her bold red dress made her stand out at the party.
bold.exampleZh: 她那件醒目的红色连衣裙让她在聚会上格外显眼。

bolt.example: He tightened the last bolt on the heavy metal door.
bolt.exampleZh: 他拧紧了那扇厚重金属门上的最后一颗螺栓。

bomb.example: The police found an old bomb in the field near the school.
bomb.exampleZh: 警察在学校附近的田地里发现了一枚旧炸弹。

bomber.example: The old bomber flew slowly over the quiet town at dawn.
bomber.exampleZh: 那架旧轰炸机在黎明时分缓缓飞过安静的小镇。

bond.example: The bond between the two sisters grew stronger over the years.
bond.exampleZh: 多年来，两姐妹之间的纽带越来越牢固。

bone.example: The dog is chewing a big bone in the yard.
bone.exampleZh: 那只狗正在院子里啃一块大骨头。

book.example: I want to book a hotel room, and I also need a book about travel.
book.exampleZh: 我想预订一间酒店房间，而且我还需要一本关于旅行的书。

boom.example: The city's boom brought many new jobs and taller buildings.
boom.exampleZh: 这座城市的繁荣带来了许多新工作和更高的建筑。

booming.example: The booming city has many new shops and jobs for young people.
booming.exampleZh: 这座繁荣的城市有许多新商店，也为年轻人提供了工作机会。

boost.example: The new policy will boost sales and help small shops grow.
boost.exampleZh: 这项新政策将促进销售，帮助小商店发展。

boot.example: The old boots were dirty, so I put them in the boot of my car.
boot.exampleZh: 那双旧靴子很脏，所以我把它们放进了汽车的后备箱里。

border.example: The river forms a natural border between the two countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两国之间的天然边界。

bore.example: His long talk began to bore the students, so they stopped listening.
bore.exampleZh: 他那冗长的讲话开始让学生们厌烦，于是他们不再听了。

boring.example: This movie is so boring that I almost fell asleep in the cinema.
boring.exampleZh: 这部电影太无聊了，我在电影院里差点睡着。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your book for a few days?
borrow.exampleZh: 我能借你的书用几天吗？

borrowing.example: The company's heavy borrowing made it hard to pay the bills.
borrowing.exampleZh: 这家公司的大量借款使其难以支付账单。

boss.example: My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday.
boss.exampleZh: 我的老板让我在周五前完成这份报告。

both.example: Both of my parents like to walk in the park after dinner.
both.exampleZh: 我父母两人都喜欢晚饭后在公园散步。

bother.example: Sorry to bother you, but I need a little help now.
bother.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰你，但我现在需要一点帮助。

bottle.example: Please put the cold water in the bottle before we leave.
bottle.exampleZh: 我们离开之前，请把冷水装进瓶子里。

bottom.example: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.

bounce.example: The red ball can bounce very high on the floor.
bounce.exampleZh: 那个红球在地板上能弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for Beijing and will leave in ten minutes.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往北京，十分钟后出发。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two countries.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河构成了两国之间的天然边界。

bow.example: He raised his bow and shot the arrow at the target.
bow.exampleZh: 他举起弓，把箭射向靶子。

bowl.example: She put the hot soup in a large bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一只大碗里。

box.example: The box on the table is full of old books.
box.exampleZh: 桌上的盒子里装满了旧书。

boy.example: The little boy likes to play football with his friends after school.
boy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company because of its unfair rules.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人因为这家公司不公平的规定而决定抵制它。

brain.example: Learning a new language is good exercise for your brain.
brain.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对你的大脑是很好的锻炼。

brake.example: He hit the brake hard when a dog ran into the road.
brake.exampleZh: 一只狗跑上马路时，他猛踩刹车。

branch.example: The bird sat on a thin branch and sang a happy song.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在细细的树枝上，唱着欢快的歌。

brand.example: This brand of coffee is very popular with young people.
brand.exampleZh: 这个品牌的咖啡在年轻人中很受欢迎。

brass.example: The old door handle is made of brass and shines in the sun.
brass.exampleZh: 那个旧门把手是黄铜做的，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

brave.example: The brave little boy helped the lost dog find its way home.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的小男孩帮助那只迷路的狗找到了回家的路。

bread.example: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast every morning.
bread.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃面包和鸡蛋当早餐。

break.example: Let's take a short break before we break the news to them.
break.exampleZh: 在我们把这个消息告诉他们之前，先稍作休息吧。

breakdown.example: The breakdown of the old machine stopped the whole production line.
breakdown.exampleZh: 这台旧机器的故障使整条生产线停了下来。

breakfast.example: I always eat eggs and toast for breakfast before school.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我上学前总是吃鸡蛋和吐司当早餐。

breast.example: The doctor listened to her breast and said she was healthy.
breast.exampleZh: 医生听了听她的胸部，说她很健康。

breath.example: Take a deep breath before you start to speak.
breath.exampleZh: 在你开始讲话之前，先深吸一口气。

breathe.example: Please breathe slowly and deeply through your nose.
breathe.exampleZh: 请用鼻子慢慢地深呼吸。

breathless.example: After running up the stairs, she felt breathless and had to sit down.
breathless.exampleZh: 跑上楼梯后，她感到喘不过气，不得不坐下来。

breathtaking.example: The view from the top of the mountain was truly breathtaking.
breathtaking.exampleZh: 山顶的景色真是令人叹为观止。

breed.example: Farmers breed cows for milk, and this breed is very strong.
breed.exampleZh: 农民饲养奶牛以获取牛奶，这个品种非常强壮。

breeding.example: The breeding of these birds takes place in the warm spring months.
breeding.exampleZh: 这些鸟的繁殖发生在温暖的春季月份。

breeze.example: A gentle breeze came through the window and cooled the room.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵微风吹过窗户，让房间凉快了下来。

brick.example: The workers used brick and stone to build the new school.
brick.exampleZh: 工人们用砖和石头建造了这所新学校。

bridge.example: The old bridge crosses the river near our school.
bridge.exampleZh: 那座旧桥在我们学校附近横跨河流。

brief.example: She gave a brief answer and left the room.
brief.exampleZh: 她简短地回答了一句，然后离开了房间。

bright.example: The bright room has a big window and a small desk.
bright.exampleZh: 这个明亮的房间有一扇大窗户和一张小书桌。

brightness.example: The brightness of the room made everyone feel happy and awake.
brightness.exampleZh: 房间的明亮让每个人都感到快乐和清醒。

brilliance.example: Her brilliance as a young scientist surprised everyone in the small laboratory.
brilliance.exampleZh: 她作为年轻科学家的才华让这个小实验室里的每个人都感到惊讶。

brilliant.example: She is a brilliant teacher and all her students love her class.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她是一位杰出的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

bring.example: Please bring your book to class tomorrow morning.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把你的书带到课堂上。

broad.example: The river is broad here, so the bridge is long.
broad.exampleZh: 这里的河很宽，所以桥很长。

broadband.example: We use fast broadband at home to watch movies and study online.
broadband.exampleZh: 我们在家里用高速宽带看电影和上网学习。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football match live tonight at eight.
broadcast.exampleZh: 广播电台今晚八点将现场直播这场足球赛。

broadcaster.example: The broadcaster said the news would start at seven tonight.
broadcaster.exampleZh: 广播公司说新闻将在今晚七点开始。

brochure.example: The travel agency gave us a colorful brochure about summer trips to the beach.
brochure.exampleZh: 旅行社给了我们一本关于夏季海滩之旅的彩色小册子。

broker.example: My broker helped me buy my first house last year.
broker.exampleZh: 我的经纪人去年帮我买了第一套房子。

bronze.example: She won a bronze medal in the swimming race last year.
bronze.exampleZh: 她在去年的游泳比赛中获得了一枚铜牌。

broom.example: She used an old broom to sweep the kitchen floor.
broom.exampleZh: 她用一把旧扫帚清扫厨房地板。

brother.example: My brother is taller than me and plays basketball very well.
brother.exampleZh: 我哥哥比我高，篮球打得很好。

brow.example: He wiped the sweat from his brow after the long run.
brow.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他擦去额头上的汗水。

brown.example: She is wearing a brown coat today.
brown.exampleZh: 她今天穿了一件棕色的外套。

brush.example: She used a small brush to clean the dirty shoes.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子把脏鞋子刷干净。

brutal.example: The brutal weather killed many animals in the mountains last winter.
brutal.exampleZh: 去年冬天，恶劣的天气让山里的许多动物死去了。

bubble.example: She laughed when the soap bubble floated up and popped.
bubble.exampleZh: 肥皂泡飘上去破了时，她笑了。

bucket.example: The farmer filled a large bucket with water for the cows.
bucket.exampleZh: 农夫用一个大水桶装满水给奶牛喝。

buddy.example: My buddy and I play basketball every Saturday morning at the park.
buddy.exampleZh: 我和我的伙伴每周六早上都在公园打篮球。

budget.example: Our family makes a monthly budget to control how much we spend.
budget.exampleZh: 我们家每月制定预算来控制花销。

buffer.example: The thick carpet acts as a buffer against the cold floor.
buffer.exampleZh: 厚厚的地毯起到了隔绝冰冷地板的作用。

bug.example: There is a bug in my computer program.
bug.exampleZh: 我的电脑程序里有一个故障。

build.example: They will build a new school near our house next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们明年将在我们家附近建造一所新学校。

building.example: The tall building next to the bank is very old.
building.exampleZh: 银行旁边的那栋高楼非常旧。

bulb.example: She turned off the light bulb and went to sleep.
bulb.exampleZh: 她关掉灯泡，然后去睡觉了。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already done.
bulk.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成了。

bull.example: The big black bull is standing quietly in the green field.
bull.exampleZh: 那头大黑公牛正静静地站在绿色的田野里。

bullet.example: The police found a bullet near the broken window.
bullet.exampleZh: 警察在破碎的窗户附近发现了一颗子弹。

bulletin.example: The school put a bulletin on the board so everyone could read the news.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校在公告栏上贴了一份公告，好让所有人都能看到这条消息。

bump.example: I bumped my head on the low door, and a small bump appeared.
bump.exampleZh: 我的头撞到了低矮的门上，出现了一个小肿块。

bunch.example: She gave me a bunch of flowers from her garden.
bunch.exampleZh: 她从她的花园里给了我一束花。

bundle.example: She put the old newspapers in a bundle and carried them downstairs.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把旧报纸捆成一捆，然后搬到了楼下。

burden.example: The extra work became a heavy burden for the whole team.
burden.exampleZh: 额外的工作成了整个团队的沉重负担。

bureaucracy.example: The new rules created more bureaucracy and slowed down our daily work.
bureaucracy.exampleZh: 新规定造成了更多官僚程序，拖慢了我们日常工作。

burn.example: Be careful with that hot pan, or you will burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个滚烫的锅，否则你会烫伤手的。

burnout.example: Too much work and no rest can lead to burnout.
burnout.exampleZh: 工作太多而不休息会导致身心俱疲。

burst.example: The balloon burst with a loud noise and scared the little boy.
burst.exampleZh: 气球砰的一声爆了，吓到了那个小男孩。

bury.example: The old dog liked to bury its bone in the soft garden soil.
bury.exampleZh: 那只老狗喜欢把骨头埋在松软的花园泥土里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上乘公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: There is a small bush with red flowers in our garden.
bush.exampleZh: 我们花园里有一丛开着红花的小灌木。

business.example: He started a small business with his brother last year.
business.exampleZh: 他去年和弟弟一起开了一家小公司。

busy.example: My mother is very busy, so I help her cook dinner.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈很忙，所以我帮她做晚饭。

but.example: I want to go out, but it is raining hard today.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是今天雨下得很大。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫把肉切成小块给我们。

butter.example: She put some butter on her bread for breakfast.
butter.exampleZh: 她早餐时在面包上涂了一些黄油。

butterfly.example: A bright butterfly landed on the yellow flower in our garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只鲜艳的蝴蝶落在了我们花园里的黄色花朵上。

button.example: He pressed the button near the door and then smiled at me.
button.exampleZh: 他按了门旁边的按钮，然后对我笑了笑。

buy.example: I want to buy a new book for my sister.
buy.exampleZh: 我想给我妹妹买一本新书。

by.example: The letter was written by my sister and sent by mail.
by.exampleZh: 这封信是我妹妹写的，并通过邮寄寄出。

bypass.example: The new road bypasses the busy town center and saves drivers much time.
bypass.exampleZh: 新修的公路绕过了繁忙的市中心，为司机节省了不少时间。

cab.example: The cab driver waited outside the station for nearly an hour.
cab.exampleZh: 出租车司机在车站外等了将近一个小时。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some pork for dinner.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚饭用卷心菜和猪肉一起做菜。

cabin.example: They stayed in a small wooden cabin near the lake for the weekend.
cabin.exampleZh: 他们周末住在湖边一间小木屋里。

cabinet.example: She put the clean cups back in the kitchen cabinet.
cabinet.exampleZh: 她把干净的杯子放回厨房的橱柜里。

cable.example: The workers used a strong cable to pull the boat to the shore.
cable.exampleZh: 工人们用一根结实的缆绳把船拉到岸边。

cache.example: The computer stores recently used data in a small cache.
cache.exampleZh: 计算机把最近用过的数据存在一个小型高速缓存里。

cactus.example: The cactus in our garden grows very slowly but needs little water.
cactus.exampleZh: 我们花园里的仙人掌长得很慢，但几乎不需要浇水。

cadet.example: The young cadet learns to march and follow orders every morning.
cadet.exampleZh: 这位年轻的军校学员每天早上学习列队行进和服从命令。

cadre.example: The company sent a few experienced cadres to lead the new project.
cadre.exampleZh: 公司派了几位有经验的骨干去领导这个新项目。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for hours.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了几个小时。

cafeteria.example: We usually eat lunch in the cafeteria at noon.
cafeteria.exampleZh: 我们通常在中午去食堂吃午饭。

cage.example: The bird sings loudly inside its small cage every morning.
cage.exampleZh: 这只鸟每天早上都在它的小笼子里大声歌唱。

cake.example: My mother made a big chocolate cake for my birthday.
cake.exampleZh: 我妈妈为我的生日做了一个大巧克力蛋糕。

calcium.example: Milk and cheese are good sources of calcium for growing children.
calcium.exampleZh: 牛奶和奶酪是成长中孩子获取钙的良好来源。

calculate.example: We need to calculate the cost before we buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 在买票之前，我们需要计算一下费用。

calculator.example: I use my calculator to add these numbers quickly.
calculator.exampleZh: 我用计算器快速把这些数字加起来。

calendar.example: I marked my birthday on the calendar so I would not forget it.
calendar.exampleZh: 我在日历上标出了我的生日，这样就不会忘记了。

calf.example: The farmer feeds the calf milk every morning before the sun rises.
calf.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上在太阳升起前给小牛喂奶。

call.example: Please call me when you get home tonight.
call.exampleZh: 今晚你到家后请给我打电话。

calm.example: She took a deep breath to stay calm before the interview.
calm.exampleZh: 面试前她深吸一口气以保持镇定。

calorie.example: This small cake has about two hundred calories in it.
calorie.exampleZh: 这个小蛋糕大约含有两百卡路里。

camel.example: The camel walked slowly across the hot sand under the bright sun.
camel.exampleZh: 骆驼在烈日下缓慢地走过滚烫的沙地。

camera.example: She bought a new camera to take photos on her trip.
camera.exampleZh: 她买了一台新相机，用来在旅行中拍照。

camp.example: The children set up a camp near the river and stayed there for two nights.
camp.exampleZh: 孩子们在河边搭起营地，在那里住了两晚。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to keep the school clean and green.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场让学校保持清洁和绿色的运动。

campus.example: Our new library is in the middle of the campus.
campus.exampleZh: 我们的新图书馆位于校园中央。

can.example: She can open the can of beans by herself.
can.exampleZh: 她能自己打开那罐豆子。

canal.example: The old canal brings water from the river to the farms.
canal.exampleZh: 那条古老的运河把河水引到农田里。

cancel.example: They had to cancel the trip because of the heavy rain.
cancel.exampleZh: 因为大雨，他们不得不取消这次旅行。

cancer.example: Smoking can cause cancer, so it is important to keep healthy habits.
cancer.exampleZh: 吸烟可能致癌，因此保持健康的习惯很重要。

candidate.example: She is a strong candidate for the job.
candidate.exampleZh: 她是这份工作的有力候选人。

candle.example: She lit a candle on the table and turned off the light.
candle.exampleZh: 她在桌上点了一支蜡烛，然后关掉了灯。

candy.example: My little sister likes candy more than ice cream.
candy.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢糖果胜过冰淇淋。

cane.example: The old man walked slowly down the street with a wooden cane.
cane.exampleZh: 老人拄着一根木手杖，沿着街道慢慢走着。

canteen.example: We eat lunch in the school canteen every day.
canteen.exampleZh: 我们每天在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: The artist painted a large blue boat on a piece of canvas.
canvas.exampleZh: 画家在一块帆布上画了一艘蓝色的大船。

cap.example: He took off his cap and put it on the table.
cap.exampleZh: 他摘下帽子，放在了桌子上。

capable.example: She is capable of doing the work very well.
capable.exampleZh: 她有能力把这项工作做得非常好。

capacity.example: This stadium has a seating capacity of fifty thousand people.
capacity.exampleZh: 这座体育场的座位容量是五万人。

capital.example: Paris is the capital of France and a very famous city.
capital.exampleZh: 巴黎是法国的首都，也是一座非常著名的城市。

captain.example: The captain told his team to stay calm and keep playing.
captain.exampleZh: 队长告诉他的队员们保持冷静并继续比赛。

capture.example: The police worked hard to capture the thief before he left the city.
capture.exampleZh: 警方努力在小偷离开城市之前抓住他。

car.example: My father drives his car to work every morning.
car.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的车去上班。

carbon.example: Carbon is a key element in all living things on Earth.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是地球上所有生物中的关键元素。

card.example: I wrote my phone number on a small card for you.
card.exampleZh: 我把电话号码写在一张小卡片上给你。

care.example: She takes good care of her little brother every day.
care.exampleZh: 她每天悉心照顾她的弟弟。

career.example: She wants a career in medicine after she finishes school.
career.exampleZh: 她毕业后想从事医学方面的职业。

careful.example: Please be careful with the hot water in that cup.
careful.exampleZh: 请小心那个杯子里的热水。

carpet.example: We put a soft carpet on the floor of the living room.
carpet.exampleZh: 我们在客厅的地板上铺了一块柔软的地毯。

carrot.example: My mother puts a carrot in the soup every time.
carrot.exampleZh: 我妈妈每次做汤都会放一根胡萝卜。

carry.example: Please carry this heavy box to the car for me.
carry.exampleZh: 请帮我把这个重箱子搬到车上。

cart.example: We put the heavy boxes in a cart and pushed it to the car.
cart.exampleZh: 我们把沉重的箱子放进手推车，然后把它推到汽车那里。

case.example: In this case, we should call the doctor right away.
case.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，我们应该马上给医生打电话。

cash.example: I paid in cash because the shop does not accept cards.
cash.exampleZh: 我付了现金，因为这家店不收银行卡。

cassette.example: My father still keeps his old cassette player in the desk drawer.
cassette.exampleZh: 我父亲仍然把他的旧磁带播放机放在书桌抽屉里。

cast.example: The director will cast three new actors in the film next week.
cast.exampleZh: 导演下周将为这部电影挑选三名新演员。

castle.example: The old castle stands on a hill near the river.
castle.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡坐落在河边的山上。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and felt relaxed all evening.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着随便的衣服去参加聚会，整晚都感到很放松。

cat.example: The little cat sleeps on the warm sofa all afternoon.
cat.exampleZh: 那只小猫整个下午都睡在温暖的沙发上。

catalog.example: The library keeps a catalog of all its books and magazines.
catalog.exampleZh: 图书馆保存着所有书籍和杂志的目录。

catch.example: She ran fast to catch the early bus and smiled at her friend.
catch.exampleZh: 她跑得很快去赶上早班公交车，并对朋友笑了笑。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category from the others on the shelf.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与书架上其他书不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps cattle on his small farm in the countryside.
cattle.exampleZh: 这位农民在乡下的小农场里养牛。

cause.example: Careless driving can cause serious accidents on the road.
cause.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶可能会在道路上引起严重事故。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street in the morning.
caution.exampleZh: 早上穿过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cautious.example: She is cautious when she walks on the wet floor.
cautious.exampleZh: 她走在地板上湿的时候很小心。

cave.example: The children found a dark cave near the river and went inside.
cave.exampleZh: 孩子们在河边发现了一个黑暗的洞穴，并走了进去。

cease.example: The rain did not cease until late in the evening.
cease.exampleZh: 雨一直到傍晚很晚才停。

ceiling.example: The ceiling in my bedroom is white and very high.
ceiling.exampleZh: 我卧室的天花板是白色的，而且很高。

celebrate.example: We celebrate my mother's birthday with a cake and a song.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们用蛋糕和一首歌来庆祝我妈妈的生日。

celebrity.example: Many young people want to be a celebrity, but fame is not easy.
celebrity.exampleZh: 许多年轻人想成为名人，但名声并不容易获得。

cell.example: Each cell in the table has a number, and the battery has many cells too.
cell.exampleZh: 表格中的每个单元格都有一个数字，电池也有许多电池单元。

cellar.example: The old man keeps his wine in a cool cellar under the house.
cellar.exampleZh: 那位老人把葡萄酒存放在房子下面一个凉爽的地窖里。

cement.example: The workers mixed cement and water to build a strong wall.
cement.exampleZh: 工人们把水泥和水混合起来，砌成一堵坚固的墙。

cent.example: This old coin is worth only one cent today.
cent.exampleZh: 这枚旧硬币今天只值一分钱。

centigrade.example: The temperature outside is about thirty degrees centigrade today.
centigrade.exampleZh: 今天外面的温度大约是三十摄氏度。

central.example: The central station is close to the main shops and hotels.
central.exampleZh: 中央车站靠近主要的商店和酒店。

centre.example: The new shopping centre is in the centre of our town.
centre.exampleZh: 新的购物中心位于我们镇的中心。

century.example: This old church was built in the nineteenth century.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk every morning before school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前都吃麦片配牛奶。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony took place in a small church near our house.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式在我们家附近的一座小教堂里举行。

certain.example: I am certain that I left my keys on the kitchen table.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定我把钥匙落在厨房桌子上了。

certificate.example: You need a birth certificate to apply for a passport.
certificate.exampleZh: 你需要出生证明才能申请护照。

chain.example: She used a strong chain to tie the dog to the tree.
chain.exampleZh: 她用一条结实的链子把狗拴在树上。

chair.example: The teacher asked me to bring a chair to the front of the room.
chair.exampleZh: 老师让我把一把椅子搬到房间前面。

chalk.example: The teacher wrote the new word on the board with a piece of chalk.
chalk.exampleZh: 老师用一支粉笔在黑板上写下了这个新单词。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge for most people.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言对大多数人来说是个巨大的挑战。

chamber.example: The old building has a small chamber where the judges meet.
chamber.exampleZh: 这栋老建筑里有一个小房间，法官们在那里开会。

champion.example: She became the champion of the school running race last year.
champion.exampleZh: 她去年成为了学校跑步比赛的冠军。

chance.example: This is a good chance for you to learn something new.
chance.exampleZh: 这是你学习新东西的好机会。

change.example: I need to change my wet clothes before we go out.
change.exampleZh: 我们出去之前，我需要换掉湿衣服。

channel.example: The teacher channeled the students' energy into a class project.
channel.exampleZh: 老师把学生的精力引导到一个班级项目上。

chaos.example: After the storm, the whole town was in chaos for days.
chaos.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，整个小镇陷入混乱好几天。

chap.example: The old chap at the corner shop always greets me with a smile.
chap.exampleZh: 街角商店的那个老伙计总是笑着跟我打招呼。

chapter.example: The first chapter of this book is about her childhood.
chapter.exampleZh: 这本书的第一章讲的是她的童年。

character.example: The main character in this story has a very kind character.
character.exampleZh: 这个故事的主角拥有非常善良的性格。

characteristic.example: Kindness is one of her best characteristics and everyone likes her.
characteristic.exampleZh: 善良是她最好的特点之一，大家都很喜欢她。

charge.example: The hotel will charge you extra for breakfast and the room's electricity.
charge.exampleZh: 酒店会就早餐和房间用电向你额外收费。

charity.example: She gave all her old clothes to a local charity last week.
charity.exampleZh: 上周她把所有旧衣服都捐给了当地的一家慈善机构。

charm.example: Her warm smile and kind words have a natural charm.
charm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑和亲切的话语有一种自然的魅力。

chart.example: The teacher drew a simple chart on the board to show our progress.
chart.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一张简单的图表来展示我们的进步。

chase.example: The little dog likes to chase birds in the park every morning.
chase.exampleZh: 这只小狗喜欢每天早上在公园里追鸟。

chat.example: I like to chat with my friends after work every day.
chat.exampleZh: 我每天下班后喜欢和朋友们闲聊。

cheap.example: I bought a cheap bag at the market yesterday, but it broke.
cheap.exampleZh: 我昨天在市场买了一个便宜的包，但它坏了。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test but the teacher saw him.
cheat.exampleZh: 他试图在考试中作弊，但老师看到了他。

check.example: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 交试卷之前请仔细检查你的答案。

cheek.example: Her cheeks turned red when the teacher praised her in class.
cheek.exampleZh: 老师在课堂上表扬她时，她的脸颊红了。

cheer.example: The students began to cheer loudly when their team scored the winning goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当他们的球队攻入制胜一球时，学生们开始大声欢呼。

cheese.example: I like to eat bread with cheese and a glass of milk.
cheese.exampleZh: 我喜欢吃面包配奶酪，再喝一杯牛奶。

chemical.example: The factory makes chemicals for farmers, and chemical waste must be cleaned carefully.
chemical.exampleZh: 这家工厂为农民生产化学品，化学废料必须小心清理。

cheque.example: I paid the rent by cheque last Friday.
cheque.exampleZh: 上周五我用支票付了房租。

cherry.example: The little girl picked a red cherry from the tree and ate it.
cherry.exampleZh: 小女孩从树上摘了一颗红樱桃吃掉了。

chess.example: My brother and I play chess every Sunday afternoon at home.
chess.exampleZh: 我和哥哥每周日下午都在家下国际象棋。

chest.example: He put his hand on his chest and took a deep breath.
chest.exampleZh: 他把手放在胸口，深吸了一口气。

chew.example: She likes to chew her food slowly before she swallows it.
chew.exampleZh: 她喜欢慢慢咀嚼食物，然后再咽下去。

chicken.example: We had chicken and rice for dinner at my grandmother's house.
chicken.exampleZh: 我们在奶奶家晚饭吃了鸡肉和米饭。

chief.example: The chief engineer explained the new plan to the whole team.
chief.exampleZh: 总工程师向整个团队解释了新计划。

child.example: Every child in the class brought a book to school today.
child.exampleZh: 班上每个孩子今天都带了一本书来学校。

childhood.example: She often talks about her happy childhood in the small village.
childhood.exampleZh: 她经常谈起自己在小村庄里快乐的童年。

chill.example: There is a chill in the air tonight, so wear a warm coat.
chill.exampleZh: 今晚空气里有股寒意，所以穿件暖和的外套吧。

chimney.example: Thick smoke came out of the chimney all morning.
chimney.exampleZh: 整个上午都有浓烟从烟囱里冒出来。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and looked out the window.
chin.exampleZh: 他把下巴搁在手上，望着窗外。

china.example: The old woman keeps her fine china in a wooden cupboard.
china.exampleZh: 那位老妇人把她精美的瓷器放在一个木柜里。

chip.example: He ate a bag of chips while watching the football game.
chip.exampleZh: 他一边看足球比赛，一边吃了一袋薯条。

chocolate.example: I bought a box of chocolate for my sister's birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我为妹妹的生日买了一盒巧克力。

choice.example: Making a choice is never easy when both options look good.
choice.exampleZh: 当两个选项看起来都不错时，做出选择从来都不容易。

choose.example: You can choose any book you like from this shelf.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从这个书架上挑选任何一本你喜欢的书。

chop.example: My mother chopped the onions into small pieces for the soup.
chop.exampleZh: 我妈妈把洋葱剁碎放进汤里。

chorus.example: The whole class sang the chorus together at the school concert.
chorus.exampleZh: 全班同学在学校音乐会上一起唱了合唱部分。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian, and he goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是个基督教徒，他每个星期天都去教堂。

christmas.example: We put up a big tree in our living room every Christmas.
christmas.exampleZh: 每年圣诞节我们都会在客厅里立一棵大圣诞树。

chronic.example: He has a chronic cough that never seems to go away.
chronic.exampleZh: 他有一种似乎永远好不了的慢性咳嗽。

church.example: The old church stands at the end of our street.
church.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂矗立在我们街道的尽头。

cigarette.example: My father smokes a cigarette after dinner every evening.
cigarette.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚上晚饭后都会抽一支香烟。

cinema.example: We went to the cinema last night to see a funny film.
cinema.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去电影院看了一部有趣的电影。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The old radio stopped working because a small part of its circuit was broken.
circuit.exampleZh: 那台旧收音机不工作了，因为它的电路有一个小部件坏了。

circulate.example: Blood circulates through the body and carries oxygen to every part.
circulate.exampleZh: 血液在体内循环，把氧气输送到每一处。

circumstance.example: Under no circumstance should you open the door to strangers at night.
circumstance.exampleZh: 在任何情况下，你晚上都不应该给陌生人开门。

cite.example: The teacher asked us to cite two sources in the report.
cite.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在报告中引用两处资料来源。

citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in this country.
citizen.exampleZh: 在这个国家，每个公民都有投票权。

city.example: The city is very busy and noisy in the morning.
city.exampleZh: 这座城市早上非常繁忙和嘈杂。

civil.example: Every citizen should know their civil rights and respect the law.
civil.exampleZh: 每个公民都应该了解自己的公民权利并尊重法律。

claim.example: She claims that the lost bag belongs to her.
claim.exampleZh: 她声称那个丢失的包是她的。

clap.example: The teacher asked us to clap after the song ended.
clap.exampleZh: 老师让我们在歌曲结束后鼓掌。

clarify.example: Could you clarify what you mean by that?
clarify.exampleZh: 你能澄清一下那是什么意思吗？

clash.example: There was a loud clash as the two cars hit each other.
clash.exampleZh: 两辆汽车相撞时发出了响亮的碰撞声。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and we have English in the morning.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生，我们上午上英语课。

classic.example: This book is a classic story that many children still love today.
classic.exampleZh: 这本书是一个经典故事，许多孩子至今仍然喜爱它。

classify.example: Teachers classify the books by subject so students can find them easily.
classify.exampleZh: 老师按学科把书分类，这样学生就能轻松找到它们。

classroom.example: Our classroom is clean and bright, and we study there every day.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们的教室干净明亮，我们每天在那里学习。

clause.example: This clause in the contract says we must pay by Friday.
clause.exampleZh: 合同中的这一条款规定我们必须在周五前付款。

clean.example: Please keep your room clean and tidy every day.
clean.exampleZh: 请每天保持你的房间干净整洁。

clear.example: The teacher gave us clear instructions before the test started.
clear.exampleZh: 老师在考试开始前给了我们清楚的说明。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了房间钥匙。

clever.example: The clever girl solved the hard puzzle in only a few minutes.
clever.exampleZh: 那个聪明的女孩只用几分钟就解出了这道难题。

click.example: Click the red button to save your file.
click.exampleZh: 点击红色按钮来保存你的文件。

client.example: Our client will visit the office next Monday morning to sign the contract.
client.exampleZh: 我们的客户将于下周一上午来办公室签署合同。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候全年温暖潮湿。

climb.example: We climb the hill every morning before school and watch the sun rise.
climb.exampleZh: 我们每天早上上学前爬那座小山，看太阳升起。

cling.example: The little boy likes to cling to his mother's hand in the crowd.
cling.exampleZh: 这个小男孩在人群中喜欢紧紧抓着妈妈的手。

clinic.example: The doctor at the clinic said my cough would get better soon.
clinic.exampleZh: 诊所的医生说我咳嗽很快就会好。

clock.example: The clock on the kitchen wall is five minutes fast today.
clock.exampleZh: 厨房墙上的钟今天快了五分钟。

close.example: Please close the door and come sit close to me.
close.exampleZh: 请关上门，过来坐到我旁边。

cloth.example: She cleaned the table with a wet cloth after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块湿布擦桌子。
