clothes.example: She washes her clothes every Sunday morning at home.
clothes.exampleZh: 她每个星期天早上在家洗衣服。

cloud.example: Dark clouds covered the sky before the heavy rain started.
cloud.exampleZh: 大雨来临之前，乌云遮住了天空。

club.example: He joined a tennis club and plays there every weekend.
club.exampleZh: 他加入了一个网球俱乐部，每个周末都在那里打球。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the door of the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警方在那座老房子的门附近发现了一条重要线索。

cluster.example: A cluster of stars shone brightly above the quiet little village.
cluster.exampleZh: 一小簇星星在安静的小村庄上方明亮地闪烁。

coach.example: My coach helps me train for the big game every week.
coach.exampleZh: 我的教练每周都帮我为大赛训练。

coal.example: The old train still burns coal to make steam for its long journey.
coal.exampleZh: 那列老火车仍然烧煤来产生蒸汽，以便完成它的长途旅程。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves come in.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着大浪涌来。

coat.example: He put on his warm coat and went outside to play.
coat.exampleZh: 他穿上暖和的外套，到外面去玩了。

cocktail.example: The waiter brought us a cold cocktail before dinner.
cocktail.exampleZh: 服务员在晚餐前给我们端来了一杯冰镇鸡尾酒。

code.example: The bank asked me to enter a secret code before I could use the machine.
code.exampleZh: 银行要求我先输入一个密码，然后我才能使用这台机器。

coffee.example: I drink a cup of coffee every morning before I go to work.
coffee.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会喝一杯咖啡。

coil.example: She coiled the long rope into a neat circle on the floor.
coil.exampleZh: 她把长绳在地上盘绕成一个整齐的圆圈。

coin.example: The teacher told us that the word was coined by a famous writer.
coin.exampleZh: 老师告诉我们，这个词是一位著名作家创造的。

coincide.example: Our holiday dates coincide this year, so we can travel together.
coincide.exampleZh: 今年我们的假期时间正好重合，所以我们可以一起旅行。

cold.example: It is very cold today, so put on your warm coat.
cold.exampleZh: 今天很冷，所以穿上你的暖外套。

collaborate.example: Our team will collaborate with a local school on this project.
collaborate.exampleZh: 我们团队将就这个项目与当地一所学校合作。

collapse.example: The old bridge may collapse if heavy trucks keep crossing it.
collapse.exampleZh: 如果重型卡车继续从这座旧桥上通过，它可能会倒塌。

collar.example: The dog has a red collar around its neck.
collar.exampleZh: 那只狗的脖子上戴着一个红色颈圈。

colleague.example: My colleague helped me finish the report before the meeting started.
colleague.exampleZh: 我的同事在会议开始前帮我完成了报告。

collect.example: My brother likes to collect old coins from different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢收集来自不同国家的旧硬币。

college.example: My sister studies English at a college near our home.
college.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所学院学习英语。

collide.example: The two cars collided at the busy corner during the morning rush hour.
collide.exampleZh: 两辆汽车在早晨高峰时段于繁忙的街角相撞。

colony.example: A large colony of ants lives under the old tree in our garden.
colony.exampleZh: 一大群蚂蚁住在我们花园里那棵老树下。

colour.example: She loves the bright colour of the flowers in spring.
colour.exampleZh: 她喜欢春天花朵明艳的色彩。

column.example: The old building has a tall stone column near the front door.
column.exampleZh: 这栋老建筑的前门附近有一根高大的石柱。

comb.example: She used a comb to comb her hair before the party.
comb.exampleZh: 聚会前她用梳子梳理了头发。

combat.example: The government is working hard to combat air pollution in big cities.
combat.exampleZh: 政府正在努力防止大城市的空气污染。

combine.example: You can combine the two small rooms to make one big room.
combine.exampleZh: 你可以把这两个小房间合并成一个大房间。

come.example: Please come to my house after school today.
come.exampleZh: 请今天放学后到我家来。

comedy.example: I like watching comedy with my friends on weekends.
comedy.exampleZh: 我喜欢周末和朋友们一起看喜剧。

comfort.example: Her kind words gave him great comfort after the loss.
comfort.exampleZh: 失去亲人后，她亲切的话语给了他极大的安慰。

command.example: The general can command his soldiers and he has good command of English.
command.exampleZh: 这位将军能指挥他的士兵，而且他的英语掌握得很好。

comment.example: She made a kind comment about my new book.
comment.exampleZh: 她对我的新书发表了一条友善的评论。

commerce.example: Online commerce has changed the way small shops sell their goods.
commerce.exampleZh: 网络商业改变了小商店销售商品的方式。

commission.example: The company paid him a small commission for every house he sold last year.
commission.exampleZh: 公司为他去年卖出的每套房子支付了一小笔佣金。

commit.example: She committed a serious mistake and promised to fix it right away.
commit.exampleZh: 她犯了一个严重的错误，并承诺立刻改正。

committee.example: The committee will meet on Friday to discuss the new plan.
committee.exampleZh: 委员会将于周五开会讨论新计划。

communicate.example: We use email to communicate with our team every day.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每天用电子邮件与团队沟通。

community.example: Our community holds a small party in the park every summer.
community.exampleZh: 我们社区每年夏天都在公园里举办一场小型聚会。

companion.example: My dog is a good companion when I walk in the park.
companion.exampleZh: 当我在公园散步时，我的狗是一个很好的伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

compare.example: If you compare the two pictures, you can see the difference.
compare.exampleZh: 如果你比较这两张图片，就能看出不同。

compete.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with big supermarkets on price.
compete.exampleZh: 小商店发现在价格上很难与大型超市竞争。

complain.example: My neighbors often complain about the loud music late at night.
complain.exampleZh: 我的邻居经常抱怨深夜音乐太吵。

complete.example: Please complete the form and return it to the office by Friday.
complete.exampleZh: 请填写这份表格，并在周五前交回办公室。

complex.example: The new hospital is a large building complex with many modern departments.
complex.exampleZh: 这家新医院是一个大型建筑群，里面有许多现代化的科室。

complicated.example: This math problem is too complicated for me to solve quickly.
complicated.exampleZh: 这道数学题太复杂了，我没办法很快解出来。

component.example: Each component of the machine is easy to clean and replace.
component.exampleZh: 这台机器的每个部件都易于清洁和更换。

compose.example: She composed a quiet song for her mother's birthday.
compose.exampleZh: 她为母亲的生日创作了一首安静的歌曲。

compound.example: Water is a simple compound of two common gases.
compound.exampleZh: 水是由两种常见气体组成的简单化合物。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of English texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对英语文章的理解力。

comprehensive.example: The teacher gave us a comprehensive review before the final exam.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 老师在期末考试前给我们做了一次全面的复习。

compress.example: Please compress the large file before you send it by email.
compress.exampleZh: 请先把这个大文件压缩，然后再通过电子邮件发送。

comprise.example: The team comprises five students from different countries and two teachers.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由来自不同国家的五名学生和两名老师组成。

compromise.example: After a long talk, both sides agreed to a fair compromise.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过长时间的商谈，双方同意了一个公平的折中方案。

compute.example: We need to compute the total cost before we buy the tickets.
compute.exampleZh: 我们需要在买票之前先算出总花费。

concentrate.example: I can't concentrate on my homework when the TV is on.
concentrate.exampleZh: 电视开着的时候我无法专心做作业。

concept.example: The idea of time is an abstract concept for young children.
concept.exampleZh: 时间的概念对幼儿来说是一个抽象的概念。

concern.example: The new rule concerns all students who live on campus this year.
concern.exampleZh: 这条新规定涉及今年所有住在校内的学生。

conclude.example: We can conclude from these results that the new method works well.
conclude.exampleZh: 我们可以从这些结果中得出结论：新方法效果很好。

concrete.example: The workers poured wet concrete onto the ground to build a strong floor.
concrete.exampleZh: 工人们把湿混凝土倒在地上，以建造坚固的地面。

condition.example: The doctor said his condition is getting better every day.
condition.exampleZh: 医生说他的状况每天都在好转。

conduct.example: The teacher will conduct a simple test in class today.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师今天将在课堂上进行一次简单的测试。

conference.example: She went to a conference in Beijing last week with her boss.
conference.exampleZh: 上周她和老板去北京参加了一个会议。

confess.example: He confessed that he broke the window by accident.
confess.exampleZh: 他承认自己不小心打破了窗户。

confidence.example: She spoke with great confidence in front of the whole class.
confidence.exampleZh: 她在全班同学面前满怀自信地发言。

confine.example: The doctor told him to confine his activities to light walking for a week.
confine.exampleZh: 医生让他一周内只限于做轻度散步这类活动。

confirm.example: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
confirm.exampleZh: 请在周五前通过电子邮件确认你的预订。

conflict.example: There is a serious conflict between what he says and what he does.
conflict.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在严重的矛盾。

confront.example: We must confront our problems before they get worse.
confront.exampleZh: 我们必须在问题变得更糟之前面对它们。

confuse.example: The teacher's long explanation confused the students even more.
confuse.exampleZh: 老师冗长的讲解让学生们更加困惑了。

congress.example: The congress will meet next week to discuss the new law.
congress.exampleZh: 国会将于下周开会讨论这项新法律。

connect.example: Please connect the computer to the printer before you start working.
connect.exampleZh: 开始工作前，请把电脑连接到打印机上。

conscience.example: His conscience told him to tell the teacher the truth.
conscience.exampleZh: 他的良心告诉他要去向老师说出真相。

conscious.example: She was still conscious after the accident and could tell us her name.
conscious.exampleZh: 事故发生后她仍然神志清醒，能告诉我们她的名字。

consensus.example: The group reached a consensus after a long and friendly discussion.
consensus.exampleZh: 经过长时间友好的讨论，这个小组达成了共识。

consent.example: She gave her consent for the doctor to start the treatment.
consent.exampleZh: 她同意让医生开始治疗。

consequence.example: Every decision has a consequence, so think carefully before you act.
consequence.exampleZh: 每个决定都有后果，所以行动前要仔细考虑。

conservative.example: My grandfather is a conservative man who likes old songs and simple clothes.
conservative.exampleZh: 我祖父是个保守的人，喜欢老歌和简单的衣服。

consider.example: We should consider other people's feelings before making a decision.
consider.exampleZh: 我们在做决定之前应该考虑他人的感受。

consist.example: The team consists of six students and two teachers.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由六名学生和两名教师组成。

constant.example: The constant noise from the street made it hard to sleep.
constant.exampleZh: 街上持续不断的噪音让人难以入睡。

constitute.example: Small daily habits constitute the foundation of a healthy life.
constitute.exampleZh: 每天的小习惯构成了健康生活的基础。

construct.example: They plan to construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在河上建造一座新桥。

consult.example: You should consult your teacher before you choose the final topic.
consult.exampleZh: 在选择最终题目之前，你应该先咨询你的老师。

consume.example: Big cars consume more gas than small cars.
consume.exampleZh: 大车比小车消耗更多的汽油。

contact.example: Please contact me by email if you have any questions.
contact.exampleZh: 如果你有任何问题，请通过电子邮件联系我。

contain.example: This box contains all the old photos from my family.
contain.exampleZh: 这个盒子里装着我家所有的老照片。

contemporary.example: She enjoys contemporary music, and her brother is a contemporary of mine.
contemporary.exampleZh: 她喜欢当代音乐，而她哥哥是我的同龄人。

content.example: The content of this box is food, and the children are content.
content.exampleZh: 这个盒子里装的是食物，孩子们很满足。

contest.example: She won first prize in the singing contest last year.
contest.exampleZh: 她去年在歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

context.example: You need to understand the context before you judge his words.
context.exampleZh: 在评判他的话之前，你需要先了解上下文。

continent.example: Asia is the largest continent in the world and has many people.
continent.exampleZh: 亚洲是世界上最大的大陆，人口众多。

continual.example: The continual noise from the street keeps me awake every night.
continual.exampleZh: 街上持续不断的噪音让我每晚都睡不着。

continue.example: Please continue reading the book while I make dinner.
continue.exampleZh: 我做晚饭的时候，请你继续读这本书。

contract.example: The company signed a new contract with a factory in China.
contract.exampleZh: 公司与一家中国工厂签订了一份新合同。

contradict.example: His later actions contradict the promises he made to us last year.
contradict.exampleZh: 他后来的行为与他去年对我们做出的承诺相矛盾。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two pictures is easy to see.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图片之间的反差很容易看出来。

contribute.example: Many people contribute money to help poor children go to school.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助贫困儿童上学。

control.example: She finds it hard to control her anger when people are rude.
control.exampleZh: 当人们无礼时，她发现自己很难控制住怒气。

convenience.example: This small shop sells many conveniences like drinks, snacks and phone cards.
convenience.exampleZh: 这家小店出售饮料、零食和电话卡等许多便利商品。

convention.example: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone new.
convention.exampleZh: 初次见面时握手是一种惯例。

conversation.example: We had a long conversation about our future plans yesterday.
conversation.exampleZh: 我们昨天就未来的计划进行了一次长谈。

convert.example: They plan to convert the old factory into a small art museum.
convert.exampleZh: 他们计划把这座旧工厂改造成一座小型艺术博物馆。

convey.example: Words can convey feelings that are hard to say out loud.
convey.exampleZh: 语言可以传达难以说出口的感受。

convince.example: I will try to convince my parents to let me study abroad.
convince.exampleZh: 我会努力说服父母让我出国留学。

cook.example: My mother likes to cook chicken soup for us on cold winter days.
cook.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在寒冷的冬日里给我们煮鸡汤。

cool.example: The evening air felt cool, so we sat outside and talked.
cool.exampleZh: 傍晚的空气很凉爽，所以我们坐在外面聊天。

cooperate.example: If we cooperate, the work will be much easier for everyone.
cooperate.exampleZh: 如果我们合作，这项工作对每个人来说都会容易得多。

coordinate.example: She will coordinate the work of the two teams next week.
coordinate.exampleZh: 她下周将协调这两个团队的工作。

cop.example: The cop helped the lost child find her parents.
cop.exampleZh: 警察帮助走失的孩子找到了她的父母。

cope.example: It is hard to cope with so much work alone.
cope.exampleZh: 一个人应付这么多工作很难。

copy.example: Please copy this page and give one copy to each student.
copy.exampleZh: 请复印这一页，并给每位学生一份副本。

core.example: The core of the problem is a lack of trust between the two teams.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心是两队之间缺乏信任。

corn.example: The farmer grows corn in his field every summer.
corn.exampleZh: 这位农民每年夏天都在他的田里种玉米。

corner.example: The small shop on the corner sells fresh bread every morning.
corner.exampleZh: 街角的那家小店每天早上卖新鲜面包。

corporate.example: All corporate employees must follow the new safety rules at work.
corporate.exampleZh: 所有公司员工在工作中都必须遵守新的安全规定。

correct.example: Please correct your mistakes before you hand in the test paper.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交试卷之前改正你的错误。

correspond.example: His actions do not correspond with the promises he made last year.
correspond.exampleZh: 他的行为与他去年许下的承诺并不相符。

corridor.example: She walked down the long corridor to find her classroom.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊走去，想找到自己的教室。

corrupt.example: The corrupt official took money and lost his job.
corrupt.exampleZh: 那个腐败的官员收了钱，丢了工作。

cost.example: The cost of the ticket is too high for most students.
cost.exampleZh: 这张票的费用对大多数学生来说太高了。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一套漂亮的戏装去参加聚会。

cottage.example: My grandparents live in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在湖边的一座小村舍里。

cotton.example: This shirt is made of soft cotton and feels very comfortable in summer.
cotton.exampleZh: 这件衬衫是柔软棉布做的，夏天穿着很舒服。

cough.example: He began to cough badly after catching a cold last week.
cough.exampleZh: 上周感冒后，他开始咳得很厉害。

could.example: Could you please help me carry these heavy books to the library?
could.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些沉重的书搬到图书馆吗？

council.example: The city council will meet next week to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会将于下周开会讨论新公园的事宜。

counsel.example: My teacher gave me wise counsel when I was unsure about my future.
counsel.exampleZh: 当我对未来感到迷茫时，老师给了我明智的忠告。

count.example: You can count on her to finish the work on time.
count.exampleZh: 你可以指望她按时完成这项工作。

counter.example: She left her keys on the counter and walked out the door.
counter.exampleZh: 她把钥匙落在柜台上，然后走出了门。

country.example: My country is very large and has many beautiful mountains.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，有许多美丽的山。

county.example: He lives on a small farm in the county near the river.
county.exampleZh: 他住在河边这个县里的一个小农场。

couple.example: The young couple moved into a small house near the park.
couple.exampleZh: 这对年轻夫妇搬进了公园附近的一栋小房子。

courage.example: It takes real courage to admit your mistake in front of everyone.
courage.exampleZh: 当着所有人的面承认错误需要真正的勇气。

course.example: This course teaches students how to write clear and simple English.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程教学生如何写出清晰简洁的英语。

court.example: The judge in the court listened carefully to the young man's story.
court.exampleZh: 法庭上的法官仔细听取了那个年轻人的陈述。

cover.example: Snow covered the whole garden last night, so the children could not play outside.
cover.exampleZh: 昨晚大雪覆盖了整个花园，所以孩子们无法在外面玩耍。

crash.example: The old computer will crash if I open too many programs.
crash.exampleZh: 如果我打开太多程序，这台旧电脑就会崩溃。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every game on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球很着迷，每场比赛都在电视上看。

create.example: The children used paper and glue to create a small house.
create.exampleZh: 孩子们用纸和胶水创造了一座小房子。

creative.example: She has a creative way of solving problems at work.
creative.exampleZh: 她在工作中解决问题有创造性的一套办法。

creature.example: This small creature lives under the rocks near the river.
creature.exampleZh: 这种小生物生活在河边的石头下面。

credit.example: She gave him credit for the good work he did.
credit.exampleZh: 她因他做的出色工作而赞扬了他。

crew.example: The whole crew worked hard to keep the ship safe.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员努力工作，确保船只安全。

crime.example: The police caught the man who committed a serious crime last night.
crime.exampleZh: 警方抓住了昨晚犯下严重罪行的那个男人。

crisis.example: The country is facing a serious economic crisis this year.
crisis.exampleZh: 这个国家今年正面临严重的经济危机。

criteria.example: The school uses clear criteria to choose new students.
criteria.exampleZh: 学校用明确的标准来挑选新学生。

critic.example: The film critic wrote a long and honest review of the new movie.
critic.exampleZh: 这位电影评论家为这部新电影写了一篇长而诚实的影评。

critical.example: Clean water is critical for the health of every community.
critical.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每个社区的健康都至关重要。

criticise.example: My teacher will criticise my essay if I make too many grammar mistakes.
criticise.exampleZh: 如果我犯太多语法错误，老师会批评我的作文。

crop.example: Farmers worked hard to bring in the crop before the rain.
crop.exampleZh: 农民们努力在雨前抢收庄稼。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross the busy street.
cross.exampleZh: 穿过繁忙的街道前要两边看看。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the concert.
crowd.exampleZh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看音乐会。

crucial.example: Getting enough sleep is crucial for students before a big exam.
crucial.exampleZh: 考试前睡够觉对学生来说至关重要。

crude.example: This table is made of crude wood, but it is very strong.
crude.exampleZh: 这张桌子是用未加工的木头做的，但非常结实。

cruel.example: It is cruel to laugh at a child who makes a mistake.
cruel.exampleZh: 嘲笑一个犯了错的孩子是残忍的。

crush.example: The heavy box fell and crushed my old phone.
crush.exampleZh: 那个重箱子掉下来，把我的旧手机压坏了。

cry.example: The baby began to cry when she lost her favorite toy.
cry.exampleZh: 宝宝丢了最喜欢的玩具，就开始哭了起来。

cultural.example: Our school holds a cultural festival every spring, and all students take part.
cultural.exampleZh: 我们学校每年春天举办文化节，全体学生都参加。

culture.example: Chinese culture has a long and rich history that many people admire.
culture.exampleZh: 中国文化有着悠久而丰富的历史，许多人对此十分敬佩。

cure.example: The new drug can cure the disease in just a few weeks.
cure.exampleZh: 这种新药只需几周就能治愈这种疾病。

curious.example: The little boy is curious about how birds fly in the sky.
curious.exampleZh: 这个小男孩好奇鸟儿是怎样在天空中飞行的。

currency.example: The country uses a new currency, and people like it.
currency.exampleZh: 这个国家使用一种新货币，人们很喜欢它。

current.example: The current is very strong in this river, so we cannot swim here.
current.exampleZh: 这条河的水流很急，所以我们不能在这里游泳。

curriculum.example: The school has a new curriculum for science and math this year.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校今年为科学和数学制定了新的课程体系。

curse.example: The old woman said a curse over the broken gate.
curse.exampleZh: 老妇人对那扇破门念了一句诅咒。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning sun into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road curves to the left as it goes up the hill.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在上山时向左弯曲。

custom.example: It is a custom in our town to eat noodles on New Year's Day.
custom.exampleZh: 在我们镇上，新年吃面条是一种习俗。

customer.example: The new customer asked our staff for help with a large order.
customer.exampleZh: 这位新顾客向我们的员工求助，想处理一笔大额订单。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into small pieces for the children.
cut.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成小块给孩子们。

cute.example: The baby panda is very cute and everyone loves to watch it.
cute.exampleZh: 那只小熊猫非常可爱，大家都喜欢看它。

cycle.example: She cycles to work every day to stay healthy and save money.
cycle.exampleZh: 她每天骑自行车上班，以保持健康并省钱。

daily.example: I read the daily news before I start my work.
daily.exampleZh: 我在开始工作前读每日新闻。

dairy.example: She cannot eat dairy, so she drinks soy milk instead.
dairy.exampleZh: 她不能吃乳制品，所以改喝豆奶。

damage.example: The storm caused serious damage to many houses in the small village.
damage.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨给小村庄的许多房屋造成了严重损害。

damp.example: The walls of the old house felt damp after the heavy rain.
damp.exampleZh: 大雨过后，那座老房子的墙壁摸起来很潮湿。

danger.example: The broken bridge is a danger to everyone who walks on it.
danger.exampleZh: 这座破损的桥对每个走上去的人都是危险。

dare.example: She did not dare to tell her parents the truth.
dare.exampleZh: 她不敢把真相告诉父母。

dark.example: The room was dark, so I turned on a small light.
dark.exampleZh: 房间里很黑，所以我打开了一盏小灯。

darling.example: She is the darling of the whole family and everyone loves her.
darling.exampleZh: 她是全家人的宠儿，每个人都喜欢她。

dash.example: She dashed across the street to catch the bus before it left.
dash.exampleZh: 她冲过马路，想在公交车开走前赶上它。

data.example: The team collected a lot of data for their science project.
data.exampleZh: 团队为他们的科学项目收集了大量数据。

database.example: The school keeps all student records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 学校把所有学生记录保存在一个大数据库中。

date.example: I wrote the date on the letter and dated it.
date.exampleZh: 我把日期写在信上并注明了日期。

daughter.example: My daughter likes to read books before she goes to bed.
daughter.exampleZh: 我女儿喜欢在睡前看书。

dawn.example: The truth began to dawn on him after she explained the whole story.
dawn.exampleZh: 在她解释整件事之后，他才开始明白真相。

day.example: We walked in the park all day and went home at night.
day.exampleZh: 我们在公园里走了一整天，晚上才回家。

daylight.example: The room is bright because daylight comes in through the window.
daylight.exampleZh: 房间里很明亮，因为日光从窗户照进来。

dead.example: The old tree in our garden is dead and has no leaves.
dead.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树已经死了，没有叶子。

deadline.example: The deadline for the school project is next Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 学校项目的最后期限是下周五。

deadly.example: The snake's bite can be deadly if you do not get help fast.
deadly.exampleZh: 如果你不迅速寻求帮助，这种蛇的咬伤可能致命。

deal.example: We need to deal with this problem before it gets worse.
deal.exampleZh: 我们需要在这个问题变得更糟之前处理它。

dealer.example: The dealer sells used cars at a low price.
dealer.exampleZh: 这个经销商以低价出售二手车。

dear.example: Everything in this small shop is too dear for me to buy.
dear.exampleZh: 这家小店里所有的东西对我来说都太贵了，我买不起。

death.example: His death was a great shock to everyone in the family.
death.exampleZh: 他的死让家里每个人都深受打击。

debate.example: The students had a long debate about school rules after class.
debate.exampleZh: 学生们课后就校规进行了长时间的辩论。

debt.example: He worked two jobs to pay off his debt.
debt.exampleZh: 他打两份工来还清债务。

decade.example: She has lived in this small town for more than a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 她在这个小镇住了十多年。

decay.example: Without regular care, the old house began to decay within a few years.
decay.exampleZh: 由于缺乏定期维护，这栋老房子几年内就开始腐坏了。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends about the broken window.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图就打破窗户的事欺骗他的朋友们。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
decent.exampleZh: 他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

decide.example: We must decide where to meet tomorrow afternoon.
decide.exampleZh: 我们必须决定明天下午在哪里见面。

decimal.example: The decimal system uses ten digits, so learning basic decimal numbers helps students in math class.
decimal.exampleZh: 十进制使用十个数字，因此学习基本的小数有助于学生在数学课上学习。

decision.example: Making a decision is not easy when both choices seem good.
decision.exampleZh: 当两个选择看起来都不错时，做出决定并不容易。

declare.example: The company declared a big loss at the meeting.
declare.exampleZh: 公司在会上宣布了一笔重大亏损。

decline.example: Sales of the old phone began to decline after new models came out.
decline.exampleZh: 新机型推出后，这款旧手机的销量开始下降。

decorate.example: We will decorate the living room with bright colors this weekend.
decorate.exampleZh: 这个周末我们会用鲜艳的颜色装饰客厅。

decrease.example: Sales of the old phone began to decrease after the new model came out.
decrease.exampleZh: 新款手机上市后，旧款手机的销量开始减少。

dedicate.example: She decided to dedicate her free time to helping children learn to read.
dedicate.exampleZh: 她决定把自己的空闲时间奉献给帮助孩子们学习阅读。

deduce.example: We can deduce from the evidence that he was there that night.
deduce.exampleZh: 我们可以从证据推断出他那天晚上在那里。

deed.example: She is known for her good deeds in the small town.
deed.exampleZh: 她因在这个小镇上的善行而闻名。

deem.example: Most people deem this plan too risky to try now.
deem.exampleZh: 大多数人认为这个计划风险太大，现在不宜尝试。

deep.example: The lake is very deep and the water looks dark blue.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖很深，水看起来是深蓝色的。

deer.example: We saw a young deer drinking water by the quiet river this morning.
deer.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一只小鹿在安静的河边喝水。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and finally defeated the strong enemy in the last game.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，终于在最后一场比赛中击败了强大的对手。

defect.example: The main defect of this old phone is its very short battery life.
defect.exampleZh: 这部旧手机的主要缺点是电池续航时间很短。

defend.example: We must defend our home from danger and keep everyone safe.
defend.exampleZh: 我们必须保卫家园免受危险，保护每个人的安全。

defendant.example: The defendant told the judge that he was at home that night.
defendant.exampleZh: 被告告诉法官，那天晚上他在家里。

defensive.example: The team played a defensive game and stopped the other side from scoring.
defensive.exampleZh: 这支球队打了一场防守型的比赛，阻止了对方得分。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the word in our own words.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己的话给这个词下定义。

definite.example: There is no definite answer to this question yet.
definite.exampleZh: 这个问题目前还没有明确的答案。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday.
definitely.exampleZh: 我星期六一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The definition of this word is clear and easy to understand.
definition.exampleZh: 这个词的定义清晰易懂。

degree.example: The temperature outside is about thirty degrees today.
degree.exampleZh: 今天外面的温度大约是三十度。

delay.example: Heavy snow may delay our flight by several hours.
delay.exampleZh: 大雪可能会使我们的航班延误几个小时。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to a trusted team member.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理会把这项任务授权给一位值得信赖的团队成员。

deliberate.example: Her deliberate choice of words made everyone stop and think.
deliberate.exampleZh: 她刻意斟酌的用词让每个人都停下来思考。

delicate.example: The delicate glass cup broke when it fell off the table.
delicate.exampleZh: 那个精致的玻璃杯从桌上掉下来时碎了。

delicious.example: This soup is really delicious, and my whole family loves it.
delicious.exampleZh: 这汤真美味，我们全家都很喜欢。

delight.example: The children shouted with delight when they saw the snow.
delight.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴地欢呼起来。

deliver.example: The doctor will deliver the baby early tomorrow morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 医生明天一早会接生这个婴儿。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package was late because of the heavy snow.
delivery.exampleZh: 由于大雪，包裹的递送迟到了。

demand.example: There is a strong demand for fresh water in this dry region.
demand.exampleZh: 在这个干旱地区，人们对淡水的需求很大。

democracy.example: In a democracy, people have the right to choose their leaders.
democracy.exampleZh: 在民主国家，人民有权选择自己的领导人。

democratic.example: The country held a democratic vote to choose its new leader.
democratic.exampleZh: 这个国家举行民主投票来选举新的领导人。

demonstrate.example: The teacher will demonstrate the experiment to the students tomorrow.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师明天将向学生们演示这个实验。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake made everyone in the room angry.
denial.exampleZh: 他对这个错误的否认让房间里的每个人都很生气。

dense.example: The forest is so dense that sunlight can hardly reach the ground.
dense.exampleZh: 这片森林非常茂密，阳光几乎照不到地面。

density.example: The density of this city is very high.
density.exampleZh: 这座城市的密度非常高。

dental.example: I have a dental checkup at the hospital next Monday morning.
dental.exampleZh: 下周一早上我要去医院做牙齿检查。

deny.example: She still denies taking the money from the office.
deny.exampleZh: 她仍然否认从办公室拿了那笔钱。

depart.example: The train will depart from the station at nine tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 火车将于明天上午九点从车站出发。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a large company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部工作。

departure.example: His sudden departure from the team surprised everyone who knew him.
departure.exampleZh: 他突然离开团队，让所有认识他的人都感到意外。

depend.example: Whether we go out tomorrow will depend on the weather.
depend.exampleZh: 我们明天是否出门将取决于天气。

dependent.example: Young children are dependent on their parents for food and care.
dependent.exampleZh: 幼小的孩子依赖父母提供食物和照顾。

depict.example: The book uses simple words to depict the life of a poor family.
depict.exampleZh: 这本书用简单的词描绘了一个贫穷家庭的生活。

deposit.example: She went to the bank to deposit her salary every month.
deposit.exampleZh: 她每个月都去银行存工资。

depress.example: The bad news depressed him, so he stayed home all day.
depress.exampleZh: 这个坏消息使他沮丧，所以他整天待在家里。

depression.example: He fell into a deep depression after losing his job last year.
depression.exampleZh: 去年失业后，他陷入了深深的抑郁之中。

depth.example: The lake has a depth of about ten meters.
depth.exampleZh: 这个湖的深度大约是十米。

deputy.example: The deputy took charge of the meeting while the manager was away.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理不在时，副手主持了会议。

derive.example: Many English words are derived from Latin and Greek.
derive.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语。

describe.example: Please describe your home to me in a few simple words.
describe.exampleZh: 请用简单的几句话向我描述你的家。

description.example: His description of the little village made me want to visit it soon.
description.exampleZh: 他对那个小村庄的描述让我很想尽快去看看。

desert.example: Camels can live for many days in the hot, dry desert.
desert.exampleZh: 骆驼能在炎热干燥的沙漠中生存很多天。

deserve.example: You work hard every day, so you deserve a good rest.
deserve.exampleZh: 你每天都很努力，所以你应该好好休息一下。

design.example: She will design a new garden for the school next year.
design.exampleZh: 她明年将为学校设计一个新花园。

designate.example: The teacher designated one student to lead the group activity.
designate.exampleZh: 老师指定一名学生来带领小组活动。

desirable.example: She is a desirable friend because she is kind and honest.
desirable.exampleZh: 她善良诚实，是一个值得交往的朋友。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well.
desire.exampleZh: 她有学好英语的强烈愿望。

desk.example: I put my books and a small lamp on the desk.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书和一盏小台灯放在书桌上。

despair.example: After losing his job, he fell into deep despair and stopped seeing friends.
despair.exampleZh: 失去工作后，他陷入深深的绝望，不再去见朋友。

desperate.example: He was desperate for a job after losing his last one.
desperate.exampleZh: 失去上一份工作后，他非常渴望得到一份工作。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, the children played outside all afternoon.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，孩子们还是在外面玩了一下午。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: After a long flight, we finally reached our destination.
destination.exampleZh: 经过长途飞行，我们终于到达了目的地。

destroy.example: The fire destroyed the old house in just a few minutes.
destroy.exampleZh: 大火在短短几分钟内就摧毁了那座老房子。

destruction.example: The fire caused great destruction to the old forest near our town.
destruction.exampleZh: 那场大火对我们镇附近的古老森林造成了巨大的破坏。

detail.example: Please give me more detail about your plan.
detail.exampleZh: 请多告诉我一些你计划的细节。

detailed.example: She gave a detailed report of the meeting to her team.
detailed.exampleZh: 她向团队提交了一份关于这次会议的详细报告。

detect.example: Doctors can detect this disease early with a simple blood test.
detect.exampleZh: 医生可以通过简单的血液检测及早发现这种疾病。

detective.example: The detective asked the old man a few simple questions about the missing car.
detective.exampleZh: 侦探向那位老人问了几个关于失踪汽车的简单问题。

determination.example: Her determination helped her finish the hard work on time.
determination.exampleZh: 她的决心帮助她按时完成了这项艰难的工作。

determine.example: We must determine the cause of the problem before we fix it.
determine.exampleZh: 我们必须先查明问题的原因，然后再解决它。

develop.example: The company plans to develop a new app for young users.
develop.exampleZh: 这家公司计划为年轻用户开发一款新应用。

development.example: The development of this new app took two years.
development.exampleZh: 这款新应用的开发花了两年时间。

device.example: This small device helps you find your keys quickly.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置能帮你快速找到钥匙。

devote.example: She devotes most of her free time to helping old people.
devote.exampleZh: 她把大部分空闲时间都用来帮助老人。

devotion.example: Her devotion to the family never changed over the years.
devotion.exampleZh: 多年来，她对家庭的奉献从未改变。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram to show how water moves in plants.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师画了一张简单的示意图，展示水在植物中如何运输。

dial.example: She dialed the wrong number and had to call again.
dial.exampleZh: 她拨错了号码，只好又打了一次。

dialect.example: My grandmother speaks a dialect that I cannot understand very well.
dialect.exampleZh: 我祖母说一种我听不太懂的方言。

diameter.example: The circle has a diameter of about ten centimeters.
diameter.exampleZh: 这个圆的直径约为十厘米。

diamond.example: She wore a small diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在派对上手指上戴着一枚小钻石戒指。

diary.example: She writes in her diary every night before going to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 她每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记本上写日记。

dictate.example: The teacher dictated the new words slowly so we could write them down.
dictate.exampleZh: 老师慢慢口授新单词，以便我们能记下来。

dictator.example: The dictator ruled the small country for over thirty years.
dictator.exampleZh: 这位独裁者统治这个小国三十多年。

die.example: His old car finally died on the way home last night.
die.exampleZh: 他的旧车昨晚在回家路上终于熄火了。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and regular exercise are both important.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说，健康的饮食和规律的运动都很重要。

differ.example: My opinion differs from his on this plan.
differ.exampleZh: 在这个计划上，我的意见和他的不同。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two answers.
difference.exampleZh: 这两个答案之间有很大的差异。

different.example: My brother and I have different hobbies and interests.
different.exampleZh: 我弟弟和我有着不同的爱好和兴趣。

difficult.example: English grammar is difficult for many students at first.
difficult.exampleZh: 英语语法一开始对许多学生来说是困难的。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty finding the right bus to the city center.
difficulty.exampleZh: 我在找去市中心的正确公交车时遇到了一些困难。

dig.example: The children like to dig in the sand behind the house.
dig.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在房子后面的沙子里挖。

digest.example: Her body needs time to digest the food after a big meal.
digest.exampleZh: 吃过大餐后，她的身体需要时间来消化这些食物。

digital.example: My watch has a digital display and shows the time clearly.
digital.exampleZh: 我的手表是数字显示的，能清楚地显示时间。

dignity.example: She faced her illness with quiet dignity and never complained.
dignity.exampleZh: 她以平静的尊严面对疾病，从不抱怨。

dimension.example: This problem has a new dimension that we did not expect.
dimension.exampleZh: 这个问题有一个我们未曾预料到的新层面。

diminish.example: The noise began to diminish after the workers left the building.
diminish.exampleZh: 工人们离开大楼后，噪音开始减弱。

dinner.example: We usually have dinner at seven every evening.
dinner.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点吃晚餐。

dip.example: She dipped her bread in the warm soup and smiled.
dip.exampleZh: 她把面包蘸进热汤里，笑了。

diploma.example: She put her college diploma on the wall next to her desk.
diploma.exampleZh: 她把大学文凭挂在书桌旁的墙上。

direct.example: The teacher gave us direct instructions before the exam.
direct.exampleZh: 考试前老师给了我们直接的指示。

direction.example: The teacher gave us clear directions to the museum.
direction.exampleZh: 老师给了我们去博物馆的明确方向。

directly.example: She went directly home after work and did not stop anywhere.
directly.exampleZh: 她下班后直接回家了，没有在任何地方停留。

director.example: The director asked everyone to stay after work for a short meeting.
director.exampleZh: 主任让大家下班后留下来开个短会。

dirt.example: Wash the dirt off your hands before you eat dinner.
dirt.exampleZh: 吃晚饭前把手上的污物洗掉。

dirty.example: His hands were dirty after he worked in the garden all morning.
dirty.exampleZh: 他在花园里干了一上午活之后，双手很脏。

disable.example: The accident disabled him for life, but he still writes books at home.
disable.exampleZh: 那场事故使他终身残疾，但他仍在家写书。

disabled.example: The building has a ramp for disabled people.
disabled.exampleZh: 这栋楼有一条供残疾人使用的坡道。

disadvantage.example: One disadvantage of this plan is that it costs too much money.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这个方案的一个缺点是要花太多钱。

disagree.example: I disagree with my brother about which movie we should watch tonight.
disagree.exampleZh: 我和弟弟对于今晚该看哪部电影意见不合。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned dark.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变暗了。

disappoint.example: I hope the movie will not disappoint you tonight.
disappoint.exampleZh: 我希望今晚这部电影不会让你失望。

disaster.example: The fire was a disaster, and many families lost their homes.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场大火是一场灾难，许多家庭失去了家园。

disastrous.example: The heavy rain had a disastrous effect on our small garden.
disastrous.exampleZh: 大雨对我们的小花园造成了灾难性的影响。

disc.example: I saved the photos on a disc and put it in my bag.
disc.exampleZh: 我把照片保存到一张光盘上，然后把它放进了包里。

discard.example: Please discard old newspapers instead of keeping them in the room.
discard.exampleZh: 请把旧报纸扔掉，不要把它们留在房间里。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge dirty water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 这家工厂不得向河里排放脏水。

discipline.example: Learning a new language takes discipline and a little practice every day.
discipline.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要自律和每天一点练习。

disclose.example: He refused to disclose the name of the person who helped him.
disclose.exampleZh: 他拒绝透露那个帮助过他的人的姓名。

discount.example: The store gave me a discount on the shoes, so I bought them.
discount.exampleZh: 商店给我打了折，所以我就把那双鞋买了。

discourage.example: Bad weather did not discourage the students from going on the school trip.
discourage.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气并没有使学生们放弃参加学校旅行。

discover.example: I was surprised to discover that my old friend lived next door.
discover.exampleZh: 我惊讶地发现我的老朋友就住在隔壁。

discovery.example: The discovery of the new planet made scientists very excited.
discovery.exampleZh: 这颗新行星的发现让科学家们非常兴奋。

discriminate.example: It is wrong to discriminate against people because of their skin color.
discriminate.exampleZh: 因为肤色而歧视他人是错误的。

discrimination.example: We must fight against discrimination in schools and at work.
discrimination.exampleZh: 我们必须反对学校和工作场所中的歧视。

discuss.example: We will discuss the plan with our teacher tomorrow morning.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们明天早上会和老师讨论这个计划。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about the new plan after lunch.
discussion.exampleZh: 午饭后我们对新计划进行了长时间的讨论。

disease.example: This serious disease can spread quickly from one person to another.
disease.exampleZh: 这种严重的疾病可以在人与人之间迅速传播。

disguise.example: He tried to disguise himself as a guard to enter the building.
disguise.exampleZh: 他试图假扮成警卫进入大楼。

disgust.example: The smell of old food filled her with disgust.
disgust.exampleZh: 旧食物的气味让她感到厌恶。

dish.example: She put the hot soup in a large white dish on the table.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一只大白盘里。

disk.example: The disk is full, so I cannot save my new files.
disk.exampleZh: 磁盘满了，所以我无法保存我的新文件。

dislike.example: Many children dislike doing homework on weekends.
dislike.exampleZh: 很多孩子不喜欢在周末做作业。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers for being late too often.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定因两名工人经常迟到而解雇他们。

disorder.example: The room was in complete disorder after the children finished playing.
disorder.exampleZh: 孩子们玩完之后，房间里一片混乱。

display.example: She will display her paintings at the small gallery in town.
display.exampleZh: 她将在镇上的小画廊里展出她的画作。

dispute.example: The two countries are trying to settle their dispute through peaceful talks.
dispute.exampleZh: 这两个国家正试图通过和平谈判解决他们的争端。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar in warm water and it will dissolve quickly.
dissolve.exampleZh: 把糖搅入温水中，它很快就会溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about fifty miles.
distance.exampleZh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约有五十英里。

distant.example: Her distant smile made me feel that we were no longer close friends.
distant.exampleZh: 她疏远的微笑让我觉得我们不再是亲密的朋友了。

distinct.example: There is a distinct difference between the two plans.
distinct.exampleZh: 这两个计划之间有明显的区别。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two words in meaning.
distinction.exampleZh: 这两个词在含义上有明显的区别。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look exactly the same.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们长得一模一样。

distribute.example: Teachers distribute the new books to all students on the first day.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师在第一天把新书分发给所有学生。

distribution.example: The distribution of food to the villagers started early this morning.
distribution.exampleZh: 向村民分发食物的行动今天一大早就开始了。

district.example: This district has many small shops and a big park.
district.exampleZh: 这个区域有许多小商店和一个大公园。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am studying in my room.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在房间里学习时，请不要打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud noise caused a disturbance in the quiet library.
disturbance.exampleZh: 那阵喧闹声在安静的图书馆里引起了一阵骚动。

diverse.example: The students in my class come from diverse families and countries.
diverse.exampleZh: 我班上的学生来自不同的家庭和国家。

diversity.example: Our school welcomes students from many countries and values this diversity.
diversity.exampleZh: 我们学校欢迎来自许多国家的学生，并珍视这种多样性。

divide.example: Please divide the cake into eight equal pieces for the children.
divide.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕分成八等份给孩子们。

division.example: The division of the money among the three brothers was fair.
division.exampleZh: 这笔钱在三兄弟之间的分配是公平的。

divorce.example: They decided to get a divorce after twenty years of unhappy marriage.
divorce.exampleZh: 在二十年不幸福的婚姻之后，他们决定离婚。

do.example: What do you want to do after class today?
do.exampleZh: 你今天下课后想做什么？

doctor.example: My mother is a doctor at a small hospital near our home.
doctor.exampleZh: 我妈妈是我们家附近一家小医院的医生。

document.example: Please keep this document in a safe place for future use.
document.exampleZh: 请把这份文件放在安全的地方，以备将来使用。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa last night.
documentary.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于非洲野生动物的纪录片。

dog.example: My dog runs to the door every time the bell rings.
dog.exampleZh: 每次门铃响，我的狗都会跑到门口。

doll.example: The little girl hugged her doll and fell asleep.
doll.exampleZh: 小女孩抱着她的玩偶睡着了。

dollar.example: I only have ten dollars, so I cannot buy that book.
dollar.exampleZh: 我只有十美元，所以买不了那本书。

domain.example: Public health is a difficult domain for young researchers to enter.
domain.exampleZh: 公共卫生是一个年轻研究者难以进入的领域。

domestic.example: Most domestic work in the home is still done by women.
domestic.exampleZh: 家里大部分家务仍然由女性承担。

dominant.example: This team is the dominant force in our local league.
dominant.exampleZh: 这支球队是我们本地联赛中占主导地位的力量。

dominate.example: Big companies often dominate the market and set the prices.
dominate.exampleZh: 大公司常常支配市场并制定价格。

donate.example: Every year, many kind people donate blood to help save lives.
donate.exampleZh: 每年都有许多善良的人捐血来帮助拯救生命。

donation.example: She made a small donation to help the children at the local school.
donation.exampleZh: 她捐了一小笔钱来帮助当地学校的孩子们。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请把门关上。

dormitory.example: The new students share a small dormitory near the school gate.
dormitory.exampleZh: 新生们共用校门附近一间小宿舍。

dose.example: The doctor told him to take one dose of the medicine after dinner.
dose.exampleZh: 医生告诉他晚饭后服用一剂这种药。

dot.example: There is a small red dot on the map near the river.
dot.exampleZh: 地图上靠近河流的地方有一个小红点。

double.example: She ordered a double room because her sister stayed with her.
double.exampleZh: 她订了一间双人房，因为她妹妹和她一起住。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the party tonight.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

down.example: She walked down the stairs and sat down by the window.
down.exampleZh: 她沿楼梯走下去，然后在窗边坐下。

download.example: I download new songs to my phone every weekend.
download.exampleZh: 我每个周末都会下载新歌到我的手机上。

downstairs.example: I left my bag downstairs and went up to get it.
downstairs.exampleZh: 我把包落在楼下，然后上楼去取。

downtown.example: We took the bus downtown to buy some books this morning.
downtown.exampleZh: 今天早上我们坐公交车去市中心买了几本书。

dozen.example: She bought a dozen eggs and some bread at the small shop.
dozen.exampleZh: 她在小商店买了一打鸡蛋和一些面包。

draft.example: She wrote the first draft of the report in one afternoon.
draft.exampleZh: 她用一个下午写完了报告的初稿。

drag.example: Please don't drag that heavy box across the floor by yourself.
drag.exampleZh: 请不要一个人把那个沉重的箱子在地板上拖来拖去。

dragon.example: The dragon in the story breathes fire and guards a cave of gold.
dragon.exampleZh: 故事里的那条龙会喷火，还守护着一个装满金子的洞穴。

drain.example: The old pipes drain rainwater away from the roof quickly.
drain.exampleZh: 这些旧管道把雨水从屋顶迅速排走。

drama.example: The drama at school was fun to watch.
drama.exampleZh: 学校里的戏剧表演看起来很有趣。

dramatic.example: The sudden change in the weather was dramatic and surprised everyone.
dramatic.exampleZh: 天气的突然变化非常剧烈，让所有人都很吃惊。

draw.example: The child likes to draw pictures of animals in his notebook.
draw.exampleZh: 这个孩子喜欢在笔记本上画动物的图画。

drawer.example: The keys are in the top drawer of my desk.
drawer.exampleZh: 钥匙在我书桌最上面的抽屉里。

drawing.example: She is drawing a small picture of her cat.
drawing.exampleZh: 她正在画一幅她的小猫的小图画。

dream.example: I had a strange dream last night, and I still dream of becoming a pilot.
dream.exampleZh: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦，而且我仍然梦想成为一名飞行员。

dress.example: She wears a red dress to work and dresses her little boy every morning.
dress.exampleZh: 她穿一条红色连衣裙去上班，每天早上还给小儿子穿衣服。

drift.example: Leaves drift slowly down the river on a quiet autumn morning.
drift.exampleZh: 在一个安静的秋日早晨，树叶缓缓地顺着河水漂流而下。

drill.example: The teacher will drill the students on new words every Monday morning.
drill.exampleZh: 老师每周一早上会训练学生记新单词。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before breakfast.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃早饭前喝一杯水。

drip.example: The old kitchen tap began to drip slowly into the sink.
drip.exampleZh: 旧厨房的水龙头开始慢慢滴水，滴进水槽里。

drive.example: He drives to work every morning, and the drive takes half an hour.
drive.exampleZh: 他每天早上开车上班，车程约半小时。

driver.example: The driver stopped the car and waited for the children to cross the road.
driver.exampleZh: 司机停下车，等孩子们过马路。

drop.example: Please don't drop the glass because it will break into small pieces.
drop.exampleZh: 请不要把玻璃杯掉在地上，因为它会碎成小块。

drought.example: The long drought made it hard for farmers to grow food.
drought.exampleZh: 长期干旱使农民难以种植粮食。

drown.example: The loud music drowned out her voice, so nobody heard her.
drown.exampleZh: 响亮的音乐盖过了她的声音，所以没人听见她说话。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a drug to help him sleep.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给了他一种药帮助他入睡。

drum.example: He beat the drum loudly during the school music show.
drum.exampleZh: 在学校音乐表演中，他大声地敲鼓。

drunk.example: He was too drunk to drive home last night.
drunk.exampleZh: 他昨晚醉得开不了车回家。

dry.example: The hot sun made the wet clothes dry very quickly.
dry.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳使湿衣服很快就干了。

dual.example: This machine has a dual purpose: it washes clothes and dries them.
dual.exampleZh: 这台机器有双重用途：既能洗衣服又能烘干。

duck.example: The little duck swims across the pond every morning with her babies.
duck.exampleZh: 这只小鸭子每天早上带着她的宝宝们游过池塘。

due.example: The train is due at six, so we should leave now.
due.exampleZh: 火车预计六点到，所以我们现在该出发了。

dull.example: The long meeting was so dull that everyone wanted to leave early.
dull.exampleZh: 那个漫长的会议太乏味了，所有人都想早点离开。

dumpling.example: My mother makes delicious dumplings with meat and vegetables every Sunday.
dumpling.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都会做美味的肉菜饺子。

during.example: I read two books during the summer holiday.
during.exampleZh: 我在暑假期间读了两本书。

dust.example: The old books on the shelf were covered with thick dust.
dust.exampleZh: 书架上的旧书覆盖着厚厚的灰尘。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dwarf.example: The dwarf in the story lives in a small house in the forest.
dwarf.exampleZh: 故事里的那个矮人住在森林里的一间小房子里。

dwell.example: Many small animals dwell in the dark forest near our village.
dwell.exampleZh: 许多小动物居住在我们村庄附近的黑暗森林里。

dynamic.example: The city has a dynamic economy that creates many new jobs every year.
dynamic.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有充满活力的经济，每年创造许多新的就业机会。

dynasty.example: The Tang dynasty is famous for its art and poetry.
dynasty.exampleZh: 唐朝以其艺术和诗歌闻名。

e-mail.example: Please e-mail me the report before Friday so I can read it.
e-mail.exampleZh: 请在周五前把报告发邮件给我，这样我能看一下。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们热切地想在圣诞节早上打开礼物。

eagle.example: The eagle flew high above the mountain and looked for food.
eagle.exampleZh: 那只鹰飞到高山之上，寻找食物。

ear.example: My left ear hurts a little after I swim in the cold water.
ear.exampleZh: 在冷水里游泳后，我的左耳有点疼。

early.example: I get up early every morning to walk my dog before school.
early.exampleZh: 我每天早上很早起床，在上学前遛狗。

earn.example: She works hard every day to earn money for her family.
earn.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，为家人挣钱。

earnest.example: She gave an earnest answer to every question from the students.
earnest.exampleZh: 她对学生们提出的每个问题都给出了认真的回答。

earth.example: The earth moves around the sun once every year.

earthquake.example: Many people ran out of their houses when the earthquake began.
earthquake.exampleZh: 地震开始时，许多人跑出了他们的房子。

ease.example: This medicine can ease the pain and help you sleep well.
ease.exampleZh: 这种药能减轻疼痛，帮助你睡个好觉。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and shines on our small village.
east.exampleZh: 太阳从东方升起，照耀着我们的小村庄。

eastern.example: The eastern part of the city has many old temples and small shops.
eastern.exampleZh: 这座城市的东部有许多古老的寺庙和小商店。

eastward.example: The birds fly eastward every autumn to find warmer weather.
eastward.exampleZh: 这些鸟每年秋天都向东飞，去寻找更温暖的天气。

easy.example: This easy English book is good for new students.
easy.exampleZh: 这本简单的英语书适合新学生。

eat.example: We usually eat rice and vegetables for lunch at home.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常在家吃米饭和蔬菜当午饭。

eavesdrop.example: She often eavesdrops on her neighbors when they talk in the yard.
eavesdrop.exampleZh: 邻居在院子里说话时，她常常偷听。

ebb.example: As the tide began to ebb, the fishermen pulled their boats back to the shore.
ebb.exampleZh: 潮水开始退去时，渔民们把船拉回了岸边。

eccentric.example: Our neighbor is an eccentric old man who talks to his plants every morning.
eccentric.exampleZh: 我们的邻居是个古怪的老人，每天早上都跟他的植物说话。

eccentricity.example: His eccentricity made the quiet office a much more interesting place to work.
eccentricity.exampleZh: 他的古怪让这个安静的办公室成了一个工作起来有趣得多的地方。

echo.example: The echo of his voice came back from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 他的声音的回声从空荡荡的大厅里传了回来。

eclecticism.example: Her design shows eclecticism because she mixes old and new styles together.
eclecticism.exampleZh: 她的设计体现出折衷主义，因为她将新旧风格融合在一起。

eclipse.example: The moon will pass in front of the sun and cause a total eclipse tomorrow.
eclipse.exampleZh: 月亮明天会运行到太阳前面，造成一次日全食。

ecology.example: Students study ecology to learn how living things depend on each other.
ecology.exampleZh: 学生们学习生态学，以了解生物之间如何相互依存。

economic.example: The country has seen strong economic growth over the past ten years.
economic.exampleZh: 这个国家在过去十年里经历了强劲的经济增长。

economical.example: This small car is economical and easy to park in the city.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车很经济实惠，而且在城市里容易停放。

economics.example: She studies economics at a small university near her home.
economics.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习经济学。

economist.example: The economist explained why prices are rising so fast this year.
economist.exampleZh: 这位经济学家解释了今年物价为何上涨得如此之快。

economize.example: We try to economize by cooking at home instead of eating out.
economize.exampleZh: 我们尽量在家做饭而不外出就餐，以节省开支。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing slowly, but many families still save money.
economy.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济正在缓慢增长，但许多家庭仍然存钱。

ecosystem.example: Pollution is harming the ecosystem of this small lake.
ecosystem.exampleZh: 污染正在损害这个小湖的生态系统。

edge.example: She sat on the edge of the bed and smiled.

edible.example: These small red berries are edible, but they do not taste very good.
edible.exampleZh: 这些红色的小浆果是可食用的，但味道不太好。

edifice.example: The old library is a beautiful edifice of stone and glass.
edifice.exampleZh: 那座旧图书馆是一座由石头和玻璃建成的美丽宏伟建筑。

edit.example: She will edit the video before we share it online.
edit.exampleZh: 她会在我们分享到网上之前剪辑这段视频。

edition.example: This is the new edition of my favorite book.
edition.exampleZh: 这是我最喜欢的那本书的新版本。

editor.example: The editor read my story and fixed a few small mistakes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并改正了几处小错误。

educate.example: Teachers educate children to be kind and careful.
educate.exampleZh: 老师教育孩子们要友善和细心。

education.example: A good education can open many doors for young people.
education.exampleZh: 良好的教育能为年轻人打开许多扇门。

educational.example: This educational video teaches children about animals in a fun way.
educational.exampleZh: 这部有教育意义的视频以有趣的方式教孩子们认识动物。

effect.example: The new rule had a big effect on how we work.
effect.exampleZh: 新规定对我们的工作方式产生了很大影响。

effective.example: This medicine is very effective for a bad cough.
effective.exampleZh: 这种药对严重咳嗽非常有效。

efficacy.example: Doctors are still testing the efficacy of this new drug on patients.
efficacy.exampleZh: 医生仍在患者身上测试这种新药的效力。

efficiency.example: The new machine improved our work efficiency by a large amount.
efficiency.exampleZh: 这台新机器大幅提高了我们的工作效率。

efficient.example: She is an efficient worker who finishes every task on time.
efficient.exampleZh: 她是一名高效的员工，每项任务都能按时完成。

effluent.example: The factory must clean its effluent before it flows into the river.
effluent.exampleZh: 工厂必须在废水流入河流之前对其进行净化处理。

effort.example: Her hard work and effort helped the team win the game.
effort.exampleZh: 她的辛勤努力帮助球队赢得了比赛。

egalitarian.example: She believes in an egalitarian society where everyone has the same rights.
egalitarian.exampleZh: 她相信一个每个人都享有同等权利的平等主义社会。

egg.example: The little boy ate a boiled egg with salt for breakfast.
egg.exampleZh: 那个小男孩早餐吃了一个加盐的水煮蛋。

eggshell.example: The little bird broke out of its eggshell this morning.
eggshell.exampleZh: 小鸟今天早上破壳而出了。

ego.example: His ego was hurt when nobody praised his new idea.
ego.exampleZh: 当没有人称赞他的新想法时，他的自尊心受到了伤害。

egoism.example: His egoism made it hard for him to keep any real friends.
egoism.exampleZh: 他的利己主义让他很难交到真正的朋友。

eight.example: My little sister is eight years old and loves to draw.

eighteen.example: My sister is eighteen years old and she studies at a big school.
eighteen.exampleZh: 我姐姐十八岁，她在一所大学校读书。

eighth.example: She lives on the eighth floor of that old building.
eighth.exampleZh: 她住在那栋旧楼的第八层。

eighty.example: My grandmother is eighty years old and still walks to the park every morning.
eighty.exampleZh: 我的祖母八十岁了，仍然每天早上步行去公园。

either.example: You can take either of the two books, but not both.
either.exampleZh: 这两本书你可以任选一本，但不能两本都拿。

eject.example: The machine will eject the empty cup and then stop working.
eject.exampleZh: 机器会弹出空杯子，然后停止工作。

elaborate.example: She made an elaborate cake for her son's birthday party.
elaborate.exampleZh: 她为儿子的生日派对做了一个精致的蛋糕。

elapse.example: Several hours elapsed before we finally found the right road.
elapse.exampleZh: 几个小时过去了，我们才终于找到正确的路。

elapsed.example: Ten minutes had elapsed before the bus finally arrived.
elapsed.exampleZh: 十分钟过去了，公交车才终于到站。

elastic.example: The waistband of these pants is elastic and very comfortable to wear.
elastic.exampleZh: 这条裤子的腰带有弹性，穿起来很舒服。

elasticity.example: The elasticity of this rubber band makes it easy to stretch.
elasticity.exampleZh: 这条橡皮筋的弹性使它很容易被拉伸。

elation.example: She felt great elation when she heard the good news.
elation.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她感到无比高兴。

elbow.example: He hurt his elbow when he fell off the bike yesterday.
elbow.exampleZh: 他昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤了肘部。

elder.example: My elder sister always helps me with my homework after school.
elder.exampleZh: 我姐姐总是在放学后帮我做作业。

elderly.example: The elderly man needs help carrying his bags up the stairs.
elderly.exampleZh: 那位年长的男士需要有人帮他把包提上楼。

elect.example: The people will elect a new leader next week.
elect.exampleZh: 人们将在下周选举一位新领导人。

election.example: The election will be held next month and everyone can vote.
election.exampleZh: 选举将在下个月举行，每个人都可以投票。

electorate.example: The electorate will vote for a new mayor next week.
electorate.exampleZh: 选民全体将在下周投票选举新市长。

electric.example: My parents bought a new electric car last week and they love it.
electric.exampleZh: 我父母上周买了一辆新的电动汽车，他们很喜欢它。

electrical.example: This old building has an electrical problem, so we need a good electrician today.
electrical.exampleZh: 这栋老房子有电路问题，所以今天我们需要一位好电工。

electricity.example: We use electricity every day to light our homes and charge our phones.
electricity.exampleZh: 我们每天都用电来照亮家里、给手机充电。

electron.example: An electron is a very small particle that moves around the center of an atom.
electron.exampleZh: 电子是一种非常小的粒子，它围绕原子中心运动。

electronic.example: My father bought a new electronic dictionary for my English study.
electronic.exampleZh: 我父亲为我的英语学习买了一本新的电子词典。

elegant.example: She wore an elegant dress to the party last night.
elegant.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条优雅的连衣裙去参加聚会。

element.example: Water is an important element of life on Earth.
element.exampleZh: 水是地球上生命的一个重要元素。

elementary.example: My son learns reading and math at the elementary school near our home.
elementary.exampleZh: 我儿子在我们家附近的小学学习阅读和数学。

elephant.example: The elephant drank water from the river with its long trunk.
elephant.exampleZh: 那头大象用长长的鼻子在河里喝水。

elevate.example: We can elevate the box with a small rope.
elevate.exampleZh: 我们可以用一根小绳子把那个箱子举起来。

elevation.example: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters above the sea.
elevation.exampleZh: 这个村庄位于海拔两千米的高处。

elevator.example: We took the elevator to the tenth floor because the stairs were too slow.
elevator.exampleZh: 我们乘电梯到了十楼，因为走楼梯太慢了。

elicit.example: The teacher asked a few simple questions to elicit answers from the shy students.
elicit.exampleZh: 老师问了几个简单的问题，以引出害羞学生们的回答。

eligible.example: She is eligible to apply for the job after one year.
eligible.exampleZh: 一年后她就有资格申请这份工作了。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate the bad habits that waste our time.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消除那些浪费时间的坏习惯。

elimination.example: The elimination of waste from the factory helped protect the local river.
elimination.exampleZh: 消除工厂的废弃物有助于保护当地的河流。

elite.example: Only a few elite players can join this famous team.
elite.exampleZh: 只有少数精英球员才能加入这支著名的球队。

elk.example: We saw a large elk standing quietly near the river in the park.
elk.exampleZh: 我们看到一只大麋鹿静静地站在公园的河边。

ellipse.example: The orbit of the planet is not a perfect circle but an ellipse.
ellipse.exampleZh: 这颗行星的轨道不是一个完美的圆，而是一个椭圆。

elm.example: An old elm grows beside the river near my house.
elm.exampleZh: 我家附近的河边长着一棵老榆树。

else.example: If this shirt is too small, please try something else.
else.exampleZh: 如果这件衬衫太小，请试试别的。

elsewhere.example: I looked for my keys here, but they must be elsewhere.
elsewhere.exampleZh: 我在这里找过钥匙，但它们肯定在别处。

elusive.example: The exact meaning of this old poem remains elusive to most readers.
elusive.exampleZh: 这首古老诗篇的确切含义对大多数读者来说仍然难以捉摸。

embark.example: She will embark on a new journey next week with her best friend.
embark.exampleZh: 她下周将和她最好的朋友开始一段新的旅程。

embarrass.example: His silly question embarrassed the teacher in front of the whole class.
embarrass.exampleZh: 他那个愚蠢的问题让老师在全班面前很尴尬。

embarrassment.example: She felt great embarrassment when she forgot his name.
embarrassment.exampleZh: 她忘记他的名字时感到非常尴尬。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to get a visa for her trip.
embassy.exampleZh: 她去大使馆办理旅行签证。

embed.example: The teacher used songs to embed new words in our minds.
embed.exampleZh: 老师用歌曲把新单词牢牢嵌入我们的脑中。

embody.example: These old songs embody the spirit of our small town.
embody.exampleZh: 这些老歌体现了我们小镇的精神。

embrace.example: She learned to embrace new ideas and change her old habits.
embrace.exampleZh: 她学会了接受新想法并改变旧习惯。

embryo.example: The embryo grows slowly inside the egg and needs warmth.
embryo.exampleZh: 胚胎在蛋内缓慢生长，需要温暖。

emerge.example: New problems emerge when the old rules stop working.
emerge.exampleZh: 当旧规则不再起作用时，新问题就会出现。

emergence.example: The emergence of new ideas often changes the world.
emergence.exampleZh: 新思想的出现常常会改变世界。

emergency.example: In an emergency, call the police and stay calm.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况时，打电话报警并保持冷静。

emigrate.example: My uncle emigrated to Australia with his family last year.
emigrate.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年和家人移居到了澳大利亚。

emission.example: The factory must cut its carbon emissions to protect the air we breathe.
emission.exampleZh: 这家工厂必须减少碳排放，以保护我们呼吸的空气。

emit.example: The old factory emits thick smoke into the air every day.
emit.exampleZh: 这家老工厂每天都向空气中排放浓烟。

emotion.example: She could not hide the strong emotion in her voice.
emotion.exampleZh: 她无法掩饰声音里强烈的情绪。

emotional.example: She got emotional when she talked about her old school friends.
emotional.exampleZh: 她谈到老同学时情绪激动起来。

emphasis.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on reading English every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 我们老师非常强调每天读英语。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师经常强调每天阅读的重要性。

emphatic.example: She was emphatic that the meeting must start on time.
emphatic.exampleZh: 她强调会议必须准时开始。

empire.example: The old empire grew rich through trade and strong armies.
empire.exampleZh: 这个古老的帝国通过贸易和强大的军队变得富有。

empirical.example: This empirical study shows that sleep improves memory.
empirical.exampleZh: 这项实证研究表明睡眠能改善记忆。

employ.example: The company plans to employ more young people in its new factory.
employ.exampleZh: 这家公司计划在其新工厂雇用更多年轻人。

employee.example: Every new employee gets a short training course in the first week.
employee.exampleZh: 每位新员工在第一周都会参加一个短期培训课程。

employer.example: My employer gave everyone a day off after the busy season.
employer.exampleZh: 忙碌的季节过后，我的雇主给每个人放了一天假。

employment.example: Finding employment after graduation can be hard for many young people.
employment.exampleZh: 毕业后找到工作对许多年轻人来说可能很难。

empowerment.example: Education gives women empowerment and a stronger voice in their communities.
empowerment.exampleZh: 教育赋予女性权能，让她们在社区中拥有更强的发言权。

enable.example: This new tool enables students to learn English more easily at home.
enable.exampleZh: 这个新工具使学生在家学英语更容易了。

enactment.example: The enactment of the new law helped many poor families.
enactment.exampleZh: 新法律的颁布帮助了许多贫困家庭。

enamel.example: The old cup is made of enamel and has a small crack.
enamel.exampleZh: 这个旧杯子是搪瓷做的，上面有一道小裂纹。

enchant.example: The beautiful music seemed to enchant everyone in the small room.
enchant.exampleZh: 那美妙的音乐似乎让小屋里的每个人都陶醉了。

enchantment.example: The old garden had a quiet enchantment that made everyone want to stay.
enchantment.exampleZh: 那座古老的花园有一种宁静的魅力，让每个人都想留下来。

enclose.example: Please enclose your photo with the form and send it to us.
enclose.exampleZh: 请随表格附上你的照片，一并寄给我们。

enclosure.example: The sheep were kept safe inside a small wooden enclosure.
enclosure.exampleZh: 羊群被安全地关在一个小木围场里。

encounter.example: Yesterday I had a short encounter with an old friend at the station.
encounter.exampleZh: 昨天我在车站与一位老朋友短暂相遇。

encourage.example: My parents always encourage me to try new things at school.
encourage.exampleZh: 父母总是鼓励我在学校尝试新事物。

encouragement.example: Her words of encouragement gave me the confidence to try again.
encouragement.exampleZh: 她的鼓励让我有勇气再试一次。

end.example: We waited at the end of the long line for the bus.
end.exampleZh: 我们在长长的等公交车队伍的末端等待。

endanger.example: Pollution and hunting endanger many wild animals today.
endanger.exampleZh: 污染和捕猎如今危及许多野生动物。

endangerment.example: Pollution is a serious endangerment to the fish in this river.
endangerment.exampleZh: 污染对这条河里的鱼构成严重危害。

endeavor.example: We will endeavor to finish the report before Friday.
endeavor.exampleZh: 我们将努力在周五前完成这份报告。

endless.example: The long desert road seemed endless to the tired travelers.
endless.exampleZh: 那条漫长的沙漠公路在疲惫的旅人看来似乎没有尽头。

endowment.example: The school used the endowment to build a new library for its students.
endowment.exampleZh: 学校用这笔捐款为学生建了一座新图书馆。

endurance.example: Long-distance running requires great endurance and a strong will.
endurance.exampleZh: 长跑需要极强的忍耐力和坚强的意志。

endure.example: She had to endure a lot of pain after the accident.
endure.exampleZh: 事故发生后，她不得不忍受巨大的疼痛。

enemy.example: The soldiers fought bravely against the enemy and won the battle.
enemy.exampleZh: 士兵们勇敢地与敌军作战并赢得了这场战斗。

energetic.example: My energetic little brother runs and plays outside all day long.
energetic.exampleZh: 我那个精力充沛的小弟弟整天在外面跑跑玩玩。

energy.example: I drink water after running because it gives me more energy.
energy.exampleZh: 我跑步后喝水，因为它给我更多能量。

enforce.example: The school must enforce the new rules every day.
enforce.exampleZh: 学校必须每天执行这些新规定。

enforcement.example: The strict enforcement of the new law helped reduce traffic accidents in our city.
enforcement.exampleZh: 新法律的严格执行有助于减少我们城市的交通事故。

engage.example: She likes to engage in sports after school with her friends.
engage.exampleZh: 她喜欢放学后和朋友们一起参加体育运动。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at a small family dinner last week.
engagement.exampleZh: 他们的订婚消息是在上周一次小型家庭晚餐上宣布的。

engine.example: The engine of the old car stopped working on the way home.
engine.exampleZh: 那辆旧车的发动机在回家的路上熄火了。

engineer.example: My father is a young engineer and he works in a big car factory.
engineer.exampleZh: 我父亲是一位年轻的工程师，他在一家大型汽车厂工作。

engineering.example: My brother studies engineering at a large university near our home.
engineering.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的一所大型大学学习工程学。

enhance.example: Good lighting can enhance the beauty of a small room.
enhance.exampleZh: 良好的照明能提升小房间的美感。

enjoy.example: I enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 我喜欢在晴朗的日子里在公园看书。

enjoyable.example: The trip to the beach was enjoyable for the whole family.
enjoyable.exampleZh: 这次海滩之行对全家人来说都很愉快。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the garden by adding more flowers this spring.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们计划今年春天扩大花园，多种一些花。

enlightenment.example: The teacher's words brought a moment of enlightenment to the whole class.
enlightenment.exampleZh: 老师的话给全班带来了片刻的启发。

enormity.example: The enormity of the crime shocked the whole small town.
enormity.exampleZh: 这桩罪行的穷凶极恶震惊了整个小镇。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal with big ears and a long nose.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种巨大的动物，有大耳朵和长鼻子。

enough.example: We have enough time to finish the work today.
enough.exampleZh: 我们今天有足够的时间完成这项工作。

enquire.example: I called the hotel to enquire about the price of a room.
enquire.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店，询问一个房间的价格。

enquiry.example: I made an enquiry at the front desk about the train times.
enquiry.exampleZh: 我在前台询问了火车的时刻。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your mind and make your life more interesting.
enrich.exampleZh: 阅读好书能丰富你的思想，让你的生活更有趣。

enrichment.example: Reading books is a good way to find enrichment in daily life.
enrichment.exampleZh: 读书是在日常生活中获得充实感的好方法。

enrol.example: New students can enrol at the school office next Monday.
enrol.exampleZh: 新生可以在下星期一去学校办公室登记入学。

enrollment.example: The school sent me a letter about my enrollment in the new class.
enrollment.exampleZh: 学校给我寄了一封信，内容是关于我注册进入新班级的事。

ensue.example: After the heavy rain, a big flood may ensue in the low areas.
ensue.exampleZh: 大雨过后，低洼地区可能接着发生大洪水。

ensure.example: Please check the door to ensure it is locked before you leave.
ensure.exampleZh: 离开前请检查门，确保已经锁好。

entail.example: This job entails a lot of hard work and long hours.
entail.exampleZh: 这份工作需要大量辛苦工作和长时间投入。

enter.example: Please enter your password before you use this new computer.
enter.exampleZh: 请在使用这台新电脑之前输入你的密码。

enterprise.example: She works for a large enterprise that makes computers.
enterprise.exampleZh: 她在一家生产电脑的大型企业工作。

entertain.example: We often entertain our friends at home on weekends.
entertain.exampleZh: 我们周末常常在家里招待朋友。

entertainment.example: We watched some light entertainment on TV after dinner last night.
entertainment.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们在电视上看了一些轻松的娱乐节目。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for music made everyone in the class want to learn more.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让班上每个人都想学得更多。

enthusiast.example: My uncle is a car enthusiast who loves old cars.
enthusiast.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个汽车爱好者，他喜欢老式汽车。

enthusiastic.example: The students were enthusiastic about the new science project.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 学生们对新的科学项目充满热情。

entire.example: She spent the entire day cleaning the house from top to bottom.
entire.exampleZh: 她花了一整天把房子从上到下打扫了一遍。

entitle.example: This ticket will entitle you to a free drink at the show.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票会让你有权在演出时免费获得一杯饮料。

entity.example: Each entity in the database has a unique name and number.
entity.exampleZh: 数据库中的每个实体都有一个唯一的名称和编号。

entrance.example: We waited for her at the main entrance of the school.
entrance.exampleZh: 我们在学校正门入口处等她。

entrant.example: Every entrant must sign in before the race starts.
entrant.exampleZh: 每位参加者都必须在比赛开始前签到。

entrepreneur.example: The young entrepreneur started a small company with only two friends.
entrepreneur.exampleZh: 这位年轻的企业家只和两个朋友一起创办了一家小公司。

entrepreneurial.example: She has a strong entrepreneurial spirit and wants to start her own small business.
entrepreneurial.exampleZh: 她有很强的创业精神，想开一家自己的小公司。

entry.example: The guard checked every entry at the front gate.
entry.exampleZh: 警卫在前门检查每一个进入的人。

environment.example: We should all work together to protect the natural environment.
environment.exampleZh: 我们都应该共同努力保护自然环境。

environmental.example: We must protect the environmental health of our city.
environmental.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们城市的环境健康。

environmentalist.example: The environmentalist asked our school to stop using plastic bags.
environmentalist.exampleZh: 那位环保主义者要求我们学校停止使用塑料袋。

envisage.example: We envisage a small school with more books and friendly teachers.
envisage.exampleZh: 我们设想一所拥有更多书籍和友善老师的小学校。

envoy.example: The king sent an envoy to talk with the leaders of the small country.
envoy.exampleZh: 国王派了一位使节去与那个小国的领导人会谈。

envy.example: She felt envy when her friend won the big prize.
envy.exampleZh: 她的朋友赢得大奖时，她感到嫉妒。

epic.example: The old song tells an epic story about a brave hero and his long journey home.
epic.exampleZh: 这首古老的歌讲述了一个关于勇敢英雄及其漫长归家旅程的史诗故事。

epidemic.example: The flu epidemic spread quickly through the school last winter.
epidemic.exampleZh: 去年冬天，流感疫情在学校里迅速传播。

epidemiology.example: She studies epidemiology at the university and wants to understand how diseases spread.
epidemiology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习流行病学，想要了解疾病是如何传播的。

episode.example: That trip to the mountains was a happy episode in my childhood.
episode.exampleZh: 那次山区之行是我童年中一段快乐的经历。

equal.example: All people are equal and should have the same rights.
equal.exampleZh: 所有人都是平等的，都应拥有相同的权利。

equality.example: We believe that equality at work is important for everyone.
equality.exampleZh: 我们认为工作中的平等对每个人都很重要。

equation.example: Balancing a chemical equation takes time and careful work.
equation.exampleZh: 配平一个化学方程式需要时间和细致的操作。

equator.example: The sun is very hot and bright near the equator.
equator.exampleZh: 在赤道附近，太阳又热又亮。

equip.example: The school will equip every classroom with a new computer next month.
equip.exampleZh: 学校下个月将为每间教室配备一台新电脑。

equipment.example: We bought new equipment for the school gym last week.
equipment.exampleZh: 我们上周为学校体育馆购买了新设备。

equity.example: The company treats all its workers with equity and respect.
equity.exampleZh: 公司公平且尊重地对待所有员工。

equivalent.example: The two answers are equivalent even though the methods look different.
equivalent.exampleZh: 尽管方法看起来不同，这两个答案是相等的。

era.example: The internet changed the way people live in this new era.
era.exampleZh: 互联网在这个新时代改变了人们的生活方式。

eradicate.example: Scientists are working hard to eradicate this disease from the world.
eradicate.exampleZh: 科学家们正在努力从世界上根除这种疾病。

erase.example: Please erase the old words on the board before class.
erase.exampleZh: 请在课前擦掉黑板上的旧字。

erect.example: They will erect a new school near the park next year.
erect.exampleZh: 他们明年将在公园附近建一所新学校。

erode.example: Waves slowly erode the rocks along this coast.
erode.exampleZh: 海浪慢慢侵蚀着这片海岸的岩石。

erosion.example: Wind and rain cause erosion of the soil on the hill.
erosion.exampleZh: 风雨造成了山上土壤的侵蚀。

erotic.example: The movie has some erotic scenes that are not suitable for children.
erotic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一些不适合儿童的色情场景。

err.example: Everyone can err, so we should learn from our mistakes.
err.exampleZh: 每个人都会犯错，所以我们应该从错误中学习。

error.example: The teacher found one small error in my homework yesterday.
error.exampleZh: 老师昨天在我的作业里发现了一个小错误。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the villagers left their homes.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山随时可能喷发，因此村民们离开了家。

eruption.example: The volcano eruption forced many people to leave their homes quickly.
eruption.exampleZh: 火山喷发迫使许多人迅速离开家园。

escape.example: The bird escaped from its cage and flew away.
escape.exampleZh: 那只鸟从笼子里逃了出来，飞走了。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橙子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer trip for the school magazine.
essay.exampleZh: 她为学校杂志写了一篇关于暑假旅行的短文。

essence.example: The essence of her idea is very simple and easy to understand.
essence.exampleZh: 她这个想法的本质非常简单，容易理解。

essential.example: Clean water is essential for every person and every family.
essential.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每个人、每个家庭都是必不可少的。

essentially.example: The two plans are essentially the same, so we can choose either one.
essentially.exampleZh: 这两个计划基本上是相同的，所以我们可以任选一个。

establish.example: The school plans to establish a new library next year.
establish.exampleZh: 学校计划明年建一座新图书馆。

establishment.example: The establishment of the new school took two years.
establishment.exampleZh: 新学校的建立花了两年时间。

estate.example: His family owns a large estate in the countryside.
estate.exampleZh: 他的家族在乡下拥有一座大庄园。

esthetic.example: Her esthetic taste makes the small room feel calm and beautiful.
esthetic.exampleZh: 她的审美品味让这个小房间显得宁静而美丽。

estimate.example: We estimate that the trip will take about three hours by car.
estimate.exampleZh: 我们估计开车这趟大约需要三个小时。

eternal.example: Their eternal love for each other never faded over the years.
eternal.exampleZh: 他们对彼此永恒的爱从未随着岁月消退。

ethic.example: Honesty is an important ethic in every kind of business.
ethic.exampleZh: 诚实是各行各业都重要的道德准则。

ethical.example: It is not ethical to test new medicine on people without their permission.
ethical.exampleZh: 未经他人许可就在人身上测试新药是不道德的。

ethics.example: She studies ethics at university and wants to help people make better choices.
ethics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习伦理学，想帮助人们做出更好的选择。

ethnic.example: This city is home to many ethnic groups who speak different languages.
ethnic.exampleZh: 这座城市居住着许多讲不同语言的民族群体。

etiquette.example: Good etiquette means saying please and thank you to everyone.
etiquette.exampleZh: 良好的礼仪意味着对每个人都说请和谢谢。

evacuate.example: The teacher told the students to evacuate the building when the fire alarm rang.
evacuate.exampleZh: 火警响起时，老师让学生们撤离大楼。

evacuation.example: The fire alarm led to a quick evacuation of the whole school.
evacuation.exampleZh: 火警导致全校师生迅速疏散。

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate our work at the end of each term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评估我们的作业。

evaluation.example: The teacher gave a fair evaluation of each student's work.
evaluation.exampleZh: 老师对每位学生的作业给出了公正的评价。

even.example: The road is even, and the number four is even too.
even.exampleZh: 这条路很平坦，数字四也是偶数。

evening.example: We usually take a walk after dinner in the evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们通常晚饭后在傍晚散步。

evenly.example: Please spread the butter evenly on the bread.
evenly.exampleZh: 请把黄油均匀地涂在面包上。

event.example: The school will hold a sports event next week.
event.exampleZh: 学校下周将举办一场体育活动。

eventually.example: After many tries, he eventually found the key under the old chair.
eventually.exampleZh: 试了很多次之后，他最终在那把旧椅子下面找到了钥匙。

ever.example: This is the best movie I have ever seen in my life.
ever.exampleZh: 这是我这辈子看过的最好的电影。

evergreen.example: Pine trees are evergreen and stay green all year round.
evergreen.exampleZh: 松树是常绿植物，一年四季都保持绿色。

every.example: Every student in our class has a new English book.
every.exampleZh: 我们班的每个学生都有一本新的英语书。

everybody.example: Everybody in our class likes the new teacher very much.
everybody.exampleZh: 我们班每个人都很喜欢这位新老师。

everyday.example: Reading a book is part of my everyday routine before bed.
everyday.exampleZh: 睡前读书是我每天例行的事情之一。

everyone.example: Everyone in the class likes the new teacher very much.
everyone.exampleZh: 班上每个人都很喜欢这位新老师。

everything.example: She told me everything about her trip to the small town.
everything.exampleZh: 她把去那个小镇旅行的一切都告诉了我。

everywhere.example: There were small flowers everywhere in the garden after the rain.
everywhere.exampleZh: 雨后花园里到处都开着小花。

evidence.example: There is no evidence that he took the money.
evidence.exampleZh: 没有证据表明他拿了那笔钱。

evident.example: It is evident that she enjoys teaching young children every day.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她每天都喜欢教小孩子。

evidently.example: The door was open, so evidently someone had come home early.
evidently.exampleZh: 门开着，所以显然有人提前回家了。

evil.example: In the story, the evil king brought hunger and fear to the whole land.
evil.exampleZh: 在故事里，那个邪恶的国王给整个土地带来了饥饿和恐惧。

evolution.example: The evolution of the internet has changed how people live and work.
evolution.exampleZh: 互联网的演变改变了人们的生活和工作方式。

evolutionary.example: The long neck of a giraffe is an evolutionary change over many years.
evolutionary.exampleZh: 长颈鹿的长脖子是经过很多年形成的进化变化。

evolve.example: Small ideas can evolve into big changes over time.
evolve.exampleZh: 小想法会随着时间逐步发展成巨大的变化。

exact.example: Please tell me the exact time of the meeting tomorrow.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我明天会议的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: She tends to exaggerate how hard her job is.
exaggerate.exampleZh: 她总爱夸大自己工作有多难。

exaggeration.example: Her story about the fish was a clear exaggeration that made everyone laugh.
exaggeration.exampleZh: 她关于那条鱼的故事明显是夸大其词，把大家都逗笑了。

exam.example: I have a math exam tomorrow morning, so I need to study tonight.
exam.exampleZh: 我明天上午有一场数学考试，所以今晚需要复习。

examination.example: The doctor gave him a careful examination and said he was fine.
examination.exampleZh: 医生给他做了仔细的检查，并说他没事。

examine.example: The doctor will examine my eyes this afternoon.
examine.exampleZh: 医生今天下午会检查我的眼睛。

example.example: Our teacher gave us a clear example to help us understand the new word.
example.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一个清晰的例子，帮助我们理解这个新单词。

exceed.example: The final cost may exceed our budget by a small amount.
exceed.exampleZh: 最终成本可能会比我们的预算超出一小部分。

exceedingly.example: The test was exceedingly difficult for most of the students in our class.
exceedingly.exampleZh: 这次考试对我们班大多数学生来说极其困难。

excel.example: She excels at math and always helps her classmates with difficult problems.
excel.exampleZh: 她擅长数学，总是帮助同学解决难题。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher and all her students like her.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，她所有的学生都喜欢她。

except.example: Everyone went to the party except Tom, who stayed home sick.
except.exampleZh: 除了生病待在家里的汤姆，所有人都去参加了聚会。

exception.example: Everyone must follow the rules, and there is no exception for anyone.
exception.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守规则，任何人都没有例外。

exceptional.example: Her performance in the school play was truly exceptional for a young student.
exceptional.exampleZh: 她在学校戏剧中的表演对一个年轻学生来说确实非常出色。

excess.example: Eating too much sugar can cause an excess of fat in the body.
excess.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会导致体内脂肪过量。

excessive.example: The teacher said that excessive noise in class makes it hard to focus.
excessive.exampleZh: 老师说课堂上过多的吵闹会让人难以集中注意力。

excessively.example: He exercises excessively and often feels very tired after work.
excessively.exampleZh: 他过度锻炼，下班后经常感到很累。

exchange.example: We often exchange ideas and help each other at work.
exchange.exampleZh: 我们在工作中经常交换想法并互相帮助。

excite.example: The good news will excite the children before the trip.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息会在旅行前让孩子们兴奋起来。
