excited.example: The little children were very excited when they saw the big birthday cake.
excited.exampleZh: 小孩子们看到那个大生日蛋糕时非常兴奋。

excitement.example: The children jumped with excitement when they saw the new puppy.
excitement.exampleZh: 孩子们看到新小狗时兴奋得跳了起来。

exciting.example: The football match was very exciting, and we all cheered loudly.
exciting.exampleZh: 那场足球比赛非常令人兴奋，我们都大声欢呼。

exclaim.example: She looked at the gift and exclaimed with joy at how beautiful it was.
exclaim.exampleZh: 她看着礼物，惊喜地大声说它多么漂亮。

exclude.example: The teacher will exclude bad apples from the game today.
exclude.exampleZh: 老师今天会把捣乱的学生排除在游戏之外。

exclusion.example: His exclusion from the team surprised everyone who knew him.
exclusion.exampleZh: 他被排除在队伍之外，这让所有认识他的人都感到惊讶。

exclusive.example: The club has an exclusive area for its members only.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这家俱乐部有一个仅供会员使用的专属区域。

exclusively.example: This room is used exclusively for meetings and quiet study.
exclusively.exampleZh: 这个房间专门用于开会和安静学习。

excursion.example: We went on a short excursion to the mountains last weekend.
excursion.exampleZh: 上周末我们去山里做了一次短途旅行。

excuse.example: His excuse for being late was not very believable.
excuse.exampleZh: 他迟到的借口不太可信。

execute.example: The team will execute the plan next week.
execute.exampleZh: 团队将在下周执行这个计划。

execution.example: The execution of the plan took two weeks.
execution.exampleZh: 该计划的执行用了两周时间。

executive.example: The chief executive will meet the new managers this morning.
executive.exampleZh: 首席执行官今天上午将会见新来的经理们。

exemplify.example: These three students exemplify the hard work we want to see.
exemplify.exampleZh: 这三位学生正是我们希望看到的勤奋努力的典型。

exercise.example: I do some exercise every morning before I go to work.
exercise.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会做一些锻炼。

exert.example: Doctors say exercise can exert a good influence on your mood.
exert.exampleZh: 医生说运动可以对你的情绪产生良好的影响。

exhaust.example: The long meeting exhausted everyone, and the car's exhaust filled the garage.
exhaust.exampleZh: 漫长的会议让每个人都精疲力尽，而汽车的废气充满了车库。

exhaustion.example: After the long race, she fell asleep from pure exhaustion.
exhaustion.exampleZh: 长跑之后，她因精疲力竭而睡着了。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit many old photos next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将展出许多老照片。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition last Sunday and saw many beautiful paintings.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周日我们去看了一个艺术展览，看到了许多美丽的画作。

exhilarating.example: The roller coaster ride was so exhilarating that we wanted to go again.
exhilarating.exampleZh: 过山车太刺激了，我们还想再玩一次。

exist.example: Many old trees exist in the forest behind our small village.
exist.exampleZh: 我们小村庄后面的森林里生长着许多老树。

existence.example: Many scientists believe in the existence of life on other planets.
existence.exampleZh: 许多科学家相信其他行星上存在生命。

existing.example: We need to improve the existing system before we add new features.
existing.exampleZh: 我们需要在添加新功能之前改进现有系统。

exit.example: Please use the back exit because the front door is closed today.
exit.exampleZh: 请走后面的出口，因为前门今天关着。

exodus.example: The war caused a mass exodus of families from the city.
exodus.exampleZh: 战争导致大批家庭撤离这座城市。

exotic.example: She likes to cook exotic food from other countries.
exotic.exampleZh: 她喜欢烹饪来自其他国家的异国风味食物。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into two new cities this year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划今年将业务扩展到两个新城市。

expansion.example: The company's rapid expansion created many new jobs in our town.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张在我们镇上创造了许多新的工作岗位。

expect.example: We expect good weather for the trip tomorrow.
expect.exampleZh: 我们预计明天旅行时天气会不错。

expectation.example: Her parents have high expectations for her grades this year.
expectation.exampleZh: 她的父母对她今年的成绩抱有很高的期望。

expedition.example: The expedition to the mountains took three weeks and was very hard.
expedition.exampleZh: 这次山区探险花了三周时间，非常艰难。

expel.example: The school decided to expel the student for breaking the rules.
expel.exampleZh: 学校决定因该学生违反规定而将其开除。

expend.example: We expend too much time on small problems at work.
expend.exampleZh: 我们在工作上的小问题上花费了太多时间。

expenditure.example: Our monthly expenditure on food is higher than last year.
expenditure.exampleZh: 我们每月在食物上的支出比去年高。

expense.example: The trip was a big expense, but we enjoyed it very much.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行是一笔很大的开支，但我们玩得很开心。

expensive.example: This watch is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这块手表太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教小孩子方面有很多经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in the science class today.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们今天在科学课上做了一个简单的实验。

experimental.example: The school is testing an experimental program for young students.
experimental.exampleZh: 这所学校正在测试一个面向低年级学生的试验性项目。

experimentation.example: Careful experimentation led the team to a safer and better design.
experimentation.exampleZh: 细致的实验使团队得到了更安全、更好的设计。

expert.example: My uncle is an expert in fixing old cars.
expert.exampleZh: 我叔叔是修理老旧汽车的专家。

expertise.example: Her expertise in computer science helped the team finish the project on time.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学方面的专业知识帮助团队按时完成了项目。

explain.example: Can you explain this word to me in simple English?
explain.exampleZh: 你能用简单的英语给我解释一下这个词吗？

explanation.example: He gave a clear explanation of the rules to the new students.
explanation.exampleZh: 他给新学生清楚地解释了这些规则。

explicit.example: Her instructions were explicit, so everyone knew exactly what to do.
explicit.exampleZh: 她的指示很明确，所以每个人都知道该做什么。

explicitly.example: The teacher explicitly told us which chapters to read for the test.
explicitly.exampleZh: 老师明确地告诉了我们考试要考哪几章。

explode.example: The old car's engine exploded on the highway yesterday.
explode.exampleZh: 那辆旧车的发动机昨天在高速公路上爆炸了。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by making them work long hours.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过让年轻工人长时间工作来剥削他们。

exploitation.example: The exploitation of the forest must be done in a careful way.
exploitation.exampleZh: 对这片森林的开发必须以谨慎的方式进行。

exploration.example: Space exploration helps us learn more about the planets and stars.
exploration.exampleZh: 太空探索帮助我们更多地了解行星和恒星。

explore.example: We will explore the forest near our school this weekend.
explore.exampleZh: 这个周末我们将探索学校附近的森林。

explosion.example: The explosion broke several windows in the old building.
explosion.exampleZh: 那次爆炸震碎了那栋旧楼的几扇窗户。

explosive.example: The police found explosive materials in the old building yesterday.
explosive.exampleZh: 警方昨天在那栋旧楼里发现了爆炸性材料。

export.example: The country exports coffee to many nations and imports machines.
export.exampleZh: 这个国家向许多国家出口咖啡，并进口机器。

exporter.example: The exporter sends fresh fruit to many countries every year.
exporter.exampleZh: 这家出口商每年向许多国家发送新鲜水果。

expose.example: This job will expose you to many new ideas and people.
expose.exampleZh: 这份工作会让你接触到许多新想法和新的人。

exposure.example: Too much exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 过度暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

express.example: I cannot express how happy I am to see you today.
express.exampleZh: 我无法表达今天见到你我有多开心。

expression.example: Her expression changed when she heard the good news.
expression.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她的表情变了。

expressive.example: Her expressive face shows every feeling, so we always know what she thinks.
expressive.exampleZh: 她富于表现力的脸会流露出每一种情绪，所以我们总能知道她在想什么。

exquisite.example: She wore an exquisite dress to the party last night.
exquisite.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条精美的连衣裙去参加聚会。

extend.example: They plan to extend the road to the next town.
extend.exampleZh: 他们计划把这条路延伸到下一个镇。

extension.example: The library is adding a new extension to give students more study space.
extension.exampleZh: 图书馆正在增建一个新的扩建部分，为学生提供更多学习空间。

extensive.example: She has extensive knowledge of plants and often helps her friends.
extensive.exampleZh: 她对植物有广泛的了解，经常帮助她的朋友们。

extent.example: To some extent, I agree with your plan.
extent.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的计划。

exterior.example: The exterior of the old house looks very clean and bright.
exterior.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的外观看起来非常干净明亮。

external.example: The external door of the old building is always locked at night.
external.exampleZh: 那栋旧楼的外门夜里总是锁着的。

extinct.example: Many large animals became extinct long before humans built the first cities.
extinct.exampleZh: 许多大型动物早在人类建造第一批城市之前就已灭绝。

extinction.example: Many animals are in danger of extinction because their homes are being destroyed.
extinction.exampleZh: 许多动物正面临灭绝的危险，因为它们的家园正在被破坏。

extra.example: The hotel charges extra for breakfast, but the room is very clean.
extra.exampleZh: 酒店早餐要额外收费，但房间非常干净。

extract.example: She used a small tool to extract the juice from the lemon.
extract.exampleZh: 她用一个小工具把柠檬的汁提取出来。

extracurricular.example: My extracurricular activities include playing basketball and joining the school music club.
extracurricular.exampleZh: 我的课外活动包括打篮球和参加学校音乐社团。

extraordinary.example: Her work on the project was extraordinary and everyone praised it.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的工作非常出色，大家都称赞她。

extravagant.example: He is too extravagant and buys things he does not need.
extravagant.exampleZh: 他太挥霍了，买了很多不需要的东西。

extreme.example: His extreme ideas often surprise the people around him.
extreme.exampleZh: 他极端的想法常常让周围的人感到惊讶。

extremely.example: The test was extremely hard, so most students could not finish it.
extremely.exampleZh: 这次考试极其难，所以大多数学生都无法完成。

eye.example: She closed her eyes and listened to the soft music.
eye.exampleZh: 她闭上眼睛，听着轻柔的音乐。

eye-catching.example: The bright red sign was eye-catching and easy to see from the road.
eye-catching.exampleZh: 那块鲜红色的招牌很醒目，从马路上很容易看到。

eyesight.example: Good eyesight helps you read small words in a book.
eyesight.exampleZh: 良好的视力能帮助你读清书上的小字。

fable.example: My grandmother told me an old fable about a clever fox.
fable.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于聪明狐狸的古老寓言。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of this shirt feels good on my skin.
fabric.exampleZh: 这件衬衫柔软的面料贴在皮肤上感觉很舒服。

fabricate.example: He tried to fabricate a story about where he was that night.
fabricate.exampleZh: 他试图编造一个关于那天晚上他在哪里的说法。

fabrication.example: The story about the lost money was a complete fabrication.
fabrication.exampleZh: 那个关于丢钱的story完全是捏造的。

fabulous.example: We had a fabulous time at the beach last weekend.
fabulous.exampleZh: 上周末我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

facade.example: Behind a calm facade, she was actually very nervous about the exam.
facade.exampleZh: 在平静的外表背后，她其实对考试非常紧张。

face.example: Her face turned red when she saw the big surprise.
face.exampleZh: 当她看到这个大惊喜时，她的脸红了。

facet.example: This problem has many facets that we need to study carefully.
facet.exampleZh: 这个问题有许多方面需要我们去仔细研究。

facial.example: She washed her facial skin with warm water every morning.
facial.exampleZh: 她每天早上用温水洗脸部的皮肤。

facilitate.example: Good roads facilitate trade between the two towns.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路促进了两座城镇之间的贸易。

facility.example: The new sports facility has a pool and two tennis courts.
facility.exampleZh: 这座新的体育设施有一个游泳池和两个网球场。

fact.example: It is a fact that water boils at one hundred degrees.
fact.exampleZh: 水在一百度时沸腾，这是一个事实。

faction.example: The party split into two factions after a bitter fight over money.
faction.exampleZh: 在围绕资金的激烈争斗之后，该党分裂成了两个派系。

factor.example: Cost is an important factor when we choose a new car.
factor.exampleZh: 当我们选择新车时，价格是一个重要因素。

factory.example: My father works in a factory that makes cars.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在一家生产汽车的工厂工作。

factual.example: Please give me a factual report about what happened yesterday.
factual.exampleZh: 请给我一份关于昨天所发生事件的真实报告。

faculty.example: She has a real faculty for learning new languages quickly.
faculty.exampleZh: 她有一种快速学习新语言的才能。

fade.example: The old blue shirt will fade in the hot summer sun.
fade.exampleZh: 那件旧蓝衬衫在夏日烈日下会褪色。

fahrenheit.example: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit, so please check the temperature on the box.
fahrenheit.exampleZh: 水在华氏212度沸腾，所以请查看盒子上的温度。

fail.example: If you do not study hard, you may fail the test.
fail.exampleZh: 如果你不努力学习，你可能会考试不及格。

failure.example: His failure to answer the letter made his mother worry a lot.
failure.exampleZh: 他没回信，这让他母亲非常担心。

faint.example: The light in the old room was faint, so I could not see clearly.
faint.exampleZh: 老房间里的灯光很微弱，所以我看不清楚。

faintly.example: I could faintly hear music coming from the room next door.
faintly.exampleZh: 我能隐约听到隔壁房间传来的音乐声。

fair.example: The weather is fair today, so we can walk to the fair.
fair.exampleZh: 今天天气晴朗，所以我们可以步行去集市。

fairly.example: The test was fairly easy, so most students finished it in thirty minutes.
fairly.exampleZh: 这次考试相当简单，所以大多数学生三十分钟内就做完了。

fairy.example: The little girl believes a fairy lives in the garden near her house.
fairy.exampleZh: 小女孩相信她家附近的花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.example: She has great faith in her students and their ability to learn.
faith.exampleZh: 她对学生以及他们的学习能力充满信心。

faithful.example: My dog is a faithful friend who waits for me every day.
faithful.exampleZh: 我的狗是一个忠实的朋友，每天都等着我。

faithfully.example: She faithfully keeps every promise she makes to her friends.
faithfully.exampleZh: 她忠实地遵守她对朋友许下的每一个承诺。

fake.example: He tried to sell a fake watch to my friend yesterday.
fake.exampleZh: 他昨天试图把一块假表卖给我朋友。

fall.example: In autumn, leaves fall from the tall trees in our garden.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天，树叶从我们花园里高大的树上落下。

false.example: The news on that website is false, so do not believe it.
false.exampleZh: 那个网站上的新闻是假的，所以不要相信它。

falsify.example: He tried to falsify the records to hide his mistakes.
falsify.exampleZh: 他试图篡改记录来掩盖自己的错误。

fame.example: He wants fame and money, but his family misses him.
fame.exampleZh: 他想要名声和金钱，但他的家人很想念他。

familiar.example: This song sounds familiar to me, but I cannot remember its name.
familiar.exampleZh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉，但我想不起它的名字。

familiarity.example: Her familiarity with the local roads saved us a lot of time.
familiarity.exampleZh: 她对当地道路的熟悉为我们节省了很多时间。

family.example: My family lives in a small house near the park.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人住在公园附近的一栋小房子里。

famine.example: The war destroyed the crops and caused a serious famine in the north.
famine.exampleZh: 战争毁坏了庄稼，在北方造成了严重的饥荒。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful old bridges and good food.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的古老桥梁和美食而闻名。

fan.example: She waved a paper fan to keep cool in the hot room.
fan.exampleZh: 她在炎热的房间里扇着一把纸扇来降温。

fancy.example: She wore a fancy dress to her friend's birthday party last night.
fancy.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条花哨的连衣裙去参加朋友的生日聚会。

fantastic.example: The view from the top of the hill was fantastic.
fantastic.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色好极了。

fantasy.example: Her fantasy about living on a small island kept her happy.
fantasy.exampleZh: 她关于住在小岛上的幻想让她很快乐。

far.example: The far station is much farther than I thought, so we must leave early.
far.exampleZh: 那个远处的车站比我想的远得多，所以我们得早点出发。

far-reaching.example: The new law had far-reaching effects on how small businesses pay their taxes.
far-reaching.exampleZh: 这项新法律对小企业缴税的方式产生了深远影响。

fare.example: The bus fare is two dollars, and I pay it every morning.
fare.exampleZh: 公交车费是两美元，我每天早上都付这笔钱。

farewell.example: We had a small party to say farewell to our teacher.
farewell.exampleZh: 我们办了一个小型聚会，向老师告别。

farm.example: My uncle grows rice and keeps a few cows on his small farm.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔在他的小农场里种水稻，还养了几头奶牛。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to work on his land.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上早起，在自己的土地上劳作。

farming.example: My grandfather has worked in farming since he was a young boy.
farming.exampleZh: 我祖父从小就从事农业劳动。

fascinate.example: The stars fascinate my little sister, who watches them every night.
fascinate.exampleZh: 星星让我妹妹着迷，她每天晚上都观察它们。

fascinating.example: The old city is a fascinating place for visitors.
fascinating.exampleZh: 这座老城对游客来说是个迷人的地方。

fascism.example: The history class discussed how fascism spread across Europe in the 1930s.
fascism.exampleZh: 历史课上讨论了法西斯主义在20世纪30年代如何蔓延到欧洲。

fashion.example: She always wears clothes that are in fashion this year.
fashion.exampleZh: 她总是穿今年流行的衣服。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: He runs fast, and he is on a fast track to success.
fast.exampleZh: 他跑得很快，而且他正处在通往成功的快车道上。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the car starts moving.
fasten.exampleZh: 汽车开动前请系好安全带。

fat.example: The fat cat sleeps on the warm sofa all afternoon.
fat.exampleZh: 那只胖猫整个下午都睡在温暖的沙发上。

fatal.example: The driver made one fatal mistake and the car crashed.
fatal.exampleZh: 司机犯了一个致命的错误，汽车撞毁了。

fate.example: She believed her fate was already written in the stars.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信她的命运早已写在星辰之中。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike when I was young.
father.exampleZh: 我小时候父亲教我骑自行车。

fatigue.example: After the long trip, he felt a lot of fatigue and went to bed early.
fatigue.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，他感到非常疲劳，于是早早就去睡了。

fault.example: It was my fault that the small machine stopped working.
fault.exampleZh: 那台小机器停止运转是我的过错。

favo(u)rable.example: The weather was favourable for our trip to the beach.
favo(u)rable.exampleZh: 天气对我们去海滩的旅行很有利。

favor.example: She did me a great favor and I will never forget it.
favor.exampleZh: 她帮了我一个大忙，我永远不会忘记。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之行很有利。

favorite.example: My favorite color is blue, and my favorite food is noodles.
favorite.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，我最喜欢的食物是面条。

fear.example: Many people fear the dark when they are young.
fear.exampleZh: 很多人在小时候都害怕黑暗。

feasible.example: It is feasible to finish the work before Friday.
feasible.exampleZh: 在周五之前完成这项工作是可行的。

feast.example: The whole village came together for a great feast after the harvest.
feast.exampleZh: 丰收之后，全村人聚在一起享用了一顿盛宴。

feat.example: Climbing that huge mountain alone was an amazing feat for a young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座大山对一个小男孩来说是一项了不起的壮举。

feather.example: The bird lost a small feather while flying over the garden.
feather.exampleZh: 那只鸟飞过花园时掉落了一根小羽毛。

feature.example: The best feature of this small town is its quiet old streets.
feature.exampleZh: 这个小镇最大的特色是它安静的老街。

february.example: My sister's birthday is in February, and we always have a small party.
february.exampleZh: 我妹妹的生日在二月，我们总会举办一个小派对。

federal.example: The federal government makes laws that all states must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定的法律，所有州都必须遵守。

fee.example: The lawyer charges a high fee for his work.
fee.exampleZh: 这位律师为他的工作收取高额费用。

feeble.example: The old man was too feeble to walk up the stairs alone.
feeble.exampleZh: 这位老人太虚弱了，无法独自走上楼梯。

feed.example: Please feed the cat before you leave for work.
feed.exampleZh: 你出门上班前请喂一下猫。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my essay.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的文章给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I feel happy when I play with my friends after school.
feel.exampleZh: 放学后和朋友们一起玩时，我感到很开心。

feeling.example: I have a strange feeling that someone is watching me.
feeling.exampleZh: 我有一种奇怪的感觉，有人在看着我。

fellow.example: He is a friendly fellow who always helps his neighbors.
fellow.exampleZh: 他是个总是帮助邻居的友好家伙。

female.example: The female doctor helped the sick child feel better.
female.exampleZh: 这位女医生帮助生病的孩子感觉好一些。

feminist.example: She became a feminist after reading about women's rights in college.
feminist.exampleZh: 她在大学读到女性权利的内容后成为了一名女权主义者。

fence.example: The farmer built a wooden fence around his field to keep the sheep in.
fence.exampleZh: 农夫在田地周围建了一道木栅栏，把羊群圈在里面。

ferry.example: We took the ferry across the river to visit the small island.
ferry.exampleZh: 我们乘渡船过河去参观那个小岛。

fertile.example: The soil here is very fertile, so crops grow well.
fertile.exampleZh: 这里的土壤非常肥沃，所以庄稼长得很好。

fertilizer.example: The farmer put fertilizer on his crops to help them grow faster.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 农民给庄稼施了肥料，好让它们长得更快。

festival.example: Our town holds a music festival every summer and many families come to enjoy it.
festival.exampleZh: 我们镇每年夏天都会举办音乐节，许多家庭前来享受。

fetch.example: I will fetch some water for the guests.
fetch.exampleZh: 我去给客人们取些水来。

fever.example: She has a high fever and needs to stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 她发高烧，今天需要卧床休息。

few.example: Few people came to the meeting because of the heavy rain.
few.exampleZh: 因为大雨，很少人来参加会议。

fibre.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables contain a lot of fibre.
fibre.exampleZh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜含有大量纤维。

fiction.example: I like reading fiction before bed because it helps me relax.
fiction.exampleZh: 我喜欢睡前读小说，因为这能帮我放松。

field.example: The farmers work in the field from morning to evening.
field.exampleZh: 农民们从早到晚在田野里劳作。

fierce.example: The dog looked fierce, but it was actually very friendly.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只狗看起来很凶猛，但实际上非常友好。

fifteen.example: The girl is fifteen years old and she plays basketball every day.
fifteen.exampleZh: 这个女孩十五岁，她每天都打篮球。

fifth.example: She finished fifth in the race and won a small prize.
fifth.exampleZh: 她在比赛中获得第五名，赢得了一个小奖品。

fifty.example: My grandfather has lived in this small town for fifty years.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖父已经在这个小镇住了五十年。

fight.example: The two boys began to fight over a toy in the playground.
fight.exampleZh: 两个男孩在操场上为了一个玩具打了起来。

figure.example: The figures on the report show a small rise in sales this year.
figure.exampleZh: 报告上的数字显示今年销售额略有上升。

file.example: Please file these papers in the cabinet before you leave today.
file.exampleZh: 请在今天离开前把这些文件归档到柜子里。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请把杯子装满水，然后再把它放到桌子上。

film.example: We watched a funny film about a small dog at the cinema last night.
film.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在电影院看了一部关于一只小狗的搞笑电影。

filter.example: This water filter removes dirt and makes the water safe to drink.
filter.exampleZh: 这个水过滤器能去除污垢，让水可以安全饮用。

final.example: This is my final answer, so please do not ask me again.
final.exampleZh: 这是我最终的答案，所以请不要再问我了。

finally.example: After a long wait, the train finally arrived at the busy station.
finally.exampleZh: 经过漫长的等待，火车终于抵达了繁忙的车站。

finance.example: The city will finance the new school with money from the state.
finance.exampleZh: 市政府将用州里的资金为这所新学校提供经费。

financial.example: The company has serious financial problems this year.
financial.exampleZh: 这家公司今年有严重的财务问题。

find.example: I cannot find my keys anywhere in this room.
find.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

finding.example: The police published their findings about the accident last week.
finding.exampleZh: 警方上周公布了关于那起事故的调查结果。

fine.example: The judge gave him a fine for parking his car there.
fine.exampleZh: 法官因他把车停在那里而对他处以罚款。

finger.example: She cut her finger while chopping vegetables for dinner last night.
finger.exampleZh: 昨晚她切菜做晚饭时割破了手指。

finish.example: I need to finish my homework before I can watch TV tonight.
finish.exampleZh: 我得先完成作业，今晚才能看电视。

fire.example: The fire burned in the fireplace all night, and they fired him the next day.
fire.exampleZh: 火在壁炉里烧了一整夜，而第二天他们解雇了他。

fireplace.example: The old man sat by the fireplace and read a book.

firm.example: This firm makes good shoes, and its workers are firm in their demands.
firm.exampleZh: 这家公司生产优质鞋子，员工们的诉求也很坚定。

first.example: This is my first day at the new school.
first.exampleZh: 这是我在新学校的第一天。

fiscal.example: The government plans to cut fiscal spending next year to reduce the deficit.
fiscal.exampleZh: 政府计划明年削减财政支出以减少赤字。

fish.example: We caught a big fish in the river yesterday.
fish.exampleZh: 我们昨天在河里抓到了一条大鱼。

fishery.example: The fishery near our town provides work for many local families.
fishery.exampleZh: 我们镇附近的渔场为许多当地家庭提供了工作。

fishing.example: My grandfather goes fishing at the lake every Sunday morning.
fishing.exampleZh: 我爷爷每个星期天早上都去湖边钓鱼。

fit.example: The shoes fit well, so I feel fit and happy today.
fit.exampleZh: 这双鞋很合脚，所以今天我觉得很健康、很开心。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 规律运动对你的体能和健康都很重要。

five.example: My little sister is five years old and starts school this year.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹五岁了，今年开始上学。

fix.example: My father fixed my bike after school yesterday.
fix.exampleZh: 昨天放学后我爸爸把我的自行车修好了。

flag.example: The flag on the school building is red and white.
flag.exampleZh: 学校大楼上的那面旗帜是红白相间的。

flame.example: The flame of the small fire lit up the whole room.
flame.exampleZh: 小火苗的火焰照亮了整个房间。

flash.example: The camera flash was so bright that I closed my eyes quickly.
flash.exampleZh: 相机的闪光灯太亮了，我飞快地闭上了眼睛。

flat.example: The land near the river is flat, and they live in a small flat nearby.
flat.exampleZh: 河边的那片地很平坦，他们就住在附近的一间小公寓里。

flatten.example: The workers flatten the soft ground before they build the new road.
flatten.exampleZh: 工人们在修建新路之前把松软的地面弄平。

flatter.example: He tried to flatter his boss to get a better job.
flatter.exampleZh: 他试图讨好老板，以获得一份更好的工作。

flavo(u)r.example: This soup has a rich flavour, and I will add some salt.
flavo(u)r.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我会加一些盐。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor that my whole family really loves.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我们全家都很喜欢。

flaw.example: The only flaw in this plan is its high cost.
flaw.exampleZh: 这个计划唯一的缺点就是成本太高。

flawless.example: Her English is flawless after years of daily practice.
flawless.exampleZh: 经过多年每日练习，她的英语完美无瑕。

flee.example: The thief tried to flee when he saw the police coming.
flee.exampleZh: 小偷看到警察过来时试图逃跑。

fleet.example: The company has a large fleet of trucks that deliver goods every day.
fleet.exampleZh: 这家公司拥有一支庞大的车队，每天运送货物。

flesh.example: The soft flesh of the fruit tastes sweet in summer.
flesh.exampleZh: 这种水果柔软的果肉在夏天尝起来很甜。

flexibility.example: Yoga can improve your flexibility and help you move more easily.
flexibility.exampleZh: 瑜伽能提高你的灵活性，让你活动起来更轻松。

flexible.example: My work hours are flexible, so I can pick up my kids.
flexible.exampleZh: 我的工作时间很灵活，所以我可以去接孩子。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed by two hours because of heavy snow.
flight.exampleZh: 由于大雪，我们飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

fling.example: He decided to fling the old ball across the wide river.
fling.exampleZh: 他决定把旧球猛扔过宽阔的河。

flip.example: She likes to flip the pages of her book quickly.
flip.exampleZh: 她喜欢快速地翻动书页。

float.example: The leaves float on the quiet water near the old bridge.
float.exampleZh: 树叶漂浮在旧桥附近平静的水面上。

flock.example: A large flock of birds flew over the quiet lake this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早晨一大群鸟飞过了安静的湖面。

flood.example: Heavy rain can cause a flood in low areas of the city.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨可能会在城市低洼地区引发洪水。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

flour.example: She bought a bag of flour to make bread for her family.
flour.exampleZh: 她买了一袋面粉为家人做面包。

flourish.example: Small shops flourish when the streets stay clean and safe.
flourish.exampleZh: 当街道保持干净和安全时，小商店就会繁荣起来。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the small town and brings fresh water.
flow.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流过小镇，带来了新鲜的水。

flower.example: She put a beautiful red flower in a small glass on the table.
flower.exampleZh: 她把一朵美丽的红花插在桌上的小玻璃杯里。

flu.example: My brother had the flu last week and stayed home from school.
flu.exampleZh: 我弟弟上周得了流感，待在家里没去上学。

fluctuate.example: Water levels in the river fluctuate with the seasons.

fluctuation.example: The fluctuation in oil prices makes it hard for small businesses to plan.
fluctuation.exampleZh: 油价的波动使小企业难以做计划。

fluent.example: She is fluent in English and often helps her classmates with homework.
fluent.exampleZh: 她英语流利，经常帮助同学做作业。

fluid.example: Water is a fluid that flows easily, but the situation here stays unstable.
fluid.exampleZh: 水是一种容易流动的流体，但这里的局势仍不稳定。

flush.example: Her face began to flush when the teacher praised her in front of everyone.
flush.exampleZh: 当老师在所有人面前表扬她时，她的脸开始变红。

fly.example: The bird can fly high in the sky, and a fly is on the table.
fly.exampleZh: 鸟能在天空中高飞，桌上有一只苍蝇。

foam.example: The waves left white foam on the sand after they hit the rocks.
foam.exampleZh: 海浪拍打岩石后，在沙滩上留下了白色的泡沫。

focus.example: In class, you should focus on the teacher and take good notes.
focus.exampleZh: 在课堂上，你应该专注于老师，并做好笔记。

fog.example: The thick fog made it hard to see the road ahead.
fog.exampleZh: 浓雾使得前方的道路很难看清。

fold.example: Please fold the letter in half before you put it in the envelope.
fold.exampleZh: 把信对折后再放进信封里。

folk.example: Folk in our town still tell that old story to children.
folk.exampleZh: 我们镇上的人们仍然给孩子们讲那个古老的故事。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我会给你指路。

following.example: Please read the following words and then answer my two questions.
following.exampleZh: 请阅读以下单词，然后回答我的两个问题。

food.example: We need to buy some food and water for the trip.
food.exampleZh: 我们需要为这次旅行买一些食物和水。

fool.example: Don't be a fool and believe everything he says.
fool.exampleZh: 别犯傻，不要相信他说的每一句话。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to go out in such heavy rain.
foolish.exampleZh: 他在这么大的雨里出门，真是太愚蠢了。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk home.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的路回家后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday morning.
football.exampleZh: 我弟弟每个星期六早上都和他的朋友们踢足球。

footstep.example: I heard his footsteps on the stairs and knew he was coming home.
footstep.exampleZh: 我听到楼梯上他的脚步声，就知道他要回家了。

for.example: I bought this book for my sister because she loves reading.
for.exampleZh: 我给妹妹买了这本书，因为她喜欢阅读。

forbid.example: The school forbids students from using their phones during class.
forbid.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

force.example: The strong wind forced us to stay inside the house all day.
force.exampleZh: 强风迫使我们一整天都待在屋里。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost experts on climate change in the world.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是世界上最重要的气候变化专家之一。

foresee.example: We cannot foresee what will happen next year.
foresee.exampleZh: 我们无法预见明年会发生什么。

forest.example: We walked through the forest and saw many tall trees.
forest.exampleZh: 我们穿过森林，看到了许多高大的树。

forever.example: I will always remember my first teacher and her kind words forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我的第一位老师和她说过的那些温暖的话。

forget.example: I often forget my keys at home.
forget.exampleZh: 我经常把钥匙忘在家里。

forgive.example: Please forgive me for being late to your party last night.
forgive.exampleZh: 请原谅我昨晚参加你的聚会迟到了。

fork.example: Please put a fork next to each plate on the table.
fork.exampleZh: 请在桌上的每个盘子旁放一把叉子。

form.example: Please fill out this form and give it to the teacher.
form.exampleZh: 请填写这张表格，然后交给老师。

formal.example: He wore a formal suit to the important meeting yesterday.
formal.exampleZh: 他昨天穿了一套正式的西装去参加那个重要会议。

format.example: Please use the same format for all the pages in this book.
format.exampleZh: 请对这本书的所有页面使用相同的格式。

formation.example: The formation of good habits takes time and daily effort.
formation.exampleZh: 良好习惯的形成需要时间和日常的努力。

former.example: The former teacher still helps students in the small town.
former.exampleZh: 那位以前的老师仍然在小镇上帮助学生们。

formula.example: The team uses a simple formula to solve this kind of math problem.
formula.exampleZh: 团队用一种简单的公式来解决这类数学问题。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a simple plan for the new project.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队将为这个新项目制定一个简单的计划。

forth.example: He stepped forth from the crowd and began to speak.
forth.exampleZh: 他从人群中向前走出，开始讲话。

fortnight.example: We will go on a trip to the beach in a fortnight.
fortnight.exampleZh: 我们两周后要去海滩旅行。

fortunate.example: I feel fortunate to have such kind friends and a loving family.
fortunate.exampleZh: 有这么多善良的朋友和充满爱的家人，我觉得很幸运。

fortunately.example: Fortunately, I found my lost keys under the chair this morning.
fortunately.exampleZh: 幸运的是，今天早上我在椅子下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

fortune.example: He made a large fortune by selling his old house.
fortune.exampleZh: 他通过卖掉旧房子赚了一大笔钱。

forward.example: Please move forward slowly and look at the big screen.
forward.exampleZh: 请慢慢向前移动，并看着大屏幕。

fossil.example: The scientist found an old fish fossil in the rock.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在岩石里发现了一块古老的鱼化石。

foster.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
foster.exampleZh: 好老师培养学生的求知热情。

found.example: They found a small school in the village last year.
found.exampleZh: 他们去年在村里建立了一所小学校。

foundation.example: Good math skills are the foundation of learning science.
foundation.exampleZh: 良好的数学能力是学习科学的基础。

founder.example: The founder of the small school is a kind old teacher.
founder.exampleZh: 这所小学校的创始人是一位和善的老教师。

fountain.example: There is a beautiful fountain in the middle of the park.
fountain.exampleZh: 公园中间有一座漂亮的喷泉。

four.example: The table in our kitchen has four chairs around it.
four.exampleZh: 我们厨房里的那张桌子周围有四把椅子。

frame.example: The old picture frame on the wall broke when it fell down.
frame.exampleZh: 墙上那个旧相框掉下来时摔坏了。

framework.example: The new framework helps teachers plan their lessons more clearly.
framework.exampleZh: 这个新框架帮助教师们更清晰地规划课程。

frank.example: She was frank with me about her mistake.
frank.exampleZh: 她坦率地向我承认了自己的错误。

fraud.example: The man was sent to prison for fraud last year.
fraud.exampleZh: 那名男子去年因欺诈罪被送进监狱。

free.example: The concert is free, so many students will come tonight.
free.exampleZh: 音乐会免费，所以今晚会有很多学生来。

freedom.example: She left her job to enjoy more freedom in her daily life.
freedom.exampleZh: 她辞去工作，以便在日常生活中享受更多自由。

freeway.example: We drove on the freeway for two hours to visit my grandparents.
freeway.exampleZh: 我们在高速公路上开了两个小时的车去看望我的祖父母。

freeze.example: The water in the small pond will freeze when the weather gets very cold.
freeze.exampleZh: 天气变得很冷时，小池塘里的水会结冰。

freight.example: The freight was too heavy for the small truck to carry.
freight.exampleZh: 这批货物太重了，那辆小卡车载不动。

frequency.example: The frequency of buses in this city is quite low at night.
frequency.exampleZh: 这座城市夜间公交车的班次频率相当低。

frequent.example: Heavy rain is frequent in this city during the summer months.
frequent.exampleZh: 夏季这几个月，这座城市经常下大雨。

frequently.example: She frequently walks to work when the weather is nice.
frequently.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，她经常步行去上班。

fresh.example: I bought some fresh fruit at the market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我在市场上买了一些新鲜的水果。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams about the new plan.
friction.exampleZh: 两个团队之间因为新计划产生了一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will meet again this Friday to talk about the plan.
friday.exampleZh: 这个星期五我们会再见面讨论这个计划。

fridge.example: Please put the milk back in the fridge after you use it.
fridge.exampleZh: 用完后请把牛奶放回冰箱里。

friend.example: My best friend lives next door and we walk to school together every morning.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友住在隔壁，我们每天早上一起走路上学。

friendly.example: The new teacher is very friendly to all the students.
friendly.exampleZh: 新老师对所有学生都很友好。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust, respect and honest communication.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在信任、尊重和坦诚的交流之上。

fright.example: The loud noise gave the little boy a terrible fright.
fright.exampleZh: 巨大的响声把那个小男孩吓坏了。

frighten.example: The loud noise may frighten the small dog in the garden.
frighten.exampleZh: 那个响亮的噪音可能会吓到花园里的小狗。

frog.example: The little green frog jumped into the pond near our house.
frog.exampleZh: 那只绿色的小青蛙跳进了我们家附近的池塘里。

from.example: She walks to school from her house every morning at eight.
from.exampleZh: 她每天早上八点从家步行去学校。

front.example: The school is in front of the park, so the children walk there every morning.
front.exampleZh: 学校在公园前面，所以孩子们每天早上都走到那里去。

frontier.example: Space travel is the new frontier for science.
frontier.exampleZh: 太空旅行是科学的新前沿。

frost.example: The grass was covered with white frost this cold morning.
frost.exampleZh: 这个寒冷的早晨，草地上覆盖着白霜。

frown.example: She frowned when she read the letter from her son.
frown.exampleZh: 她读到儿子的信时皱起了眉头。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is good for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果对你的健康有好处。

frustrate.example: Long delays often frustrate people who are waiting for a bus.
frustrate.exampleZh: 长时间的延误常常让等公交车的人感到沮丧。

fry.example: I fry two eggs in the pan every morning.
fry.exampleZh: 我每天早上在平底锅里煎两个鸡蛋。

fuel.example: The car needs more fuel before we can continue our long journey.
fuel.exampleZh: 在我们继续长途旅行之前，这辆车需要更多燃料。

fulfil.example: Hard work can help you fulfil your dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfil.exampleZh: 努力工作可以帮助你实现成为医生的梦想。

fulfill.example: She worked hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of fresh water from the well.
full.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了来自井里的清水。

fun.example: Learning English with friends is great fun and makes every day interesting.
fun.exampleZh: 和朋友一起学英语很有乐趣，让每一天都变得有趣。

function.example: The main function of this small machine is to clean the floor quickly.
function.exampleZh: 这台小机器的主要功能是快速清洁地板。

functional.example: This simple kitchen tool is very functional and easy to use.
functional.exampleZh: 这个简单的厨房工具功能实用，而且很容易使用。

fund.example: The school used the fund to buy new books for the library.
fund.exampleZh: 学校用这笔专款为图书馆购买新书。

fundamental.example: Good sleep is fundamental to staying healthy and thinking clearly every day.
fundamental.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠是保持健康和每天思维清晰的根本。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funny.example: That funny movie made the whole family laugh all evening.
funny.exampleZh: 那部有趣的电影让全家人笑了一整晚。

fur.example: The cat has soft fur, and she likes to sleep on my bed.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的毛，她喜欢睡在我的床上。

furious.example: My father was furious when he saw the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲看到破窗户时非常愤怒。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new office with desks and chairs next week.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们下周会用桌椅来布置新办公室。

furniture.example: We bought some new furniture for the living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 我们上周为客厅买了一些新家具。

further.example: We need further tests before we can solve this problem.
further.exampleZh: 我们需要做进一步的测试才能解决这个问题。

furthermore.example: The room is small; furthermore, it has no windows.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这个房间很小，而且没有窗户。

fury.example: He shook with fury when he saw the broken window.
fury.exampleZh: 看到被打破的窗户时，他气得浑身发抖。

fuse.example: A small fuse protects the machine from too much electricity.
fuse.exampleZh: 一个小保险丝保护机器免受过量电流的损害。

fusion.example: The dish is a fusion of sweet and spicy flavors.
fusion.exampleZh: 这道菜是甜味与辣味的融合。

future.example: She is saving money now for a better future.
future.exampleZh: 她现在存钱是为了一个更好的未来。

gab.example: Every morning the two old friends have a friendly gab over coffee.
gab.exampleZh: 每天早上，两位老朋友都会一边喝咖啡一边友好地闲聊。

gadget.example: My father bought a small gadget that helps him open jars easily.
gadget.exampleZh: 我爸爸买了一个小装置，能帮他轻松打开罐子。

gaiety.example: The music and dancing filled the room with gaiety all night.
gaiety.exampleZh: 音乐和舞蹈让整个房间整夜都充满欢乐。

gaily.example: The children ran gaily through the garden on a sunny spring morning.
gaily.exampleZh: 孩子们在阳光明媚的春日早晨欢快地跑过花园。

gain.example: She works hard to gain more experience in her new job.
gain.exampleZh: 她努力工作，以便在新工作中获得更多经验。

gait.example: His slow gait showed that his knee was still hurting.
gait.exampleZh: 他缓慢的步态表明他的膝盖还在疼。

galaxy.example: Our galaxy contains billions of stars and many planets.
galaxy.exampleZh: 我们的星系包含数十亿颗恒星和许多行星。

gallery.example: We spent the afternoon looking at paintings in the new art gallery.
gallery.exampleZh: 我们在新的美术馆里看了一下午的画。

gallon.example: We bought two gallons of milk at the store yesterday.
gallon.exampleZh: 我们昨天在商店买了两加仑牛奶。

galvanize.example: Good leaders can galvanize a team into action.
galvanize.exampleZh: 好的领导者能激励团队行动起来。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on cards, but he never bets too much money.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢玩牌赌博，但从不押太多钱。

game.example: The children are playing a fun game in the park.
game.exampleZh: 孩子们正在公园里玩一个有趣的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of boys was playing football in the street after school.
gang.exampleZh: 放学后，一帮男孩在街上踢足球。

gap.example: There is a big gap between the two teams in skill.
gap.exampleZh: 两支队伍在技术上有很大的差距。

garage.example: My father keeps his old car in the garage behind our house.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲把他的旧车停在我们家后面的车库里。

garbage.example: Please put all the garbage in the bag outside the door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把所有垃圾放进门外那个袋子里。

garden.example: My grandmother grows tomatoes and many beautiful flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我祖母在她的小花园里种西红柿和许多美丽的花。

garment.example: She washed the dirty garment in warm water and hung it outside.
garment.exampleZh: 她用温水洗了那件脏衣服，然后把它挂到外面晾干。

gas.example: The gas from the old stove made the whole kitchen smell bad.
gas.exampleZh: 旧炉子漏出的气体让整个厨房都很难闻。

gasoline.example: The car stopped because it ran out of gasoline on the highway.
gasoline.exampleZh: 汽车在高速公路上因为汽油耗尽而停了下来。

gasp.example: She gasped for air after running up the stairs.
gasp.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后大口喘气。

gate.example: Please close the gate before the dog runs out.
gate.exampleZh: 请在狗跑出去之前把大门关上。

gather.example: Every morning, students gather in the school yard to talk with friends.
gather.exampleZh: 每天早上，学生们聚集在校园里和朋友聊天。

gauge.example: The teacher used a test to gauge how much we had learned.
gauge.exampleZh: 老师用一次测验来评估我们学了多少。

gay.example: They painted the room in gay colors and the children loved it.
gay.exampleZh: 他们把房间刷成鲜艳的颜色，孩子们很喜欢。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time last night.
gaze.exampleZh: 昨晚她长时间凝望着星星。

gear.example: He changed gear before driving up the steep hill.
gear.exampleZh: 他在开车上陡坡之前换了挡。

gender.example: Please write your name and gender on the form.
gender.exampleZh: 请在表格上写下你的姓名和性别。

gene.example: Each gene in our body helps decide how we grow.
gene.exampleZh: 我们身体里的每个基因都帮助决定我们如何成长。

general.example: This is a general rule that all students should remember.
general.exampleZh: 这是一条所有学生都应该记住的一般规则。

generally.example: People generally get up early on weekdays and rest at weekends.
generally.exampleZh: 人们通常在工作日早起，周末休息。

generate.example: The new machine can generate electricity for the whole village.
generate.exampleZh: 这台新机器能为整个村庄发电。

generation.example: My grandfather's generation worked hard and saved money for their children.
generation.exampleZh: 我祖父那一代人努力工作，为孩子们攒钱。

generous.example: My generous friend always shares his lunch with me at school.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的朋友在学校总是和我分享他的午餐。

genetic.example: The scientists found a genetic reason why some people cannot digest milk.
genetic.exampleZh: 科学家发现了有些人无法消化牛奶的遗传原因。

genetics.example: She studies genetics at the university and hopes to become a researcher.
genetics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习遗传学，希望成为一名研究员。

genius.example: He is a genius at solving difficult math problems.
genius.exampleZh: 他是解决数学难题的天才。

gentle.example: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice to the scared little boy.
gentle.exampleZh: 护士用温柔的声音对那个害怕的小男孩说话。

gentleman.example: The old gentleman helped the little girl cross the busy street.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老先生帮助小女孩穿过了繁忙的街道。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, so everyone trusted her right away.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的微笑是真诚的，所以大家立刻都信任她。

geography.example: I like geography because it helps me understand mountains, rivers and cities.
geography.exampleZh: 我喜欢地理，因为它帮助我了解山脉、河流和城市。

geology.example: She studies geology at college because she loves rocks and mountains.
geology.exampleZh: 她在大学学习地质学，因为她喜欢岩石和山脉。

geometry.example: We study geometry in math class and learn about shapes and angles.
geometry.exampleZh: 我们在数学课上学习几何学，了解图形和角。

germ.example: Wash your hands to stop germs from getting into your body.
germ.exampleZh: 洗手可以防止细菌进入你的身体。

german.example: She is learning German at school because her father comes from Germany.
german.exampleZh: 她在学校学德语，因为她父亲来自德国。

gesture.example: She made a small gesture with her hand to show she agreed.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了个小手势，表示她同意。

get.example: I hope to get a new bike for my birthday.
get.exampleZh: 我希望生日时能得到一辆新自行车。

ghost.example: She says she saw a ghost in the old house last night.
ghost.exampleZh: 她说她昨晚在那栋老房子里看到了一个鬼。

giant.example: That giant tree in the park is older than my grandfather.
giant.exampleZh: 公园里那棵巨大的树比我祖父还要老。

gift.example: My sister gave me a nice gift for my birthday.
gift.exampleZh: 我姐姐送了我一份很好的生日礼物。

gifted.example: She is a gifted singer and often sings at school events.
gifted.exampleZh: 她是一位有天赋的歌手，经常在学校活动中唱歌。

gigantic.example: The blue whale is a gigantic animal that lives in the ocean.
gigantic.exampleZh: 蓝鲸是一种生活在海洋里的巨大动物。

girl.example: The little girl next door likes to sing and dance with her friends.
girl.exampleZh: 隔壁的小女孩喜欢和朋友们一起唱歌跳舞。

give.example: Please give this book to your little sister after school.
give.exampleZh: 放学后请把这本书给你的小妹妹。

glad.example: I am very glad to see you and your family today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人，我非常高兴。

glance.example: She gave the letter a quick glance and put it down.
glance.exampleZh: 她匆匆瞥了一眼那封信，然后把它放下了。

glare.example: She gave him an angry glare and left the room without a word.
glare.exampleZh: 她愤怒地瞪了他一眼，一言不发地离开了房间。

glass.example: She drank a glass of cold milk before going to bed.
glass.exampleZh: 她睡觉前喝了一杯冷牛奶。

glide.example: The small boat glided slowly across the calm lake at sunset.
glide.exampleZh: 夕阳下，小船在平静的湖面上缓缓滑行。

glimpse.example: I caught a glimpse of the sea through the trees.
glimpse.exampleZh: 我透过树木瞥见了一小片海。

global.example: The company has a global plan to protect the environment.
global.exampleZh: 这家公司有一个保护全球环境的总体计划。

globe.example: People from every part of the globe want to see this beautiful place.
globe.exampleZh: 来自世界各地的人都想看看这个美丽的地方。

gloom.example: The gloom of the small room made everyone feel sad.
gloom.exampleZh: 那间小房间的昏暗让每个人都感到难过。

gloomy.example: The old room was dark and gloomy on rainy days.
gloomy.exampleZh: 下雨天时，那间旧房间又暗又阴沉。

glory.example: The old soldier won great glory for his country in the war.
glory.exampleZh: 这位老兵在战争中为他的国家赢得了巨大的荣誉。

glove.example: I wear a warm glove on each hand when it snows.
glove.exampleZh: 下雪时我每只手都戴一只暖和的手套。

glow.example: The candles glow softly and give a warm light to the whole room.
glow.exampleZh: 蜡烛柔和地发光，给整个房间带来温暖的光。

glue.example: I need some glue to fix this broken cup.
glue.exampleZh: 我需要一些胶水来修这个破杯子。

goal.example: My goal is to learn English well this year.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是今年把英语学好。

goat.example: The farmer keeps a goat and two sheep on his small farm.
goat.exampleZh: 农夫在他的小农场里养了一只山羊和两只绵羊。

god.example: The people in the old story prayed to a god every morning.
god.exampleZh: 那个古老故事里的人们每天早上都向一位神祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger every day.
gold.exampleZh: 她每天手指上都戴着一枚金戒指。

golden.example: The golden sun set slowly behind the quiet hills.
golden.exampleZh: 金色的太阳缓缓落在安静的山丘后面。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is very good at drawing pictures of animals.
good.exampleZh: 她很擅长画动物的图画。

goods.example: The goods in this shop are cheap and very good.
goods.exampleZh: 这家商店里的商品便宜又很好。

govern.example: Rules govern how the members of the club must behave.
govern.exampleZh: 规则规定了俱乐部成员必须遵守的行为方式。

government.example: The government plans to build more schools for children.
government.exampleZh: 政府计划为孩子们建更多学校。

governor.example: The governor will visit our school next Monday.
governor.exampleZh: 州长下周一将参观我们学校。

grab.example: The little boy tried to grab the last cookie from the plate.
grab.exampleZh: 那个小男孩试图从盘子里抓走最后一块饼干。

grace.example: She moved across the stage with great grace and quiet confidence.
grace.exampleZh: 她以极大的优雅和安静的自信走过舞台。

graceful.example: Her graceful dance made everyone in the room smile.
graceful.exampleZh: 她优美的舞姿让房间里的每个人都笑了。

grade.example: My sister is in the fifth grade at a nearby school.
grade.exampleZh: 我妹妹在附近一所学校读五年级。

gradual.example: The gradual change in the weather made everyone feel more comfortable.
gradual.exampleZh: 天气逐渐的变化让每个人都感觉更舒适。

gradually.example: The weather gradually got warmer as spring arrived.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天的到来，天气逐渐变暖。

graduate.example: She will graduate from college next year and look for a job.
graduate.exampleZh: 她明年大学毕业，然后找工作。

grain.example: A few grains of rice fell on the table while I was cooking.
grain.exampleZh: 我做饭的时候，几粒米掉在了桌子上。

grand.example: The grand hotel has a big garden and many bright rooms.
grand.exampleZh: 这家宏伟的酒店有一个大花园和许多明亮的房间。

grant.example: The school granted her a small grant to continue her studies.
grant.exampleZh: 学校授予她一笔小额补助金，让她继续学业。

grape.example: She ate a red grape from the bowl on the table.
grape.exampleZh: 她从桌上的碗里吃了一颗红葡萄。

graph.example: The graph shows how the temperature changes over the year.
graph.exampleZh: 这个图表显示了全年温度的变化情况。

graphic.example: The teacher gave a graphic description of the storm, so we could easily picture it.
graphic.exampleZh: 老师对那场暴风雨作了生动的描述，所以我们很容易想象出它的样子。

grasp.example: I can grasp the main idea of this book.
grasp.exampleZh: 我能理解这本书的主要意思。

grass.example: The children are playing on the green grass in the park.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在公园的绿草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful to my teacher for her help every day.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感激我的老师每天对我的帮助。

gratitude.example: I want to show my gratitude to my teacher for her help.
gratitude.exampleZh: 我想向老师表达我的感激之情，感谢她的帮助。

grave.example: The doctor said his illness was grave but he could still get better.
grave.exampleZh: 医生说他的病很严重，但他仍有可能康复。

gravity.example: The apple fell to the ground because of gravity.
gravity.exampleZh: 苹果因为重力而落到了地上。

gray.example: The sky turned gray before the heavy rain started in the afternoon.
gray.exampleZh: 下午下大雨之前，天空变得阴沉起来。

great.example: This is a great day for our small town.
great.exampleZh: 对我们这个小镇来说，这是伟大的一天。

greatly.example: The new plan greatly improved the lives of many people in our town.
greatly.exampleZh: 这项新计划大大改善了我们镇上许多人的生活。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cake before his sister came home.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在妹妹回家前把蛋糕全吃光了。

greek.example: My friend studies Greek at school and reads old Greek books with ease.
greek.exampleZh: 我的朋友在学校学希腊语，能轻松读懂古老的希腊文书籍。

green.example: The leaves on the trees turn green every spring.
green.exampleZh: 每年春天树上的叶子都会变绿。

greenhouse.example: The old greenhouse is full of tomatoes and small green plants.
greenhouse.exampleZh: 那个旧温室里种满了西红柿和小绿植。

greet.example: She always greets her neighbors with a warm smile every morning.
greet.exampleZh: 她每天早上总是用温暖的微笑和邻居们打招呼。

grief.example: She felt deep grief after her old dog died last winter.
grief.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗死后，她感到深深的悲痛。

grill.example: We put the fish on the grill and waited for it to cook.
grill.exampleZh: 我们把鱼放在烤架上，等着它烤熟。

grim.example: The news was grim, and everyone in the room stayed silent.
grim.exampleZh: 消息令人沮丧，房间里的每个人都沉默不语。

grin.example: She grinned at me when she heard the good news.
grin.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时冲我咧嘴笑了。

grind.example: She used a small stone to grind the coffee beans this morning.
grind.exampleZh: 今天早上她用一块小石头把咖啡豆磨碎了。

grip.example: She held the rope with a strong grip and climbed up.
grip.exampleZh: 她紧紧抓住绳子，向上爬去。

grocery.example: I stop at the grocery on my way home to buy milk and eggs.
grocery.exampleZh: 我回家路上会去食品杂货店买牛奶和鸡蛋。

gross.example: The gross weight of the box is ten kilos, which is too heavy.
gross.exampleZh: 这个箱子的毛重是十公斤，太重了。

ground.example: The children sat on the ground to eat their lunch.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地上吃午饭。

group.example: Our group meets in the library every Friday afternoon after class.
group.exampleZh: 我们小组每周五下午放学后在图书馆见面。

grow.example: Children grow very fast when they eat healthy food every day.
grow.exampleZh: 孩子们每天吃健康的食物就会长得很快。

growth.example: The company saw strong growth in sales last year.
growth.exampleZh: 这家公司去年的销售额实现了强劲增长。

guarantee.example: The shop will guarantee this watch for two years.
guarantee.exampleZh: 这家店会为这块手表保修两年。

guard.example: Two guards stand at the gate to guard the old museum every night.
guard.exampleZh: 两名警卫每晚守在大门口保卫这座古老的博物馆。

guess.example: I can only guess what he means by that strange message.
guess.exampleZh: 我只能猜测他那条奇怪的消息是什么意思。

guest.example: We have a guest staying with us this week.
guest.exampleZh: 这周有一位客人住在我们这里。

guidance.example: My teacher gave me useful guidance on how to study English well.
guidance.exampleZh: 老师给了我关于如何学好英语的有用指导。

guide.example: Our teacher will guide us through the new lesson today.
guide.exampleZh: 我们老师今天会指导我们学习新课。

guideline.example: The new safety guidelines tell workers how to use the machines.
guideline.exampleZh: 新的安全准则告诉工人如何操作这些机器。

guilt.example: He felt deep guilt after breaking his promise to his best friend.
guilt.exampleZh: 他对最好的朋友违背诺言后感到深深的内疚。

guilty.example: He felt guilty because he lied to his mother about the broken window.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为打碎窗户的事对母亲撒了谎而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after dinner.
guitar.exampleZh: 我哥哥每天晚饭后都弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a wide gulf between what he says and what he does.
gulf.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在巨大差距。

gum.example: Chewing gum too often can be bad for your gums.
gum.exampleZh: 经常嚼口香糖可能对牙龈不好。

gun.example: The police found a gun in the back of his car.
gun.exampleZh: 警方在他的汽车后部发现了一把枪。

gym.example: I go to the gym with my friends every Tuesday and Thursday.
gym.exampleZh: 我每周二和周四都和朋友去健身房。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for young children.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对小孩子来说是一个好习惯。

habitat.example: The forest is a good habitat for many small animals.
habitat.exampleZh: 森林是许多小动物的良好栖息地。

hail.example: The children ran outside to hail their teacher and then laughed as hail hit the roof.
hail.exampleZh: 孩子们跑到外面向老师欢呼，接着冰雹打在屋顶上，他们笑了起来。

hair.example: She has long black hair and a warm smile.
hair.exampleZh: 她有一头黑色长发和温暖的笑容。

half.example: I ate half of the cake and saved the other half for later.
half.exampleZh: 我吃了一半蛋糕，把另一半留着以后吃。

hall.example: We waited for our teacher in the school hall after lunch.
hall.exampleZh: 午饭后我们在学校礼堂里等老师。

halt.example: The train came to a halt at the small station.

ham.example: My mother put some ham and cheese in my sandwich for lunch.
ham.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我的午餐三明治里放了一些火腿和奶酪。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in his room.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用一把锤子修好了他房间里那把坏掉的椅子。

hamper.example: Heavy rain hampered the rescue team on the mountain.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨妨碍了山上的救援队。

hand.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner with us.
hand.exampleZh: 请在我们一起吃晚饭前洗手。

handbook.example: The teacher gave each student a handbook with all the class rules.
handbook.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生发了一本包含所有班级规则的手册。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to the early class today.
handful.exampleZh: 今天只有少数学生来上早课。

handle.example: Please handle the box by its handle and do not drop it.
handle.exampleZh: 请抓住箱子的把手搬它，不要把它摔了。

handsome.example: Her brother is a tall and handsome young man.
handsome.exampleZh: 她的哥哥是个又高又英俊的年轻人。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is very clear, so everyone can read her notes easily.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的笔迹很工整，所以每个人都能轻松读懂她的笔记。

handy.example: A small pocket knife is handy when you need to cut something.
handy.exampleZh: 当你需要剪东西时，一把小折刀很方便。

hang.example: Please hang your wet coat on the chair so it can dry.
hang.exampleZh: 请把你的湿外套挂在椅子上晾干。

happen.example: Bad things can happen when you drive too fast in the rain.
happen.exampleZh: 下雨天开车太快时，可能会发生糟糕的事情。

happy.example: The children look very happy when they play in the park.
happy.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里玩耍时看起来非常快乐。

harassment.example: She reported the harassment at work to her manager the next morning.
harassment.exampleZh: 第二天早上，她把工作中受到的骚扰报告给了经理。

harbor.example: The small boat found a safe harbor before the storm arrived.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前找到了一个安全的避风港。

hard.example: This bread is too hard for me to eat.
hard.exampleZh: 这块面包太硬了，我吃不了。

harden.example: Years of hard work hardened his body and his will.
harden.exampleZh: 多年的辛勤工作使他的身体和意志都变得坚强。

hardly.example: I can hardly hear you because the music is too loud.
hardly.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，我几乎听不见你说话。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the cold winter months.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在寒冷的冬季月份里面临巨大的艰难。

hardware.example: The new computer comes with all the hardware you need.
hardware.exampleZh: 这台新电脑配有你需要的全部硬件。

harm.example: Too much sun can harm your skin and make it red.
harm.exampleZh: 晒太阳过多会伤害你的皮肤，使它变红。

harmful.example: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth and health.
harmful.exampleZh: 吃太多糖对你的牙齿和健康有害。

harmony.example: The team works in harmony, and everyone helps each other every day.
harmony.exampleZh: 这个团队和谐协作，每个人每天都互相帮助。

harsh.example: The teacher was harsh when she spoke to the noisy students.
harsh.exampleZh: 老师对吵闹的学生说话时很严厉。

harvest.example: The farmers harvest the rice in the fields every autumn.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民们每年秋天在田里收割稻子。

haste.example: In her haste to leave, she forgot her phone on the desk.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙离开时把手机忘在了桌子上。

hate.example: I hate waiting for the bus in the cold rain.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌在冷雨中等待公交车。

hatred.example: Her deep hatred for lies made her tell the truth every time.
hatred.exampleZh: 她对谎言的深切憎恨让她每次都说出真相。

have.example: I have two small dogs and a cat at home.
have.exampleZh: 我家里有两只小狗和一只猫。

hawk.example: The hawk circled high above the field and then flew away.
hawk.exampleZh: 那只鹰在田野上空盘旋，然后飞走了。

hay.example: The farmer put dry hay in the barn for the cows.
hay.exampleZh: 农民把干草放进谷仓里给奶牛吃。

he.example: He is my best friend and we play football every day.
he.exampleZh: 他是我最好的朋友，我们每天一起踢足球。

head.example: He turned his head and looked at the door behind him.
head.exampleZh: 他转过头，看了看身后的门。

headache.example: I had a bad headache last night and went to bed early.
headache.exampleZh: 昨晚我头痛得厉害，早早就睡了。

heading.example: The heading at the top of the page tells readers what the report is about.
heading.exampleZh: 页面顶部的标题告诉读者这份报告是关于什么的。

headline.example: The news about the earthquake was the headline in every paper today.
headline.exampleZh: 关于地震的消息是今天每份报纸的头条标题。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a bigger city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 这家公司去年把总部搬到了一个更大的城市。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart and help you move on.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈一颗破碎的心，帮助你继续前行。

health.example: Regular exercise and good food are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和良好的饮食对你的健康很重要。

healthy.example: Eating vegetables every day helps you stay healthy and strong.
healthy.exampleZh: 每天吃蔬菜有助于你保持健康和强壮。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见鸟儿在窗外唱歌。

hearing.example: His hearing got worse after years of working in the noisy factory.
hearing.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的工厂工作多年后，他的听力变差了。

heart.example: She has a kind heart and always helps the people around her.
heart.exampleZh: 她有一颗善良的心，总是帮助身边的人。

heat.example: The heat from the sun made the room very warm.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量让房间变得很暖和。

heater.example: We turned on the heater because the room was very cold.
heater.exampleZh: 我们打开了加热器，因为房间非常冷。

heaven.example: Many people believe their good deeds will lead them to heaven after death.
heaven.exampleZh: 许多人相信他们的善行会在死后带他们进入天堂。

heavy.example: The box is very heavy, so I cannot lift it alone.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子很重，所以我一个人搬不动。

heel.example: The new shoes hurt my heel when I walk too far.
heel.exampleZh: 这双新鞋走太远时磨我的脚后跟。

height.example: The height of the mountain makes it hard to climb in winter.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度使得它在冬天很难攀登。

heighten.example: The loud music heightened the tension in the small room.
heighten.exampleZh: 吵闹的音乐加深了这个小房间里的紧张气氛。

heir.example: The old man left all his money to his only heir.
heir.exampleZh: 这位老人把所有的钱都留给了他唯一的继承人。

helicopter.example: The helicopter landed on the roof of the tall hospital building.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机降落在医院高楼的楼顶上。

hell.example: War is a hell that no one should have to live through.
hell.exampleZh: 战争是没人应该经历的苦境。

hello.example: Hello, my name is Tom and I am happy to meet you.
hello.exampleZh: 你好，我叫汤姆，很高兴见到你。

help.example: Can you help me carry this box to the car?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬到车上吗？

helpful.example: My teacher is very helpful when I ask her questions.
helpful.exampleZh: 我问老师问题时，她非常乐于助人。

hen.example: The hen laid three eggs in the nest this morning.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡今天早上在窝里下了三个蛋。

hence.example: It was raining hard, hence the game was canceled.
hence.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被取消了。

her.example: I gave her a small gift for her birthday.
her.exampleZh: 我送了她一份小礼物作为生日礼物。

herb.example: She grows herbs like mint and basil in a small pot.
herb.exampleZh: 她在小盆里种薄荷和罗勒这类草本植物。

herd.example: A large herd of cows was walking slowly across the green field.
herd.exampleZh: 一大群奶牛正慢慢走过绿色的田野。

here.example: Please sit here and wait for your name to be called.
here.exampleZh: 请坐在这里，等着叫你的名字。

heritage.example: The old town is an important part of our cultural heritage.
heritage.exampleZh: 这座老城是我们文化遗产的重要组成部分。

hero.example: The young boy said his father was his greatest hero.
hero.exampleZh: 这个小男孩说他父亲是他最伟大的英雄。

heroic.example: The firefighter made a heroic effort to save the child from the burning house.
heroic.exampleZh: 消防员为从燃烧的房子里救出孩子做出了英勇的努力。

hesitate.example: Don't hesitate to ask me if you need help with your homework.
hesitate.exampleZh: 如果你做作业需要帮助，请尽管问我，不要犹豫。

hi.example: I saw Tom this morning and he smiled and said hi to me.
hi.exampleZh: 今天早上我见到汤姆，他笑着跟我打了声招呼。

hide.example: The little boy tried to hide his toys under the bed.
hide.exampleZh: 小男孩试图把玩具藏在床底下。

hierarchy.example: The company has a clear hierarchy of managers and workers.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 公司有明确的经理与员工的等级制度。

high.example: The wall is very high, so I cannot climb over it.
high.exampleZh: 这堵墙很高，所以我爬不过去。

highlight.example: The teacher will highlight the most important words in the text.
highlight.exampleZh: 老师会强调课文中最重要的词。

highly.example: My teacher speaks highly of my work and says I can do better.
highly.exampleZh: 老师非常赞许我的作业，说我还能做得更好。

highway.example: We drove along the highway to visit our grandparents in another city.
highway.exampleZh: 我们沿着公路行驶，去另一座城市看望祖父母。

hike.example: We plan to hike in the hills this weekend and enjoy the fresh air.
hike.exampleZh: 我们打算这个周末去山里远足，享受新鲜空气。

hill.example: We walked up the hill to watch the sunset.
hill.exampleZh: 我们走上小山去看日落。

him.example: I saw him at the park yesterday and we talked for a while.
him.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园看见他，我们聊了一会儿。

hint.example: She gave me a hint about the answer so I could finish.
hint.exampleZh: 她给了我一点关于答案的提示，所以我能完成了。

hip.example: He fell and hurt his hip while playing basketball with friends.
hip.exampleZh: 他和朋友打篮球时摔倒，伤了髋部。

hire.example: They decided to hire a new teacher for the small school.
hire.exampleZh: 他们决定为这所小学校聘请一位新老师。

historian.example: The historian wrote a short book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于中国古代生活的小书。

historical.example: The museum shows many historical objects from ancient China.
historical.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出了许多来自中国古代的历史文物。

history.example: She is reading a book about the history of China.
history.exampleZh: 她正在读一本关于中国历史的书。

hit.example: He hit the ball hard and it flew over the wall.
hit.exampleZh: 他用力击球，球飞过了墙。

hobby.example: My hobby is reading books, and I also enjoy playing tennis on weekends.
hobby.exampleZh: 我的业余爱好是读书，周末我也喜欢打网球。

hold.example: Please hold the door open for me while I carry these boxes.
hold.exampleZh: 我搬这些箱子的时候，请帮我把门扶着别关上。

hole.example: The small rabbit ran into a deep hole under the old tree.
hole.exampleZh: 那只小兔子跑进了老树下的一個深洞里。

holiday.example: We plan to take a long holiday at the beach this summer.
holiday.exampleZh: 今年夏天我们打算去海边度一个长假。

hollow.example: This old tree is hollow inside, so birds often build nests in it.
hollow.exampleZh: 这棵老树里面是空心的，所以鸟儿常常在里面筑巢。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

home.example: I go home after school every day to see my family.
home.exampleZh: 我每天放学后回家看望家人。

homeland.example: He returned to his homeland after many years away.
homeland.exampleZh: 他在外多年后回到了祖国。

homework.example: I finish my homework before dinner every day.
homework.exampleZh: 我每天在晚饭前完成家庭作业。

honest.example: She is an honest girl who always tells the truth.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是说真话。

honey.example: My little sister likes to put honey in her warm tea.
honey.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢在她的热茶里加蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to stand here and speak to you today.
honor.exampleZh: 今天站在这里对你们讲话是我的莫大荣幸。

honorary.example: She received an honorary degree from the university for her charity work.
honorary.exampleZh: 她因慈善工作获得了这所大学的名誉学位。

hook.example: The fisherman put a small worm on his hook and waited for a fish.
hook.exampleZh: 渔夫把一条小虫子放在鱼钩上，等着鱼上钩。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party this Saturday.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你能来参加这个星期六的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: We are hopeful that the weather will be better tomorrow.
hopeful.exampleZh: 我们希望明天的天气会好一些。

horizon.example: The sun rose slowly above the horizon and the sky turned bright.
horizon.exampleZh: 太阳缓缓升上地平线，天空变得明亮起来。

horizontal.example: Draw a horizontal line across the page before you write anything.
horizontal.exampleZh: 在你写任何东西之前，先在页面上画一条水平线。

horn.example: The old car's horn made a loud noise in the street.
horn.exampleZh: 那辆旧汽车的喇叭在街上发出了很大的响声。

horrible.example: The weather was horrible, so we stayed home all day.
horrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们一整天都待在家里。

horror.example: She felt pure horror when the door opened by itself at night.
horror.exampleZh: 夜里门自己打开时，她感到纯粹的恐惧。

horse.example: The horse ran across the field and jumped over the fence.
horse.exampleZh: 那匹马跑过田野，跃过了栅栏。

hospital.example: My mother works as a nurse in the city hospital.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在市医院当护士。

host.example: Our host made us dinner and showed us around the city.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人为我们做了晚饭，还带我们游览了这座城市。

hostage.example: The police worked hard to free the hostage from the small room.
hostage.exampleZh: 警方努力将人质从那个小房间里解救出来。

hostile.example: The hostile crowd shouted at the players as they left the field.
hostile.exampleZh: 当球员们离开球场时，充满敌意的人群对他们大喊大叫。

hostility.example: Her cold voice showed clear hostility toward the new plan.
hostility.exampleZh: 她冷淡的语气显示出对新计划的明显敌意。

hot.example: The soup is too hot to eat right now, so let it cool.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，现在没法喝，让它凉一会儿吧。

hotel.example: We stayed at a small hotel near the train station last night.
hotel.exampleZh: 昨晚我们住在火车站附近的一家小旅馆。

hour.example: I study English for one hour every evening after dinner.
hour.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后学一小时英语。

house.example: My uncle lives in a small house near the river.
house.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在河边的一座小房子里。

household.example: My household has five people, and we all share the housework.
household.exampleZh: 我家有五口人，我们共同分担家务。

housework.example: I do housework with my mother every Saturday morning at home.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上在家和妈妈一起做家务。

housing.example: Many young people in big cities cannot afford decent housing.
housing.exampleZh: 大城市的许多年轻人负担不起像样的住房。

how.example: How do you go to school every morning?
how.exampleZh: 你每天早上怎样去上学？

however.example: I wanted to go out, however I had too much work to do.
however.exampleZh: 我想出去，然而我有太多工作要做。

hug.example: She likes to hug her little brother before he goes to school.
hug.exampleZh: 她喜欢在弟弟上学前抱抱他。

huge.example: There is a huge tree in front of our school.
huge.exampleZh: 我们学校前面有一棵巨大的树。

human.example: Every human needs clean water and fresh air to stay healthy.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都需要干净的水和新鲜的空气来保持健康。

humanity.example: We must treat every person with kindness and humanity.
humanity.exampleZh: 我们必须以善意和人道对待每一个人。

humble.example: He is a humble man who never talks about his own success.
humble.exampleZh: 他是个谦逊的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

humor.example: Her good humor made the long trip feel short and happy.
humor.exampleZh: 她愉快的心情让漫长的旅程变得短暂而快乐。

humorous.example: My funny uncle often tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
humorous.exampleZh: 我有趣的叔叔经常讲一些让人发笑的幽默故事。

hundred.example: There are about five hundred students in our school this year.
hundred.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有五百名学生。

hunger.example: Many children in the world still suffer from hunger every day.
hunger.exampleZh: 世界上仍有许多儿童每天都在忍受饥饿。

hungry.example: The hungry children ran home quickly to eat their warm dinner.
hungry.exampleZh: 那些饥饿的孩子们飞快地跑回家吃热腾腾的晚饭。

hunt.example: They hunt for food in the forest every morning.
hunt.exampleZh: 他们每天早上在森林里搜寻食物。

hurdle.example: The runner jumped over the last hurdle and won the race.
hurdle.exampleZh: 那名跑者跨过最后一个栏架，赢得了比赛。

hurry.example: Don't hurry, we still have plenty of time before the train leaves.
hurry.exampleZh: 别着急，火车开车前我们还有很多时间。

hurt.example: My words hurt her feelings and I felt very sorry.
hurt.exampleZh: 我的话伤害了她的感情，我感到非常抱歉。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for us every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后都为我们做晚饭。

hut.example: The old man lives in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边的一间小棚屋里。

hydrogen.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, so both are important for life.
hydrogen.exampleZh: 水由氢和氧组成，因此两者对生命都很重要。

hypothesis.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a simple experiment.
hypothesis.exampleZh: 科学家用一个简单的实验检验了她的假说。

hysterical.example: She became hysterical when she heard the bad news about her brother.
hysterical.exampleZh: 听到关于她弟弟的坏消息时，她变得歇斯底里。

ice.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on.
ice.exampleZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，不能在上面走。

iceberg.example: The ship hit an iceberg and began to sink very slowly.
iceberg.exampleZh: 船撞上了一座冰山，开始非常缓慢地下沉。

icon.example: The icon on my phone opens the camera app.
icon.exampleZh: 我手机上的这个图标可以打开相机应用。

icy.example: The icy wind made my hands cold and numb.
icy.exampleZh: 冰冷的风让我的双手又冷又麻木。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class trip next week.
idea.exampleZh: 对于下周的班级旅行，我有一个好主意。

ideal.example: A quiet room with good light is ideal for reading.
ideal.exampleZh: 一个安静且光线好的房间最适合读书。

idealism.example: Her idealism makes her believe that people are always kind.
idealism.exampleZh: 她的理想主义让她相信人们总是善良的。

idealist.example: My uncle is an idealist who believes everyone wants to help others.
idealist.exampleZh: 我的叔叔是个理想主义者，他相信每个人都愿意帮助别人。

identical.example: The two brothers wore identical shirts to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 两兄弟昨晚去参加聚会时穿了完全相同的衬衫。

identify.example: Can you identify the man in this old photo?
identify.exampleZh: 你能认出这张旧照片里的那个人吗？

identity.example: Her identity as a teacher gives her a strong sense of purpose.
identity.exampleZh: 她作为教师的身份给了她强烈的使命感。

ideology.example: The ideology of the group shaped how its members saw the world.
ideology.exampleZh: 这个群体的意识形态塑造了成员看待世界的方式。

idiom.example: This English idiom is hard to understand without a good example.
idiom.exampleZh: 这个英语习语如果没有一个好例子就很难理解。

idiot.example: He felt like an idiot after he forgot her name again.
idiot.exampleZh: 他又忘了她的名字，觉得自己像个白痴。

idle.example: He is too idle to look for a job and stays home all day.
idle.exampleZh: 他太懒惰了，不去找工作，整天待在家里。

idol.example: The young singer became an idol for many students at her school.
idol.exampleZh: 这位年轻歌手成了她学校里许多学生的偶像。

ignite.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass and start a big fire.
ignite.exampleZh: 一颗火星就能点燃干草，引发一场大火。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the basic rules caused many problems for the whole team.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对基本规则的无知给整个团队带来了很多问题。

ignorant.example: He is ignorant of the basic rules of the game.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对这个游戏的基本规则一无所知。

ignore.example: You should not ignore the teacher's advice when you study English.
ignore.exampleZh: 你学英语时不应该忽视老师的建议。

ill.example: He is very ill and cannot go to work today.
ill.exampleZh: 他病得很重，今天不能去上班。

illegal.example: It is illegal to drive a car without a license.
illegal.exampleZh: 没有驾照开车是违法的。

illness.example: His illness kept him at home for two weeks last month.
illness.exampleZh: 上个月他的病让他在家待了两周。

illuminate.example: The new streetlights illuminate the whole road at night.
illuminate.exampleZh: 新的路灯在夜间照亮了整条路。

illusion.example: The mirror creates the illusion that the room is much bigger.
illusion.exampleZh: 镜子造成的错觉让这个房间看起来大得多。

illustrate.example: Let me illustrate my point with a simple example.
illustrate.exampleZh: 让我用一个简单的例子来说明我的观点。

illustration.example: The book has a clear illustration of the water cycle on page ten.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书第十页有一幅清晰的水循环插图。

image.example: Her friendly smile gave the company a warm and honest image.
image.exampleZh: 她友好的微笑给公司带来了温暖而诚实的形象。

imagery.example: The poem uses strong imagery to describe the quiet lake at night.
imagery.exampleZh: 这首诗用强烈的意象来描绘夜晚宁静的湖面。

imaginary.example: The little girl has an imaginary friend who goes everywhere with her.
imaginary.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个想象中的朋友，无论她走到哪里都跟着她。

imagination.example: Children need time to play and use their imagination every day.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们每天都需要时间去玩耍并发挥他们的想象力。

imaginative.example: She is an imaginative child who often draws strange and beautiful animals.
imaginative.exampleZh: 她是个富于想象力的孩子，经常画些奇怪又美丽的动物。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy you were when you heard the good news.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象你听到这个好消息时有多开心。

imitate.example: Children often imitate their parents when they are playing at home.
imitate.exampleZh: 孩子们在家里玩耍时常常模仿他们的父母。

immediate.example: We need an immediate answer to this simple question now.
immediate.exampleZh: 我们现在就需要对这道简单问题给出一个立即的答复。

immense.example: The immense mountain was covered with snow all year round.
immense.exampleZh: 这座巨大的山整年都被白雪覆盖。

immerse.example: She likes to immerse herself in music after a long day at work.
immerse.exampleZh: 工作一整天后，她喜欢让自己沉浸在音乐中。

immigrant.example: The immigrant worked hard and opened a small shop in the city.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民努力工作，在城里开了一家小店。

immigrate.example: Many people immigrate to big cities to find better jobs.
immigrate.exampleZh: 许多人移居到大城市寻找更好的工作。

immigration.example: My grandfather came to this country through immigration when he was young.
immigration.exampleZh: 我祖父年轻时通过移民来到这个国家。

imminent.example: Dark clouds showed that a heavy storm was imminent.
imminent.exampleZh: 乌云表明一场大暴雨即将来临。

immoral.example: It is immoral to steal money from old people.
immoral.exampleZh: 偷老人的钱是不道德的。

immune.example: People who get the vaccine are immune to this serious disease.
immune.exampleZh: 接种疫苗的人对这种严重疾病具有免疫力。

impact.example: The new law will have a big impact on small businesses.
impact.exampleZh: 这项新法律将对小企业产生巨大影响。

impair.example: Too little sleep can impair your memory and slow your thinking.
impair.exampleZh: 睡眠太少会损害你的记忆力，并使你的思维变慢。

impale.example: The knight used his spear to impale the enemy's shield.
impale.exampleZh: 骑士用长矛刺穿了敌人的盾牌。

impart.example: Teachers impart knowledge to students and help them grow.
impart.exampleZh: 老师把知识传授给学生，并帮助他们成长。

impartial.example: A good judge must be impartial when deciding a difficult case.
impartial.exampleZh: 一位好法官在裁决棘手案件时必须保持公正。

impatient.example: He gets impatient when he has to wait for the bus.
impatient.exampleZh: 他等公交车时就会变得不耐烦。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we leave now before the storm arrives.
imperative.exampleZh: 我们必须在暴风雨来临之前离开。

imperial.example: The old museum was built during the imperial age of that country.
imperial.exampleZh: 这座古老的博物馆建于那个国家的帝国时期。

impersonal.example: The large office felt impersonal and cold, so nobody wanted to stay there long.
impersonal.exampleZh: 那间大办公室显得冷漠、缺乏人情味，因此没人愿意久留。

implement.example: The school will implement a new plan to help students read more books.
implement.exampleZh: 学校将实施一项新计划，帮助学生多读书。

implication.example: The new law has serious implications for small businesses in our town.
implication.exampleZh: 这项新法律对我们镇上的小企业有严重影响。

implicit.example: There was an implicit warning in her quiet voice.
implicit.exampleZh: 她平静的声音里含着一种暗示性的警告。

imply.example: The dark clouds imply that rain is coming soon.
imply.exampleZh: 乌云暗示着雨马上就要来了。

import.example: The import of foreign cars is important to this country.
import.exampleZh: 进口外国汽车对这个国家很重要。

importance.example: Good teachers know the importance of listening to their students.
importance.exampleZh: 好老师知道倾听学生的重要性。

important.example: It is important to drink enough water every day.
important.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水很重要。

impose.example: The government decided to impose a new tax on imported cars.
impose.exampleZh: 政府决定对进口汽车征收一项新税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish this work in one day.
impossible.exampleZh: 一天之内完成这项工作是不可能的。

impress.example: Her hard work and kindness impressed everyone in the small class.
impress.exampleZh: 她的勤奋和善良给这个小班里的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

impression.example: Her kind smile left a good impression on everyone at the meeting.
impression.exampleZh: 她和善的微笑给会上每个人都留下了好印象。

impressive.example: Her speech at the meeting was very impressive.
impressive.exampleZh: 她在会议上的演讲非常令人印象深刻。

improve.example: We can improve our English by reading and practicing every day.
improve.exampleZh: 我们可以通过每天阅读和练习来提高英语水平。

improvement.example: Your English shows great improvement after months of daily practice.
improvement.exampleZh: 经过几个月的每日练习，你的英语有了很大的进步。

impulse.example: He bought the expensive watch on impulse and later regretted it.
impulse.exampleZh: 他一时冲动买下了那块昂贵的手表，后来后悔了。

in.example: My keys are in my bag, and my sister is in at home.
in.exampleZh: 我的钥匙在我的包里，我妹妹在家。

inadequate.example: The old computer was inadequate for running the new software.
inadequate.exampleZh: 这台旧电脑配置不足，无法运行新软件。

inaugurate.example: The new mayor will inaugurate the city's first public library next Monday.
inaugurate.exampleZh: 新市长将于下周一为这座城市的第一座公共图书馆举行落成典礼。

incentive.example: The company offers a cash incentive to employees who finish the work early.
incentive.exampleZh: 公司向提前完成工作的员工提供现金奖励。

inch.example: The table is about two inches wider than the one in my room.
inch.exampleZh: 这张桌子比我房间里的那张大约宽两英寸。

incidence.example: The incidence of this disease is higher in older people.
incidence.exampleZh: 这种疾病在老年人中的发病率更高。

incident.example: That small incident at school taught me to be more careful.
incident.exampleZh: 学校里那件小事教会我要更加小心。

incline.example: I incline to believe his story because he seems honest.
incline.exampleZh: 我倾向于相信他的说法，因为他看起来很诚实。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free wifi in every room.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐以及每个房间的免费无线网络。

including.example: The price includes breakfast, including fresh fruit and coffee.
including.exampleZh: 价格包含早餐，包括新鲜水果和咖啡。

inclusive.example: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free Wi-Fi.
inclusive.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐和免费无线网络。

income.example: Her monthly income is enough to pay the rent and buy food.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入足够支付房租和购买食物。

incorporate.example: We will incorporate your ideas into the new plan next week.
incorporate.exampleZh: 我们下周会把你的想法纳入新计划。

increase.example: The number of students in our school will increase next year.
increase.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生人数明年将会增加。

increasingly.example: People increasingly use their phones to pay for things in shops.
increasingly.exampleZh: 人们在商店里越来越多地使用手机付款。

incredible.example: The view from the top of the hill was incredible.
incredible.exampleZh: 山顶上的景色令人难以置信。

incur.example: The company will incur heavy losses if the strike continues.
incur.exampleZh: 如果罢工持续下去，公司将招致严重损失。

indeed.example: This book is indeed very useful for beginners.
indeed.exampleZh: 这本书对初学者确实很有用。

indefinite.example: The meeting has been put off for an indefinite period.

independence.example: Children need independence, but they still need help from their parents.
independence.exampleZh: 孩子需要独立，但他们仍然需要父母的帮助。

independent.example: She is an independent thinker who makes her own decisions.
independent.exampleZh: 她是一个独立思考的人，自己做出决定。

index.example: Use the index at the back of the book to find the page.
index.exampleZh: 用书后面的索引来找到那一页。

indicate.example: These results indicate that the new method works well.
indicate.exampleZh: 这些结果表明这种新方法效果很好。

indication.example: The dark clouds are a clear indication that rain is coming soon.
indication.exampleZh: 乌云是即将下雨的明显迹象。

indicator.example: The red light is a good indicator of danger on this road.
indicator.exampleZh: 红灯是这条路上危险的一个良好指示信号。

indifferent.example: He seemed indifferent to the news and said nothing at all.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他对这个消息似乎漠不关心，什么也没说。

indigenous.example: The museum shows the art of indigenous people from this region.
indigenous.exampleZh: 这家博物馆展出了这个地区土著人的艺术品。
