indirect.example: She gave an indirect answer to my question about the money.
indirect.exampleZh: 她对我关于钱的问题给了个间接的回答。

indispensable.example: Clean water is indispensable for good health and everyday life.
indispensable.exampleZh: 清洁的水对健康和日常生活来说是必不可少的。

individual.example: Each individual student in our class has a different way of learning.
individual.exampleZh: 我们班上每个学生都有不同的学习方式。

indoor.example: There is an indoor pool in our new school building.
indoor.exampleZh: 我们新教学楼里有一个室内游泳池。

induce.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about the trip.
induce.exampleZh: 什么也无法诱使他改变关于这次旅行的想法。

industrial.example: Our city has a large industrial area near the river.
industrial.exampleZh: 我们城市在河边有一个很大的工业区。

industrialize.example: Many countries began to industrialize quickly after the war ended.
industrialize.exampleZh: 战争结束后，许多国家开始迅速实现工业化。

industry.example: The car industry gives many jobs to people in this city.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车工业为这座城市的人们提供了许多工作岗位。

inertia.example: Her inertia kept her on the sofa all weekend instead of going out.
inertia.exampleZh: 她的惰性让她整个周末都待在沙发上，没有出门。

inevitable.example: It is inevitable that the old factory will close next year.
inevitable.exampleZh: 这家老工厂明年关闭是不可避免的。

inexpensive.example: This small restaurant serves inexpensive food that tastes really good.
inexpensive.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆提供便宜又好吃的食物。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all night.
infant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿整晚都在母亲怀里安静地睡着。

infect.example: The sick boy may infect the other children at school.
infect.exampleZh: 那个生病的男孩可能会传染学校里的其他孩子。

infection.example: Wash your hands often to stop the infection from spreading.
infection.exampleZh: 经常洗手以防止感染传播。

infectious.example: Her laughter was so infectious that everyone in the room started smiling.
infectious.exampleZh: 她的笑声极具感染力，房间里的每个人都开始笑了起来。

infer.example: We can infer from his smile that he is happy.
infer.exampleZh: 从他的微笑我们可以推断出他很开心。

inference.example: His inference about the missing money turned out to be completely wrong.
inference.exampleZh: 他对那笔丢失的钱的推断结果完全错了。

inferior.example: This old phone is inferior to my new one in every way.
inferior.exampleZh: 这部旧手机在各方面都不如我的新手机。

infinite.example: The universe seems infinite, and nobody knows where it ends.
infinite.exampleZh: 宇宙似乎是无限的，没有人知道它在哪里结束。

inflate.example: People often inflate the tires of their bikes before a long ride.
inflate.exampleZh: 人们常在长途骑行前给自行车轮胎充气。

inflation.example: Inflation makes everyday things like food and clothes more expensive.
inflation.exampleZh: 通货膨胀使得食物和衣服等日常用品变得更贵。

inflict.example: The new rules inflict heavy costs on small business owners.
inflict.exampleZh: 新规定给小企业主带来了沉重的负担。

influence.example: His teacher had a strong influence on his choice of career.
influence.exampleZh: 他的老师对他的职业选择有很大的影响。

influential.example: She is an influential teacher who helps many students at our school.
influential.exampleZh: 她是一位有影响力的老师，在我们学校帮助了很多学生。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

informal.example: The meeting was informal, so everyone spoke freely and no one wore a suit.
informal.exampleZh: 这次会议是非正式的，所以大家畅所欲言，也没有人穿西装。

information.example: I need more information about this job before I apply.
information.exampleZh: 在申请之前，我需要更多关于这份工作的信息。

infrastructure.example: The city needs to improve its infrastructure before the new houses are built.
infrastructure.exampleZh: 在建造新房子之前，这座城市需要改善其基础设施。

ingredient.example: Flour is the main ingredient in bread and cakes.
ingredient.exampleZh: 面粉是面包和蛋糕的主要原料。

inhabit.example: Many small birds inhabit the trees near our school.
inhabit.exampleZh: 许多小鸟栖息在我们学校附近的树上。

inhabitant.example: Every inhabitant of the small town knows the old baker well.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个小镇的每位居民都很熟悉那位老面包师。

inherent.example: There is an inherent risk in every new business.
inherent.exampleZh: 每一项新生意都存在固有的风险。

inherit.example: Children often inherit their parents' eye color and hair color.
inherit.exampleZh: 孩子常常通过遗传获得父母的眼色和发色。

initial.example: His initial idea was simple, but it became very popular later.
initial.exampleZh: 他最初的想法很简单，但后来变得非常受欢迎。

initially.example: Initially, I found the new job quite hard.
initially.exampleZh: 最初，我觉得这份新工作相当难。

initiate.example: They plan to initiate a new program at the school next month.
initiate.exampleZh: 他们计划下个月在学校发起一个新项目。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to help her new classmates feel welcome.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动帮助新同学，让他们感到受欢迎。

inject.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into his arm this morning.
inject.exampleZh: 护士今天上午会把药注射进他的手臂。

injure.example: He fell off his bike and injured his left leg.
injure.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤了左腿。

injury.example: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 他因为膝盖受伤而错过了比赛。

injustice.example: She was angry about the injustice done to her poor family.
injustice.exampleZh: 她对发生在自己贫穷家庭身上的不公感到愤怒。

ink.example: Please use blue ink to write your name on this form.
ink.exampleZh: 请用蓝色墨水在这张表格上写下你的名字。

inland.example: This small inland town is far from the sea and very quiet.
inland.exampleZh: 这个小小的内陆城镇远离大海，非常安静。

inlet.example: The small boat rested in a quiet inlet near the rocks.
inlet.exampleZh: 小船停在岩石附近一个安静的小水湾里。

inmate.example: The new inmate shares a small room with two other men.
inmate.exampleZh: 新来的同住者与另外两名男子合住一个小房间。

inn.example: We stayed at a small inn near the river last night.
inn.exampleZh: 昨晚我们住在河边的一家小客栈里。

inner.example: Her inner voice told her to stay calm during the difficult test.
inner.exampleZh: 在艰难的考试中，她内心的声音告诉她要保持冷静。

innocent.example: The judge said the young man was innocent of the crime.
innocent.exampleZh: 法官说这个年轻人在这起犯罪中是无罪的。

innovate.example: Small companies must innovate to grow in a changing market.
innovate.exampleZh: 小公司必须创新，才能在不断变化的市场中成长。

innovation.example: The new phone shows how innovation can make our daily lives much easier.
innovation.exampleZh: 这款新手机展示了创新如何让我们的日常生活变得更加便利。

innovative.example: This innovative app helps students learn English words in a fun way.
innovative.exampleZh: 这个创新的应用帮助学生以有趣的方式学习英语单词。

innumerable.example: There are innumerable stars in the sky on a clear night.
innumerable.exampleZh: 在晴朗的夜晚，天空中有无数的星星。

input.example: Please input your password before you start the computer.
input.exampleZh: 请在启动电脑前输入你的密码。

inquire.example: I called the hotel to inquire about the price of a room.
inquire.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店，询问一个房间的价格。

inquiry.example: The police made an inquiry into the accident and asked many witnesses.
inquiry.exampleZh: 警方对这起事故进行了调查，并询问了许多目击者。

inquisitive.example: The inquisitive child asks many questions about how things work.
inquisitive.exampleZh: 这个好奇的孩子问了很多关于事物如何运作的问题。

insane.example: It is insane to drive so fast in heavy rain.
insane.exampleZh: 在这么大的雨里开这么快真是太荒唐了。

insect.example: A small insect is walking on the green leaf.
insect.exampleZh: 一只小昆虫正在绿叶上爬。

inseparable.example: The two sisters are inseparable and do everything together every day.
inseparable.exampleZh: 这对姐妹形影不离，每天做什么都在一起。

insert.example: Please insert your card into the machine and wait for a message.
insert.exampleZh: 请将你的银行卡插入机器，然后等待提示信息。

inside.example: The cat is sleeping inside the warm box.
inside.exampleZh: 那只猫正在温暖的箱子里睡觉。

insight.example: She has a deep insight into how young children learn languages.
insight.exampleZh: 她对幼儿如何学习语言有深刻的洞察力。

insist.example: She insisted on paying for dinner even though I told her not to.
insist.exampleZh: 尽管我告诉她不用，她还是坚持要付晚餐的钱。

inspect.example: The teacher will inspect our homework before the class starts.
inspect.exampleZh: 老师会在上课前检查我们的作业。

inspector.example: The inspector looked carefully at every room in the old school building.
inspector.exampleZh: 检查员仔细查看了这栋老旧教学楼的每一个房间。

inspire.example: My teacher's kind words inspired me to work harder at school.
inspire.exampleZh: 老师温暖的话语激励我在学校里更加努力。

install.example: They will install the new software on every computer this afternoon.
install.exampleZh: 他们今天下午会在每台电脑上安装这个新软件。

instance.example: In this instance, the teacher gave us a simple example to explain the rule.
instance.exampleZh: 在这个例子中，老师给了我们一个简单的例子来解释这条规则。

instant.example: He felt instant relief after drinking a glass of cold water.
instant.exampleZh: 喝了一杯冷水后，他立刻感到轻松了。

instead.example: I wanted tea, but we had no milk, so I drank water instead.
instead.exampleZh: 我本想喝茶，但没有牛奶了，所以就改喝水。

instinct.example: Her instinct told her to run when she heard the strange noise.
instinct.exampleZh: 听到那奇怪的声音时，她的本能告诉她快跑。

instinctive.example: She has an instinctive fear of the dark.
instinctive.exampleZh: 她对黑暗有一种本能的恐惧。

institute.example: The new institute will help young people learn science and technology.
institute.exampleZh: 这个新研究所将帮助年轻人学习科学和技术。

institution.example: The bank is a large financial institution in our city.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是我们城市里一家大型金融机构。

institutional.example: The school has institutional rules that all students must follow.
institutional.exampleZh: 这所学校有所有学生都必须遵守的制度性规定。

instruct.example: The teacher instructed us to read the book carefully before class.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师指示我们在上课前仔细读这本书。

instruction.example: The teacher gave clear instructions before the students started the test.
instruction.exampleZh: 老师在学生开始考试前给出了清楚的指示。

instructive.example: The teacher told us an instructive story about honesty.
instructive.exampleZh: 老师给我们讲了一个关于诚实的有启发性的故事。

instructor.example: Our driving instructor is very patient with new students.
instructor.exampleZh: 我们的驾驶教练对新学员非常有耐心。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my eyes.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的眼睛。

instrumental.example: Music was instrumental in helping him feel calm and happy again.
instrumental.exampleZh: 音乐在帮助他重新感到平静和快乐方面起了重要作用。

insufficient.example: The food was insufficient for all the hungry children at the school.
insufficient.exampleZh: 食物不够学校里所有饥饿的孩子们吃。

insulate.example: Thick walls insulate the house well in cold weather.
insulate.exampleZh: 厚墙在寒冷天气里能很好地为房子隔热。

insulator.example: Rubber is a good insulator, so it keeps electricity from flowing through.
insulator.exampleZh: 橡胶是良好的绝缘体，因此它能阻止电流通过。

insult.example: Please do not insult your classmates when you are angry with them.
insult.exampleZh: 当你生同学的气时，请不要侮辱他们。

insurance.example: He pays for car insurance every month to stay safe on the road.
insurance.exampleZh: 他每月支付汽车保险费，以便在路上保持安全。

insure.example: We insure our house against fire and other damage.
insure.exampleZh: 我们给房子投保火灾及其他损坏险。

intact.example: Luckily, the old vase was still intact after the move.
intact.exampleZh: 幸运的是，那只旧花瓶搬家后仍然完好无损。

intake.example: You should reduce your daily intake of sugar and salt to stay healthy.
intake.exampleZh: 为了保持健康，你应该减少每天糖和盐的摄入量。

integral.example: Practice is an integral part of learning any new language.
integral.exampleZh: 练习是学习任何一门新语言不可或缺的一部分。

integrate.example: Our school tries to integrate new students into class activities quickly.
integrate.exampleZh: 我们学校努力让新同学尽快融入班级活动。

integration.example: The integration of the two teams took only a few weeks.
integration.exampleZh: 两个团队的整合只花了几周时间。

integrity.example: Her integrity made everyone trust her with important work.
integrity.exampleZh: 她的正直让每个人都放心把重要工作交给她。

intellect.example: Her sharp intellect helped her solve the difficult problem quickly.
intellect.exampleZh: 她敏锐的智力帮助她很快解决了这个难题。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual talks with her friends after class.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢课后和朋友们进行智力上的交谈。

intelligence.example: Her intelligence helped the team solve the difficult problem quickly.
intelligence.exampleZh: 她的智慧帮助团队迅速解决了这个难题。

intelligent.example: She is a very intelligent student who learns new things quickly.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她是一个非常聪明的学生，学新东西很快。

intelligible.example: The teacher's explanation was clear and intelligible to all the students.
intelligible.exampleZh: 老师的解释清楚明白，所有学生都能理解。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算在今晚晚饭前完成作业。

intense.example: The intense heat made it hard for us to work outside.
intense.exampleZh: 强烈的酷热让我们很难在户外工作。

intensify.example: The heavy rain intensified the problems on the old road.
intensify.exampleZh: 大雨加剧了这条旧路上的问题。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到吃惊。

intensive.example: The city offers an intensive English course for new students each summer.
intensive.exampleZh: 这座城市每年夏天为新学生开设密集英语课程。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my mind about the trip.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有打算改变关于这次旅行的想法。

interact.example: Children learn social skills when they interact with others in group activities.
interact.exampleZh: 孩子们在集体活动中与他人互动时学习社交技能。

interaction.example: Good interaction between teacher and students makes English classes more fun.
interaction.exampleZh: 师生之间良好的互动让英语课更有趣。

interactive.example: This interactive game helps children learn new words in a fun way.
interactive.exampleZh: 这个互动游戏帮助孩子们以有趣的方式学习新单词。

intercept.example: The police tried to intercept the letters before they reached him.
intercept.exampleZh: 警方试图在这些信件送到他手里之前将其截住。

interchange.example: We often interchange ideas during our weekly team meetings.
interchange.exampleZh: 我们经常在每周的团队会议上交换想法。

intercourse.example: Good intercourse between the two countries helps trade and peace.
intercourse.exampleZh: 两国之间的良好往来有助于贸易与和平。

interdependent.example: In a small village, people are interdependent because every family needs help from others.
interdependent.exampleZh: 在小村庄里，人们相互依存，因为每个家庭都需要他人的帮助。

interest.example: She has a strong interest in music and plays the piano every day.
interest.exampleZh: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣，每天都弹钢琴。

interested.example: My little brother is very interested in space and stars.
interested.exampleZh: 我的小弟弟对太空和星星非常感兴趣。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting and I want to read it again.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我想再读一遍。

interface.example: The new interface is easy to use and looks very clean.
interface.exampleZh: 这个新界面易于使用，看起来也很整洁。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work when I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要干涉我的工作。

interference.example: My parents' interference made the problem worse.
interference.exampleZh: 父母的干涉让问题变得更糟。

interim.example: The company hired an interim manager while they searched for a permanent one.
interim.exampleZh: 公司在寻找正式人选期间聘请了一位临时经理。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was bright and clean.
interior.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的内部明亮又干净。

intermediate.example: This class is for students at an intermediate level of English.
intermediate.exampleZh: 这个班是给英语中级水平的学生上的。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal reports private and only managers can read them.
internal.exampleZh: 公司将其内部报告保密，只有经理可以阅读。

internalize.example: Children internalize the rules of their culture by watching the adults around them.
internalize.exampleZh: 孩子们通过观察身边的成年人，将文化的规则内化。

international.example: She works for an international company and travels to many countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去很多国家出差。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to check my email and read news.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天使用互联网查看电子邮件和阅读新闻。

interplay.example: The interplay between light and shadow makes this painting interesting.
interplay.exampleZh: 光与影的相互作用使这幅画很有意思。

interpret.example: Please interpret this letter for me so I can understand it.
interpret.exampleZh: 请帮我解释这封信，好让我能看懂。

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem was very different from mine.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的理解和我的很不一样。

interpreter.example: She works as an interpreter at the United Nations.
interpreter.exampleZh: 她在联合国担任口译员。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking to the class.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我在给全班讲话时，请不要打断我。

interruption.example: A loud noise caused an interruption during the meeting.
interruption.exampleZh: 一声巨响在会议期间造成了中断。

intersection.example: Turn left at the next intersection and you will see the bank.
intersection.exampleZh: 在下一个十字路口左转，你就会看到那家银行。

interstate.example: We drove on the interstate highway to visit our grandparents in another state.
interstate.exampleZh: 我们沿着州际公路开车去看望住在另一个州的祖父母。

interval.example: There is a short interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 两节课之间有一段短暂的间隔。

intervene.example: The teacher had to intervene when the two students began to argue loudly.
intervene.exampleZh: 那两个学生开始大声争吵时，老师不得不介入。

intervention.example: The teacher's intervention stopped the fight between the two boys.
intervention.exampleZh: 老师的干预阻止了两个男孩之间的打斗。

interview.example: She has an interview for a new job on Monday morning.
interview.exampleZh: 她周一上午有一场新工作的面试。

intimacy.example: Trust and honest talk can build real intimacy between two people.
intimacy.exampleZh: 信任和坦诚的交谈能在两个人之间建立真正的亲密。

intimate.example: She is intimate with her old school friends and tells them everything.
intimate.exampleZh: 她和以前的学校朋友很亲密，什么事都告诉他们。

intimidate.example: The big boy tried to intimidate the smaller children at school.
intimidate.exampleZh: 那个大男孩试图在学校里恐吓比他小的孩子。

intimidation.example: The big dog stood in front of the gate, and its loud barking was pure intimidation.
intimidation.exampleZh: 那只大狗站在大门前，它响亮的吠叫纯粹是恐吓。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and made a cup of tea.
into.exampleZh: 她走进厨房，泡了一杯茶。

intoxicate.example: The sweet wine intoxicated him, and he began to laugh at everything.
intoxicate.exampleZh: 甜酒使他醉了，他开始对一切都发笑。

intricacy.example: The intricacy of the old clock amazed the young boy.
intricacy.exampleZh: 这座古老时钟的错综复杂让这个小男孩惊叹不已。

intricate.example: The old watch has an intricate design with many small parts.
intricate.exampleZh: 这块旧手表有着错综复杂的设计，里面有许多小零件。

intrigue.example: The plot of the movie began to intrigue her after the first scene.
intrigue.exampleZh: 看完第一幕之后，这部电影的情节开始激起她的好奇心。

intriguing.example: The book tells an intriguing story about a small town.
intriguing.exampleZh: 这本书讲述了一个关于小镇的引人入胜的故事。

intrinsic.example: Reading has an intrinsic value that goes beyond passing exams.
intrinsic.exampleZh: 阅读具有一种超越考试及格的内在价值。

introduce.example: Let me introduce my friend Tom to my parents.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把我的朋友汤姆介绍给我的父母。

introduction.example: The introduction to the book explains its main ideas.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书的引言解释了它的主要观点。

intrude.example: Please do not intrude when the door is closed.
intrude.exampleZh: 门关着的时候请不要闯入。

intrusion.example: The loud noise was an intrusion into our quiet evening at home.
intrusion.exampleZh: 那阵巨响是对我们家中宁静夜晚的打扰。

invade.example: Every summer, tourists invade this small quiet town by the sea.
invade.exampleZh: 每年夏天，游客都会涌入这个安静的海边小镇。

invader.example: The soldiers fought bravely to stop the invaders from entering the city.
invader.exampleZh: 士兵们英勇作战，阻止入侵者进入城市。

invariably.example: She invariably arrives early and checks every detail before the meeting starts.
invariably.exampleZh: 她总是很早到达，并在会议开始前检查每一个细节。

invasion.example: The soldiers fought bravely against the invasion of their country.
invasion.exampleZh: 士兵们勇敢地抵抗对他们国家的入侵。

invent.example: He tried to invent a simple machine to help his mother cook.
invent.exampleZh: 他试着发明一台简单的机器来帮母亲做饭。

invention.example: The telephone is a great invention that changed the way people talk.
invention.exampleZh: 电话是一项伟大的发明，它改变了人们交谈的方式。

inventive.example: She is an inventive girl who makes toys from old boxes.
inventive.exampleZh: 她是个有创造力的女孩，会用旧盒子做玩具。

inventor.example: The inventor built a small machine to help his mother cook.
inventor.exampleZh: 这位发明家造了一台小机器来帮母亲做饭。

inventory.example: The store checks its inventory every month to see what is missing.
inventory.exampleZh: 这家店每个月都检查库存，看缺了什么。

inverse.example: The inverse of a number is one divided by that number.
inverse.exampleZh: 一个数的倒数就是一除以这个数。

invert.example: She inverted the cup to let the water run out.
invert.exampleZh: 她把杯子倒过来，让水流出去。

invest.example: My parents want to invest their money in a small shop.
invest.exampleZh: 我父母想把他们的钱投资到一家小商店里。

investigate.example: The police will investigate the case and find out the truth.
investigate.exampleZh: 警方将调查这起案件，查明真相。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the missing money.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方开始调查那笔失踪的钱。

investigator.example: The investigator asked the witness a few simple questions about the missing car.
investigator.exampleZh: 调查员就那辆失踪的汽车向目击者问了几个简单的问题。

investment.example: My father made a big investment in a small local company last year.
investment.exampleZh: 我父亲去年向一家本地小公司做了一笔大投资。

investor.example: The investor put his money into a small company last year.
investor.exampleZh: 这位投资者去年把钱投进了一家小公司。

invisible.example: The air is invisible, but we can feel it on a windy day.
invisible.exampleZh: 空气是看不见的，但在刮风的日子里我们能感觉到它。

invitation.example: I got an invitation to her birthday party and I am very happy.
invitation.exampleZh: 我收到了她生日聚会的邀请，我非常高兴。

invite.example: I want to invite my new friends to dinner this Saturday evening.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请我的新朋友们这周六晚上来吃晚饭。

inviting.example: The warm bread on the table looked very inviting to everyone.
inviting.exampleZh: 桌上热腾腾的面包在大家看来非常诱人。

invoice.example: Please send me the invoice for your work last month.
invoice.exampleZh: 请把你上个月工作的发票寄给我。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and long meetings.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作将涉及大量出差和漫长的会议。

involved.example: She was involved in planning the school trip with her friends.
involved.exampleZh: 她和朋友们一起参与了学校旅行的策划。

involvement.example: His involvement in the project helped the whole team finish on time.
involvement.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的参与帮助整个团队按时完成。

inward.example: She took a deep breath and turned her inward thoughts into words.
inward.exampleZh: 她深吸一口气，把内心的想法化作了语言。

iron.example: She will iron her white shirt before the meeting this morning.
iron.exampleZh: 今天早上开会前，她会把白衬衫熨平。

ironic.example: It is ironic that he forgot his own birthday.
ironic.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，他忘记了自己的生日。

ironically.example: Ironically, the rain stopped right after we canceled the picnic.
ironically.exampleZh: 讽刺的是，我们刚取消野餐，雨就停了。

ironwork.example: The old gate is beautiful ironwork made by a local craftsman.
ironwork.exampleZh: 这扇旧大门是由当地工匠制作的精美铁制品。

irony.example: Life is full of irony: the fire station burned down last night.
irony.exampleZh: 生活充满了讽刺：消防站昨晚被烧毁了。

irregular.example: His sleep schedule is irregular because he often works late at night.
irregular.exampleZh: 他的作息不规律，因为他经常工作到很晚。

irrelevant.example: His question was irrelevant to the topic we were discussing.
irrelevant.exampleZh: 他的问题与我们正在讨论的话题不相关。

irrespective.example: She bought the dress irrespective of the high price.
irrespective.exampleZh: 她不顾高昂的价格买下了那条裙子。

irreversible.example: The damage to the old forest is irreversible and will last forever.
irreversible.exampleZh: 对这片古老森林的破坏是不可逆转的，将永远持续下去。

irrigate.example: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river every summer.
irrigate.exampleZh: 每年夏天，农民用河水灌溉他们的田地。

irrigation.example: The farmers use irrigation to grow rice in dry areas.
irrigation.exampleZh: 农民在干旱地区用灌溉来种植水稻。

irritable.example: He gets irritable when he is tired and hungry.
irritable.exampleZh: 他又累又饿的时候就会变得易怒。

irritate.example: Loud noise can irritate people who are trying to work.
irritate.exampleZh: 噪音会激怒正在努力尝试工作的人。

irritation.example: He could not hide his irritation when the train was late again.
irritation.exampleZh: 火车又晚点时，他无法掩饰自己的恼怒。

island.example: There is a small island in the middle of the lake.

isle.example: We took a small boat to the isle and stayed there all day.
isle.exampleZh: 我们坐小船去了那座小岛，并在那里待了一整天。

isolate.example: The doctor had to isolate the sick child from the others.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生不得不把生病的孩子与其他孩子隔离开。

isolated.example: The old house is isolated and far from the busy town.
isolated.exampleZh: 那座老房子很孤立，远离繁忙的小镇。

isolation.example: After the storm, the village lived in isolation for three days.
isolation.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，那个村子与外界隔绝了三天。

isotope.example: Scientists use a special isotope of carbon to study ancient objects.
isotope.exampleZh: 科学家使用一种特殊的碳同位素来研究古代物品。

issue.example: The new issue of the magazine came out today.
issue.exampleZh: 这本杂志的新一期今天发行了。

it.example: It is very cold today, so please wear a warm coat.
it.exampleZh: 今天很冷，所以请穿一件暖和的外套。

item.example: She put every item on the shopping list into her basket.
item.exampleZh: 她把购物清单上的每件商品都放进了购物篮里。

itemize.example: Please itemize all the costs so we can check the total.
itemize.exampleZh: 请逐条列出所有费用，以便我们核对总额。

its.example: The dog wagged its tail when I got home.
its.exampleZh: 我回家时，那只狗摇着它的尾巴。

itself.example: The little cat cleaned itself after eating the fish.
itself.exampleZh: 小猫吃完鱼后自己清理了身体。

ivory.example: The old box is made of ivory and feels very smooth.
ivory.exampleZh: 这个旧盒子是用象牙做的，摸起来很光滑。

jab.example: The nurse gave him a quick jab in the arm.
jab.exampleZh: 护士在他的胳膊上快速打了一针。

jacket.example: He put on a warm jacket before going outside in the cold.
jacket.exampleZh: 他在寒冷中出门前穿上了一件暖和的夹克。

jagged.example: The broken glass had jagged edges, so we did not touch it.
jagged.exampleZh: 碎玻璃的边缘参差不齐，所以我们没有碰它。

jaguar.example: The jaguar moves quietly through the thick green forest.
jaguar.exampleZh: 这只美洲豹安静地穿过茂密的绿色森林。

jail.example: He spent two years in jail for stealing a car.
jail.exampleZh: 他因偷车在监狱里待了两年。

jam.example: The morning traffic jam made us late for school again today.
jam.exampleZh: 今天早上的交通堵塞又让我们上学迟到了。

january.example: January is the first month of the year and it is often very cold.
january.exampleZh: 一月是一年中的第一个月，通常非常冷。

jar.example: She kept the cookies in a glass jar on the kitchen table.
jar.exampleZh: 她把饼干放在厨房桌子上的一个玻璃罐里。

jargon.example: The doctor used too much medical jargon, so I could not understand him.
jargon.exampleZh: 医生用了太多医学术语，所以我听不懂他的话。

jasmine.example: My grandmother grows jasmine in her garden and its smell is very sweet.
jasmine.exampleZh: 我奶奶在花园里种了茉莉，它的气味很香。

jaunty.example: He gave a jaunty wave and walked off down the street.
jaunty.exampleZh: 他轻快地挥了挥手，然后沿街走开了。

jaw.example: He fell off the bike and hurt his jaw.
jaw.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤到了下巴。

jazz.example: My brother likes to listen to jazz while he does his homework.
jazz.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢一边写作业一边听爵士乐。

jealous.example: She feels jealous when her best friend talks to other girls.
jealous.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友和其他女孩说话时，她会感到嫉妒。

jealousy.example: His jealousy grew stronger every time she talked about her new friend.
jealousy.exampleZh: 每当她谈起自己的新朋友，他的嫉妒就更加强烈。

jeans.example: She wears blue jeans and a white shirt to school every day.
jeans.exampleZh: 她每天穿蓝色牛仔裤和白衬衫去上学。

jeep.example: My uncle drives an old jeep across the hills every weekend.
jeep.exampleZh: 我叔叔每个周末都开着一辆旧吉普车翻越山丘。

jeopardize.example: Smoking can jeopardize your health and the health of people around you.
jeopardize.exampleZh: 吸烟会危及你的健康以及身边人的健康。

jeopardy.example: His careless words put the whole team in jeopardy.
jeopardy.exampleZh: 他不慎的言辞使整个团队陷入了危险。

jerk.example: He gave the rope a quick jerk and the box moved.
jerk.exampleZh: 他猛拽了一下绳子，箱子就移动了。

jersey.example: He wore a blue jersey to the football game yesterday.
jersey.exampleZh: 他昨天穿了一件蓝色运动衫去看足球赛。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds on its way to Tokyo.
jet.exampleZh: 这架喷气式飞机飞越云层，前往东京。

jewel.example: She wore a beautiful jewel around her neck at the party.
jewel.exampleZh: 她在聚会上脖子上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

jewellery.example: She wears beautiful jewellery to the party every year.
jewellery.exampleZh: 她每年都戴着漂亮的首饰去参加聚会。

job.example: She found a new job at a small shop near her home.
job.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一家小商店找到了一份新工作。

jockey.example: The jockey rode the horse very fast and won the big race today.
jockey.exampleZh: 那位职业赛马骑师骑着马飞快地奔跑，今天赢得了那场大赛。

jog.example: I like to have a short jog every morning before school.
jog.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早上上学前慢跑一会儿。

join.example: The plumber fixed the join between the two pipes with tape.
join.exampleZh: 水管工用胶带把两根管子的接合处修好了。

joint.example: The two companies signed a joint agreement to build a new school.
joint.exampleZh: 两家公司签署了一项联合协议，共同建造一所新学校。

joke.example: It was a joke gift, but she liked it anyway.
joke.exampleZh: 那是个玩笑性质的礼物，不过她还是喜欢。

jolly.example: The jolly old man laughed and gave the children some sweets.
jolly.exampleZh: 那位愉快的老人笑着给了孩子们一些糖果。

jolt.example: The truck hit a hole and jolted everyone in the back seat.
jolt.exampleZh: 卡车撞到一个坑，把后座的每个人都颠了一下。

jostle.example: People jostled each other to get a seat on the crowded bus.
jostle.exampleZh: 人们互相推挤着，想在拥挤的公交车上抢到一个座位。

jot.example: I always jot down new words in a small notebook.
jot.exampleZh: 我总是把新单词匆匆记在一个小本子上。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before she goes to sleep.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会在日记里写点东西。

journalism.example: She wants to study journalism so she can write news for a big newspaper.
journalism.exampleZh: 她想学习新闻学，这样就能为一家大报社写新闻了。

journalist.example: The journalist asked the mayor several questions after the meeting.
journalist.exampleZh: 会议结束后，那名记者向市长提了几个问题。

journey.example: The journey to the mountain took three hours by bus.
journey.exampleZh: 坐公交车去山里的旅程花了三个小时。

jovial.example: Our jovial neighbor always greets everyone with a big smile.
jovial.exampleZh: 我们那位快活的邻居总是笑容满面地和大家打招呼。

joy.example: Her joyful smile brought me great joy on a hard day.
joy.exampleZh: 她快乐的笑容在我艰难的一天里带给我极大的喜悦。

joyful.example: The children were joyful when they saw the snow outside.
joyful.exampleZh: 孩子们看到外面的雪时非常高兴。

joystick.example: The pilot moved the joystick to turn the plane.
joystick.exampleZh: 飞行员移动操纵杆来让飞机转向。

jubilee.example: The whole town held a big party for the school's fiftieth jubilee.
jubilee.exampleZh: 全镇为学校建校五十周年举办了一场盛大的聚会。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
judge.exampleZh: 法官在做出决定前仔细听取了双方的意见。

judgement.example: Her judgement of the situation was correct, and everyone trusted her.
judgement.exampleZh: 她对形势的判断是正确的，大家都信任她。

judicial.example: The judicial system must be fair to every citizen.
judicial.exampleZh: 司法系统必须对每一位公民都公正。

judo.example: My sister practices judo at the sports center every Tuesday evening.
judo.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周二晚上在体育中心练习柔道。

jug.example: She filled the jug with cold water and put it on the table.
jug.exampleZh: 她把罐子装满冷水，放在桌子上。

juggle.example: She can juggle three balls and still answer the phone.
juggle.exampleZh: 她能一边抛接三个球，一边接电话。

juice.example: I drink a glass of orange juice every morning before breakfast.
juice.exampleZh: 我每天早上早餐前喝一杯橙汁。

juicy.example: The ripe peach is juicy and tastes very sweet in summer.
juicy.exampleZh: 这个熟透的桃子很多汁，夏天吃起来很甜。

jukebox.example: The old jukebox in the corner played our favorite song last night.
jukebox.exampleZh: 角落里那台旧自动点唱机昨晚播放了我们最喜欢的歌。

july.example: We will go to the beach with our family in July.
july.exampleZh: 我们将在七月和家人一起去海滩。

jumbo.example: The store sells a jumbo bag of rice at a low price.
jumbo.exampleZh: 这家商店以低价出售一大袋大米。

jump.example: The cat tried to jump over the small fence but failed.
jump.exampleZh: 那只猫想跳过那道小栅栏，但没跳过去。

junction.example: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the station.
junction.exampleZh: 在下一个交叉口向左转，你就会看到车站。

june.example: We will take a short family trip in June this year.
june.exampleZh: 今年六月我们会去进行一次短途家庭旅行。

jungle.example: Many wild animals live in the jungle and find food there.
jungle.exampleZh: 许多野生动物生活在丛林中，并在那里觅食。

junior.example: As a junior employee, she often asks her senior colleagues for help.
junior.exampleZh: 作为一名初级员工，她经常向资深同事寻求帮助。

junk.example: There is too much junk in the old room.
junk.exampleZh: 那个旧房间里堆了太多废旧杂物。

junta.example: The junta took control of the country after a quick and quiet coup.
junta.exampleZh: 军政府在一次迅速而无声的政变后控制了这个国家。

jurisdiction.example: The court has no jurisdiction over crimes committed in another country.
jurisdiction.exampleZh: 该法院对在其他国家犯下的罪行没有管辖权。

juror.example: The juror listened carefully to all the facts before making a decision.
juror.exampleZh: 那位陪审员在做出决定前仔细听取了所有事实。

jury.example: The jury listened carefully to all the facts before making their decision.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团在做出决定前仔细听取了所有事实。

just.example: She just finished her homework and is now free to play outside.
just.exampleZh: 她刚做完作业，现在有空去外面玩了。

justice.example: The people asked for justice after the unfair trial.
justice.exampleZh: 在那场不公正的审判之后，人们要求伸张正义。

justification.example: There is no justification for treating people that way.
justification.exampleZh: 那样对待人是没有正当理由的。

justify.example: He tried to justify his mistake by blaming the bad weather.
justify.exampleZh: 他试图把错误归咎于恶劣的天气来为自己辩解。

juvenile.example: The juvenile bird cannot fly yet, but it will soon learn.
juvenile.exampleZh: 这只幼鸟还不能飞，但它很快就会学会。

kale.example: My mother puts fresh kale in her salad every morning.
kale.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上都在沙拉里放新鲜的羽衣甘蓝。

kaleidoscope.example: Life is a kaleidoscope of colors, surprises, and small daily changes.
kaleidoscope.exampleZh: 生活是一个由色彩、惊喜和日常小变化组成的万花筒。

kamikaze.example: The kamikaze attack surprised the soldiers on the ship.
kamikaze.exampleZh: 那次神风突击队的袭击让船上的士兵措手不及。

kangaroo.example: We saw a kangaroo jump across the road on our way home.
kangaroo.exampleZh: 我们在回家的路上看到一只袋鼠跳过马路。

karate.example: My brother learns karate at a small school near our house.
karate.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的一所小学校里学空手道。

karma.example: She believes good karma will come back to her one day.
karma.exampleZh: 她相信善业总有一天会回报到她身上。

kayak.example: We took a small kayak across the calm lake near our camp.
kayak.exampleZh: 我们乘一只小皮划艇穿过营地附近平静的湖面。

kebab.example: My friends and I bought some kebab from a small shop near the park.
kebab.exampleZh: 我和朋友们在公园附近的一家小店买了一些烤肉串。

keen.example: She is keen to learn English and practises every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她渴望学英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: She keeps a small garden and grows fresh vegetables for her family.
keep.exampleZh: 她经营着一个小菜园，为家人种植新鲜蔬菜。

kennel.example: My dog sleeps in a small kennel behind our house every night.
kennel.exampleZh: 我的狗每天晚上都睡在我们家后面的一个小狗窝里。

keratin.example: Keratin makes your hair and nails strong and healthy.
keratin.exampleZh: 角蛋白使你的头发和指甲强韧健康。

kernel.example: The kernel of his idea is simple and very useful.
kernel.exampleZh: 他想法中的核心很简单，也非常有用。

ketchup.example: I put some ketchup on my fries at lunch today.
ketchup.exampleZh: 今天午餐时我在薯条上挤了些番茄酱。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to make hot tea.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡热茶。

key.example: The key to this problem is to ask the right question.
key.exampleZh: 这个问题的关键在于提出正确的问题。

keyboard.example: I type my homework on the keyboard every night.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天晚上用键盘打作业。

keynote.example: The keynote of her speech was hope for the future.
keynote.exampleZh: 她演讲的主旨是对未来的希望。

keystone.example: Trust is the keystone of a good friendship.
keystone.exampleZh: 信任是良好友谊的基石。

kick.example: He kicked the ball hard and then jumped up in excitement.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢球，然后兴奋地跳了起来。

kickoff.example: The kickoff of the new project will happen next Monday morning.
kickoff.exampleZh: 新项目的启动将在下周一上午进行。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to play soccer with his friends after school.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁的小孩喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

kidnap.example: The police are looking for the men who tried to kidnap the little boy.
kidnap.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找那些试图绑架这个小男孩的男子。

kidney.example: The doctor said my left kidney is healthy and works very well.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生说我左肾健康，功能良好。

kill.example: He tried to kill the spider with a shoe.
kill.exampleZh: 他试着用一只鞋把蜘蛛打死。

killer.example: The police finally caught the killer after a long search.
killer.exampleZh: 经过长时间搜寻，警方终于抓住了那个杀手。

kilo.example: This bag of rice weighs five kilos, so please help me carry it.
kilo.exampleZh: 这袋米重五公斤，请帮我搬一下。

kilogram.example: This bag of rice weighs one kilogram, so it is easy to carry.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋大米重一公斤，所以很容易携带。

kilometre.example: The school is about two kilometres from my home.
kilometre.exampleZh: 学校离我家大约两公里。

kilowatt.example: This small machine uses only one kilowatt of power each hour.
kilowatt.exampleZh: 这台小机器每小时只使用一千瓦的电力。

kimono.example: She wore a beautiful silk kimono to the festival last summer.
kimono.exampleZh: 去年夏天她穿着一件漂亮的丝绸和服去参加节日活动。

kin.example: All my kin came to the wedding, and we had a big dinner together.
kin.exampleZh: 我所有的亲属都来参加了婚礼，我们一起吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

kind.example: She is kind to everyone, and this kind of kindness makes people happy.
kind.exampleZh: 她对每个人都很和蔼，这种善良让人开心。

kindergarten.example: My little sister goes to kindergarten every morning on the school bus.
kindergarten.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上坐校车去幼儿园。

kindle.example: The teacher's story kindled a love of reading in the young students.
kindle.exampleZh: 老师的故事点燃了年轻学生们对阅读的热爱。

kindness.example: I will never forget her kindness to me when I was new here.
kindness.exampleZh: 我永远不会忘记我刚来这里时她对我的好意。

kinetic.example: The kinetic energy of the moving ball made it hard to stop.
kinetic.exampleZh: 运动球的动能使其很难停下来。

king.example: The king lived in a large castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for more than forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国四十多年。

kinship.example: The two families share a strong kinship that goes back many years.
kinship.exampleZh: 这两个家族之间有着深厚的亲属关系，可以追溯到很多年前。

kiosk.example: We bought cold drinks from a small kiosk near the park gate.
kiosk.exampleZh: 我们在公园大门附近的一个小售货亭买了冷饮。

kiss.example: She gave her little son a quick kiss before he went to school.
kiss.exampleZh: 她的小儿子上学前，她飞快地吻了他一下。

kit.example: She bought a small kit with tools to fix her bike.
kit.exampleZh: 她买了一个带工具的小套装来修理她的自行车。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kitchenware.example: We bought some new kitchenware for our small apartment last week.
kitchenware.exampleZh: 上周我们为我们的小公寓买了一些新的厨房用具。

kite.example: The little boy flies a red kite in the park on windy days.
kite.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在有风的日子里在公园里放一只红色的风筝。

kitten.example: The little kitten sleeps in a basket next to my bed.
kitten.exampleZh: 那只小猫睡在我床边的篮子里。

knack.example: She has a knack for making new students feel welcome.
knack.exampleZh: 她有一种让新同学感到受欢迎的本领。

knapsack.example: He put some bread and water in his knapsack before the long walk.
knapsack.exampleZh: 长途步行前，他把一些面包和水放进了背包里。

knee.example: My knee hurts a little after I run for a long time.
knee.exampleZh: 我跑了很久之后，膝盖有点疼。

kneel.example: He had to kneel down on the floor to look under the bed.
kneel.exampleZh: 他不得不跪在地板上往床底下看。

knife.example: Please be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 切面包时请小心那把锋利的刀。

knight.example: The brave knight rode his horse to the old castle.
knight.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士骑着马去了古老的城堡。

knit.example: My grandmother likes to knit warm sweaters for us in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢在冬天给我们织暖和的毛衣。

knob.example: Turn the knob on the radio to make the music louder.
knob.exampleZh: 转动收音机上的旋钮，让音乐声更大一些。

knock.example: Someone is knocking loudly on the front door, so please go and open it.
knock.exampleZh: 有人正在大声敲前门，请去开一下。

knot.example: He tied a strong knot in the rope and pulled it tight.
knot.exampleZh: 他在绳子上打了一个结实的结，然后拉紧。

know.example: I want to know the truth about what happened last night.
know.exampleZh: 我想知道昨晚发生的事情的真相。

knowledge.example: She has a lot of knowledge about plants and animals.
knowledge.exampleZh: 她对植物和动物有很多了解。

knowledgeable.example: Our new teacher is very knowledgeable and always answers our questions clearly.
knowledgeable.exampleZh: 我们的新老师知识渊博，总是清楚地回答我们的问题。

knuckle.example: I hit my knuckle on the table while cleaning the room.
knuckle.exampleZh: 我打扫房间时把指关节撞到了桌子上。

koala.example: The koala sleeps in the tree for most of the day.
koala.exampleZh: 考拉一天大部分时间都睡在树上。

kook.example: My neighbor is a friendly kook who talks to his garden every morning.
kook.exampleZh: 我的邻居是个友善的怪人，每天早上都跟他的花园说话。

kowtow.example: He refused to kowtow to the new boss and kept his own ideas.
kowtow.exampleZh: 他拒绝向新老板磕头顺从，坚持自己的想法。

kungfu.example: My grandfather taught me kungfu when I was a little boy.
kungfu.exampleZh: 我小时候爷爷教过我功夫。

lab.example: We do many science experiments in the lab after school.
lab.exampleZh: 放学后我们在实验室做很多科学实验。

label.example: Please label each box before you put it on the shelf.
label.exampleZh: 请在每个盒子上贴好标签，再把它们放到架子上。

laboratory.example: The students do science experiments in the laboratory every Friday afternoon.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们每周五下午在实验室做科学实验。

laborious.example: The laborious task of cleaning the whole house took us all day.
laborious.exampleZh: 打扫整栋房子的费力工作花了我们一整天。

labour.example: The farmer's hard labour in the field made the whole family tired.
labour.exampleZh: 农夫在田里的辛苦劳动让全家人都累了。

labyrinth.example: The old city has a labyrinth of narrow streets that confuse every visitor.
labyrinth.exampleZh: 这座老城有一片错综复杂的狭窄街道，让每位游客都迷路。

lace.example: She wore a white dress with lace around the neck.
lace.exampleZh: 她穿了一条领口带蕾丝的白色连衣裙。

lack.example: Many students lack the confidence to speak English in class.
lack.exampleZh: 许多学生缺乏在课堂上说英语的信心。

lactose.example: Many people cannot drink milk because their bodies have trouble digesting lactose.
lactose.exampleZh: 许多人不能喝牛奶，因为他们的身体难以消化乳糖。

ladder.example: He climbed the ladder to reach the top shelf.
ladder.exampleZh: 他爬上梯子去够最上层的架子。

laden.example: The truck was laden with boxes of fresh fruit.
laden.exampleZh: 那辆卡车满载着一箱箱新鲜水果。

lady.example: The lady next door often gives us fresh flowers from her garden.
lady.exampleZh: 隔壁那位女士常常送我们她花园里的鲜花。

lagoon.example: We swam in the warm lagoon behind the island.
lagoon.exampleZh: 我们在岛后温暖的潟湖里游泳。

lake.example: We swam in the lake near our house last summer.
lake.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在家附近的湖里游泳。

lamb.example: The little lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.exampleZh: 那只小羔羊在田野里紧挨着它的妈妈。

lame.example: He gave a lame excuse for being late to the meeting again.
lame.exampleZh: 他又为开会迟到给了一个站不住脚的借口。

lament.example: Many people came to lament the loss of the old village school.
lament.exampleZh: 许多人前来哀悼那所老村校的消失。

lamp.example: She turned on the lamp and read a book in bed.

lampshade.example: The lampshade on my desk is broken, so I need a new one.
lampshade.exampleZh: 我桌上的灯罩坏了，所以我需要一个新的。

lance.example: The knight picked up his lance and rode toward the castle.
lance.exampleZh: 骑士拿起他的长矛，朝城堡骑去。

land.example: The plane will land at the airport in ten minutes.
land.exampleZh: 飞机将在十分钟后降落在机场。

landfill.example: The old factory site is now a landfill for city waste.
landfill.exampleZh: 那个旧厂址现在是处理城市垃圾的填埋场。

landing.example: The plane made a smooth landing and everyone clapped.
landing.exampleZh: 飞机平稳着陆，大家都鼓起了掌。

landlady.example: The landlady rents a small room to two students.
landlady.exampleZh: 女房东把一个小房间租给了两个学生。

landlord.example: The landlord came to fix the broken water pipe in our kitchen.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东来修理我们厨房里坏掉的水管。

landmark.example: The old clock tower is a famous landmark in our city.
landmark.exampleZh: 那座古老的钟楼是我们城市著名的地标。

landmine.example: The soldiers stopped walking because they saw a landmine on the road.
landmine.exampleZh: 士兵们停下脚步，因为他们看到路上有一枚地雷。

landscape.example: The landscape outside my window is green and very beautiful in spring.
landscape.exampleZh: 春天时，我窗外的风景一片翠绿，非常美丽。

lane.example: The little boy rode his bike down the narrow lane behind our house.
lane.exampleZh: 那个小男孩骑着自行车沿着我们屋后的窄巷前行。

language.example: Learning a new language can open doors to many different cultures.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言可以打开通往许多不同文化的大门。

languid.example: After the long walk, she felt languid and wanted to do nothing.
languid.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，她感到倦怠，什么都不想做。

languish.example: The old dog languished in the small cage for many lonely days.
languish.exampleZh: 那只老狗在狭小的笼子里受煎熬，度过了许多孤独的日子。

lank.example: The lank young man stood quietly by the tall wooden door.
lank.exampleZh: 那个瘦长的年轻人静静地站在高大的木门旁。

lantern.example: We hung a red paper lantern above the door for the new year.
lantern.exampleZh: 为了迎接新年，我们在门上方挂了一盏红纸灯笼。

lap.example: The little dog sat on her lap during the whole car ride.
lap.exampleZh: 整个车程中，那只小狗都坐在她的大腿上。

lapel.example: He wore a small pin on his lapel at the wedding.
lapel.exampleZh: 婚礼上，他在西装翻领上别了一枚小别针。

lapse.example: A small lapse in attention caused the team to miss the deadline.
lapse.exampleZh: 一次小小的疏忽导致团队错过了截止日期。

laptop.example: I take my laptop to the library every day after class.
laptop.exampleZh: 我每天下课后都把笔记本电脑带到图书馆。

large.example: They live in a large house near the park.
large.exampleZh: 他们住在公园附近的一栋大房子里。

largely.example: The success of the project depends largely on how well the team works together.
largely.exampleZh: 这个项目的成功主要取决于团队合作得有多好。

largesse.example: Her largesse helped many poor families in the small town.
largesse.exampleZh: 她的慷慨帮助了小镇上的许多贫困家庭。

larva.example: The larva eats leaves and grows bigger every day.
larva.exampleZh: 幼虫吃叶子，每天都在长大。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to fix my eye.
laser.exampleZh: 医生用激光治疗我的眼睛。

lash.example: The strong wind lashed the trees all night long.
lash.exampleZh: 大风整夜猛烈地抽打着树木。

lasso.example: The cowboy threw his lasso around the calf's neck.
lasso.exampleZh: 牛仔把套索套在小牛的脖子上。

last.example: This is the last bus to the city tonight.
last.exampleZh: 这是今晚去城里的最后一班公交车。

lasting.example: The new paint gives the old wooden table a lasting shine.
lasting.exampleZh: 这种新油漆让旧木桌有了持久的光泽。

latch.example: He lifted the latch and pushed the old wooden door open.
latch.exampleZh: 他抬起门闩，推开了那扇旧木门。

late.example: I was late for school this morning because my bike broke.
late.exampleZh: 今天早上我上学迟到了，因为我的自行车坏了。

lately.example: I have been very busy at work lately.

latent.example: The doctor said the virus may stay latent in the body for years.
latent.exampleZh: 医生说这种病毒可能在体内潜伏多年。

later.example: I will call you later when I finish my work.
later.exampleZh: 我完成工作后会稍后给你打电话。

lateral.example: The doctor found a small cut on the lateral side of his leg.
lateral.exampleZh: 医生在他腿的侧面发现了一个小伤口。

latitude.example: The teacher gave us more latitude to choose our own topics this term.
latitude.exampleZh: 这学期老师给了我们更多自由来选择自己的课题。

latter.example: Of the two plans, the latter one seems much easier to follow.
latter.exampleZh: 在这两个方案中，后一个似乎更容易照着做。

laud.example: Our teacher will laud the students who help others in class.
laud.exampleZh: 我们的老师会赞美那些在班上帮助别人的学生。

laugh.example: The children laugh at the funny story their teacher tells them.
laugh.exampleZh: 孩子们听老师讲有趣的故事时笑了。

laughter.example: Her laughter filled the small room and made everyone smile.
laughter.exampleZh: 她的笑声充满了小房间，让每个人都笑了。

launch.example: They plan to launch a new phone next week.
launch.exampleZh: 他们计划下周推出一款新手机。

laundry.example: I need to do the laundry before I go to work.

lava.example: The hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
lava.exampleZh: 炽热的熔岩沿着火山坡缓缓流下。

lavatory.example: Please tell me where the lavatory is on this floor.
lavatory.exampleZh: 请告诉我这一层的洗手间在哪里。

lavish.example: She gave her friends lavish gifts on every birthday.
lavish.exampleZh: 她每次过生日都给朋友们送奢华的礼物。

law.example: Everyone must obey the law and treat other people fairly.
law.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守法律，公平对待他人。

lawful.example: It is lawful to park your car here on Sundays.
lawful.exampleZh: 周日在这里停车是合法的。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the green lawn.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在绿色的草坪上踢足球。

lawsuit.example: The workers filed a lawsuit against the company for unpaid wages.
lawsuit.exampleZh: 工人们因未付工资而起诉了这家公司。

lawyer.example: The lawyer helped my family understand the difficult court case.
lawyer.exampleZh: 这位律师帮助我的家人理解了这起复杂的法庭案件。

lax.example: Security was lax at the gate, so anyone could walk in.
lax.exampleZh: 门口的安保很松懈，所以任何人都能走进去。

lay.example: Please lay the books on the table before you leave.
lay.exampleZh: 离开前请把书放在桌子上。

layer.example: The cake has three layers of chocolate and cream.
layer.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力和奶油。

layman.example: As a layman, I cannot explain how this machine works.
layman.exampleZh: 作为一个门外汉，我无法解释这台机器是如何工作的。

layoff.example: The company announced a layoff of fifty workers at its main factory.
layoff.exampleZh: 公司宣布在其主工厂裁员五十名工人。

layout.example: The layout of the room makes it feel big and bright.
layout.exampleZh: 这个房间的布局让它显得又大又明亮。

lazy.example: My lazy brother never cleans his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 我懒惰的弟弟周末从不打扫他的房间。

lead.example: Small daily choices can lead to big changes in your life.
lead.exampleZh: 每天的小选择会给你的生活带来巨大的改变。

leader.example: She is a strong leader who always helps her team.
leader.exampleZh: 她是一位坚强的领导者，总是帮助她的团队。

leadership.example: Good leadership can help a small team do great things.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导才能帮助一个小团队做出伟大的事情。

leading.example: She is a leading expert on climate change.
leading.exampleZh: 她是气候变化方面的一位顶尖专家。

leaf.example: A green leaf fell from the tree and landed on the ground.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片绿叶从树上落下，掉在了地上。

leaflet.example: She handed me a leaflet about the new library hours.
leaflet.exampleZh: 她递给我一张关于图书馆新开放时间的传单。

league.example: Our school joined a new sports league last year and won three games.
league.exampleZh: 我们学校去年加入了一个新的体育联赛，并赢了三场比赛。

leak.example: The old pipe began to leak water onto the kitchen floor.
leak.exampleZh: 那根旧水管开始往厨房地板上漏水。

lean.example: Please do not lean on the glass door because it may break.
lean.exampleZh: 请不要倚靠这扇玻璃门，因为它可能会碎。

leap.example: The little girl likes to leap over small puddles after the rain.
leap.exampleZh: 那个小女孩喜欢在雨后跳过小水坑。

learn.example: I want to learn English well before I go to London.
learn.exampleZh: 我想在去伦敦之前把英语学好。

learned.example: The learned professor explained the old book to his students.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的教授向学生们解释了那本古书。

learning.example: Learning a new language takes time, but it is very useful.
learning.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间，但它非常有用。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

least.example: She has the least money of all the students in her class.
least.exampleZh: 她是班上所有学生中钱最少的。

leather.example: My new leather jacket is soft and very comfortable to wear.
leather.exampleZh: 我的新皮夹克很柔软，穿起来非常舒服。

leave.example: I always leave my keys on the small table near the door.
leave.exampleZh: 我总是把钥匙留在门边的小桌子上。

lecture.example: I went to a lecture about modern art yesterday afternoon.
lecture.exampleZh: 我昨天下午去听了一场关于现代艺术的讲座。

lecturer.example: Our lecturer explained the difficult lesson again after class.
lecturer.exampleZh: 我们的讲师课后又讲解了一遍这个难懂的课程。

left.example: The bank is on the left side of the street.

leg.example: My left leg hurts after the long walk in the park.
leg.exampleZh: 在公园走了很长的路后，我的左腿疼。

legacy.example: The old house was a legacy from his grandmother and he kept it.
legacy.exampleZh: 这所老房子是他祖母留下的遗产，他一直保留着。

legal.example: The legal team read the contract before we signed it.
legal.exampleZh: 我们在签署合同之前，法务团队阅读了这份合同。

legend.example: My grandfather often tells an old legend about the mountain near our village.
legend.exampleZh: 我爷爷经常讲一个关于我们村子附近那座山的古老传说。

legendary.example: This legendary hero is famous in many old stories.
legendary.exampleZh: 这位传说中的英雄在许多古老故事中很有名。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect workers and give them safer jobs.
legislation.exampleZh: 这项新法规将保护工人，并为他们提供更安全的工作。

legitimate.example: He has a legitimate reason for missing the meeting yesterday.
legitimate.exampleZh: 他昨天缺席会议有正当的理由。

leisure.example: In my leisure time, I like to read books and take long walks.
leisure.exampleZh: 在空闲时间，我喜欢读书和长时间散步。

lemon.example: She likes to add a slice of lemon to her tea every morning.
lemon.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上往茶里加一片柠檬。

lend.example: Can you lend me your bike for the weekend?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把自行车借给我用这个周末吗？

length.example: Please measure the length of the table before you buy a new cloth.
length.exampleZh: 买新桌布之前，请量一下桌子的长度。

lens.example: The lens of my camera was dirty, so the photos came out unclear.
lens.exampleZh: 我相机的镜头脏了，所以照片拍出来不清晰。

less.example: I have less time today than I had yesterday morning.
less.exampleZh: 我今天的时间比昨天早上少。

lesson.example: I learned an important lesson from my first job.
lesson.exampleZh: 我从第一份工作中学到了重要的一课。

let.example: Please let me help you with your heavy bags.
let.exampleZh: 请让我帮你拿这些沉重的包。

lethal.example: This snake has a lethal bite, so stay away from it.
lethal.exampleZh: 这条蛇咬一口就能致命，所以要远离它。

letter.example: I wrote a short letter to my best friend yesterday.
letter.exampleZh: 昨天我给最好的朋友写了一封短信。

level.example: Her English level is much higher than mine.
level.exampleZh: 她的英语水平比我的高得多。

levy.example: The city will levy a new tax on all hotel rooms next year.
levy.exampleZh: 该市明年将对所有酒店房间征收一项新税。

liability.example: The company accepts full liability for the damage caused by its truck.
liability.exampleZh: 公司对其卡车造成的损坏承担全部责任。

liberal.example: Her liberal parents let her choose her own friends and hobbies.
liberal.exampleZh: 她开明的父母让她自己选择朋友和爱好。

liberate.example: The soldiers came to liberate the small town from enemy control.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们前来将这座小镇从敌人的控制中解放出来。

liberty.example: People fought for liberty and freedom for many years.
liberty.exampleZh: 人们为自由和解放奋斗了许多年。

library.example: I often go to the library to study after school.
library.exampleZh: 放学后我经常去图书馆学习。

licence.example: You need a licence to drive a car in this country.
licence.exampleZh: 在这个国家，你需要执照才能开车。

license.example: The city will license the new restaurant before it opens next month.
license.exampleZh: 市里会在那家新餐厅下个月开业前给它发执照。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to see if the soup was ready.
lid.exampleZh: 她掀开锅盖，看看汤是否煮好了。

lie.example: My dog likes to lie on the sofa for hours after lunch.
lie.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢在午饭后躺在沙发上好几个小时。

life.example: Every life is important, so we should be kind to everyone.
life.exampleZh: 每个生命都很重要，所以我们应该善待每一个人。

lifestyle.example: A healthy lifestyle helps you feel better and have more energy every day.
lifestyle.exampleZh: 健康的生活方式能让你感觉更好，每天都更有精力。

lifetime.example: He spent his lifetime helping poor children in his small town.
lifetime.exampleZh: 他一生都在帮助他小镇上的贫困儿童。

lift.example: Can you help me lift this heavy box onto the table?
lift.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这个重箱子抬到桌子上吗？

ligament.example: The doctor said I hurt a ligament in my knee while running.
ligament.exampleZh: 医生说我跑步时伤到了膝盖里的一条韧带。

light.example: The light from the window is bright and warm.

lightning.example: The lightning lit up the whole sky during the storm last night.
lightning.exampleZh: 昨晚暴风雨中，闪电照亮了整个天空。

like.example: I like reading books with my friends after school.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢放学后和朋友们一起看书。

likelihood.example: There is a strong likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.

likely.example: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
likely.exampleZh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

likewise.example: He works hard, and his sister likewise does well in school.
likewise.exampleZh: 他学习努力，他的妹妹同样在学校表现很好。

limb.example: The bird hurt one of its limbs and could not fly for a week.
limb.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了一条腿，一个星期都不能飞。

limit.example: There is a limit on how much water you can use each day.
limit.exampleZh: 每天你能用多少水是有限制的。

limitation.example: One limitation of this plan is that it costs too much money.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个方案的一个缺点是它花费太多钱了。

limited.example: The shop has only a limited number of fresh eggs today.
limited.exampleZh: 这家店今天只有数量有限的鲜鸡蛋。

line.example: Please draw a straight line on the paper with your ruler.
line.exampleZh: 请用你的尺子在纸上画一条直线。

linear.example: The graph shows a linear relationship between the two simple variables.
linear.exampleZh: 这张图显示两个简单变量之间存在线性关系。

linen.example: She washed the linen and hung it in the sun.
linen.exampleZh: 她洗了亚麻布，并把它挂在太阳下晾晒。

liner.example: The huge white liner slowly left the busy port this morning.
liner.exampleZh: 那艘巨大的白色邮轮今天早上缓缓离开了繁忙的港口。

linger.example: The smell of coffee lingered in the kitchen long after breakfast.
linger.exampleZh: 早餐过后很久，咖啡的香味仍在厨房里萦绕不散。

linguistic.example: Her linguistic skills help her learn new languages very quickly.
linguistic.exampleZh: 她的语言能力帮助她很快学会新的语言。

link.example: This bridge links the small town to the big city.
link.exampleZh: 这座桥连接着小镇和大城市。

lion.example: The lion sleeps under a big tree in the warm afternoon.
lion.exampleZh: 狮子在温暖的午后睡在一棵大树下。

lip.example: She put some red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 她在聚会前往嘴唇上涂了些红色。

liquid.example: She spilled some liquid on the table while pouring the juice.
liquid.exampleZh: 她倒果汁时把一些液体洒在了桌子上。

liquor.example: My father keeps a bottle of liquor in the cupboard for special days.
liquor.exampleZh: 我父亲在橱柜里放着一瓶烈酒，留着特殊日子喝。

list.example: Please make a list of the things we need for the trip.
list.exampleZh: 请把我们旅行需要的东西列一个清单。

listen.example: I listen to music every morning before I go to work.
listen.exampleZh: 我每天早上在上班前听音乐。

literacy.example: We help children build strong literacy skills through reading every day.
literacy.exampleZh: 我们通过每天阅读帮助孩子们培养扎实的读写能力。

literal.example: His literal translation of the sentence sounded strange to native speakers.
literal.exampleZh: 他对这句话的逐字翻译在母语者听来很怪。

literary.example: She has a literary mind and loves reading old novels.
literary.exampleZh: 她有文学头脑，喜欢读旧小说。

literature.example: She likes to read English literature in her free time.
literature.exampleZh: 她喜欢在空闲时间读英国文学作品。

litre.example: This bottle holds one litre of water, which is enough for the trip.
litre.exampleZh: 这个瓶子能装一升水，足够这次旅行使用。

litter.example: Please do not leave litter on the ground after your picnic.
litter.exampleZh: 野餐后请不要把垃圾留在地上。

little.example: The little cat is sleeping on the warm chair.
little.exampleZh: 那只小猫正在温暖的椅子上睡觉。

live.example: I live in a small house near the river with my family.
live.exampleZh: 我和家人住在河边的一栋小房子里。

livelihood.example: Many farmers depend on the river for their livelihood every year.
livelihood.exampleZh: 许多农民每年都依靠这条河维持生计。

lively.example: The children are lively and full of fun at the party.
lively.exampleZh: 孩子们在聚会上很活泼，充满乐趣。

liver.example: The doctor said my liver is healthy and I should eat less fat.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说我的肝脏很健康，我应该少吃脂肪。

livestock.example: The farmer keeps livestock on his small farm outside the town.
livestock.exampleZh: 那位农民在城外的小农场里饲养牲畜。

living.example: The cost of living is high in big cities today.
living.exampleZh: 如今大城市的生计成本很高。

lizard.example: A small green lizard ran across the warm rock and hid in the grass.
lizard.exampleZh: 一只绿色的小蜥蜴跑过温热的岩石，躲进了草丛里。

load.example: The server failed because the load on it was too heavy.
load.exampleZh: 服务器出了故障，因为它的负载太重了。

loaf.example: I bought a loaf of bread and some milk at the store.
loaf.exampleZh: 我在商店买了一条面包和一些牛奶。

loan.example: I took out a small loan to buy a new car last month.
loan.exampleZh: 上个月我申请了一笔小额贷款买了一辆新车。

lobby.example: We waited in the hotel lobby for our rooms to be ready.
lobby.exampleZh: 我们在酒店大堂等待房间准备好。

local.example: We ate at a local restaurant near our hotel last night.
local.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在酒店附近的一家当地餐馆吃了饭。

locate.example: Please help me locate the keys on the table.
locate.exampleZh: 请帮我找到桌子上的钥匙在哪里。

location.example: The film crew found a quiet location near the river for the shoot.
location.exampleZh: 摄制组在河边找到了一个安静的拍摄地点。

lock.example: Please lock the front door before you leave the house.
lock.exampleZh: 你离开家之前请把前门锁上。

locker.example: I put my bag in the locker before going to class.
locker.exampleZh: 上课前我把包放进了储物柜。

locomotive.example: The old locomotive pulled six cars slowly up the hill.
locomotive.exampleZh: 那台旧机车拉着六节车厢缓缓爬上山坡。

lodge.example: They will lodge a complaint with the hotel manager about the noise.
lodge.exampleZh: 他们将就噪音问题向酒店经理提出投诉。

lofty.example: The lofty mountain is covered with snow all year round.
lofty.exampleZh: 这座高耸的山终年积雪。

log.example: The captain kept a log of every trip across the sea.
log.exampleZh: 船长把每一次出海航行都记在日志里。

logic.example: The logic of his plan is easy to understand.
logic.exampleZh: 他计划的逻辑很容易理解。

logical.example: It is logical to check your work before you give it to the teacher.
logical.exampleZh: 在把作业交给老师之前先检查一遍，是合乎逻辑的。

loneliness.example: After moving to a new city, he often felt a deep loneliness at night.
loneliness.exampleZh: 搬到新城市后，他夜里常常感到深深的孤独。

lonely.example: The old man lives alone and often feels lonely in his small house.
lonely.exampleZh: 这位老人独自生活，常常在他小小的房子里感到孤独。

long.example: She has long hair and a kind smile.
long.exampleZh: 她有一头长发和善良的笑容。

longing.example: She felt a deep longing for her home and her family.
longing.exampleZh: 她对家和家人怀有深深的渴望。

longitude.example: The ship's longitude was measured by the captain at noon.
longitude.exampleZh: 船长在正午测量了这艘船的经度。

longitudinal.example: The study tracked children over ten years in a longitudinal design.
longitudinal.exampleZh: 这项研究采用纵向设计，对儿童进行了十年的跟踪调查。

look.example: Please look at the picture on the wall and tell me what you see.
look.exampleZh: 请看墙上那幅画，告诉我你看到了什么。

loom.example: A dark shape loomed out of the fog ahead of us.
loom.exampleZh: 一个黑色的影子在我们前方的雾中赫然显现。

loop.example: The program uses a loop to repeat the same steps again.
loop.exampleZh: 这个程序用一个循环来重复相同的步骤。

loophole.example: The rich man found a loophole in the tax law and paid less.
loophole.exampleZh: 那个富人找到了税法中的一个漏洞，因此少缴了税。

loose.example: My old jeans are too loose, so I need a smaller size.
loose.exampleZh: 我的旧牛仔裤太松了，所以我需要小一号的。

loot.example: The soldiers were punished for trying to loot the empty houses.
loot.exampleZh: 士兵们因试图掠夺空房子而受到惩罚。

lord.example: The old lord lived in a castle on the hill.
lord.exampleZh: 那位年迈的领主住在山上的城堡里。

lose.example: I don't want to lose my keys again.
lose.exampleZh: 我不想再弄丢我的钥匙了。

loss.example: The fire caused a big loss for the small shop.
loss.exampleZh: 这场火灾给这家小店造成了很大的损失。

lost.example: The lost dog walked slowly along the quiet road and looked for home.
lost.exampleZh: 那只迷路的狗沿着安静的路慢慢走着，寻找着家。

lot.example: She has a lot of friends at school and she likes them all.
lot.exampleZh: 她在学校有很多朋友，她喜欢他们所有人。

lotion.example: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them every morning.
lotion.exampleZh: 她每天早上洗完手后都会在手上涂乳液。

lottery.example: My father buys a lottery ticket every week but never wins.
lottery.exampleZh: 我父亲每周都会买一张彩票，但从来没中过。

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down a little.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太大声了，请把它调小一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher's voice came through the loudspeaker and everyone could hear it clearly.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师的声音通过扬声器传来，每个人都能清楚地听到。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge until our room was ready.
lounge.exampleZh: 我们在酒店休息室里等待，直到房间准备好。

love.example: I love my family and we are very happy together.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，我们在一起非常幸福。

lovely.example: The little girl has a lovely smile and everyone likes her.
lovely.exampleZh: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容，大家都喜欢她。

lover.example: My brother is a great lover of old jazz records.
lover.exampleZh: 我哥哥非常喜欢老爵士乐唱片。

low.example: The wall is too low for the children to climb over.
low.exampleZh: 这堵墙太低了，孩子们翻不过去。

lower.example: Please lower the window a little because the room is too hot.
lower.exampleZh: 请把窗户放低一点，因为房间太热了。

loyal.example: A loyal dog will always wait for its owner at the door.
loyal.exampleZh: 忠诚的狗总会在门口等待它的主人。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her old friends never changed over the years.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对老朋友的忠诚多年来从未改变。

luck.example: I think good luck helped me find my lost keys today.
luck.exampleZh: 我觉得是好运帮我今天找到了丢失的钥匙。

lucky.example: She felt lucky to find a seat on the crowded bus.
lucky.exampleZh: 在拥挤的公交车上能找到座位，她觉得很幸运。

lucrative.example: Selling handmade bags online turned out to be a very lucrative business.
lucrative.exampleZh: 在网上卖手工包变成了一门非常有利可图的生意。

luggage.example: I put my luggage in the car before we left for the airport.
luggage.exampleZh: 去机场之前，我把行李放进了车里。

lumber.example: The old house was built from rough lumber cut nearby.
lumber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用附近砍伐的粗糙木材建造的。

luminous.example: The luminous moon shines brightly over the quiet lake at night.
luminous.exampleZh: 明亮的月亮在夜晚静静地照耀着湖面。

lump.example: The doctor found a small lump on my arm yesterday.
lump.exampleZh: 医生昨天在我手臂上发现了一个小肿块。

lunar.example: The Lunar New Year is a very important holiday in China.
lunar.exampleZh: 农历新年在中国是一个非常重要的节日。

lunch.example: I eat lunch with my friends at school every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和朋友们一起吃午餐。

lush.example: The hills behind our house are lush and green after the spring rain.
lush.exampleZh: 春雨过后，我们屋后的山丘一片茂盛翠绿。

luxury.example: For most people, a new car is a luxury they cannot afford.
luxury.exampleZh: 对大多数人来说，一辆新车是他们买不起的奢侈品。

lymph.example: The doctor said the lymph in my neck felt a little swollen.
lymph.exampleZh: 医生说，我脖子里的淋巴结摸起来有点肿。

lynch.example: The angry crowd wanted to lynch the man before the police arrived.
lynch.exampleZh: 愤怒的人群想在警察到达之前对那个人处以私刑。

lyric.example: She wrote the lyrics for a new song about her hometown.
lyric.exampleZh: 她为一首关于家乡的新歌写了歌词。

lyrical.example: Her lyrical voice made the simple song feel warm and full of feeling.
lyrical.exampleZh: 她抒情的嗓音让这首简单的歌显得温暖而富有感情。

lyricist.example: The lyricist wrote a beautiful song for the new movie.
lyricist.exampleZh: 这位歌词作者为这部新电影写了一首优美的歌。

machine.example: This machine helps us wash many clothes quickly every day.
machine.exampleZh: 这台机器每天帮我们快速清洗很多衣服。

machinery.example: The factory bought new machinery to make the work faster and safer.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器，让工作更快、更安全。

macho.example: He acts macho in front of his friends but is gentle at home.
macho.exampleZh: 他在朋友面前表现得很有大男子气概，但在家里却很温柔。

mad.example: The loud noise made the old dog mad.
mad.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音让那只老狗发疯了。

madam.example: Excuse me, madam, could you please tell me where the bus station is?
madam.exampleZh: 打扰一下，夫人，您能告诉我公交车站在哪里吗？

mafia.example: The police finally caught the mafia boss after many years.
mafia.exampleZh: 警方多年后终于抓获了那个黑手党头目。

magazine.example: I read a sports magazine every weekend at my home.
magazine.exampleZh: 我每个周末都在家读一本体育杂志。

magic.example: The old story says that a wizard used magic to help the poor children.
magic.exampleZh: 这个故事说，一位巫师用魔法帮助那些可怜的孩子。

magical.example: The garden looked magical in the soft evening light.
magical.exampleZh: 花园在柔和的傍晚光线下看起来十分迷人。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
magistrate.exampleZh: 地方法官在做出裁决前仔细听取了双方的意见。

magma.example: The hot magma slowly moved up through a crack in the volcano.
magma.exampleZh: 炽热的岩浆顺着火山中的裂缝缓慢上升。

magnesium.example: Magnesium is a light metal that burns with a bright white flame.
magnesium.exampleZh: 镁是一种轻金属，燃烧时会发出明亮的白色火焰。

magnet.example: He used a magnet to pick up the small metal pins from the floor.
magnet.exampleZh: 他用一块磁铁把地上的小金属针捡了起来。

magnetic.example: The magnetic toy sticks to the fridge and is fun for children.
magnetic.exampleZh: 这个磁性玩具能吸在冰箱上，孩子们玩得很开心。

magnificent.example: The old castle looked magnificent in the light of the setting sun.
magnificent.exampleZh: 那座古老的城堡在夕阳的照耀下显得非常壮丽。

magnify.example: This glass can magnify small words so older people read them easily.
magnify.exampleZh: 这块玻璃能放大很小的字，方便老年人阅读。

magnitude.example: The magnitude of the problem surprised everyone at the meeting.
magnitude.exampleZh: 问题的严重程度让会上的每个人都感到意外。

maiden.example: The company took its maiden flight to Tokyo last week.
maiden.exampleZh: 这家公司上周完成了飞往东京的首航。

mail.example: I get a lot of mail every day at my office.
mail.exampleZh: 我每天在办公室收到很多邮件。

mailbox.example: I put the letter in his mailbox this morning before work.
mailbox.exampleZh: 今天早上上班前，我把信放进了他的邮箱。

main.example: The main problem is that we do not have enough time.
main.exampleZh: 主要问题是我们没有足够的时间。

mainland.example: Many people travel from the mainland to this small island by boat.
mainland.exampleZh: 许多人从大陆乘船前往这个小岛。

mainly.example: The class is mainly made up of students from China and Japan.
mainly.exampleZh: 这个班主要由来自中国和日本的学生组成。

mainstream.example: This idea is now part of the mainstream in many countries.
mainstream.exampleZh: 这个想法如今在许多国家已成为主流的一部分。

maintain.example: We must maintain good habits to stay healthy and happy every day.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须保持良好的习惯，才能每天都健康快乐。

maintenance.example: Regular maintenance keeps our machines in good working order.
maintenance.exampleZh: 定期的维护能让我们的机器保持良好运转。

majesty.example: The old king walked into the hall with great majesty.
majesty.exampleZh: 老国王威严十足地走进大厅。

major.example: Safety is a major concern for every student in our school.
major.exampleZh: 安全是我们学校每个学生的主要关切。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class like to play football after school.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

make.example: I will make a cake for my sister today.
make.exampleZh: 我今天要为妹妹做一个蛋糕。

makeup.example: She put on some makeup before the party last night.
makeup.exampleZh: 昨晚聚会前她化了一些妆。

male.example: The male teacher in our school is very kind to his students.
male.exampleZh: 我们学校的那位男老师对学生非常和蔼。

malice.example: She said it without any malice, but her words still hurt him.
malice.exampleZh: 她说这话并没有恶意，但她的言辞还是伤害了他。

mall.example: We went to the new mall to buy some clothes and shoes.
mall.exampleZh: 我们去新商场买了一些衣服和鞋子。

malnutrition.example: Many poor children in that country suffer from malnutrition because they do not get enough food.
malnutrition.exampleZh: 那个国家的许多贫困儿童因为吃不饱而营养不良。

mammal.example: A whale is a mammal that lives in the ocean.
mammal.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是生活在海洋中的哺乳动物。

man.example: The man next door works in a bank and has two children.
man.exampleZh: 隔壁的那个男人在银行工作，有两个孩子。

manage.example: She manages a small team in the city.
manage.exampleZh: 她在城里管理一个小团队。

manageable.example: The work is hard but still manageable if we plan carefully.
manageable.exampleZh: 这项工作虽然艰难，但只要我们仔细计划，仍然是可管理的。

management.example: Good management helps the team finish its work on time.
management.exampleZh: 良好的管理能帮助团队按时完成工作。

manager.example: The manager asked us to finish the report before Friday.
manager.exampleZh: 经理要我们在周五之前完成这份报告。

mandate.example: The new law mandates that all drivers wear seat belts.
mandate.exampleZh: 新法律命令所有司机都必须系安全带。

mandatory.example: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for every driver in this country.
mandatory.exampleZh: 在这个国家，每个司机都必须系安全带。

manhood.example: He proved his manhood by taking care of his family.
manhood.exampleZh: 他通过照顾家人来证明自己的男子气概。

manifest.example: Her smile manifested how happy she felt that day.
manifest.exampleZh: 她的微笑表明了她那天有多开心。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the results of the test.
manipulate.exampleZh: 他试图操纵测试的结果。

mankind.example: This discovery may change the future of all mankind.
mankind.exampleZh: 这一发现可能会改变全人类的未来。

manner.example: She speaks to everyone in a kind and gentle manner.
manner.exampleZh: 她以和善温柔的方式与每个人说话。

mansion.example: They live in a big old mansion near the river.
mansion.exampleZh: 他们住在河边一座又大又旧的宅邸里。

manual.example: This old machine needs manual work because it has no power.
manual.exampleZh: 这台旧机器需要手工操作，因为它没有电力。

manufacture.example: The manufacture of these cars takes place in a large factory.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这些汽车的制造在一家大工厂里进行。

manufacturer.example: This company is a well-known manufacturer of small kitchen appliances.
manufacturer.exampleZh: 这家公司是一家知名的小型厨房电器制造商。

manuscript.example: The writer sent his manuscript to the publisher last week.
manuscript.exampleZh: 这位作家上周把手稿寄给了出版社。

many.example: Many students in my class like to play football after school.
many.exampleZh: 我们班上许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。

map.example: I looked at the map to find the way to the park.
map.exampleZh: 我看地图找到了去公园的路。

maple.example: There is a big maple tree in front of my house.
maple.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵大枫树。

marathon.example: My father runs a marathon every year in our city.
marathon.exampleZh: 我父亲每年都在我们城市跑一次马拉松。

marble.example: The table in our living room is made of white marble.
marble.exampleZh: 我们客厅里的桌子是用白色大理石做的。

march.example: The soldiers march down the street every morning before breakfast.
march.exampleZh: 士兵们每天早晨在早饭前沿街行进。

margin.example: She wrote her name in the margin of the page.
margin.exampleZh: 她把名字写在了页面的边缘上。

marginal.example: The change had only a marginal effect on our daily life.
marginal.exampleZh: 这个变化对我们的日常生活只有微不足道的影响。

marine.example: The marine park is home to many colorful fish and sea turtles.
marine.exampleZh: 这个海洋公园是许多色彩斑斓的鱼和海龟的家园。

mark.example: There is a dark mark on the old wooden table.
mark.exampleZh: 那张旧木桌上有一块深色的痕迹。

market.example: I buy fresh fruit at the market near my house every Sunday morning.
market.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上都在家附近的市场买新鲜水果。

marketing.example: She works in marketing and helps the company find new customers.
marketing.exampleZh: 她在营销部门工作，帮助公司寻找新客户。

marriage.example: Their marriage has been happy for over twenty years.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻二十多年来一直很幸福。

marry.example: She wants to marry her best friend next spring.
marry.exampleZh: 她想明年春天嫁给她最好的朋友。

marsh.example: The children were told to stay away from the marsh behind the farm.
marsh.exampleZh: 孩子们被告知要远离农场后面的沼泽。

martyr.example: The soldier became a martyr for his country during the long and terrible war.
martyr.exampleZh: 在那场漫长而可怕的战争中，这名士兵成为了为国献身的烈士。

marvel.example: We marvel at the bright stars in the night sky.
marvel.exampleZh: 我们惊叹于夜空中的明亮繁星。

marvellous.example: The little girl did a marvellous job in the school play.
marvellous.exampleZh: 这个小女孩在学校话剧里表现得非常出色。

marvelous.example: The small team did a marvelous job on the school play.
marvelous.exampleZh: 这个小组在学校话剧上做得非常出色。

masculine.example: He has a very masculine voice that people notice right away.
masculine.exampleZh: 他有一副非常男性化的嗓音，人们一听就会注意到。

mask.example: The little boy wore a scary mask to the Halloween party last night.
mask.exampleZh: 昨晚那个小男孩戴着吓人的面具去参加万圣节派对。

mass.example: A mass of people gathered in the square to watch the show.
mass.exampleZh: 大量的人聚集在广场上观看表演。

massive.example: The old building has a massive door that takes two people to open.
massive.exampleZh: 这栋老建筑有一扇巨大的门，需要两个人才能打开。

master.example: The dog follows his master everywhere he goes.
master.exampleZh: 这只狗走到哪里都跟着它的主人。

masterpiece.example: This old painting is a masterpiece of modern art.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 这幅古老的画是现代艺术的杰作。

mat.example: I put a soft mat on the floor beside my bed.
mat.exampleZh: 我在床边地板上放了一块软垫子。

match.example: We watched a great basketball match on TV last night.
match.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在电视上看了一场精彩的篮球比赛。

mate.example: My best mate and I play football every Saturday morning.
mate.exampleZh: 我最好的伙伴和我每周六早上都踢足球。

material.example: We need more material to build a small house for the dog.
material.exampleZh: 我们需要更多材料来给狗搭一个小房子。

maternal.example: Her maternal love gave the child a warm and safe home.
maternal.exampleZh: 她的母爱给了孩子一个温暖而安全的家。

math.example: Math is my favorite subject because I like working with numbers.
math.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目，因为我喜欢和数字打交道。

mathematical.example: She solved the mathematical problem quickly and explained her answer to the class.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她很快解出了这道数学题，并向全班解释了她的答案。

maths.example: Maths is my favourite subject at school this year.
maths.exampleZh: 数学是我今年在学校最喜欢的科目。

matter.example: This matter is very important, so we should talk about it today.
matter.exampleZh: 这件事情非常重要，所以我们应该今天讨论一下。

matters.example: The manager handles all business matters during the weekly meeting.
matters.exampleZh: 经理在每周会议上处理所有事务。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and handles problems calmly.
mature.exampleZh: 就她的年龄而言，她非常成熟，能冷静地处理问题。

maximize.example: The company wants to maximize profits by selling more products online.
maximize.exampleZh: 这家公司想通过在网上销售更多产品来实现利润最大化。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this old car is only sixty miles per hour.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆旧车的最高速度只有每小时六十英里。

may.example: It may rain this afternoon, so take your umbrella with you.
may.exampleZh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以你带上雨伞吧。

maybe.example: Maybe it will rain later, so please take your umbrella with you.
maybe.exampleZh: 也许待会儿会下雨，所以请带上你的雨伞。

mayor.example: The new mayor promised to build more parks for the children.
mayor.exampleZh: 新市长承诺为孩子们修建更多公园。

meadow.example: The children ran across the green meadow and picked wild flowers.
meadow.exampleZh: 孩子们跑过绿色的草地，采摘野花。

meal.example: I eat three meals a day with my family at home.
meal.exampleZh: 我每天在家和我的家人一起吃三顿饭。

mean.example: I don't know what this word means in English.
mean.exampleZh: 我不知道这个单词在英语里是什么意思。

meaning.example: Can you explain the meaning of this word to me?
meaning.exampleZh: 你能向我解释一下这个词的意思吗？

meaningful.example: Reading a good book with my family is a meaningful way to spend the weekend.
meaningful.exampleZh: 和家人一起读一本好书是度过周末的有意义的方式。

means.example: This is a simple means of learning new words every day.
means.exampleZh: 这是每天学习新单词的一种简单方法。

meantime.example: In the meantime, I will finish my homework and wait for you.
meantime.exampleZh: 在此期间，我会完成作业并等你。

measure.example: Please measure the length of the table before we buy a new cloth.
measure.exampleZh: 在我们买新桌布之前，请量一下桌子的长度。

measurement.example: The measurement of the room showed that it was too small.
measurement.exampleZh: 对这个房间的测量表明它太小了。

meat.example: I eat meat and rice for dinner every day.
meat.exampleZh: 我每天晚餐吃肉和米饭。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 那位技工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: The robot's mechanical arms can lift heavy boxes easily.
mechanical.exampleZh: 这个机器人的机械臂能轻松举起重箱子。

mechanics.example: He studies mechanics at school and often fixes small machines at home.
mechanics.exampleZh: 他在学校学习力学，也常在家里修理小机器。

mechanism.example: The teacher explained the mechanism of how plants make food from sunlight.
mechanism.exampleZh: 老师解释了植物如何利用阳光制造食物的机制。

medal.example: She won a gold medal for swimming at the school sports meeting.
medal.exampleZh: 她在学校运动会上因游泳赢得了一枚金牌。

media.example: The media often report news about sports, weather and famous people.
media.exampleZh: 媒体经常报道体育、天气和名人的新闻。

medical.example: She wants to study medical science at a good university next year.
medical.exampleZh: 她想明年在一所好大学学习医学科学。

medicate.example: The doctor decided to medicate the patient after the tests.
medicate.exampleZh: 检查之后，医生决定给这位病人用药治疗。

medication.example: The doctor told me to take this medication after breakfast every day.
medication.exampleZh: 医生让我每天早饭后服用这种药物。

medicine.example: The doctor said I should take this medicine twice a day.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生说我应该每天吃两次这种药。

medieval.example: The medieval castle on the hill is very old.
medieval.exampleZh: 山上的中世纪城堡非常古老。

meditation.example: Daily meditation helps me stay calm and focus on my work.
meditation.exampleZh: 每天冥想帮助我保持平静，并专注于工作。

medium.example: The teacher used music as a medium to help students learn English.
medium.exampleZh: 老师用音乐作为媒介来帮助学生学习英语。

meet.example: I am happy to meet my old friend at the park today.
meet.exampleZh: 今天在公园里遇见老朋友，我很高兴。

meeting.example: We have a meeting in the office every Monday morning.
meeting.exampleZh: 我们每周一早上在办公室开会。

melody.example: The melody of this song is soft and easy to remember.
melody.exampleZh: 这首歌的旋律柔和，很容易记住。

melt.example: The snow will melt quickly in the warm spring sun.
melt.exampleZh: 雪在温暖的春日阳光下会很快融化。

meltdown.example: The company's sudden meltdown surprised everyone who worked there.
meltdown.exampleZh: 公司突然的崩溃让在那里工作的每个人都感到意外。

member.example: Every member of our family helps clean the house on Sunday.
member.exampleZh: 我们家每个成员星期天都会帮忙打扫房子。

membership.example: You need a valid membership to use the swimming pool at this hotel.
membership.exampleZh: 你需要有效的会员资格才能使用这家酒店的游泳池。

memorial.example: They built a memorial garden to remember the soldiers who died.
memorial.exampleZh: 他们建了一座纪念花园来缅怀阵亡的士兵。

memory.example: My memory of that summer day is still very clear.
memory.exampleZh: 我对那个夏日的记忆仍然非常清晰。

menace.example: The dark clouds above the city were a menace to everyone outside.
menace.exampleZh: 城市上空的乌云对户外的每个人都是威胁。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for both your mental and physical health.
mental.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的精神和身体健康都有好处。

mention.example: She forgot to mention the meeting time in her email.
mention.exampleZh: 她忘了在邮件里提到会议时间。

mentor.example: My mentor at work helps me learn new skills every day.
mentor.exampleZh: 我工作上的导师每天帮助我学习新技能。

menu.example: The waiter gave us the menu and asked what we wanted to drink.
menu.exampleZh: 服务员把菜单递给我们，并问我们想喝什么。

merchant.example: The old merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the small street market.
merchant.exampleZh: 那位老商人在这条小街的市场上卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

mercury.example: The old thermometer broke, and the mercury ran out onto the floor.
