mercury.exampleZh: 那支旧温度计碎了，水银流到了地板上。

mercy.example: She showed mercy to the lost puppy and took it home.
mercy.exampleZh: 她对那只迷路的小狗心生怜悯，把它带回了家。

mere.example: It was a mere five minutes before the rain stopped.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅五分钟后，雨就停了。

merely.example: He is merely a friend, not my boyfriend.
merely.exampleZh: 他只不过是个朋友，不是我的男朋友。

merge.example: We will merge the two small teams into one big group next week.
merge.exampleZh: 下周我们会把这两个小团队合并成一个大组。

merger.example: The two small banks announced a merger last week after long talks.
merger.exampleZh: 两家小银行在长时间商谈后于上周宣布合并。

merit.example: Honesty is her greatest merit, and everyone trusts her.
merit.exampleZh: 诚实是她最大的优点，每个人都信任她。

merry.example: The children were merry as they sang songs around the fire.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们围着火唱歌，非常欢乐。

mess.example: My room is a mess after the party last night.
mess.exampleZh: 昨晚聚会之后，我的房间一团凌乱。

message.example: I sent him a short message about the meeting tomorrow.
message.exampleZh: 我给他发了一条关于明天会议的简短信息。

metal.example: This bridge is made of strong metal and can hold many cars.
metal.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的金属制成，能承载许多汽车。

metallic.example: The robot has a metallic body that shines in the sun.
metallic.exampleZh: 这个机器人有一个在阳光下闪闪发光的金属身体。

metaphor.example: The poem uses a metaphor to compare life to a journey.
metaphor.exampleZh: 这首诗用隐喻把人生比作一段旅程。

meter.example: The meter on the wall shows how much water we use.
meter.exampleZh: 墙上的仪表显示我们用了多少水。

method.example: She found a simple method to solve the math problem quickly.
method.exampleZh: 她找到了一个简单的方法来快速解决这道数学题。

metre.example: The room is five metres long and three metres wide.
metre.exampleZh: 这个房间长五米，宽三米。

metric.example: The scientist used metric units to measure the length of the table.
metric.exampleZh: 科学家用公制单位测量桌子的长度。

metropolitan.example: She enjoys the busy life in this large metropolitan area.
metropolitan.exampleZh: 她喜欢这个大都市区忙碌的生活。

middle.example: There is a small round table in the middle of the room.
middle.exampleZh: 房间中间有一张小圆桌。

midnight.example: The train leaves at midnight, so we must arrive early.
midnight.exampleZh: 火车午夜出发，所以我们必须早点到。

midway.example: We stopped for lunch midway through the long train journey.
midway.exampleZh: 我们在漫长的火车旅途中途停下来吃午饭。

might.example: It might rain later, so please take an umbrella with you.
might.exampleZh: 待会儿可能会下雨，所以请随身带把伞。

migrant.example: The migrant found a new home and a good job in the city.
migrant.exampleZh: 这位移居者在城市里找到了新家，也找到了一份好工作。

migrate.example: Every year these birds migrate south to find warmer weather.
migrate.exampleZh: 每年这些鸟都会向南迁移，寻找更温暖的天气。

mild.example: The winter in this city is mild, so we rarely need heavy coats.
mild.exampleZh: 这座城市的冬天很温和，所以我们很少需要厚外套。

mile.example: My home is only one mile from the school, so I often walk there.
mile.exampleZh: 我家离学校只有一英里，所以我常走路去。

milestone.example: Learning to walk is an important milestone for every baby.
milestone.exampleZh: 学会走路对每个婴儿来说都是一个重要的里程碑。

militant.example: The militant group refused to talk and kept fighting for many years.
militant.exampleZh: 这个好战的团体拒绝谈判，并持续战斗了许多年。

military.example: The country spends a lot of money on military training every year.
military.exampleZh: 这个国家每年在军事训练上花费大量资金。

milk.example: I drink a glass of milk every morning before I go to school.
milk.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前喝一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still makes flour for the village.
mill.exampleZh: 河边的老磨坊仍然为村庄磨制面粉。

millennium.example: The city will celebrate its second millennium with a big party next year.
millennium.exampleZh: 这座城市明年将举办盛大的聚会来庆祝它的第二个千年。

millimetre.example: The line is only two millimetres thick, so it is very hard to see.
millimetre.exampleZh: 这条线只有两毫米粗，所以很难看清。

million.example: This old city has more than one million people living in it now.
million.exampleZh: 这座古城现在有一百多万人居住。

millionaire.example: The old man became a millionaire after he sold his small company.
millionaire.exampleZh: 那位老人在卖掉他的小公司后成了百万富翁。

mind.example: She has a sharp mind and learns new things very quickly.
mind.exampleZh: 她头脑敏锐，学新东西非常快。

mine.example: That red bike is mine, and the blue one is yours.
mine.exampleZh: 那辆红色的自行车是我的，蓝色的那辆是你的。

mineral.example: This rock is rich in a mineral that people use to make glass.
mineral.exampleZh: 这种岩石富含一种人们用来制造玻璃的矿物。

minimal.example: The damage to the old car was minimal after the small accident.
minimal.exampleZh: 那次小事故后，这辆旧车受到的损伤极小。

minimize.example: Please close the door to minimize the noise from the busy street.
minimize.exampleZh: 请关上门，以尽量减小繁忙街道传来的噪音。

minimum.example: The minimum age to drive a car here is eighteen.
minimum.exampleZh: 这里开车的最小年龄是十八岁。

minister.example: The minister promised to build more schools for children in the city.
minister.exampleZh: 这位部长承诺为城市里的孩子们建更多的学校。

minor.example: This is a minor problem, so we can fix it later today.
minor.exampleZh: 这是一个次要的问题，所以我们今天晚些时候再解决。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students wanted to change the school rules.
minority.exampleZh: 只有一小部分学生想改变校规。

minute.example: I will be there in five minutes, so please wait for me.
minute.exampleZh: 我五分钟后到，请等我一下。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
miracle.exampleZh: 事故中没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: She looked in the mirror and smiled at her new haircut.
mirror.exampleZh: 她照了照镜子，对着自己的新发型笑了。

miserable.example: He felt miserable after losing his job and his home.
miserable.exampleZh: 他失去了工作和家，感到很悲惨。

misery.example: Losing his old dog filled him with deep misery for many weeks.
misery.exampleZh: 失去他的老狗让他好几个星期都深陷痛苦之中。

miss.example: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus home.
miss.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们会错过回家的最后一班公交车。

missile.example: The army fired a missile at the enemy base last night.
missile.exampleZh: 军队昨晚向敌方基地发射了一枚导弹。

mission.example: Her mission is to help more children learn to read.
mission.exampleZh: 她的使命是帮助更多孩子学会阅读。

missionary.example: The missionary traveled far to share his faith with others.
missionary.exampleZh: 这位传教士远行去向他人传播他的信仰。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not be too hard on yourself.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以不要对自己太苛刻。

mix.example: Mix the eggs and milk together in a large bowl.
mix.exampleZh: 把鸡蛋和牛奶一起混合在一个大碗里。

mixture.example: This soup is a mixture of vegetables, beans, and rice.
mixture.exampleZh: 这汤是蔬菜、豆子和米饭的混合物。

moan.example: He began to moan about the pain in his back.
moan.exampleZh: 他开始因背部的疼痛而呻吟。

mobile.example: The mobile library brings books to children in small villages.
mobile.exampleZh: 流动图书馆把书带给小村庄里的孩子们。

mobility.example: Good public transport gives people more mobility in the city.
mobility.exampleZh: 良好的公共交通让人们在城市中拥有更强的流动性。

mode.example: The teacher explained a new mode of learning to the class.
mode.exampleZh: 老师向全班讲解了一种新的学习方式。

model.example: We built a small model of the house for the science class.
model.exampleZh: 我们为科学课做了一个小房子模型。

moderate.example: This restaurant has moderate prices, so we eat there often.
moderate.exampleZh: 这家餐厅价格适中，所以我们经常去那里吃。

modern.example: Modern life is easier because we have phones and fast trains.
modern.exampleZh: 现代生活更方便，因为我们有手机和高速列车。

modernize.example: The company plans to modernize its old factory next year.
modernize.exampleZh: 公司计划明年使其旧工厂现代化。

modest.example: She is modest about her success and never talks about it.
modest.exampleZh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚，从不谈起。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before the meeting starts tomorrow.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在明天会议开始前修改这个计划。

moist.example: The cake stays moist if you keep it in a closed box.
moist.exampleZh: 如果你把蛋糕放在密封盒里，它就能保持湿润。

moisture.example: The moisture in the air makes the room feel very wet.
moisture.exampleZh: 空气中的水分让房间感觉很潮湿。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find your file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我去找一下你的文件。

momentum.example: The team's early success gave them the momentum to finish the project.
momentum.exampleZh: 团队早期的成功给了他们完成这个项目的动力。

monetary.example: The government uses monetary policy to control prices and support economic growth.
monetary.exampleZh: 政府运用货币政策来控制物价并支持经济增长。

money.example: I do not have enough money to buy a new car this year.
money.exampleZh: 我没有足够的钱今年买一辆新车。

monitor.example: The teacher looked at the monitor to check every student's screen.
monitor.exampleZh: 老师看着监视器，检查每个学生的屏幕。

monkey.example: The little monkey climbed the tall tree very fast.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只小猴子非常快地爬上了那棵高树。

monopoly.example: The big company has a monopoly on phone service in this small town.
monopoly.exampleZh: 这家大公司在这个小镇的电话服务上处于垄断地位。

month.example: We will visit our grandparents next month during the school holiday.
month.exampleZh: 我们将在下个月的学校假期去看望祖父母。

monthly.example: The company sends a monthly report to all its employees.
monthly.exampleZh: 公司每月向所有员工发送一份报告。

monument.example: The old monument stands in the middle of the city park.
monument.exampleZh: 这座古老的纪念碑矗立在城市公园的中央。

monumental.example: Building the new bridge was a monumental task for our small town.
monumental.exampleZh: 建造这座新桥对我们的小镇来说是一项巨大的工程。

mood.example: My mood is good today because the sun is shining.
mood.exampleZh: 今天阳光明媚，所以我心情很好。

moon.example: The moon is very bright tonight, so we can walk home without a light.
moon.exampleZh: 今晚月亮很亮，所以我们不用灯也能走回家。

moral.example: Teachers should help children develop strong moral values from an early age.
moral.exampleZh: 老师应当帮助孩子从小培养坚定的道德观念。

more.example: I need more time to finish this easy task today.
more.exampleZh: 我今天需要更多时间来完成这项简单的任务。

moreover.example: The room is clean and cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又便宜；此外，它离车站很近。

morning.example: I drink a cup of hot water every morning before breakfast.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早晨早饭前都喝一杯热水。

mortgage.example: They still have twenty years to pay off their mortgage.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们还有二十年才能还清按揭贷款。

most.example: Of all the students, she spends the most time in the library.
most.exampleZh: 在所有学生中，她在图书馆待的时间最多。

mostly.example: The people here are mostly friendly and always ready to help visitors.
mostly.exampleZh: 这里的人大多很友善，总是乐于帮助游客。

mother.example: My mother makes breakfast for us every morning before school.
mother.exampleZh: 我母亲每天早上上学前为我们做早餐。

motion.example: The motion of the boat on the water made me feel sleepy.
motion.exampleZh: 船在水面上的运动让我感到困倦。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate their students to work hard every day.
motivate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生每天努力学习。

motivation.example: Strong motivation helps students study hard every day.
motivation.exampleZh: 强烈的动机帮助学生每天努力学习。

motive.example: The police could not find a clear motive for the crime.
motive.exampleZh: 警方无法找到这起犯罪的明确动机。

motor.example: The motor of this old car is very loud.
motor.exampleZh: 这辆旧汽车的发动机声音很大。

motorway.example: We drove north on the motorway for three hours to visit my grandparents.
motorway.exampleZh: 我们沿着高速公路向北开了三个小时去看望我的祖父母。

mount.example: He likes to mount the stairs quickly every morning before breakfast.
mount.exampleZh: 他喜欢每天早上早饭前快速登上楼梯。

mountain.example: We climbed a high mountain last summer and saw snow at the top.
mountain.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们爬了一座高山，在山顶看到了雪。

mourn.example: Many people mourn the loss of their old friends.
mourn.exampleZh: 许多人哀悼老朋友的离世。

mouse.example: The little mouse ran quickly across the kitchen floor and hid behind the box.
mouse.exampleZh: 那只小老鼠迅速跑过厨房地板，躲到了箱子后面。

mouth.example: Please close your mouth when you eat your food.

move.example: Please move your chair to the other side of the table.
move.exampleZh: 请把你的椅子移到桌子的另一边。

movement.example: Regular movement every day keeps your body strong and healthy.
movement.exampleZh: 每天规律运动能让你的身体强壮又健康。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 我们昨晚在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: She does not have much time to finish her work today.
much.exampleZh: 她今天没有很多时间完成工作。

mud.example: The children came home with mud on their shoes and clothes.
mud.exampleZh: 孩子们回家时鞋子和衣服上都沾满了泥。

multiple.example: This job has multiple tasks that need to be finished today.
multiple.exampleZh: 这份工作有多重任务需要在今天完成。

multiply.example: If you multiply three by four, you get twelve.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你用三乘以四，就会得到十二。

municipal.example: The municipal government built a new park near our school last year.
municipal.exampleZh: 市政府去年在我们学校附近建了一个新公园。

mural.example: The children painted a colorful mural on the wall outside their school.
mural.exampleZh: 孩子们在学校外面的墙上画了一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画。

murder.example: The police are still looking for the man who committed the murder.
murder.exampleZh: 警方仍在寻找犯下这起谋杀案的那名男子。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles in his arms.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房，锻炼手臂上结实的肌肉。

muscular.example: The muscular man lifted the heavy box with one hand.
muscular.exampleZh: 那个肌肉发达的男人一只手就举起了沉重的箱子。

museum.example: We visited the science museum with our classmates last Friday afternoon.
museum.exampleZh: 上周五下午我们和同学一起参观了科学博物馆。

mushroom.example: I like to put fresh mushroom slices in my soup.
mushroom.exampleZh: 我喜欢在汤里放新鲜的蘑菇片。

music.example: I like to listen to music when I study at home.
music.exampleZh: 我在家学习时喜欢听音乐。

musical.example: She has a strong musical talent and plays the piano very well.
musical.exampleZh: 她有很强的音乐天赋，钢琴弹得非常好。

musician.example: My uncle is a musician and he plays the piano very well.
musician.exampleZh: 我叔叔是音乐家，他钢琴弹得很好。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you go out to play.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业才能出去玩。

mute.example: He stayed mute during the meeting and said nothing at all.
mute.exampleZh: 他在会上保持沉默，什么也没说。

mutter.example: She muttered a few words under her breath and walked away.
mutter.exampleZh: 她小声嘀咕了几句，然后走开了。

mutton.example: My mother cooks mutton with potatoes for dinner every Sunday.
mutton.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都用土豆炖羊肉。

mutual.example: Good friends show mutual respect and always help each other.
mutual.exampleZh: 好朋友之间相互尊重，并且总是互相帮助。

myriad.example: There are a myriad of stars in the night sky.

mysterious.example: There is a mysterious light in the old house at night.
mysterious.exampleZh: 夜里那座老房子里有一道神秘的光。

mystery.example: The old house on the hill is still a mystery to everyone in town.
mystery.exampleZh: 山上那座老房子对镇上的每个人来说仍然是个谜。

myth.example: Many children love the old myth about a giant who lived in the sky.
myth.exampleZh: 许多孩子喜欢那个关于住在天空中的巨人的古老神话。

mythical.example: Dragons and unicorns are mythical animals from old stories.
mythical.exampleZh: 龙和独角兽是古老故事中的神话动物。

nag.example: My mother keeps nagging me about cleaning my room.
nag.exampleZh: 我妈妈总是唠叨我打扫房间。

nail.example: He used a hammer to hit the nail into the wood.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进了木头里。

naive.example: He is too naive to see that his friend is lying.
naive.exampleZh: 他太天真了，看不出他的朋友在撒谎。

naked.example: The little boy ran across the beach with his naked feet in the warm sand.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩光着脚跑过海滩，脚踩在温暖的沙子里。

namely.example: Only one student passed the test, namely Tom.
namely.exampleZh: 只有一个学生通过了考试，即汤姆。

nap.example: I usually take a short nap after lunch on busy workdays.
nap.exampleZh: 忙碌的工作日里，我通常会在午饭后小睡一会儿。

napkin.example: The waiter put a clean white napkin beside my plate before dinner.
napkin.exampleZh: 晚餐前，服务员在我盘子旁边放了一块干净的白色餐巾。

narrate.example: She will narrate the story to the children at the library today.
narrate.exampleZh: 她今天将在图书馆给孩子们讲述这个故事。

narrative.example: The film tells a powerful narrative about a family moving to a new country.
narrative.exampleZh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于一家人搬到新国家的有力故事。

narrow.example: The road is too narrow for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条路太窄了，两辆车无法通过。

nasty.example: He gave me a nasty look and then walked away.
nasty.exampleZh: 他恶狠狠地看了我一眼，然后就走开了。

natality.example: The country's natality has fallen in recent years.
natality.exampleZh: 近年来该国的出生率有所下降。

nation.example: Our nation has a long history and a rich culture.
nation.exampleZh: 我们的国家有着悠久的历史和丰富的文化。

national.example: The national team will play a big game in our city tomorrow.
national.exampleZh: 国家队明天将在我们城市进行一场重要比赛。

nationalism.example: Nationalism can bring people together, but it can also cause serious problems between countries.
nationalism.exampleZh: 民族主义可以把人们团结起来，但也可能在国家之间引发严重问题。

nationality.example: Please write your name and nationality on this form.
nationality.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和国籍。

nationwide.example: The company launched a nationwide campaign to help students read more books.
nationwide.exampleZh: 这家公司发起了一场全国性的活动，帮助学生多读书。

native.example: She is a native speaker of Chinese and speaks it with her family every day.
native.exampleZh: 她是中文母语者，每天都和家人说中文。

natural.example: It is natural for children to ask many questions about the world.
natural.exampleZh: 孩子们对世界提出许多问题是自然的。

naturalist.example: The naturalist studied plants and animals in the forest for many years.
naturalist.exampleZh: 这位博物学家在森林里研究动植物很多年。

naturally.example: She naturally speaks in a calm and friendly way.
naturally.exampleZh: 她自然而然地用平静友好的方式说话。

nature.example: It is good to spend time in nature with your family.
nature.exampleZh: 和家人一起在大自然中度过时光是件好事。

naughty.example: The naughty little boy hid his sister's toy under the bed.
naughty.exampleZh: 那个顽皮的小男孩把他妹妹的玩具藏在床底下。

naval.example: The country spent a lot of money on naval ships last year.
naval.exampleZh: 这个国家去年在海军舰艇上花了很多钱。

navigation.example: The ship's navigation system helps sailors find the right way at sea.
navigation.exampleZh: 这艘船的导航系统帮助水手在海上找到正确的航向。

near.example: There is a small shop near my house.
near.exampleZh: 我家附近有一家小商店。

nearby.example: There is a small park nearby where children often play.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一个小公园，孩子们经常在那里玩。

neat.example: Her small room is always neat and clean.
neat.exampleZh: 她的小房间总是整洁干净。

neatly.example: She neatly folded all the clothes and put them in the box.
neatly.exampleZh: 她把所有衣服整洁地叠好，放进了箱子里。

necessarily.example: You do not necessarily need to be rich to have a happy life.
necessarily.exampleZh: 你不一定要富有才能拥有幸福的生活。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是必要的。

necessity.example: Clean water is a basic necessity for every family in the world.
necessity.exampleZh: 清洁的水是世界上每个家庭的基本必需品。

neck.example: He wore a warm red scarf around his neck in winter.
neck.exampleZh: 冬天他在脖子上围了一条暖和的红色围巾。

necklace.example: She wore a beautiful gold necklace to the party last night.
necklace.exampleZh: 她昨晚戴了一条漂亮的金项链去参加聚会。

need.example: I need your help with this homework today.
need.exampleZh: 我今天需要你帮忙做这份作业。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give me the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给我打针。

negative.example: Too many negative thoughts can make it hard to enjoy your day.
negative.exampleZh: 太多消极的想法会让你难以享受一天。

neglect.example: Parents should not neglect their children when they are busy with work.
neglect.exampleZh: 父母忙于工作时不应忽视自己的孩子。

negligence.example: The driver's negligence caused the accident and hurt two people on the road.
negligence.exampleZh: 司机的疏忽导致了这场事故，并造成路上两人受伤。

negligible.example: The difference in price was negligible, so we bought the cheaper one.
negligible.exampleZh: 价格差异微不足道，所以我们买了便宜的那个。

negotiable.example: The price is negotiable, so we can discuss it again tomorrow.
negotiable.exampleZh: 价格是可以协商的，所以我们可以明天再讨论。

negotiate.example: The two sides will negotiate a new deal next week.
negotiate.exampleZh: 双方将于下周谈判一项新协议。

negotiation.example: The two sides reached an agreement after a long negotiation.
negotiation.exampleZh: 双方经过长时间的谈判后达成了协议。

neighbour.example: Our neighbour next door often helps us look after the garden.
neighbour.exampleZh: 隔壁的邻居经常帮我们照看花园。

neighbourhood.example: Our neighbourhood has a small park and a new library.
neighbourhood.exampleZh: 我们的街区有一个小公园和一座新图书馆。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee in the morning.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟早上都不喜欢喝咖啡。

neoclassical.example: The neoclassical building has tall white columns and a simple, elegant front.
neoclassical.exampleZh: 这座新古典主义建筑有着高高的白色柱子和简洁优雅的正面。

neonatal.example: The hospital has a special unit for neonatal care.
neonatal.exampleZh: 这家医院有一个专门的新生儿护理病房。

nephew.example: My nephew is ten years old and he loves playing football after school.
nephew.exampleZh: 我的侄子十岁了，他喜欢放学后踢足球。

nerve.example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole school.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全校师生面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: She feels nervous before every exam, so she studies extra hard.
nervous.exampleZh: 她每次考试前都感到紧张，所以格外用功学习。

nest.example: Two small birds built a nest in the tree outside my window.
nest.exampleZh: 两只小鸟在我窗外的那棵树上筑了一个巢。

net.example: He caught three big fish in his net and sold them.
net.exampleZh: 他用网捕到三条大鱼，然后把它们卖了。

network.example: She joined a small network of friends who share job leads.
network.exampleZh: 她加入了一个分享工作线索的小型朋友圈。

neutral.example: A good judge must stay neutral and listen to both sides of the story.
neutral.exampleZh: 一个好的法官必须保持中立，听取双方的陈述。

neutrality.example: The judge showed complete neutrality during the difficult court case.
neutrality.exampleZh: 在这场艰难的法庭案件中，法官表现出了完全的中立。

nevertheless.example: The test was hard; nevertheless, she passed it easily.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 考试很难，然而她轻松通过了。

new.example: She bought a new phone last week and loves it.
new.exampleZh: 她上周买了一部新手机，很喜欢它。

newborn.example: The newborn baby slept quietly in her mother's arms all morning.
newborn.exampleZh: 这个刚出生的婴儿整个上午都在母亲怀里安静地睡着。

newly.example: The newly opened shop sells fresh bread every morning.
newly.exampleZh: 这家新开的店每天早上卖新鲜面包。

news.example: I watch the news every evening to learn what is happening.
news.exampleZh: 我每天晚上看新闻，了解正在发生的事。

newsagent.example: The newsagent sells newspapers, magazines and sweets on our street corner.
newsagent.exampleZh: 街角的报刊店出售报纸、杂志和糖果。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: We will visit my grandmother next week and stay for two days.
next.exampleZh: 我们下周将去看望我的祖母，并在那里住两天。

nice.example: The weather is very nice today, so we can walk outside.
nice.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以出去散步。

nicotine.example: Smoking cigarettes gives you nicotine, and that makes it very hard to stop.
nicotine.exampleZh: 抽烟会让你摄入尼古丁，这使你很难戒掉。

niece.example: My niece came to visit us with her mother last weekend.
niece.exampleZh: 上周末我的侄女和她妈妈来看望我们。

night.example: The stars are very bright in the sky at night.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚天空中星星非常明亮。

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare last night and woke up crying.
nightmare.exampleZh: 我昨晚做了一个可怕的噩梦，醒来时哭了。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green.
nitrogen.exampleZh: 植物需要土壤中的氮才能长得健壮而翠绿。

noble.example: His noble actions helped many poor families in our small town.
noble.exampleZh: 他高尚的行为帮助了我们小镇上的许多贫困家庭。

nod.example: She gave a gentle nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点了点头，对我微笑。

noise.example: The loud noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上喧闹的噪音让我整夜无法入睡。

nominal.example: He is the nominal leader, but she makes all the real decisions.
nominal.exampleZh: 他是名义上的领导，但所有真正的决定都由她来做。

nominate.example: The teacher will nominate two students for the school prize.
nominate.exampleZh: 老师将提名两名学生参评学校奖项。

nomination.example: Her nomination for the award surprised everyone in the office.
nomination.exampleZh: 她获得该奖项的提名让办公室里的每个人都感到意外。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个也没来参加聚会。

nonetheless.example: The plan was difficult, but we finished it nonetheless.
nonetheless.exampleZh: 这个计划很难，但我们还是完成了。

nonprofit.example: Our nonprofit group gives free books to children in the village.
nonprofit.exampleZh: 我们的非营利组织给村里的孩子们免费送书。

nonsense.example: What he said was complete nonsense and no one believed him.
nonsense.exampleZh: 他说的话全是胡说，没人相信他。

noodle.example: My mother makes noodle soup with eggs and fresh vegetables for us.
noodle.exampleZh: 我妈妈为我们做加了鸡蛋和新鲜蔬菜的面条汤。

norm.example: Working late every day soon became the norm in our small office.
norm.exampleZh: 每天加班很快成了我们这个小办公室的常态。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到疲倦是正常的。

normally.example: I normally walk to school with my sister every morning.
normally.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上和姐姐一起走路去学校。

north.example: The small town is in the north of the country.
north.exampleZh: 这个小镇位于该国的北部。

northern.example: The northern part of the country is colder and gets more snow.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部更冷，降雪也更多。

northward.example: The birds flew northward when the warm spring days arrived.
northward.exampleZh: 温暖的春日到来时，鸟儿们向北飞去。

nose.example: The dog has a wet nose and a very good sense of smell.
nose.exampleZh: 这只狗的鼻子湿湿的，嗅觉非常灵敏。

nostalgia.example: The old song filled her with nostalgia for her childhood in the countryside.
nostalgia.exampleZh: 那首老歌让她对乡下度过的童年充满怀念。

notable.example: This small town is notable for its old stone bridge.
notable.exampleZh: 这个小镇因它的古老石桥而闻名。

notably.example: The weather was bad, notably on the last day of our trip.
notably.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，尤其是我们旅行的最后一天。

notation.example: The teacher showed us a simple notation for writing music down.
notation.exampleZh: 老师给我们展示了一种记录音乐的简单记号法。

note.example: Please take notes during the lecture and review them before the exam.
note.exampleZh: 请在讲座期间记笔记，并在考试前复习这些笔记。

noteworthy.example: Her recent progress in English is quite noteworthy for such a young student.
noteworthy.exampleZh: 对这么小的学生来说，她最近在英语上的进步相当值得注意。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so we can use it.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么也没有，所以我们可以用它。

notice.example: I did not notice the small sign on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的小告示。

noticeable.example: There is a noticeable change in the weather today.
noticeable.exampleZh: 今天的天气有明显的变化。

notification.example: I got a notification on my phone about the meeting.
notification.exampleZh: 我手机上收到了一条关于会议的通知。

notify.example: Please notify the teacher if your child will be absent from class.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你的孩子缺课，请通知老师。

notion.example: She had a strange notion that cats can understand human words.
notion.exampleZh: 她有一个奇怪的想法，认为猫能听懂人类的话。

notorious.example: This street is notorious for its heavy traffic and loud noise.
notorious.exampleZh: 这条街因交通拥堵和噪音大而声名狼藉。

nourish.example: Good food and clean water nourish the body and help children grow strong.
nourish.exampleZh: 好的食物和干净的水滋养身体，帮助孩子们茁壮成长。

novel.example: This novel tells a new and very interesting story about a young girl.
novel.exampleZh: 这本小说讲述了一个关于年轻女孩的新奇而有趣的故事。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new game soon wore off for most of the children.
novelty.exampleZh: 这款新游戏的新奇感很快对大多数孩子来说就消失了。

nowadays.example: Nowadays many people use their phones to buy things and pay bills.
nowadays.exampleZh: 如今许多人用手机买东西和付账单。

nowhere.example: There is nowhere to sit because the room is full of boxes.
nowhere.exampleZh: 房间里堆满了箱子，没有地方可以坐。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us a lot of clean energy.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以为我们提供大量清洁能源。

nucleus.example: The nucleus is the control center of every living cell in our body.
nucleus.exampleZh: 细胞核是我们身体中每个活细胞的控制中心。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude woman standing by the window.
nude.exampleZh: 画家画了一位站在窗边的裸体女子。

nuisance.example: The loud music from next door is a real nuisance every night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 隔壁传来的吵闹音乐每晚都是个真正的麻烦。

numb.example: My fingers went numb after I played in the cold snow for an hour.
numb.exampleZh: 在寒冷的雪地里玩了一小时后，我的手指变得麻木了。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这一页的顶部。

numerical.example: Please put these numbers in numerical order from smallest to largest.
numerical.exampleZh: 请把这些数字按从小到大的数字顺序排列。

numerous.example: There are numerous books on the desk in my small room.
numerous.exampleZh: 我小房间的书桌上有很多书。

nurse.example: My sister is a nurse and she takes care of sick children.
nurse.exampleZh: 我姐姐是一名护士，她照顾生病的孩子。

nursery.example: My little sister spends every weekday at the nursery near our home.
nursery.exampleZh: 我妹妹每个工作日都在我们家附近的托儿所度过。

nurture.example: Parents nurture their children with love and care every day.
nurture.exampleZh: 父母每天用爱与关怀养育他们的孩子。

nut.example: He put a bowl of nuts on the table for his friends.
nut.exampleZh: 他在桌上放了一碗坚果给朋友们。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养能帮助孩子强壮成长并保持健康。

nutritional.example: Good nutritional food helps children grow strong and stay healthy.
nutritional.exampleZh: 营养丰富的食物能帮助孩子长得强壮并保持健康。

nutritionist.example: The nutritionist told my mother to eat more fresh vegetables every day.
nutritionist.exampleZh: 营养师告诉我妈妈每天多吃新鲜蔬菜。

nutritious.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables are nutritious and good for your health.
nutritious.exampleZh: 新鲜的水果和蔬菜很有营养，对健康有益。

nylon.example: This bag is made of strong nylon and it is very light.
nylon.exampleZh: 这个包由结实的尼龙制成，而且非常轻。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上七点钟起床。

oak.example: The old oak in our garden gives us shade in summer.
oak.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老橡树在夏天为我们遮阴。

oar.example: He pulled hard on the oar to move the small boat forward.
oar.exampleZh: 他用力划桨，把小船向前推进。

oath.example: He took an oath to tell the truth in court today.
oath.exampleZh: 他今天在法庭上宣誓说实话。

obedience.example: The dog learned obedience through simple training every day.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗通过每天简单的训练学会了服从。

obedient.example: The obedient dog sat quietly when its owner gave the signal.
obedient.exampleZh: 那只听话的狗在主人发出信号时安静地坐下了。

obese.example: The obese cat could not jump onto the chair.
obese.exampleZh: 那只肥胖的猫跳不上椅子。

obesity.example: Obesity is a serious health problem for many children today.
obesity.exampleZh: 肥胖症如今是许多儿童面临的严重健康问题。

obey.example: Students must obey the school rules at all times.
obey.exampleZh: 学生必须始终遵守校规。

object.example: I object to this plan because the final goal is not clear.
object.exampleZh: 我反对这个计划，因为最终目标并不明确。

objection.example: She raised no objection to the new plan at the meeting.
objection.exampleZh: 她在会上对新计划没有提出任何异议。

objective.example: Our main objective is to finish the project on time.
objective.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是按时完成这个项目。

obligation.example: Every citizen has an obligation to follow the laws of the country.
obligation.exampleZh: 每个公民都有遵守国家法律的义务。

oblige.example: The bad weather obliged us to cancel our trip to the beach.
oblige.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们取消了去海滩的旅行。

obscene.example: The movie was banned because some scenes were considered obscene.
obscene.exampleZh: 这部电影被禁，因为其中一些场景被认为是淫秽的。

obscure.example: The meaning of this old book is obscure to most modern readers.
obscure.exampleZh: 这本旧书的意思对大多数现代读者来说都很晦涩。

observation.example: Her careful observation of the birds helped the class learn a lot.
observation.exampleZh: 她对鸟类细致的观察帮助全班学到了很多东西。

observe.example: Please observe the birds quietly and write down what you see.
observe.exampleZh: 请安静地观察这些鸟，并写下你看到的东西。

observer.example: The observer stood quietly and watched how the birds built their nests.
observer.exampleZh: 观察者静静地站着，观察鸟儿如何筑巢。

obstacle.example: The fallen tree was a big obstacle on the road to school.
obstacle.exampleZh: 倒下的树是通往学校路上的一大障碍。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台获得一张免费地图。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显，他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: This is a good occasion to say thank you to my parents.
occasion.exampleZh: 这是一个向我的父母道谢的好时机。

occasional.example: She pays an occasional visit to her old friends in the countryside.
occasional.exampleZh: 她偶尔去乡下看望老朋友。

occasionally.example: I occasionally walk to work when the weather is nice.
occasionally.exampleZh: 天气好的时候我偶尔会步行去上班。

occupation.example: Teaching is a difficult occupation that requires a lot of patience.
occupation.exampleZh: 教书是一份需要很多耐心的艰难职业。

occupy.example: The shop occupies the whole first floor of the building.
occupy.exampleZh: 这家商店占用了这栋楼的整个一层。

occur.example: The accident occurred at the corner of the street yesterday.

occurrence.example: The police are investigating the strange occurrence last night.
occurrence.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚发生的奇怪事件。

ocean.example: The ocean is deep and full of many strange fish.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋很深，里面充满了许多奇怪的鱼。

odd.example: It is odd that the door is open today.

oddity.example: The old clock in the hall is a strange oddity in our modern house.
oddity.exampleZh: 走廊里的那座旧钟在我们这栋现代住宅里是件古怪的稀罕物。

odds.example: The odds of rain are high this afternoon.
odds.exampleZh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很大。

offence.example: He was arrested for a serious offence and had to go to court.
offence.exampleZh: 他因一项严重罪行被逮捕，不得不去法庭受审。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my simple question.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用这个简单的问题冒犯你。

offensive.example: His offensive words made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable and upset.
offensive.exampleZh: 他那些无礼的话让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服和难过。

offer.example: The company offered him a better job with more money.
offer.exampleZh: 公司给了他一份薪水更高的好工作。

office.example: My father works in a small office near the train station.
office.exampleZh: 我父亲在火车站附近的一间小办公室工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the old man cross the busy street.
officer.exampleZh: 那位警官帮助老人穿过了繁忙的街道。

official.example: The official report gave clear facts about the new school plan.
official.exampleZh: 这份官方报告提供了关于新学校计划的明确事实。

offset.example: We planted more trees to offset the carbon from our flight.
offset.exampleZh: 我们种了更多树来抵消飞行产生的碳排放。

often.example: I often walk to school with my sister in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我早上常常和妹妹一起走路去学校。

oil.example: Please add some oil to the pan before you cook the eggs.
oil.exampleZh: 煎鸡蛋之前请往锅里加点油。

old.example: My old bike is still very useful for short trips.
old.exampleZh: 我的旧自行车短途出行仍然很有用。

olive.example: She put a green olive on top of the salad.
olive.exampleZh: 她在沙拉上面放了一颗绿色的橄榄。

omega.example: The omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.
omega.exampleZh: 欧米茄是希腊字母表的最后一个字母。

omission.example: The omission of his name from the list was a careless mistake.
omission.exampleZh: 名单上遗漏了他的名字，这是一个粗心的错误。

omit.example: Please do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 请不要在你的报告中遗漏任何重要细节。

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

one.example: I have one brother and two sisters in my family.
one.exampleZh: 我家里有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。

ongoing.example: The ongoing project will take a few more weeks to finish.
ongoing.exampleZh: 这个正在进行中的项目还需要几周才能完成。

onion.example: My mother puts fresh onion in the soup to make it taste better.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放新鲜洋葱，让它味道更好。

online.example: I often buy books online because the prices are usually lower.
online.exampleZh: 我经常在网上买书，因为价格通常更低。

only.example: She is the only person who knows the answer to this question.
only.exampleZh: 她是唯一知道这个问题答案的人。

onslaught.example: The soldiers could not hold the bridge against the sudden onslaught.
onslaught.exampleZh: 士兵们无法守住那座桥，抵挡不住突如其来的猛攻。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a glass.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，碰倒了一个玻璃杯。

onward.example: The team walked onward through the rain without stopping to rest.
onward.exampleZh: 队伍冒着雨继续向前走，没有停下来休息。

opaque.example: The thick glass bottle is opaque, so I cannot see the water inside.
opaque.exampleZh: 这个厚玻璃瓶是不透明的，所以我看不到里面的水。

open.example: The store is open every day, and we open it at nine.
open.exampleZh: 这家店每天都营业，我们九点开门。

opening.example: The opening of the new store was a happy day for everyone.
opening.exampleZh: 新店的开张对每个人来说都是快乐的一天。

opera.example: My mother loves opera, so we went to the opera house together last night.
opera.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢歌剧，所以我们昨晚一起去了歌剧院。

operate.example: My father taught me how to operate this old machine safely.
operate.exampleZh: 父亲教过我如何安全地操作这台旧机器。

operation.example: The doctor will perform the operation early tomorrow morning.
operation.exampleZh: 医生明天一早将进行手术。

operational.example: The new machine is now operational and ready for daily use.
operational.exampleZh: 这台新机器现在可以运转，已准备好日常使用。

operator.example: The operator answered the phone and helped me find the right number.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了电话，并帮我找到了正确的号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is better than the film.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书比电影更好。

opponent.example: My opponent in the final match was strong, but I stayed calm.
opponent.exampleZh: 决赛中我的对手很强，但我保持了冷静。

opportunity.example: This job is a good opportunity for you to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作是你学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the new plan because it will cost too much money.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这个新计划，因为它会花费太多钱。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from my house.

opposition.example: The plan met strong opposition from local residents and teachers.
opposition.exampleZh: 该计划遭到了当地居民和教师的强烈反对。

opt.example: You can opt for the cheaper plan if you want.
opt.exampleZh: 如果你愿意，你可以选择更便宜的那个方案。

optical.example: The scientist used an optical instrument to study tiny light waves.
optical.exampleZh: 科学家用一台光学仪器研究微小的光波。

optimism.example: Her quiet optimism helped the whole team through a very difficult year.
optimism.exampleZh: 她平静的乐观帮助整个团队度过非常艰难的一年。

optimistic.example: She stays optimistic about the future even when things are hard.
optimistic.exampleZh: 即使处境艰难，她对未来依然保持乐观。

optimum.example: They found the optimum temperature for the plants to grow well.
optimum.exampleZh: 他们找到了植物良好生长的最适宜温度。

option.example: You have two options: take the bus or walk to school.
option.exampleZh: 你有两个选择：坐公交车或者走路去学校。

optional.example: This class is optional, so you can leave early today.
optional.exampleZh: 这门课是选修的，所以你今天可以早点离开。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but not both.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，但不能两样都喝。

oral.example: Our teacher gave us an oral test instead of a written one.
oral.exampleZh: 老师给我们做了一次口头测试，而不是笔试。

orange.example: My sister likes to eat a sweet orange after lunch every day.
orange.exampleZh: 我妹妹喜欢每天午饭后吃一个甜甜的橙子。

orbit.example: The small moon moves in a steady orbit around the large planet.
orbit.exampleZh: 这颗小卫星沿着稳定的轨道围绕这颗大行星运行。

orchestra.example: The orchestra played beautiful music at the concert last night.
orchestra.exampleZh: 昨晚管弦乐队在音乐会上演奏了优美的音乐。

order.example: The teacher gave us an order to stay in our seats.
order.exampleZh: 老师命令我们留在座位上。

orderly.example: The books on the shelf are always clean and orderly.
orderly.exampleZh: 书架上的书总是干净整齐。

ordinary.example: My father is an ordinary worker, but he works very hard every day.
ordinary.exampleZh: 我父亲是一名普通工人，但他每天工作都很努力。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体中一个重要的器官。

organic.example: This farm grows organic vegetables without using any harmful chemicals.
organic.exampleZh: 这个农场种植有机蔬菜，不使用任何有害化学物质。

organism.example: Every living organism needs water and food to grow and stay healthy.
organism.exampleZh: 每一个生物体都需要水和食物才能生长并保持健康。

organization.example: The organization helps poor children go to school.
organization.exampleZh: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童上学。

organize.example: We need to organize the meeting for next week.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要安排下周的会议。

orientation.example: The new students had an orientation to learn about the school.
orientation.exampleZh: 新生参加了迎新介绍，以了解这所学校。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍然是个谜。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the museum keeps it very safe.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作品，博物馆把它保存得非常安全。

originality.example: The judge liked the originality of her simple but clever design.
originality.exampleZh: 评委喜欢她那简单却巧妙的设计所具有的独创性。

originally.example: This building was originally a small school for village children.
originally.exampleZh: 这座建筑最初是一所为村里孩子开设的小学校。

originate.example: Many old stories originate from small villages.
originate.exampleZh: 许多古老的故事起源于小村庄。

ornament.example: She put a small ornament on the tree.
ornament.exampleZh: 她在树上放了一个小装饰品。

orphan.example: The orphan lives with a kind family in the small village.
orphan.exampleZh: 那个孤儿和一个小村庄里的一户善良人家住在一起。

orthodox.example: Her family follows the orthodox traditions of their small village.
orthodox.exampleZh: 她的家人遵循他们小村庄的正统传统。

ostrich.example: The ostrich ran across the field very fast.
ostrich.exampleZh: 那只鸵鸟飞快地跑过田野。

other.example: Some students like math, but other students like English and art.
other.exampleZh: 有些学生喜欢数学，但其他学生喜欢英语和美术。

otherwise.example: Please write it down now, otherwise you will forget it later.
otherwise.exampleZh: 请现在就把它写下来，否则你以后会忘记。

ought.example: You ought to say sorry to her right now.

ounce.example: I need just one ounce of cheese for this simple recipe.
ounce.exampleZh: 这个简单的食谱我只需要一盎司奶酪。

out.example: The sun came out and the children went out to play.
out.exampleZh: 太阳出来了，孩子们也出去玩了。

outbreak.example: There was a sudden outbreak of flu in our small town last winter.
outbreak.exampleZh: 去年冬天，我们的小镇上突然爆发了流感。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game surprised everyone in our class.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让我们班上每个人都很惊讶。

outdoor.example: We like to have outdoor meals when the weather is warm and sunny.
outdoor.exampleZh: 天气温暖晴朗的时候，我们喜欢在户外用餐。

outdoors.example: The children love to play outdoors after school every day.
outdoors.exampleZh: 孩子们每天放学后都喜欢在户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer walls of the old house need a new coat of paint.
outer.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙需要刷一层新漆。

outfit.example: She wore a beautiful outfit to the party last night.
outfit.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一套漂亮的衣服去参加聚会。

outing.example: Our class went on a short outing to the nearby hill last weekend.
outing.exampleZh: 上周末我们班去附近的小山进行了一次短途郊游。

outlet.example: The factory built a new outlet to release waste water safely.
outlet.exampleZh: 工厂建了一个新的排放口来安全地排放废水。

outline.example: The teacher gave us a short outline of the new course today.
outline.exampleZh: 老师今天给了我们一份新课程的简短大纲。

outlook.example: Her outlook on life has changed a lot since she moved abroad.
outlook.exampleZh: 自从她搬到国外后，她对生活的看法变了很多。

output.example: The factory increased its output by ten percent last year.
output.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的产量增加了百分之十。

outrage.example: The whole town felt outrage after hearing about the terrible crime.
outrage.exampleZh: 听到那起可怕的罪行后，整个小镇都感到愤慨。

outright.example: He outright refused to answer any of our simple questions.
outright.exampleZh: 他直截了当地拒绝回答我们任何简单的问题。

outset.example: From the outset, she knew the plan would be hard to finish.
outset.exampleZh: 从一开始，她就知道这个计划很难完成。

outside.example: The children are playing outside in the garden.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们正在外面的花园里玩耍。

outskirts.example: They live on the outskirts of the city, where the houses are cheaper.
outskirts.exampleZh: 他们住在城市边缘的郊区，那里的房子更便宜。

outstanding.example: Her outstanding work on the project helped the whole team succeed.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她在这个项目上的杰出工作帮助整个团队取得了成功。

outward.example: Her outward smile hid the sadness she felt inside.
outward.exampleZh: 她外表的微笑掩盖了内心的悲伤。

oval.example: The mirror in the bathroom is oval and hangs above the sink.
oval.exampleZh: 浴室里的镜子是椭圆形的，挂在水槽上方。

oven.example: Please put the cake in the oven for about thirty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕放进烤箱里烤大约三十分钟。

over.example: The plane flew over the city and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越这座城市，然后安全着陆。

overall.example: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
overall.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要低。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己对公开演讲的恐惧。

overhead.example: A plane flew overhead while we were playing in the park.
overhead.exampleZh: 我们在公园玩耍时，一架飞机从头顶飞过。

overhear.example: I overheard them talking about the party in the kitchen.
overhear.exampleZh: 我无意中听到他们在厨房里谈论那个聚会。

overlap.example: The two teams' work often overlaps, so they share the same office.
overlap.exampleZh: 两个团队的工作经常重叠，所以他们共用同一间办公室。

overlook.example: We often overlook small mistakes when we are in a hurry.
overlook.exampleZh: 我们匆忙时常常忽略小错误。

overnight.example: The small shop became famous overnight after a video of its owner went viral.
overnight.exampleZh: 一段老板的视频走红后，这家小店一夜之间出了名。

overseas.example: She plans to study overseas next year after she finishes high school.
overseas.exampleZh: 她打算高中毕业后明年去海外留学。

overtake.example: The fast car will overtake the slow truck on the hill.
overtake.exampleZh: 那辆快车会在山丘上超过那辆慢卡车。

overthrow.example: The people wanted to overthrow the old government and build a better country.
overthrow.exampleZh: 人民想要推翻旧政府，建立一个更好的国家。

overtime.example: She often works overtime to finish the project on time.
overtime.exampleZh: 她经常加班以按时完成这个项目。

overturn.example: The court decided to overturn the old rule last week.
overturn.exampleZh: 法院上周决定推翻这条旧规定。

overweight.example: The doctor told him he was overweight and should eat less and exercise more.
overweight.exampleZh: 医生告诉他体重超标，应该少吃多运动。

overwhelm.example: The small team felt overwhelmed by the huge amount of work.
overwhelm.exampleZh: 这个小团队被大量的工作压得不知所措。

overwhelming.example: The support from my friends was overwhelming and gave me great courage.
overwhelming.exampleZh: 朋友们的支持是压倒性的，给了我很大的勇气。

owe.example: I owe my friend ten dollars and I will pay him tomorrow.
owe.exampleZh: 我欠我朋友十美元，我明天会还给他。

owl.example: The owl sat quietly in the tree and watched the field all night.
owl.exampleZh: 那只猫头鹰静静地停在树上，整夜注视田野。

own.example: I own this old bike, and it is my own now.
own.exampleZh: 我拥有这辆旧自行车，它现在是我自己的了。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop lives next door to my parents.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的业主住在我父母隔壁。

ownership.example: She has full ownership of the small house near the river.
ownership.exampleZh: 她完全拥有河边那栋小房子。

oxide.example: Iron oxide gives the rocks their bright red color.
oxide.exampleZh: 氧化铁使这些岩石呈现出明亮的红色。

oxygen.example: Plants and animals need oxygen to live, so clean air is very important.
oxygen.exampleZh: 植物和动物需要氧气才能生存，所以清洁的空气非常重要。

oyster.example: My father likes to eat fresh oysters with lemon at the beach.
oyster.exampleZh: 我爸爸喜欢在海边配着柠檬吃新鲜的牡蛎。

ozone.example: The ozone layer high above the earth protects us from harmful sun rays.
ozone.exampleZh: 地球高空的臭氧层保护我们免受有害太阳光线的伤害。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace because his leg still hurt.
pace.exampleZh: 他因为腿还疼，所以走得很慢。

pacific.example: The Pacific Ocean is very big and deep.
pacific.exampleZh: 太平洋非常大而且很深。

pack.example: I need to pack my clothes and books into the big bag.
pack.exampleZh: 我需要把衣服和书打包进大背包里。

package.example: The new phone comes in a small package with a charger and a case.
package.exampleZh: 这部新手机装在一个小包裹里，里面配有充电器和保护壳。

packet.example: She bought a packet of cookies and shared it with her friends.
packet.exampleZh: 她买了一小包饼干，和朋友们一起分享。

pact.example: The two countries signed a pact to keep peace in the region.
pact.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项协定，以维护该地区的和平。

pad.example: She wrote the phone number on a small pad by the bed.
pad.exampleZh: 她把电话号码写在床边的一个小本子上。

paddle.example: We used a wooden paddle to move the small boat across the lake.
paddle.exampleZh: 我们用一根木桨把小船划过湖面。

pagan.example: The old pagan festival is still celebrated in some villages today.
pagan.exampleZh: 这个古老的异教节日至今仍在一些村庄里庆祝。

page.example: I read the first page of the book before bed.
page.exampleZh: 我在睡前读了这本书的第一页。

pain.example: She felt a sharp pain in her back after the long walk.
pain.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，她感到背部一阵剧痛。

painful.example: It was a painful lesson, but I learned something useful from it.
painful.exampleZh: 这是一次痛苦的教训，但我从中学到了有用的东西。

paint.example: We need to paint the walls of the new house this weekend.
paint.exampleZh: 这个周末我们需要给新房子刷墙。

painting.example: She hung a beautiful painting of the sea on her bedroom wall.
painting.exampleZh: 她在卧室墙上挂了一幅美丽的海景油画。

pair.example: She bought a new pair of shoes for the party.
pair.exampleZh: 她为参加聚会买了一双新鞋。

palace.example: The old king lived in a large palace near the river.
palace.exampleZh: 那位老国王住在河边一座巨大的宫殿里。

palatable.example: The soup was very palatable, and everyone asked for more.
palatable.exampleZh: 这汤非常可口，每个人都要求再来一些。

pale.example: Her face looked pale after the long night on the train.
pale.exampleZh: 在火车上度过漫长的一夜后，她的脸色看起来很苍白。

palm.example: She held the small bird gently in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她轻轻地把小鸟捧在手心里。

pamphlet.example: The teacher gave us a small pamphlet about the school library.
pamphlet.exampleZh: 老师给了我们一本关于学校图书馆的小册子。

pan.example: She put the eggs in a hot pan and waited for them to cook.
pan.exampleZh: 她把鸡蛋放进热平底锅里，等着它们煎熟。

panacea.example: No single law can be a panacea for all the problems in our schools.
panacea.exampleZh: 没有任何一项法律能成为解决我们学校所有问题的万灵药。

pane.example: A cold wind blew through the broken pane of the old window.
pane.exampleZh: 一阵冷风从旧窗户破碎的玻璃处吹了进来。

panel.example: A panel of experts will answer questions from the audience today.
panel.exampleZh: 一个专家小组今天将回答观众的提问。

panic.example: She felt a sudden panic when she could not find her keys.
panic.exampleZh: 当她找不到钥匙时，她突然感到一阵恐慌。

panorama.example: The book gives a wide panorama of modern art in Europe.
panorama.exampleZh: 这本书对欧洲现代艺术做了全景式的介绍。

pant.example: After running up the stairs, she began to pant heavily.
pant.exampleZh: 跑上楼梯后，她开始大口喘气。

pants.example: He put on his pants and went out to work.
pants.exampleZh: 他穿上裤子，出门去上班了。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and gave it to me.
paper.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后递给了我。

paperback.example: I bought a paperback at the airport before my long flight.
paperback.exampleZh: 我在机场买了一本平装书，准备长途飞行时看。

parachute.example: The pilot opened his parachute and landed safely in the field.
parachute.exampleZh: 飞行员打开降落伞，安全地降落在田野里。

parade.example: We watched the parade go down the street on a sunny morning.
parade.exampleZh: 我们在一个阳光明媚的早晨看着游行队伍沿街行进。

paradigm.example: The new teaching paradigm puts students at the center of learning.
paradigm.exampleZh: 新的教学范式把学生置于学习的中心。

paradise.example: This quiet island feels like paradise to people who love nature.
paradise.exampleZh: 这座安静的小岛对热爱自然的人来说就像天堂。

paradox.example: It is a paradox that the rich man worries about money every day.
paradox.exampleZh: 这是个悖论：那个富人每天都为钱发愁。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph and tell me what it means.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请读第一段，然后告诉我它是什么意思。

parallel.example: The two roads are parallel and they run along the river.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路是平行的，而且沿着河延伸。

paralysis.example: The accident left him with paralysis in both legs.
paralysis.exampleZh: 那场事故使他双腿瘫痪。

parameter.example: You can change this parameter to make the program run faster.
parameter.exampleZh: 你可以更改这个参数，让程序运行得更快。

paramount.example: Safety is paramount when children play near the water.
paramount.exampleZh: 孩子们在水边玩耍时，安全是最重要的。

paraphrase.example: The teacher asked us to paraphrase the short paragraph in our own words.
paraphrase.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己的话改述这段短文。

parasite.example: The doctor said a tiny parasite was making the child sick.
parasite.exampleZh: 医生说是一种微小的寄生虫让孩子生病了。

parcel.example: She sent a small parcel to her friend in another city.
parcel.exampleZh: 她给另一个城市的朋友寄了一个小包裹。

pardon.example: I beg your pardon, I did not hear your name clearly.
pardon.exampleZh: 对不起，我没有听清你的名字。

parent.example: My parents always help me with my homework after dinner.
parent.exampleZh: 我的父母总是在晚饭后帮我做作业。

parenthood.example: Parenthood brings both great joy and new responsibilities to young couples.
parenthood.exampleZh: 为人父母给年轻夫妇带来巨大的喜悦，也带来新的责任。

parity.example: The two countries finally agreed on parity in trade and taxes.
parity.exampleZh: 两国最终在贸易和税收上达成了对等。

park.example: We can park the car near the park and walk inside.
park.exampleZh: 我们可以把车停在公园附近，然后走进去。

parking.example: The parking lot is full, so we must wait.
parking.exampleZh: 停车场满了，所以我们只能等着。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，议会通过了这项新法律。

parlor.example: Our small parlor has a soft sofa and a wooden table.
parlor.exampleZh: 我们的小客厅里有一张软沙发和一张木桌。

parole.example: The prisoner was released on parole after serving five years.
parole.exampleZh: 那名囚犯服刑五年后获得假释。

parrot.example: My little brother is a parrot and repeats everything I say.
parrot.exampleZh: 我弟弟是个学舌者，我说什么他就重复什么。

part.example: She only ate part of the cake and saved the rest for later.
part.exampleZh: 她只吃了蛋糕的一部分，把剩下的留到以后吃。

partial.example: The judge was partial to the home team and made some unfair calls.
partial.exampleZh: 裁判偏袒主队，做出了几个不公平的判罚。

participant.example: Each participant received a small gift at the end of the meeting.
participant.exampleZh: 每位参与者在会议结束时都收到了一份小礼物。

participate.example: Our teacher hopes every student can participate in the class discussion today.
participate.exampleZh: 我们老师希望今天每个学生都能参与课堂讨论。

participation.example: Her participation in the school play made her very happy.
participation.exampleZh: 她参加学校的戏剧演出让她非常开心。

particle.example: Tiny particles of dust floated in the sunlight.
particle.exampleZh: 细小的灰尘微粒在阳光下飘浮。

particular.example: She is very particular about the food she eats every day.
particular.exampleZh: 她对每天吃的食物非常挑剔。

particularly.example: I particularly like the quiet park near my home.
particularly.exampleZh: 我特别喜欢我家附近的那个安静的公园。

particulate.example: The air in the city is full of small particulate from cars and factories.
particulate.exampleZh: 城市空气中充满了来自汽车和工厂的小颗粒。

partisan.example: His partisan speech made it clear he supported only one side.
partisan.exampleZh: 他那偏袒的演讲清楚表明他只支持一方。

partition.example: A glass partition separates the kitchen from the living room.
partition.exampleZh: 一道玻璃隔断把厨房和客厅隔开。

partly.example: I partly agree with you, but some of your ideas still need more thought.
partly.exampleZh: 我部分同意你的看法，但你的一些想法还需要更多思考。

partner.example: My business partner and I opened a small shop last year.
partner.exampleZh: 我和我的生意伙伴去年开了一家小店。

partnership.example: Our company formed a strong partnership with a local school last year.
partnership.exampleZh: 我们公司去年与当地一所学校建立了牢固的合作关系。

party.example: She invited all her friends to the party on Saturday night.
party.exampleZh: 她邀请了所有朋友参加周六晚上的聚会。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt, and I will pass the exam tomorrow.
pass.exampleZh: 请把盐递给我，我明天会通过考试。

passage.example: The narrow passage leads to a small garden behind the old house.
passage.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的通道通向老房子后面的一个小花园。

passbook.example: I took my passbook to the bank to check my savings.
passbook.exampleZh: 我带着存折去银行查看我的存款。

passenger.example: The passenger asked the driver to stop at the next station.
passenger.exampleZh: 乘客请司机在下一站停车。

passerby.example: A passerby saw the old man fall and helped him stand up.
passerby.exampleZh: 一位过路人看到老人摔倒，就上前扶他站起来。

passion.example: Her passion for music helps her practice the piano every single day.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐的热情让她每天都练习钢琴。

passionate.example: She is very passionate about music and plays the piano every day.
passionate.exampleZh: 她对音乐充满热情，每天都弹钢琴。

passive.example: He is too passive at work and never shares his ideas.
passive.exampleZh: 他在工作中太被动了，从不分享自己的想法。

passport.example: You must show your passport before you get on the plane.
passport.exampleZh: 你上飞机前必须出示你的护照。

password.example: I forgot my password and cannot open my email account today.
password.exampleZh: 我忘了密码，今天打不开我的电子邮箱账户。

past.example: In the past, people wrote letters to their friends far away.
past.exampleZh: 过去，人们写信给远方的朋友。

pasture.example: The farmer lets his cows walk in the green pasture every morning.
pasture.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上让他的奶牛在绿色的牧场上走动。

pat.example: She gave the little dog a gentle pat on the head.
pat.exampleZh: 她轻轻拍了拍那只小狗的头。

patch.example: The doctor put a patch on my eye and told me to rest.
patch.exampleZh: 医生在我眼睛上贴了一块眼罩，并让我休息。

patent.example: The company filed a patent for its new design last year.
patent.exampleZh: 该公司去年为其新设计申请了专利。

path.example: We walked along a narrow path through the quiet green forest.
path.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过安静的绿色森林。

pathetic.example: It is pathetic that he still blames others for his own mistakes.
pathetic.exampleZh: 他仍然把自己犯的错怪到别人头上，这很可悲。

pathology.example: She decided to study pathology because she wanted to understand how diseases harm the body.
pathology.exampleZh: 她决定学习病理学，因为她想了解疾病如何损害身体。

pathway.example: This pathway leads to the garden behind the old house.
pathway.exampleZh: 这条小路通向老房子后面的花园。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with his patients every day.
patient.exampleZh: 这位医生每天对他的病人都很有耐心。

patriot.example: He is a true patriot who loves his country and helps his neighbors.
patriot.exampleZh: 他是一个真正的爱国者，热爱自己的国家并帮助邻里。

patriotic.example: Many patriotic citizens sing the national song at the school event.
patriotic.exampleZh: 许多爱国的市民在学校活动上唱国歌。

patrol.example: Two police officers patrol the streets near our school every night.
patrol.exampleZh: 两名警察每天晚上在我们学校附近的街道巡逻。

patron.example: A rich patron gave the young artist money to study in Paris.
patron.exampleZh: 一位富有的赞助人给了这位年轻艺术家一笔去巴黎学习的钱。

patronize.example: Please do not patronize me; I only want honest advice.
patronize.exampleZh: 请不要用高人一等的态度对我，我只想要诚实的建议。

pattern.example: The teacher noticed a clear pattern in the students' answers.
pattern.exampleZh: 老师注意到学生们的答案中有一个明显的模式。

pause.example: Let us pause for a moment before we continue the game.
pause.exampleZh: 让我们暂停一会儿，然后再继续比赛。

pave.example: The workers will pave the road in front of our school this week.
pave.exampleZh: 工人们本周将铺设我们学校前面的道路。

pavement.example: The children rode their bikes along the pavement in front of the school.
pavement.exampleZh: 孩子们沿着学校门前的人行道骑自行车。

paw.example: The little dog hurt its paw while playing in the garden yesterday.
paw.exampleZh: 那只小狗昨天在花园里玩耍时伤到了爪子。

pay.example: I will pay for the tickets and you can pay for dinner.
pay.exampleZh: 我来付门票钱，你付晚餐的钱。

payable.example: The full amount is payable by the end of this month.
payable.exampleZh: 全额款项须在本月底前支付。

payment.example: You can make the payment online with a credit card.
payment.exampleZh: 你可以用信用卡在线付款。

pea.example: My mother cooked some peas with rice for dinner last night.
pea.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈做了豌豆和米饭当晚餐。

peace.example: After the long war, the country finally returned to peace.
peace.exampleZh: 漫长的战争之后，这个国家终于恢复了和平。

peaceful.example: The small village is very peaceful in the early morning.
peaceful.exampleZh: 这个小村庄在清晨非常宁静。

peacetime.example: In peacetime, many soldiers spend their time training and helping local people.
peacetime.exampleZh: 在和平时期，许多士兵把时间用于训练和帮助当地民众。

peak.example: We climbed to the peak of the mountain before sunrise and saw the whole valley.
peak.exampleZh: 我们在日出前爬到了山顶，看到了整个山谷。

peanut.example: I like to eat peanuts with a glass of milk after dinner.
peanut.exampleZh: 晚饭后我喜欢配一杯牛奶吃花生。

pear.example: She put a ripe pear in her lunch bag today.
pear.exampleZh: 她今天把一个熟梨放进了午餐袋里。

pearl.example: The diver found a rare pearl inside the shell.
pearl.exampleZh: 潜水员在贝壳里发现了一颗罕见的珍珠。

peasant.example: The peasant worked in the field from morning until night.
peasant.exampleZh: 那个农民从早到晚在地里干活。

peculiar.example: There was a peculiar smell in the old house.
peculiar.exampleZh: 那座老房子里有一股奇怪的气味。

pedal.example: Press the pedal gently to stop the bike.
pedal.exampleZh: 轻轻踩下踏板来刹住自行车。

peel.example: Please peel the potatoes before you put them in the pot.
peel.exampleZh: 请先把土豆削皮，再放进锅里。

peep.example: She peeped through the keyhole to see who was inside the room.
peep.exampleZh: 她透过锁孔偷看，想知道房间里是谁。

peer.example: She felt nervous when her peers looked at her new dress.
peer.exampleZh: 当同龄人看她的新裙子时，她感到紧张。

pen.example: She writes her letters with a blue pen.
pen.exampleZh: 她用一支蓝色钢笔写信。

penalize.example: The new rules will penalize drivers who use their phones while driving.
penalize.exampleZh: 新规定将处罚开车时使用手机的司机。

penalty.example: The driver had to pay a heavy penalty for parking in the wrong place.
penalty.exampleZh: 那位司机因乱停车不得不支付高额罚款。

pencil.example: I use a pencil to draw a picture of my cat.
pencil.exampleZh: 我用铅笔画了一幅我的猫的画。

pending.example: The final decision on the new project is still pending.
pending.exampleZh: 关于新项目的最终决定仍待定。

pendulum.example: The pendulum of public opinion swung back toward the old policy.
pendulum.exampleZh: 舆论的钟摆又摆回了旧政策一边。

penetrate.example: The heavy rain can penetrate the thin roof of the old house.
penetrate.exampleZh: 大雨能穿透那座老房子的薄屋顶。

peninsula.example: Italy is a long peninsula that extends into the Mediterranean Sea.
peninsula.exampleZh: 意大利是一个伸入地中海的狭长半岛。

penny.example: I only have a penny left in my pocket today.
penny.exampleZh: 今天我的口袋里只剩下一分钱了。

pension.example: My grandfather gets a small pension from the company every month.
pension.exampleZh: 我爷爷每月从公司领取一笔不多的养老金。

pensioner.example: The old pensioner takes a slow walk in the park every morning.
pensioner.exampleZh: 那位退休老人每天早上都在公园里慢慢散步。

people.example: Many people in this town work in the small shops near the river.
people.exampleZh: 这个镇上的许多人在河边的小商店里工作。

pepper.example: Please add some salt and pepper to the soup before you serve it.
pepper.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一些盐和胡椒。

per.example: We eat three meals per day and drink water between them.
per.exampleZh: 我们每天吃三顿饭，两餐之间喝水。

perceive.example: Children can perceive small changes in their parents' mood very quickly.
perceive.exampleZh: 孩子们能很快察觉父母情绪上的细微变化。

percent.example: About sixty percent of the students passed the final exam easily.
percent.exampleZh: 大约百分之六十的学生轻松通过了期末考试。

percentage.example: The percentage of students who walk to school is very small this year.
percentage.exampleZh: 今年步行上学的学生比例非常小。

perception.example: My perception of the city changed after I lived there for a year.
perception.exampleZh: 在那里住了一年后，我对这座城市的看法改变了。

perch.example: A small bird perched quietly on the branch outside my window.
perch.exampleZh: 一只小鸟静静地栖息在我窗外的树枝上。

perennial.example: The garden has many perennial flowers that come back every spring.
perennial.exampleZh: 这个花园里有许多多年生花卉，每年春天都会重新长出来。

perfect.example: Her English is perfect, and she works hard to perfect her writing.
perfect.exampleZh: 她的英语很完美，她努力使自己的写作更完善。

perfection.example: She practices the piano every day in her pursuit of perfection.
perfection.exampleZh: 她每天练习钢琴，追求完美。

perform.example: The young students will perform a short play at the school show tonight.
perform.exampleZh: 这些年轻学生今晚将在学校演出中表演一个短剧。

performance.example: Her performance in the school play was very good.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校戏剧中的表演非常出色。

perfume.example: She wears a light perfume that smells like fresh flowers.
perfume.exampleZh: 她喷了一款淡淡的香水，闻起来像新鲜的花朵。

perhaps.example: Perhaps she will come to the party with her brother tonight.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许她今晚会和她的哥哥一起来参加聚会。

peril.example: The old bridge is in great peril and should be closed to all traffic.
peril.exampleZh: 这座老桥濒临极大危险，应该对所有车辆关闭。

period.example: This is a busy period for our small team.
period.exampleZh: 这对我们的小团队来说是一段忙碌的时期。

periodic.example: The doctor says I need periodic checkups to keep my health in good shape.
periodic.exampleZh: 医生说我需要定期体检，以保持良好的健康状况。

periodical.example: She reads a science periodical in the library every week.
periodical.exampleZh: 她每周都在图书馆读一本科学期刊。

perish.example: Many plants will perish quickly if they get no water or sunlight.
perish.exampleZh: 许多植物如果没有水和阳光，很快就会枯死。

perjury.example: The witness was charged with perjury after lying in court.
perjury.exampleZh: 该证人在法庭上说谎后被控犯有伪证罪。

perk.example: A free lunch is one perk of working at this company.
perk.exampleZh: 免费午餐是在这家公司工作的好处之一。

permanence.example: The family hoped for permanence when they bought their first house together.
permanence.exampleZh: 这家人一起买下第一套房子时，盼望着能有一个长久稳定的家。

permanent.example: The museum is a permanent home for these old paintings.
permanent.exampleZh: 这座博物馆是这些古老画作的永久居所。

permeate.example: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole house.
permeate.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个房子。

permissible.example: It is permissible to park your car here after six o'clock.
permissible.exampleZh: 六点以后在这里停车是允许的。

permission.example: My parents gave me permission to go to the party.
permission.exampleZh: 我父母允许我去参加聚会。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

perpetual.example: She lives in perpetual fear of losing her job.
perpetual.exampleZh: 她一直生活在对失去工作的持续恐惧中。

perplex.example: The strange question perplexed the young student for a long time.
perplex.exampleZh: 这个奇怪的问题使那个年轻学生困惑了很久。

persecute.example: The cruel king persecuted people who did not share his beliefs.
persecute.exampleZh: 那个残暴的国王迫害不认同他信仰的人。

persist.example: If you persist in practicing every day, your English will improve.
persist.exampleZh: 如果你坚持每天练习，你的英语就会进步。

persistent.example: Her persistent efforts finally helped her pass the difficult exam.
persistent.exampleZh: 她坚持不懈的努力最终帮助她通过了那场很难的考试。

person.example: She is a kind person who always helps others.
person.exampleZh: 她是一个总是帮助别人的善良的人。

persona.example: He wears a friendly persona at work but is quiet at home.
persona.exampleZh: 他在工作中戴着友善的人格面具，但在家里却很安静。

personal.example: My personal opinion is that we should start the meeting earlier.
personal.exampleZh: 我个人的意见是我们应该把会议提前开始。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel happy and comfortable.
personality.exampleZh: 她温暖的个性让每个人都感到快乐和自在。

personalize.example: Teachers often personalize lessons to meet the needs of each student.
personalize.exampleZh: 老师们常常使课程个性化，以满足每个学生的需求。

personify.example: In many old stories, people personify the sun and the moon as gods.
personify.exampleZh: 在许多古老的故事里，人们把太阳和月亮拟人化为神。

personnel.example: All personnel must wear an ID badge in the building.
personnel.exampleZh: 所有员工在楼内都必须佩戴工牌。

perspective.example: Trying to see the problem from her perspective helped us find a better solution.
perspective.exampleZh: 试着从她的视角看这个问题，帮助我们找到了更好的解决办法。

persuade.example: She tried to persuade her brother to eat more vegetables.
persuade.exampleZh: 她试着说服弟弟多吃蔬菜。

persuasion.example: His persuasion finally changed her mind about the trip.
persuasion.exampleZh: 他的劝说终于改变了她对这次旅行的想法。

pertain.example: These rules pertain to all students in our school.
pertain.exampleZh: 这些规定适用于我们学校的所有学生。

pertinent.example: Her question was very pertinent to our discussion about the new plan.
pertinent.exampleZh: 她的问题与我们关于新计划的讨论非常相关。

pervasive.example: A pervasive smell of smoke filled the whole house after the fire.
pervasive.exampleZh: 火灾之后，一股弥漫的烟味充满了整栋房子。

perverse.example: It seems perverse to refuse help when you need it.
perverse.exampleZh: 在你需要帮助的时候拒绝帮助，似乎是不合常理的。

pervert.example: He tried to pervert the truth to protect his friend.
pervert.exampleZh: 他试图歪曲事实来保护他的朋友。

pessimism.example: Her pessimism about the future makes it hard for her to try new things.
pessimism.exampleZh: 她对未来的悲观情绪让她很难去尝试新事物。

pessimistic.example: My father is pessimistic about the weather this weekend.
pessimistic.exampleZh: 我父亲对这不周末的天气很悲观。

pesticide.example: Farmers often use pesticide on their crops to keep insects away.
pesticide.exampleZh: 农民常常在庄稼上使用杀虫剂来驱赶昆虫。

pet.example: My pet cat likes to sleep on the warm sofa every afternoon.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物猫每天下午都喜欢睡在温暖的沙发上。

petition.example: She signed the petition to save the old library.
petition.exampleZh: 她签署了拯救旧图书馆的请愿书。

petrify.example: The loud scream petrified her, and she could not move at all.
petrify.exampleZh: 那声尖叫把她吓呆了，她完全动弹不得。

petrol.example: We need to buy some petrol before we drive to the next town.
petrol.exampleZh: 开车去下一个城镇之前，我们需要买些汽油。

petroleum.example: This country uses petroleum to make fuel for cars and planes.
petroleum.exampleZh: 这个国家用石油为汽车和飞机制造燃料。

petty.example: He often argues about petty things and forgets what really matters.
petty.exampleZh: 他经常为琐碎的事情争吵，却忘了真正重要的东西。

pharmacy.example: I went to the pharmacy to buy medicine for my mother.
pharmacy.exampleZh: 我去药房给我妈妈买药。

phase.example: We are in the final phase of the project.
phase.exampleZh: 我们正处于项目的最后阶段。

phenomenal.example: The band put on a phenomenal show last night in the city.
phenomenal.exampleZh: 乐队昨晚在城里献上了一场非凡的演出。

phenomenon.example: The northern lights are a natural phenomenon that many people travel to see.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 北极光是一种自然现象，许多人专程旅行去观赏它。

philanthropic.example: The philanthropic man gave much money to help poor children in his town.
philanthropic.exampleZh: 这位乐善好施的男子捐了很多钱来帮助镇上的穷苦孩子。

philosopher.example: The old philosopher often sits by the river and thinks about life.
philosopher.exampleZh: 那位老哲学家常常坐在河边思考人生。

philosophy.example: Her philosophy is to stay calm and keep learning every day.
philosophy.exampleZh: 她的人生观是保持冷静，并且每天继续学习。

phone.example: I need to phone my mother and tell her about the meeting.
phone.exampleZh: 我需要打电话给妈妈，告诉她关于会议的事。

phonetic.example: She uses phonetic symbols to help her students pronounce new words.
phonetic.exampleZh: 她使用音标符号帮助学生发音新单词。

photo.example: I put a photo of my family on the wall next to the window.
photo.exampleZh: 我把一张全家福照片贴在窗户旁边的墙上。

photocopy.example: Please make a photocopy of your ID card for the front desk.
photocopy.exampleZh: 请给你的身份证复印一份交给前台。

photograph.example: She took a photograph of the old bridge near her home.
photograph.exampleZh: 她拍了一张她家附近那座老桥的照片。

photographic.example: She has a photographic memory and can remember every small detail.
photographic.exampleZh: 她有逼真的记忆力，能记住每一个微小的细节。

photography.example: She loves photography and takes pictures of birds every weekend.
photography.exampleZh: 她热爱摄影，每个周末都去拍鸟。

phrase.example: She used a short phrase in her English lesson today.
phrase.exampleZh: 她今天在英语课上用了一个简短的短语。

physical.example: Regular physical activity is good for both your body and your mind.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动对你的身体和心理都有好处。

physician.example: The physician told me to rest at home for three days.
physician.exampleZh: 医生让我在家休息三天。

physics.example: Our physics teacher explained how light travels through water.
physics.exampleZh: 我们的物理老师讲解了光如何在水里传播。

physiological.example: The doctor said the changes were physiological and not caused by stress.
physiological.exampleZh: 医生说这些变化是生理性的，并非由压力引起。

physiology.example: She studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
physiology.exampleZh: 她学习生理学，以了解人体是如何运作的。

physique.example: His strong physique helped him play sports well.
physique.exampleZh: 他强壮的体格帮助他打好运动。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚做完作业后都会弹钢琴。

pick.example: Please pick a book from the shelf and read it.
pick.exampleZh: 请从书架上挑一本书来读。

picket.example: A picket stood at the gate and watched everyone who came in.
picket.exampleZh: 一名纠察队员站在大门口，注视着每一个进来的人。

picnic.example: We will have a picnic in the park this Sunday.
picnic.exampleZh: 这个星期天我们将在公园野餐。

picture.example: There is a picture of my family on the wall.
picture.exampleZh: 墙上有一张我家人的照片。

picturesque.example: The small village looks very picturesque in the soft morning light.
picturesque.exampleZh: 小村庄在柔和的晨光中看起来十分如画。

pie.example: My mother made an apple pie for the family dinner last night.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨晚为家庭晚餐做了一个苹果派。

piece.example: She cut the cake into pieces and gave one to each child.
piece.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成块，给每个孩子分了一块。

pier.example: The small boat waited by the pier for the fishermen to return.
pier.exampleZh: 小船在码头边等候渔民归来。

piety.example: Her piety toward her parents was known to everyone in the village.
piety.exampleZh: 她对父母的孝顺，村里人都知道。

pigment.example: The artist mixed red pigment with oil to paint the wall.
pigment.exampleZh: 画家把红色颜料和油混合起来粉刷墙壁。

pile.example: There is a pile of books on the desk.

pilgrim.example: Every year, many pilgrims walk a long way to visit that old temple.
pilgrim.exampleZh: 每年都有许多朝圣者走很远的路去参拜那座古老的寺庙。

pill.example: The doctor told me to take one pill after breakfast every morning.
pill.exampleZh: 医生让我每天早上早饭后吃一片药。

pillar.example: The old bridge rests on a strong stone pillar in the middle.
pillar.exampleZh: 这座老桥靠中间一根坚固的石柱支撑。

pillow.example: She put a soft pillow under her head and fell asleep quickly.
pillow.exampleZh: 她把一个柔软的枕头放在头下，很快就睡着了。

pilot.example: The pilot flew the small plane over the mountains before sunset.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员在日落前驾驶那架小飞机飞越群山。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚大头针把纸固定在板上。

pinch.example: She gave my arm a quick pinch and laughed.
pinch.exampleZh: 她快速捏了一下我的胳膊，然后笑了。

pine.example: There is a tall pine tree in front of our house.
pine.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵高大的松树。

pineapple.example: She likes to eat fresh pineapple with her breakfast every morning.
pineapple.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上吃新鲜菠萝配早餐。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress and white shoes to the party.
pink.exampleZh: 她穿着粉色连衣裙和白色鞋子去参加聚会。

pint.example: He drank a pint of milk after his long run.
pint.exampleZh: 他长跑之后喝了一品脱牛奶。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in the study of modern languages.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是现代语言研究领域的先驱。

pious.example: She is a pious woman who prays every morning before work.
pious.exampleZh: 她是个虔诚的女人，每天早上上班前都会祈祷。

pipe.example: Water flows through the long pipe under the street.
pipe.exampleZh: 水流经街道下方的长管道。

pipeline.example: The new pipeline carries oil from the coast to the city.
pipeline.exampleZh: 这条新管道把石油从海边输送到城市。

pirate.example: The pirate sailed across the sea and hid his gold on a small island.
pirate.exampleZh: 那个海盗横渡大海，把金子藏在一座小岛上。

pistol.example: The police officer carried a pistol and walked slowly into the dark house.
pistol.exampleZh: 警察带着一把手枪，慢慢走进了那栋黑房子。

piston.example: The mechanic cleaned the piston before putting the engine back together.
piston.exampleZh: 机械师在重新组装发动机之前把活塞清理干净了。

pit.example: The workers dug a deep pit in the ground behind the old factory.
pit.exampleZh: 工人们在老工厂后面的地上挖了一个深坑。

pitch.example: The singer hit a very high pitch at the end of the song.
pitch.exampleZh: 歌手在歌曲结尾唱出了一个非常高的音高。

pitiable.example: The lost little dog looked pitiable in the cold rain.
pitiable.exampleZh: 那只迷路的小狗在冷雨中看起来可怜极了。

pitiful.example: The lost little dog looked pitiful in the cold rain.
pitiful.exampleZh: 那只走失的小狗在冷雨中看起来怪可怜的。

pizza.example: My sister and I ate a large pizza with cheese and tomatoes last night.
pizza.exampleZh: 昨晚我和妹妹吃了一个加奶酪和番茄的大比萨饼。

place.example: Please place your bag in a safe place near the door.
place.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门附近一个安全的地方。

plague.example: War and plague brought great suffering to the small village.
plague.exampleZh: 战争和瘟疫给这个小村庄带来了巨大的苦难。

plain.example: The teacher used plain words so everyone could understand the lesson.
plain.exampleZh: 老师用简单的词，这样每个人都能听懂这堂课。

plan.example: We need a clear plan before we start the new project.
plan.exampleZh: 在开始新项目之前，我们需要一个清晰的计划。

plane.example: The plane flew high above the clouds and we could see the sun.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方高高飞过，我们能看到太阳。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet where we know life exists.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们已知唯一存在生命的行星。

plant.example: She planted a small tree in the garden behind our factory.
plant.exampleZh: 她在我们工厂后面的花园里种了一棵小树。

plastic.example: This chair is made of plastic, so it is very light.
plastic.exampleZh: 这把椅子是塑料做的，所以很轻。

plate.example: She put the hot soup in a white plate on the table.
plate.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一个白色盘子里。

plateau.example: After a long climb, the hikers reached a wide plateau with no trees.
plateau.exampleZh: 经过长时间的攀登，徒步者到达了一片没有树木的宽阔高原。

platform.example: The train is waiting at platform three, so please hurry up.
platform.exampleZh: 火车正在三号站台等候，所以请快点。

plausible.example: Her excuse sounded plausible, but nobody in the room believed it.
plausible.exampleZh: 她的借口听起来似乎合理，但屋里没人相信。

play.example: The children like to play games in the park after school.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在公园里玩游戏。

playground.example: The children are playing happily in the playground after school.
playground.exampleZh: 放学后孩子们在操场上开心地玩耍。

plea.example: Her plea for help was heard by the whole village.
plea.exampleZh: 她求助的恳求被整个村子听到了。

pleasant.example: The weather was very pleasant today, so we took a long walk in the park.
pleasant.exampleZh: 今天天气非常宜人，所以我们在公园里散了很久的步。

please.example: Please sit down and tell me what you need.
please.exampleZh: 请坐下，告诉我你需要什么。

pleasure.example: It is a great pleasure to meet you and your family today.
pleasure.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人是我的莫大荣幸。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her brother every day.
pledge.exampleZh: 她发誓每天都要帮助她的弟弟。

plentiful.example: Fresh water is plentiful in this area during the rainy season.
plentiful.exampleZh: 在雨季，这个地区有充足的淡水。

plenty.example: We have plenty of time to finish the work today.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们今天有充足的时间完成这项工作。

plight.example: Many families are in a difficult plight after losing their homes.
plight.exampleZh: 许多家庭失去家园后陷入了困境。

plot.example: The movie has a simple plot, but the actors are very good.
plot.exampleZh: 这部电影的情节很简单，但演员们演得很好。

plug.example: He put the plug in the sink and the water stopped.
plug.exampleZh: 他把塞子放进水槽，水就停了。

plunge.example: The cold water made him plunge into the lake without any fear.
plunge.exampleZh: 冰冷的水让他毫不畏惧地跳入湖中。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and the answer is a plus number.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，答案是正数。

pocket.example: He put the keys in his pocket before leaving the house.
pocket.exampleZh: 他出门前把钥匙放进了口袋里。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the river near her home.
poem.exampleZh: 她写了一首关于家附近那条河的短诗。

poet.example: The young poet wrote a short poem about the rain.
poet.exampleZh: 那位年轻的诗人写了一首关于雨的小诗。

poetry.example: She loves poetry because simple words can hold deep feelings.
poetry.exampleZh: 她喜欢诗歌，因为简单的词语也能承载深厚的感情。

point.example: Please point to the main point on this page.
point.exampleZh: 请指出这一页上的要点。

poison.example: Someone put poison in the dog's food last night.
poison.exampleZh: 昨晚有人在这只狗的食物里放了毒药。

poisonous.example: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, so never eat them without asking an expert.
poisonous.exampleZh: 有些野生蘑菇是有毒的，所以千万不要不问专家就吃它们。

pole.example: The flag hangs from a tall pole in front of the school.
pole.exampleZh: 旗子挂在学校前面一根高高的杆子上。

police.example: The police are looking for a man near the school.
police.exampleZh: 警方正在学校附近寻找一名男子。

policy.example: The company has a new policy about working from home.
policy.exampleZh: 公司有一项关于居家办公的新政策。

polish.example: He needs to polish his shoes and then polish his short essay.
polish.exampleZh: 他需要擦亮皮鞋，然后润色他那篇短文。

polite.example: Please be polite when you talk to your new teacher.
polite.exampleZh: 和你的新老师说话时请礼貌一些。

political.example: He often talks about political problems with his friends after work.
political.exampleZh: 他下班后常和朋友谈论政治问题。

politician.example: The politician promised to help the poor families in our town.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家承诺帮助我们镇上的贫困家庭。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at university and wants to work in government.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学习政治学，以后想在政府工作。

poll.example: The new poll shows that most people want better public schools.
poll.exampleZh: 这项新的民意测验显示，大多数人希望有更好的公立学校。

pollute.example: Factories often pollute the river with dirty water.
pollute.exampleZh: 工厂经常用脏水污染这条河。

pollution.example: Air pollution in big cities is bad for children and old people.
pollution.exampleZh: 大城市的空气污染对儿童和老人有害。

polytechnic.example: My brother studies engineering at a polytechnic near our home.
polytechnic.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的一所理工学院学习工程学。

pond.example: There are many small fish swimming in the pond behind our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家后面的池塘里游着许多小鱼。

ponder.example: I need more time to ponder this question before I answer.
ponder.exampleZh: 我需要更多时间来考虑这个问题，然后再回答。

pool.example: The children swim in the pool every hot summer afternoon.
pool.exampleZh: 孩子们在炎热的夏日午后都会去游泳池游泳。

poor.example: The poor family lives in a small house near the river.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭住在河边的一间小房子里。

pop.example: She likes pop music, and the balloon went pop in her hands.
pop.exampleZh: 她喜欢流行音乐，气球在她手里砰的一声爆了。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people all over the world.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在世界各地的年轻人中非常流行。

population.example: The population of our city has grown quickly in the past ten years.
population.exampleZh: 我们城市的人口在过去十年里增长得很快。

porch.example: We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall.
porch.exampleZh: 我们坐在门廊上看雨落下。

pork.example: My mother cooks pork with rice and fresh vegetables for dinner.
pork.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚餐用米饭和新鲜蔬菜做猪肉。

port.example: This small port is busy because many ships arrive every morning.
