port.exampleZh: 这个小型港口很繁忙，因为每天早上都有许多船只抵达。

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry on trips.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小巧的便携式收音机在旅行时很容易携带。

porter.example: The porter carried our heavy bags up to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 搬运工把我们的重行李搬到了房间。

portion.example: She ate only a small portion of the cake and saved the rest.
portion.exampleZh: 她只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的留了起来。

portrait.example: She painted a portrait of her grandmother and hung it in the living room.
portrait.exampleZh: 她画了一幅祖母的肖像，并把它挂在客厅里。

portray.example: The movie tries to portray the young doctor as a true hero.
portray.exampleZh: 这部电影试图把这位年轻医生描绘成一个真正的英雄。

pose.example: The new rule may pose a serious problem for small shops.
pose.exampleZh: 这项新规定可能会给小商店带来严重的问题。

position.example: The map shows the exact position of the old church.
position.exampleZh: 地图显示了那座老教堂的准确位置。

positive.example: She always keeps a positive attitude when she meets difficult problems at work.
positive.exampleZh: 她在工作中遇到难题时总是保持积极的态度。

possess.example: She does not possess a car, so she walks to work every day.
possess.exampleZh: 她没有汽车，所以每天步行去上班。

possession.example: This old watch is my most valuable possession.
possession.exampleZh: 这块旧手表是我最珍贵的财产。

possibility.example: There is still a possibility that we will win the game tomorrow.
possibility.exampleZh: 我们明天仍有可能赢得这场比赛。

possible.example: It is possible to finish the work before Friday.
possible.exampleZh: 在周五之前完成这项工作是可能的。

possibly.example: She will possibly arrive late because of the heavy rain.
possibly.exampleZh: 由于大雨，她可能会迟到。

post.example: I read the news in his post and shared it with my friends.
post.exampleZh: 我在他的帖子里看到了这条消息，并把它分享给了朋友们。

poster.example: There is a big movie poster on the wall of my bedroom.
poster.exampleZh: 我卧室的墙上有一张很大的电影海报。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting until next Monday because of the rain.
postpone.exampleZh: 由于下雨，我们不得不把会议推迟到下周一。

posture.example: Good posture helps your back feel better when you sit for a long time.
posture.exampleZh: 良好的姿势能让你久坐时背部感觉更舒服。

pot.example: She put the soup in a big pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把汤倒进炉子上的一口大锅里。

potato.example: My mother cooked some potatoes with beef for dinner last night.
potato.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨晚做了土豆炖牛肉当晚餐。

potential.example: She has great potential as a singer, but she needs more practice.
potential.exampleZh: 她作为歌手很有潜力，但她需要更多练习。

pottery.example: She made a small cup in her pottery class last week.
pottery.exampleZh: 她上周在陶艺课上做了一个小杯子。

poultry.example: The farm keeps poultry such as chickens and ducks for fresh eggs.
poultry.exampleZh: 这个农场饲养鸡和鸭等家禽以获取新鲜鸡蛋。

pound.example: This bag weighs about one pound, so it is easy to carry.
pound.exampleZh: 这个包大约重一磅，所以很容易携带。

pour.example: Please pour some hot water into the cup for me.
pour.exampleZh: 请帮我把一些热水倒进杯子里。

poverty.example: Many families still live in poverty without enough food or clean water.
poverty.exampleZh: 许多家庭仍然生活在贫困之中，没有足够的食物或干净的水。

powder.example: She mixed the white powder with water to make a simple cake.
powder.exampleZh: 她把白色粉末和水混合，做了一个简单的蛋糕。

power.example: The sun gives us light and power, and it costs nothing.
power.exampleZh: 太阳给我们光和电力，而且分文不取。

powerful.example: This small car has a powerful engine and it runs very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车有一台强劲的发动机，跑得很快。

practical.example: We need a practical plan that we can finish this week.
practical.exampleZh: 我们需要一个本周能完成的可行方案。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English speaking skills.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习是提高英语口语能力的最佳方法。

pragmatic.example: She is pragmatic and always looks for simple solutions to problems.
pragmatic.exampleZh: 她很务实，总是寻找解决问题的简单办法。

prairie.example: Many wild horses run freely across the wide prairie in summer.
prairie.exampleZh: 夏天，许多野马在广阔的大草原上自由奔跑。

praise.example: The teacher gave the student high praise for his hard work.
praise.exampleZh: 老师因这名学生的努力而给予了他高度赞扬。

pray.example: Every night she prays for her family's health and happiness.
pray.exampleZh: 她每天晚上都为家人的健康和幸福祈祷。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before the long trip home.
prayer.exampleZh: 在漫长的回家旅途之前，她静静地做了一次祈祷。

preach.example: My grandfather likes to preach about the value of hard work.
preach.exampleZh: 我祖父喜欢说教努力工作的价值。

precarious.example: His job is precarious and he never knows how long it will last.
precarious.exampleZh: 他的工作不稳定，他永远不知道这份工作能持续多久。

precede.example: Dark clouds usually precede a heavy storm in summer.
precede.exampleZh: 夏天的暴风雨来临之前通常会出现乌云。

precedent.example: This court case set a precedent for how similar cases are handled.
precedent.exampleZh: 这一法院案例为处理类似案件树立了一个先例。

precinct.example: The police officer walked around the precinct to make sure everything was safe.
precinct.exampleZh: 警察在管区内走了一圈，以确保一切安全。

precious.example: Her old letters are very precious to me.
precious.exampleZh: 那些旧信件对我来说非常珍贵。

precipitate.example: The sudden drop in sales could precipitate a serious crisis for the company.
precipitate.exampleZh: 销售额的突然下降可能会促成公司的一场严重危机。

precise.example: Her instructions were precise, so everyone finished the task quickly.
precise.exampleZh: 她的指示很精确，所以大家都很快完成了任务。

precision.example: This work requires great precision and careful attention to every small detail.
precision.exampleZh: 这项工作需要极高的精确度，并且要仔细关注每一个小细节。

preclude.example: Bad weather could preclude us from going to the beach today.
preclude.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气可能会妨碍我们今天去海滩。

predecessor.example: My new boss is much kinder than her predecessor.
predecessor.exampleZh: 我的新老板比她的前任和善得多。

predict.example: Scientists cannot predict exactly when the next big earthquake will happen.
predict.exampleZh: 科学家无法准确预测下一次大地震会在什么时候发生。

prediction.example: Her prediction about the weather was right, and it rained all weekend.
prediction.exampleZh: 她对天气的预测是对的，整个周末都在下雨。

predominant.example: Blue is the predominant color in this painting.
predominant.exampleZh: 蓝色是这幅画中占主导地位的颜色。

predominantly.example: The students in this class are predominantly from small towns near the school.
predominantly.exampleZh: 这个班的学生主要来自学校附近的小镇。

preeminent.example: She is the preeminent scientist in our country today.
preeminent.exampleZh: 她是我国当今最杰出的科学家。

prefer.example: I prefer tea in the morning, but my brother likes coffee.
prefer.exampleZh: 我早上更喜欢喝茶，但我弟弟喜欢咖啡。

preference.example: I have a preference for tea in the morning.

pregnant.example: My sister is pregnant and she will have a baby next month.
pregnant.exampleZh: 我姐姐怀孕了，她下个月就要生宝宝了。

prejudice.example: We should treat everyone fairly and never let prejudice decide how we act.
prejudice.exampleZh: 我们应该公平对待每个人，绝不让偏见决定我们的行为。

preliminary.example: We did some preliminary work before the main test began.
preliminary.exampleZh: 在主要测试开始之前，我们做了一些初步的工作。

premature.example: It is premature to make a decision before we see all the facts.
premature.exampleZh: 在我们了解全部事实之前就做决定，为时过早。

premier.example: The premier asked his team to focus on the most important problem first.
premier.exampleZh: 总理要求他的团队先集中解决最重要的问题。

premiere.example: The movie premiere will be held in the city tonight.
premiere.exampleZh: 这部电影的首映今晚将在该市举行。

premise.example: The whole plan rests on the premise that prices will stay low.
premise.exampleZh: 整个计划建立在价格将保持低位这一前提之上。

premium.example: The company pays a premium for good health insurance.
premium.exampleZh: 公司为好的健康保险支付额外费用。

premonition.example: She had a premonition that something bad would happen on the trip.
premonition.exampleZh: 她有一种预感，觉得这次旅行中会发生不好的事。

preoccupation.example: His preoccupation with chess sometimes worries his family and friends.
preoccupation.exampleZh: 他对国际象棋的痴迷有时令家人和朋友担心。

preparation.example: Good preparation is the key to a successful trip.
preparation.exampleZh: 充分的准备是旅行成功的关键。

preparatory.example: She took a preparatory course before the exam.
preparatory.exampleZh: 她在考试前参加了一门预备课程。

prepare.example: We need to prepare dinner for our guests tonight.
prepare.exampleZh: 我们需要为今晚的客人准备晚餐。

prescribe.example: The doctor prescribed some medicine for my cough.
prescribe.exampleZh: 医生为我的咳嗽开了一些药。

prescription.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for my cough.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张治咳嗽的处方。

presence.example: Her quiet presence made everyone in the room feel calmer.
presence.exampleZh: 她安静的存在让房间里的每个人都感到更平静。

present.example: She is present at the meeting and will give him a small gift.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并且会送给他一份小礼物。

presentable.example: She looked clean and presentable before the important job interview.
presentable.exampleZh: 重要的工作面试前，她看起来干净又得体。

presentation.example: Her presentation about the new project was clear and easy to understand.
presentation.exampleZh: 她关于新项目的展示清晰易懂。

preservative.example: This jam has no preservatives, so keep it in the fridge.
preservative.exampleZh: 这瓶果酱不含防腐剂，所以要放在冰箱里。

preserve.example: We must preserve this old building for the people who come after us.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为后来的人保护这座古老的建筑。

preside.example: The mayor will preside over the meeting in the town hall tonight.
preside.exampleZh: 市长今晚将在市政厅主持这场会议。

president.example: The president of the company will visit our school next Monday.
president.exampleZh: 公司总裁下周一将来参观我们学校。

press.example: Please press the red button to start the machine.
press.exampleZh: 请按红色按钮启动机器。

pressing.example: The doctor said the injury was pressing and needed quick care.
pressing.exampleZh: 医生说这处伤情紧急，需要尽快处理。

pressure.example: Students often feel pressure before a big exam.
pressure.exampleZh: 学生在大型考试前常常感到压力。

prestige.example: The old school has great prestige in our city.
prestige.exampleZh: 这所老学校在我们城市有很大的声望。

prestigious.example: She works at a prestigious university in the north of the country.
prestigious.exampleZh: 她在该国北部一所享有盛誉的大学工作。

presumably.example: He is not here yet, so presumably he missed the bus.
presumably.exampleZh: 他还没到，所以大概是他错过了公交车。

presume.example: I presume you are tired after the long trip.
presume.exampleZh: 我猜你长途旅行后一定累了。

pretend.example: He pretended to be asleep when his mother came into the room.
pretend.exampleZh: 他妈妈走进房间时，他假装睡着了。

pretext.example: He said he was tired as a pretext to leave the party early.
pretext.exampleZh: 他说自己累了，以此作为提前离开聚会的借口。

pretty.example: The garden looks very pretty in spring, and the flowers smell quite nice too.
pretty.exampleZh: 这个花园在春天看起来非常漂亮，花儿闻起来也相当香。

prevail.example: In small towns, old traditions still prevail over modern habits.
prevail.exampleZh: 在小镇上，古老的传统仍然胜过现代的习惯。

prevalent.example: This idea is prevalent among young people today.
prevalent.exampleZh: 这个想法在当今年轻人中很普遍。

prevent.example: Regular exercise and a healthy diet can prevent many serious diseases.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和健康饮食可以预防许多严重疾病。

prevention.example: Washing your hands is a simple prevention against many common illnesses.
prevention.exampleZh: 洗手是预防许多常见疾病的一种简单方法。

previous.example: I met her in a previous job at a small shop.
previous.exampleZh: 我在以前一份小商店的工作中见过她。

prey.example: The lion quietly watched its prey from behind the tall grass.
prey.exampleZh: 狮子在高高的草丛后面静静地注视着它的猎物。

price.example: The price of this small car is too high for me.
price.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车的价格对我来说太高了。

pride.example: Her pride in her work helped her finish the difficult project.
pride.exampleZh: 她对自己工作的自豪感帮助她完成了这个困难的项目。

priest.example: The priest spoke kindly to the children after the morning service.
priest.exampleZh: 早晨礼拜结束后，牧师和蔼地跟孩子们说话。

primarily.example: This book is primarily for students who want to learn English.
primarily.exampleZh: 这本书主要是为想学英语的学生写的。

primary.example: The primary reason I chose this school is its small class size.
primary.exampleZh: 我选择这所学校的主要原因是它的小班规模。

prime.example: Safety is our prime concern when we build new roads.
prime.exampleZh: 修建新道路时，安全是我们的首要关注。

primeval.example: These primeval forests have stood unchanged for thousands of years.
primeval.exampleZh: 这些原始森林数千年来一直没有改变。

primitive.example: Their early tools were primitive and made of stone.
primitive.exampleZh: 他们早期的工具很简陋，是用石头做的。

principal.example: The principal reason for his success is his hard work and patience.
principal.exampleZh: 他成功的主要原因是他的努力和耐心。

principle.example: She always follows one simple principle: be honest with everyone you meet.
principle.exampleZh: 她始终遵循一个简单的原则：对遇到的每个人都要诚实。

print.example: Please print two copies of this page for the meeting.
print.exampleZh: 请为这次会议打印两页这份文件。

printer.example: The printer in our office is broken again today.
printer.exampleZh: 我们办公室的打印机今天又坏了。

printing.example: The printing of this book took two weeks.
printing.exampleZh: 这本书的印刷用了两周时间。

prior.example: She had no prior experience in teaching before this job.
prior.exampleZh: 在得到这份工作之前，她没有先前的教学经验。

priority.example: My top priority this week is to finish the report on time.
priority.exampleZh: 我这周的首要优先事项是按时完成这份报告。

prison.example: He spent three years in prison after the robbery.
prison.exampleZh: 抢劫之后他在监狱里待了三年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner stood quietly by the window and looked at the gray sky.
prisoner.exampleZh: 那个囚犯静静地站在窗边，望着灰色的天空。

privacy.example: Everyone has the right to privacy in their own home.
privacy.exampleZh: 每个人在自己家里都享有隐私权。

private.example: This is a private road, so only the people who live here can use it.
private.exampleZh: 这是一条私人道路，所以只有住在这里的人才能使用。

privilege.example: It is a privilege to work with such kind and helpful people.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这么友善、乐于助人的人一起工作是一种荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school writing contest and felt very happy.
prize.exampleZh: 她在学校写作比赛中获得了一等奖，感到非常高兴。

probability.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow.
probability.exampleZh: 明天下雨的可能性很大。

probable.example: It is probable that the train will be late this morning.
probable.exampleZh: 今天早上火车很可能会晚点。

probably.example: It will probably rain tomorrow, so we should take an umbrella.
probably.exampleZh: 明天很可能会下雨，所以我们应该带把伞。

probation.example: The young worker is still on probation for the first three months.
probation.exampleZh: 这位年轻员工头三个月仍在试用期。

probe.example: The doctor used a small tool to probe the wound carefully.
probe.exampleZh: 医生用一个小工具仔细地探查了伤口。

problem.example: We have a big problem with the old computer in our office.
problem.exampleZh: 我们办公室里那台旧电脑有个大问题。

problematic.example: The old bridge is problematic because it is not safe for cars.
problematic.exampleZh: 这座旧桥有问题，因为它对汽车来说不安全。

procedure.example: The doctor explained the procedure to the patient before the operation.
procedure.exampleZh: 医生在手术前向病人解释了这个手术程序。

proceed.example: After a short break, we will proceed with the next part of the plan.
proceed.exampleZh: 短暂休息后，我们将继续进行计划的下一部分。

proceeds.example: The proceeds from the concert will help the local school.
proceeds.exampleZh: 音乐会的收入将帮助当地学校。

process.example: We must follow each step of the process to get the right result.
process.exampleZh: 我们必须遵循这个过程的每一个步骤，才能得到正确的结果。

procession.example: A long procession of students walked slowly through the quiet street.
procession.exampleZh: 一长队学生缓慢地穿过安静的街道。

proclaim.example: The school proclaimed the winner of the contest on Friday morning.
proclaim.exampleZh: 学校在周五上午宣布了比赛的获胜者。

proclamation.example: The king sent a proclamation to every town to announce the new law.
proclamation.exampleZh: 国王向每个城镇发出公告，宣布这项新法律。

prodigy.example: The young prodigy played the piano beautifully at the concert last night.
prodigy.exampleZh: 那位年轻的神童昨晚在音乐会上把钢琴弹得很动听。

produce.example: This farm produces fresh vegetables and fruit for the local market.
produce.exampleZh: 这个农场为当地市场生产新鲜的蔬菜和水果。

product.example: This new product is cheap and easy to use.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品便宜且易于使用。

production.example: The factory increased its production of cars last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年提高了汽车的产量。

productive.example: Our short meeting was productive and everyone left with clear next steps.
productive.exampleZh: 我们的短会富有成效，每个人离开时都带着明确的下一步。

productivity.example: Good sleep helps improve your productivity at work and school.
productivity.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠有助于提高你在工作和学习中的效率。

profess.example: He professes to know nothing about the missing money.
profess.exampleZh: 他声称对失踪的钱一无所知。

professed.example: His professed love for music was never shown in his daily life.
professed.exampleZh: 他声称对音乐的热爱在日常生活中从未表现出来。

profession.example: She chose teaching as her profession and has worked in it for years.
profession.exampleZh: 她选择了教书作为自己的职业，并已从事多年。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse and cares for many patients every day.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，每天都照顾许多病人。

professionalism.example: Her professionalism makes every customer feel respected and well cared for.
professionalism.exampleZh: 她的职业精神让每位顾客都感到受尊重并且受到周到照顾。

professor.example: My professor answered my question after class yesterday.
professor.exampleZh: 昨天课后，我的教授回答了我的问题。

proffer.example: She proffered a cup of tea to the tired guest.
proffer.exampleZh: 她向疲惫的客人递上了一杯茶。

proficiency.example: She has great proficiency in English after years of daily practice.
proficiency.exampleZh: 经过多年每日练习，她的英语非常熟练。

profile.example: Her profile in the photo shows a clear and gentle face.
profile.exampleZh: 照片里她的侧脸轮廓清晰而柔和。

profit.example: The small shop makes a good profit every month.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店每个月都能获得不错的利润。

profitable.example: The small shop became very profitable after it started selling coffee.
profitable.exampleZh: 这家小店开始卖咖啡后就变得非常赚钱。

profound.example: The old teacher had a profound effect on all his students.
profound.exampleZh: 这位老教师对所有学生都产生了深远的影响。

profusion.example: The garden was full of a profusion of bright wild flowers.
profusion.exampleZh: 花园里开满了大量鲜艳的野花。

progeny.example: Her three sons are her only progeny and they live abroad.
progeny.exampleZh: 她的三个儿子是她唯一的后代，他们住在国外。

program.example: The new program on TV teaches children how to draw animals.
program.exampleZh: 电视上的这个新节目教孩子们如何画动物。

programme.example: I watched an interesting programme about wild animals on TV last night.
programme.exampleZh: 昨晚我在电视上看了一个关于野生动物的有趣节目。

progress.example: She made good progress in English this term.
progress.exampleZh: 这学期她的英语进步很大。

progression.example: Her rapid progression from beginner to teacher surprised everyone in the class.
progression.exampleZh: 她从初学者到教师的快速进步让班上每个人都很惊讶。

progressive.example: Our school has a progressive plan to help students learn new skills.
progressive.exampleZh: 我们学校有一个循序渐进的计划，帮助学生掌握新技能。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

prohibition.example: The prohibition on smoking in this building starts next week.
prohibition.exampleZh: 这栋大楼内禁止吸烟的规定下周开始生效。

project.example: The team will finish the new project before the end of this year.
project.exampleZh: 团队将在今年年底前完成这个新项目。

projection.example: The company's projection for next year's sales seems too high.
projection.exampleZh: 公司对明年销售额的预测似乎过高。

proletariat.example: The proletariat in this city works long hours in the factories.
proletariat.exampleZh: 这个城市的工人阶级在工厂里长时间工作。

proliferate.example: Online shops continue to proliferate as more people buy things from home.
proliferate.exampleZh: 随着越来越多的人在家购物，网店不断激增。

prolific.example: She is a prolific writer who has published over twenty books.
prolific.exampleZh: 她是一位多产的作家，已经出版了二十多本书。

prolong.example: We decided to prolong the meeting to discuss the new plan.
prolong.exampleZh: 我们决定延长会议时间来讨论新计划。

prominence.example: The tall tower stands out with great prominence against the small houses.
prominence.exampleZh: 那座高塔在小房子之间十分突出，格外显眼。

prominent.example: She is a prominent doctor in our small town.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们小镇上一位著名的医生。

promise.example: She promised to call me after work, and I believe her promise.
promise.exampleZh: 她答应下班后给我打电话，我相信她的诺言。

promising.example: She is a promising young singer with a beautiful voice.
promising.exampleZh: 她是一位有前途的年轻歌手，嗓音很美。

promo.example: The store sent a short promo to all its customers last week.
promo.exampleZh: 这家商店上周向所有顾客发送了一段简短的促销广告。

promote.example: The school is working hard to promote healthy eating among its students.
promote.exampleZh: 学校正在努力在学生中推广健康饮食。

prompt.example: His prompt reply helped us finish the task on time.
prompt.exampleZh: 他及时的回复帮助我们按时完成了任务。

prone.example: People who sit all day are prone to back pain.
prone.exampleZh: 整天坐着的人容易背痛。

pronounce.example: Many students find it hard to pronounce this long word correctly.
pronounce.exampleZh: 许多学生觉得正确读出这个长单词很难。

pronounced.example: She spoke with a pronounced accent that everyone noticed right away.
pronounced.exampleZh: 她说话带着明显的口音，大家一下子就注意到了。

proof.example: The police found proof that he was at the scene of the crime.
proof.exampleZh: 警方找到了他在犯罪现场的证据。

propaganda.example: The government used propaganda to make people support the new law.
propaganda.exampleZh: 政府利用宣传让民众支持这项新法律。

propagate.example: Good ideas spread quickly, but bad news can also propagate fast.
propagate.exampleZh: 好想法传播得很快，但坏消息也能迅速扩散。

propel.example: A strong wind propelled the small boat across the lake.
propel.exampleZh: 一阵强风推动小船穿过湖面。

propensity.example: She has a propensity to spend too much money on clothes.
propensity.exampleZh: 她有在衣服上花太多钱的倾向。

proper.example: It is important to wear proper clothes for the job.
proper.exampleZh: 为这份工作穿合适的衣服很重要。

property.example: This old house is the most valuable property my family owns.
property.exampleZh: 这栋老房子是我家拥有的最有价值的财产。

prophecy.example: The old woman's prophecy about the flood came true.
prophecy.exampleZh: 那位老妇人关于洪水的预言成真了。

prophet.example: The old prophet told the people that a great flood was coming soon.
prophet.exampleZh: 那位老先知告诉人们，一场大洪水即将来临。

proportion.example: A small proportion of the students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 一小部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She made a good proposal at the meeting yesterday.
proposal.exampleZh: 她昨天在会上提出了一个很好的提议。

propose.example: I propose that we meet again next week to talk about the plan.
propose.exampleZh: 我建议我们下周再见面谈谈这个计划。

proposition.example: She accepted the proposition and started working on the new task.
proposition.exampleZh: 她接受了这项提议，并开始着手这项新任务。

prose.example: She writes simple prose about her life in the countryside.
prose.exampleZh: 她用简朴的散文描写自己在乡下的生活。

prosecute.example: The police decided to prosecute the man for stealing money from the store.
prosecute.exampleZh: 警方决定以从商店偷钱的罪名起诉这名男子。

prospect.example: The prospect of a better job made him study harder every day.
prospect.exampleZh: 找到更好工作的前景让他每天都更加努力地学习。

prospective.example: The school held a meeting for prospective students and their parents.
prospective.exampleZh: 学校为未来的学生及其家长举行了一场会议。

prosper.example: The small town began to prosper after the new road was built.
prosper.exampleZh: 新路修好之后，这个小镇开始繁荣起来。

prosperity.example: The small town enjoyed years of peace and prosperity after the new factory opened.
prosperity.exampleZh: 新工厂开办后，这座小镇享受了多年的和平与繁荣。

prosperous.example: Our small town became prosperous after the new factory opened last year.
prosperous.exampleZh: 去年新工厂开业后，我们的小镇变得繁荣起来。

protect.example: Parents should protect their children from danger at home and school.
protect.exampleZh: 父母应该保护孩子免受家中和学校的危险。

protection.example: This cream gives good protection from the sun.
protection.exampleZh: 这款防晒霜能提供良好的防晒保护。

protective.example: Parents should be protective of their children but also let them grow.
protective.exampleZh: 父母应该保护孩子，但也要让他们成长。

protein.example: Many people eat eggs and beans to get enough protein every day.
protein.exampleZh: 很多人每天吃鸡蛋和豆类来摄入足够的蛋白质。

protest.example: Many students marched in the street to protest against the new rule.
protest.exampleZh: 许多学生在街上游行，抗议这项新规定。

protocol.example: The two countries signed a protocol on trade and shared it with reporters.
protocol.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项贸易议定书，并向记者公开了这份文件。

prototype.example: The team built a simple prototype before making the final product.
prototype.exampleZh: 团队在制作最终产品之前先做了一个简单的原型。

protract.example: They decided to protract the meeting by asking more questions.
protract.exampleZh: 他们决定通过多问一些问题来延长会议。

proud.example: My parents are very proud of me because I work hard at school.
proud.exampleZh: 我父母为我感到非常骄傲，因为我在学校很努力。

prove.example: The test results prove that he is a good student.
prove.exampleZh: 测试结果证明他是一个好学生。

proverb.example: My grandmother often ends a story with an old proverb about patience.
proverb.exampleZh: 我奶奶经常用一句关于耐心的古老谚语来结束故事。

provide.example: The school will provide free books and lunch for every student this year.
provide.exampleZh: 学校今年将为每位学生提供免费的书本和午餐。

provident.example: His provident habits helped him save enough money for a new house.
provident.exampleZh: 他节俭的习惯帮他攒够了钱买一栋新房子。

province.example: She lives in a small province in the north of the country.
province.exampleZh: 她住在这个国家北部的一个小省份里。

provision.example: The old contract has a provision about extra pay for night work.
provision.exampleZh: 这份旧合同里有一条关于夜班额外报酬的规定。

provisional.example: We made a provisional plan for the trip but may change it later.
provisional.exampleZh: 我们为这次旅行定了一个临时计划，但之后可能会修改。

provocation.example: He hit the man without any provocation and was arrested by the police.
provocation.exampleZh: 他毫无缘由地挑衅性地打了那个人，随后被警察逮捕了。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked everyone in the room and caused a big argument.
provoke.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话激怒了房间里的每个人，引发了一场大争论。

proximity.example: The hotel's proximity to the train station makes travel very easy.
proximity.exampleZh: 酒店靠近火车站，出行非常方便。

prudent.example: It is prudent to save money before you buy an expensive car.
prudent.exampleZh: 在买一辆昂贵的汽车之前存钱是明智的。

psychiatrist.example: The psychiatrist talked with the young man for an hour and helped him feel calm.
psychiatrist.exampleZh: 精神科医生和那个年轻人聊了一个小时，帮助他平静下来。

psychiatry.example: My sister wants to study psychiatry after she finishes her medical degree.
psychiatry.exampleZh: 我姐姐想在完成医学学位后学习精神病学。

psychological.example: The doctor said his problems were psychological, not physical.
psychological.exampleZh: 医生说他的问题是心理上的，而不是身体上的。

psychologist.example: The psychologist helped my brother feel less worried about school.
psychologist.exampleZh: 那位心理学家帮助我弟弟减少了对学校的担忧。

psychology.example: She is studying psychology because she wants to understand how people think.
psychology.exampleZh: 她正在学习心理学，因为她想了解人们如何思考。

pub.example: We met some friends at a small pub near the station last night.
pub.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在车站附近一家小酒吧见了几位朋友。

public.example: The public library is open to everyone every day of the week.
public.exampleZh: 这家公共图书馆每周每天都对所有人开放。

publication.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她第一本书的出版让她非常开心。

publicity.example: The new film got a lot of publicity before it came out.
publicity.exampleZh: 这部新电影在上映前得到了大量宣传。

publish.example: The writer will publish his new book next month.
publish.exampleZh: 这位作家下个月将出版他的新书。

pudding.example: My mother made a sweet pudding for us after dinner.
pudding.exampleZh: 妈妈在晚饭后给我们做了一份甜甜的布丁。

puff.example: She puffed out the candle and then ran to the door.
puff.exampleZh: 她吹灭蜡烛，然后跑向门口。

pull.example: Please pull the heavy box across the floor to the other side.
pull.exampleZh: 请把那个重箱子从地板上拖到另一边去。

pulp.example: The machine turns wood into pulp for making cheap paper.
pulp.exampleZh: 这台机器把木头变成纸浆，用来制造廉价的纸张。

pulse.example: The doctor felt his pulse and said he was fine.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生摸了摸他的脉搏，说他没事。

pump.example: We need a pump to get water out of the old well.
pump.exampleZh: 我们需要一台水泵把老井里的水抽出来。

pumpkin.example: My mother made a sweet soup with pumpkin for dinner last night.
pumpkin.exampleZh: 昨晚我妈妈用南瓜做了一锅甜汤当晚餐。

punch.example: The boxer tried to punch his opponent, but he missed and fell.
punch.exampleZh: 拳击手试图拳打对手，但他打空了并摔倒了。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for her morning classes.

punctuation.example: Good punctuation helps readers understand where sentences begin and end.
punctuation.exampleZh: 正确的标点有助于读者理解句子的起止位置。

puncture.example: A sharp nail made a small puncture in my bike tire.
puncture.exampleZh: 一颗尖钉子在我的自行车轮胎上扎出了一个小孔。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the test.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚在考试中作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The punishment for breaking the school rules was a week of cleaning.
punishment.exampleZh: 违反校规的惩罚是打扫卫生一周。

pupil.example: The pupil raised his hand to answer the teacher's question.
pupil.exampleZh: 那个小学生举手回答老师的问题。

puppet.example: The puppet moved its arms and legs when the child pulled the strings.
puppet.exampleZh: 孩子拉动线时，木偶的手臂和腿就动了起来。

puppy.example: The little puppy follows me everywhere in the garden.
puppy.exampleZh: 这只小狗在花园里到处跟着我。

purchase.example: She went to the store to purchase a new laptop for her son.
purchase.exampleZh: 她去商店给儿子买了一台新笔记本电脑。

pure.example: The water in this mountain lake is pure and very clean.
pure.exampleZh: 这座山间湖泊里的水纯净而清澈。

purify.example: Plants can help purify the air in your home.
purify.exampleZh: 植物可以帮助净化你家里的空气。

purity.example: The purity of the mountain water surprised every visitor that morning.
purity.exampleZh: 那天早上，山间水流的纯净让每位游客都感到惊讶。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress and a small silver ring to the party.
purple.exampleZh: 她穿着一条紫色连衣裙，戴着一枚小银戒指去参加聚会。

purpose.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan our next project.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是规划我们的下一个项目。

purse.example: She opened her purse and found only a few coins inside.
purse.exampleZh: 她打开钱包，发现里面只有几枚硬币。

pursue.example: She wants to pursue a career in medicine after college.
pursue.exampleZh: 她想在大学毕业后从事医学方面的职业。

pursuit.example: Her pursuit of a better job took her to another city.
pursuit.exampleZh: 为了追求一份更好的工作，她去了另一座城市。

push.example: She pushed the heavy box across the floor and into the next room.
push.exampleZh: 她把那个沉重的箱子推过地板，推进了隔壁房间。

put.example: Please put your books on the desk before you leave the room.
put.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把你的书放在书桌上。

puzzle.example: The missing key is a puzzle that makes everyone think hard.
puzzle.exampleZh: 那把丢失的钥匙是一个让每个人都苦思冥想的谜。

puzzled.example: She looked puzzled when I asked her about the new plan.
puzzled.exampleZh: 当我问她关于那个新计划时，她看起来很困惑。

pyramid.example: The ancient pyramid stands in the desert and many people visit it each year.
pyramid.exampleZh: 这座古老的金字塔矗立在沙漠中，每年都有很多人来参观它。

python.example: We saw a huge python sleeping under the tree in the zoo.
python.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到一条巨大的蟒蛇在树下睡觉。

quack.example: The duck said quack and swam across the small pond.
quack.exampleZh: 鸭子嘎嘎叫了一声，游过了小池塘。

quaff.example: He quaffed a cold glass of water after the long run.
quaff.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他大口喝下了一杯冷水。

quagmire.example: The team got into a quagmire of problems after the budget was cut.
quagmire.exampleZh: 预算被削减后，团队陷入了问题的困境。

quail.example: The shy boy quailed when the teacher asked him to speak.
quail.exampleZh: 当老师让他发言时，这个害羞的男孩胆怯了。

quaint.example: We stayed in a quaint little village with old stone houses and narrow streets.
quaint.exampleZh: 我们住在一个古雅的小村庄里，那里有古老的石头房子和狭窄的街道。

quake.example: The ground began to quake and everyone ran out of the building.
quake.exampleZh: 地面开始震动，所有人都跑出了大楼。

qualification.example: She has the right qualifications for this job.
qualification.exampleZh: 她具备这份工作所需的资格。

qualify.example: She worked hard for two years to qualify as a doctor.
qualify.exampleZh: 她努力工作了两年才取得医生资格。

quality.example: The quality of this food is very good.
quality.exampleZh: 这种食物的质量非常好。

quantify.example: We need to quantify the cost before we make a final decision.
quantify.exampleZh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要量化成本。

quantitative.example: The study uses quantitative data to show how prices changed over time.
quantitative.exampleZh: 这项研究使用定量数据来说明价格随时间的变化。

quantity.example: We need a large quantity of water for the whole team.
quantity.exampleZh: 整个团队需要大量的水。

quarrel.example: The two brothers had a quarrel about who should use the computer first.
quarrel.exampleZh: 两兄弟为谁先用电脑吵了一架。

quarry.example: The old quarry outside town is now a deep lake.
quarry.exampleZh: 城外的老采石场现在成了一个深湖。

quarter.example: She spent a quarter of her money on new books last week.
quarter.exampleZh: 上周她把四分之一的钱花在了新书上。

quarterly.example: The company sends a quarterly report to all its staff.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司向全体员工发送季度报告。

quartz.example: The white sand on this beach is mostly made of tiny quartz pieces.
quartz.exampleZh: 这片海滩上的白沙主要由细小的石英颗粒组成。

queen.example: The queen waved to the crowd from the balcony of her palace.
queen.exampleZh: 女王从宫殿阳台上向人群挥手。

queer.example: Something about his story feels queer and I do not trust him.
queer.exampleZh: 他的说法有些可疑，我不太相信他。

quench.example: I drank a lot of cold water to quench my thirst after the long run.
quench.exampleZh: 长跑之后我喝了很多凉水来解渴。

query.example: She asked a quick query about the new schedule.
query.exampleZh: 她就新日程提出了一个简短的疑问。

quest.example: Their quest for clean water took many years.
quest.exampleZh: 他们对清洁水源的寻求持续了很多年。

question.example: I have a question about the new plan, and I doubt it will work.
question.exampleZh: 关于这个新计划我有个问题，而且我怀疑它行不通。

questionnaire.example: Please fill out this questionnaire before you leave the office today.
questionnaire.exampleZh: 请在今天离开办公室之前填写这份问卷。

queue.example: We had to queue for an hour to buy the tickets.
queue.exampleZh: 我们不得不排队一个小时买票。

quick.example: She is quick at learning new things at school.
quick.exampleZh: 她在学校学新东西很快。

quiet.example: The library is very quiet in the early morning.
quiet.exampleZh: 清晨时图书馆非常安静。

quit.example: He decided to quit his job and move to another city.
quit.exampleZh: 他决定辞掉工作，搬到另一座城市去。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, so I finished it in ten minutes.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，所以我十分钟就做完了。

quiver.example: Her cold hands began to quiver as she waited for the bus.
quiver.exampleZh: 她等公交车时，冰冷的双手开始颤抖。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz on the new words today.
quiz.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们做了一次关于新单词的小测验。

quota.example: The company set a strict quota for new hires this year.
quota.exampleZh: 公司为今年的新员工人数设定了严格的配额。

quotation.example: The writer begins the article with a quotation from an old letter.
quotation.exampleZh: 作者以一封旧信中的引文作为文章的开头。

quote.example: Please quote the exact words she said in the meeting.
quote.exampleZh: 请引用她在会上说的原话。

rabbit.example: A small white rabbit is eating grass in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 一只小白兔正在花园里吃草。

rabid.example: My rabid brother watches every football game twice and never misses one.
rabid.exampleZh: 我那个狂热的弟弟每场足球赛都要看两遍，一场都不错过。

race.example: Many people from every race ran in the race today.
race.exampleZh: 今天有许多来自不同种族的人参加了这场赛跑。

racial.example: Many people are working hard to end racial unfairness in schools and jobs.
racial.exampleZh: 许多人正在努力消除学校和工作中存在的种族不公平现象。

racing.example: My brother loves racing and watches it on TV every Sunday.
racing.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢赛车，每周日都在电视上看。

racism.example: Many people are working hard to end racism in schools and at work.
racism.exampleZh: 许多人正在努力消除学校和工作场所中的种族歧视。

rack.example: Please put your bag on the rack above your seat.
rack.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在座位上方的行李架上。

radar.example: The pilot used radar to find the airport in the heavy fog.
radar.exampleZh: 飞行员用雷达在浓雾中找到了机场。

radiant.example: She looked radiant in her new dress at the party.
radiant.exampleZh: 她在派对上穿着新裙子，显得容光焕发。

radiate.example: Warm light radiates from the fire and fills the whole room.
radiate.exampleZh: 温暖的光从火中散发出来，充满了整个房间。

radiation.example: The doctor warned that too much radiation is bad for your health.
radiation.exampleZh: 医生警告说，过多的辐射对健康有害。

radiator.example: The radiator in my bedroom keeps the room warm all winter.
radiator.exampleZh: 我卧室里的暖气片整个冬天都让房间保持温暖。

radical.example: The new leader wants radical changes to make the school better.
radical.exampleZh: 这位新领导希望进行彻底的改革，让学校变得更好。

radio.example: My father listens to the radio every morning while eating breakfast.
radio.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上吃早饭时都会听收音机。

radioactive.example: The old factory left radioactive waste in the ground near the river.
radioactive.exampleZh: 那家旧工厂在河边的地下留下了放射性废料。

rag.example: He cleaned the dirty table with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 他用一块旧抹布擦干净了那张脏桌子。

rage.example: His face turned red with rage when he heard the bad news.
rage.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，他气得脸都红了。

raid.example: The police made a raid on the house early this morning.
raid.exampleZh: 警方今天清晨突袭了那栋房子。

rail.example: Hold the rail tightly when you walk down the stairs.
rail.exampleZh: 下楼梯时要紧紧抓住扶手。

railroad.example: The new railroad runs through the mountains and connects two small towns.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条新铁路穿过群山，连接着两个小镇。

railway.example: My father takes the railway to work every morning.
railway.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上坐火车上班。

rain.example: The rain stopped in the afternoon, so we walked to the park.
rain.exampleZh: 雨在下午停了，所以我们步行去了公园。

rainbow.example: After the storm, a bright rainbow appeared over the green hills.
rainbow.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，一道明亮的彩虹出现在绿色的山丘上方。

raise.example: They raise money to help children in poor areas go to school.
raise.exampleZh: 他们筹集资金帮助贫困地区的孩子上学。

rally.example: The fans held a rally to support the team.
rally.exampleZh: 球迷们举行集会来支持球队。

ram.example: The angry goat rammed the fence and then ran away.
ram.exampleZh: 那只愤怒的山羊撞击了栅栏，然后跑开了。

ranch.example: My uncle lives on a large ranch with many cows and horses.
ranch.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在一个养着许多奶牛和马的大牧场上。

random.example: We picked a random number and used it to choose the winner.
random.exampleZh: 我们随机选了一个数字，用它来决定获胜者。

range.example: The shop has a wide range of cheap shoes for young students.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店有各种适合年轻学生的便宜鞋子。

rank.example: He holds a high rank in the army and often ranks first.
rank.exampleZh: 他在军队中军衔很高，而且常常排名第一。

ransom.example: The family had to pay a large ransom to get the boy back.
ransom.exampleZh: 这家人不得不支付一大笔赎金才能把孩子赎回来。

rap.example: The rapper's new rap song has a strong beat and funny words.
rap.exampleZh: 这位说唱歌手的新说唱歌曲节奏强劲，歌词有趣。

rapid.example: The rapid growth of the city brought many new jobs.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速增长带来了许多新的工作机会。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里看到雪是很少见的。

rarely.example: My brother rarely eats breakfast because he wakes up late every morning.
rarely.exampleZh: 我弟弟很少吃早饭，因为他每天早上都起得很晚。

rash.example: It is rash to make such a big decision without asking anyone.
rash.exampleZh: 不问任何人就做出这么大的决定是轻率的。

rate.example: The rate of pay is higher for night workers at this factory.
rate.exampleZh: 这家工厂夜班工人的工资标准更高。

rather.example: The film was rather long, but I enjoyed it a lot.
rather.exampleZh: 这部电影相当长，但我很喜欢。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is three to one.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生和女生的比例是三比一。

rational.example: A rational person thinks carefully before making an important decision.
rational.exampleZh: 一个理性的人在做重要决定前会仔细思考。

rattle.example: The strong wind made the old window rattle all night long.
rattle.exampleZh: 大风让那扇旧窗户整夜嘎嘎作响。

raw.example: We ate raw fish with rice and a little salt.
raw.exampleZh: 我们吃了生鱼配米饭和一点盐。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the window and brightened the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一缕阳光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

razor.example: He used a sharp razor to shave his face this morning.
razor.exampleZh: 今天早上他用一把锋利的剃须刀刮脸。

reach.example: We can reach the top of the hill before noon.
reach.exampleZh: 我们中午之前就能到达山顶。

react.example: She did not react when I told her the bad news.
react.exampleZh: 当我告诉她这个坏消息时，她没有反应。

reaction.example: Her quick reaction saved the child from the falling branch.
reaction.exampleZh: 她迅速的反应使孩子免于被落下的树枝砸到。

read.example: I read a short book every night before I go to sleep.
read.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会读一本薄薄的书。

reader.example: This book is a good reader for young children.
reader.exampleZh: 这本书是适合幼儿的好读物。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us move the boxes.
readily.exampleZh: 她乐意地答应了帮我们搬箱子。

reading.example: Reading every day helps me learn new words and think more clearly.
reading.exampleZh: 每天阅读帮助我学习新单词，并思考得更清晰。

ready.example: I am ready to help you with your homework tonight.
ready.exampleZh: 我今晚乐意帮你做作业。

real.example: The story is real, and it happened in our small town last year.
real.exampleZh: 这个故事是真实的，它去年发生在我们的小镇上。

realism.example: Her new novel shows a strong sense of realism about family life.
realism.exampleZh: 她的新小说对家庭生活表现出强烈的现实主义态度。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can actually finish this year.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要一个现实可行的计划，能在今年真正完成。

reality.example: The reality of the job is harder than I expected.
reality.exampleZh: 这份工作的实际情况比我预想的更难。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until I saw the clock.
realize.exampleZh: 直到看到钟，我才意识到时间已经很晚了。

really.example: I really like this small book about animals.
really.exampleZh: 我真的很喜欢这本关于动物的小书。

realm.example: The world of music is a realm where everyone can find joy.
realm.exampleZh: 音乐的世界是一个每个人都能找到快乐的领域。

reap.example: Farmers reap the rice in autumn and then sell it.
reap.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，然后把它卖掉。

rear.example: The children sat in the rear of the car and looked out.
rear.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在汽车后部，向外面看。

reason.example: There is a good reason why she left the meeting early.
reason.exampleZh: 她提前离开会议有一个很好的理由。

reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for a fair price.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求一个公道的价格是合理的。

reassure.example: The doctor reassured her that the test results were normal.
reassure.exampleZh: 医生让她放心，检查结果是正常的。

rebel.example: The young rebel refused to follow the old rules of the school.
rebel.exampleZh: 那个年轻的叛逆者拒绝遵守学校的旧规矩。

rebuild.example: After the fire, the workers helped rebuild the old school in just one year.
rebuild.exampleZh: 火灾之后，工人们帮忙在短短一年内重建了这所老学校。

recall.example: I cannot recall where I put my keys last night.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起来昨晚把钥匙放在哪里了。

recede.example: The flood water began to recede after the heavy rain stopped.
recede.exampleZh: 大雨停后，洪水开始退去。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt after you pay for your food.
receipt.exampleZh: 付完餐费后请保留收据。

receive.example: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
receive.exampleZh: 我每周都会收到朋友寄来的一封信。

receiver.example: The receiver of the letter was very happy to read it.
receiver.exampleZh: 这封信的接收者读到它时非常高兴。

recent.example: I have not seen him in recent weeks.
recent.exampleZh: 最近几周我没有见过他。

recently.example: I recently bought a new bike and ride it to work every day.
recently.exampleZh: 我最近买了一辆新自行车，每天骑它去上班。

reception.example: The hotel reception is on the first floor near the main door.
reception.exampleZh: 酒店前台在一楼，靠近正门。

receptionist.example: The receptionist at the front desk gave me a warm welcome.
receptionist.exampleZh: 前台的接待员热情地欢迎了我。

recession.example: The country lost many jobs during the recent recession.
recession.exampleZh: 在最近的经济衰退期间，这个国家失去了许多工作。

recipe.example: This recipe is easy to follow for a simple family dinner.
recipe.exampleZh: 这个食谱很简单，适合做一顿家常晚餐。

recite.example: Every morning the students recite a short poem in class.
recite.exampleZh: 每天早上学生们在课堂上背诵一首短诗。

recognition.example: She smiled when she saw the recognition in his eyes.
recognition.exampleZh: 当她看到他眼中认出她的神情时，她笑了。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him because he was wearing a hat.
recognize.exampleZh: 我没认出他，因为他戴着一顶帽子。

recommend.example: I recommend this small restaurant because the food is fresh and cheap.
recommend.exampleZh: 我推荐这家小餐馆，因为食物新鲜又便宜。

recommendation.example: My teacher wrote a recommendation for my college application.
recommendation.exampleZh: 我的老师为我的大学申请写了一封推荐信。

reconcile.example: We must reconcile our different ideas before we make the final plan.
reconcile.exampleZh: 我们必须在制定最终计划前调和彼此不同的想法。

record.example: She broke the world record for the fastest run last year.
record.exampleZh: 她去年打破了最快跑步的世界纪录。

recorder.example: My father gave me a small recorder for my birthday.
recorder.exampleZh: 我父亲在我生日时送了我一台小录音机。

recover.example: It took him two weeks to recover from the bad cold.
recover.exampleZh: 他花了两个星期才从重感冒中康复。

recovery.example: Her recovery after the surgery was slow but steady.
recovery.exampleZh: 她手术后的康复虽然缓慢，但很稳定。

recreation.example: Swimming is a popular recreation for families in summer.
recreation.exampleZh: 游泳是夏天家庭喜爱的消遣活动。

recruit.example: The company plans to recruit ten new workers next month.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月招募十名新员工。

red.example: She bought a red dress for the party last night.
red.exampleZh: 她为昨晚的聚会买了一条红色的连衣裙。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of waste we produce at home.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少家里产生的垃圾量。

reduction.example: The store gave us a small reduction in the price of the coat.
reduction.exampleZh: 商店给我们把那件外套的价格降低了一点。

redundant.example: The last paragraph of his essay is redundant and should be removed.
redundant.exampleZh: 他文章的最后一段是多余的，应该删掉。

refer.example: You can refer to this book when you write your report.
refer.exampleZh: 你写报告时可以查阅这本书。

referee.example: The referee stopped the game when a player fell down.
referee.exampleZh: 一名球员摔倒时，裁判中止了比赛。

reference.example: This book is a useful reference for students learning English.
reference.exampleZh: 这本书是学习英语的学生有用的参考。

reflect.example: The calm lake reflects the trees and the sky very clearly.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面非常清晰地映出了树木和天空。

reflection.example: The calm lake gave a clear reflection of the tall trees.
reflection.exampleZh: 平静的湖面清晰地映出了高树的倒影。

reform.example: The new leader promised to reform the tax system and help small businesses.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人承诺改革税制并帮助小企业。

refrain.example: Please refrain from talking loudly during the exam.
refrain.exampleZh: 考试期间请避免大声说话。

refresh.example: A short walk outside can refresh your mind after a long day.
refresh.exampleZh: 漫长的一天之后，到外面短暂散步能让你的头脑恢复清醒。

refrigerator.example: Please put the milk in the refrigerator before it gets warm.
refrigerator.exampleZh: 请把牛奶放进冰箱，以免它变热。

refuge.example: The old church became a safe refuge for families during the flood.
refuge.exampleZh: 洪水期间，那座古老的教堂成了家庭的安全避难所。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived at the camp with only a few small bags.
refugee.exampleZh: 那家难民只带着几个小包来到了营地。

refund.example: The store gave me a full refund for the broken phone.
refund.exampleZh: 商店为那部坏掉的手机给我全额退款。

refuse.example: I refuse to eat that food because it smells very bad.
refuse.exampleZh: 我拒绝吃那个食物，因为它闻起来很糟。

refute.example: She used clear facts to refute his wrong idea about the plan.
refute.exampleZh: 她用清晰的事实反驳了他关于这个计划的错误想法。

regain.example: After a short rest, she began to regain her strength and confidence.
regain.exampleZh: 短暂休息之后，她开始恢复体力和信心。

regard.example: Many people regard her as a kind and honest leader.
regard.exampleZh: 许多人认为她是一位善良诚实的领导者。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding the new schedule for next week.
regarding.exampleZh: 关于下周的新日程，我有一个问题。

regardless.example: Regardless of the rain, we will go to the park today.
regardless.exampleZh: 不管下不下雨，我们今天都会去公园。

regime.example: The new regime promised to make life better for ordinary people.
regime.exampleZh: 新政权承诺要让普通人的生活变得更好。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and clean rivers.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以茶叶和清澈的河流而闻名。

regional.example: The regional weather is often warm and sunny in spring.
regional.exampleZh: 该地区的天气在春天通常温暖晴朗。

register.example: You must register your name at the front desk before you enter.
register.exampleZh: 你必须在进入前到前台登记你的名字。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to her before she left.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在她离开前没有跟她道别。

regular.example: She takes regular breaks from work to stay healthy and focused.
regular.exampleZh: 她定期从工作中抽身休息，以保持健康和专注。

regularly.example: I regularly walk to work when the weather is nice.
regularly.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我经常步行上班。

regulate.example: The government makes new rules to regulate how much water people use.
regulate.exampleZh: 政府制定了新规定来管理人们的用水量。

regulation.example: The school has strict regulations about using phones during class.
regulation.exampleZh: 学校对上课期间使用手机有严格的规定。

reinforce.example: These new rules will reinforce the team's good habits.
reinforce.exampleZh: 这些新规则将加强团队的良好习惯。

reject.example: The team decided to reject the plan because it cost too much money.
reject.exampleZh: 团队决定驳回这个计划，因为它的花费太高了。

relate.example: These two problems relate to each other in a very clear way.
relate.exampleZh: 这两个问题以非常明显的方式相互关联。

relation.example: My relation with my cousin is very close and happy.
relation.exampleZh: 我和我表弟的关系非常亲密、愉快。

relationship.example: She has a good relationship with her parents.

relative.example: My relatives will visit us this weekend.
relative.exampleZh: 我的亲戚这个周末会来看望我们。

relax.example: After a long week of work, I like to relax with soft music at home.
relax.exampleZh: 工作了一周之后，我喜欢在家听轻音乐放松一下。

release.example: The band will release a new song next week.
release.exampleZh: 乐队下周将发布一首新歌。

relevant.example: This book is very relevant to our class discussion today.
relevant.exampleZh: 这本书与我们今天的课堂讨论非常相关。

relief.example: The medicine gave him some relief from the pain.
relief.exampleZh: 这药让他的疼痛有所缓解。

relieve.example: This medicine can relieve your headache quickly.
relieve.exampleZh: 这种药能很快缓解你的头痛。

religion.example: My grandmother follows her religion with great care every single day.
religion.exampleZh: 我奶奶每天都非常虔诚地遵循她的宗教信仰。

religious.example: Her family is deeply religious and goes to church every Sunday morning.
religious.exampleZh: 她的家人非常虔诚，每个星期天早上都去教堂。

relish.example: She relishes every moment she spends with her family.
relish.exampleZh: 她享受与家人共度的每一刻。

rely.example: You can rely on him to finish the work on time.
rely.exampleZh: 你可以依靠他按时完成这项工作。

remain.example: Only a few old houses remain in this quiet village.
remain.exampleZh: 这个安静的村庄里只剩下几座老房子。

remains.example: The remains of an old stone house stand near the river.
remains.exampleZh: 一座古老石屋的遗迹矗立在河边。

remark.example: She made a kind remark about my new dress.
remark.exampleZh: 她对我的新连衣裙说了句善意的评论。

remarkable.example: She has a remarkable ability to remember every name.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她有一种非凡的能力，能记住每一个名字。

remedy.example: The best remedy for a cold is rest and hot tea.
remedy.exampleZh: 感冒最好的治疗方法是休息和喝热茶。

remember.example: I still remember the first day we met at school.
remember.exampleZh: 我仍然记得我们在学校第一次见面的那天。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tomorrow morning.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我明天早上给妈妈打电话。

reminiscent.example: The old song is reminiscent of my happy school days.
reminiscent.exampleZh: 这首老歌让我想起快乐的求学时光。

remote.example: He lives in a remote village far from the city.
remote.exampleZh: 他住在一个远离城市的偏僻村庄里。

removal.example: The removal of the old tree made the yard much brighter.
removal.exampleZh: 移走那棵老树后，院子变得明亮多了。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you enter the room.

render.example: The new software can render the old files into a modern format.
render.exampleZh: 这款新软件能把旧文件转换成现代格式。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before Friday.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在星期五之前续借我的图书馆书籍。

renewable.example: Wind and solar power are renewable sources of energy.
renewable.exampleZh: 风能和太阳能是可再生能源。

rent.example: We rent a small apartment, and the rent is not too high.
rent.exampleZh: 我们租了一间小公寓，租金不算太高。

repair.example: He tried to repair the old bike, but it was too broken.
repair.exampleZh: 他试着修理那辆旧自行车，但它坏得太严重了。

repay.example: I will repay the money to my friend next week.
repay.exampleZh: 我下周会把钱还给我的朋友。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone can hear it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复这个问题，让大家都能听到。

repeatedly.example: She repeatedly checked her phone during the long meeting this morning.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 今天上午开长会时，她反复查看手机。

repel.example: This spray can repel mosquitoes and keep them away from your skin.
repel.exampleZh: 这种喷雾能驱赶蚊子，让它们远离你的皮肤。

replace.example: The new machine can replace three workers in the small factory.
replace.exampleZh: 这台新机器能取代小工厂里的三名工人。

replacement.example: We need a replacement for the broken chair in the kitchen.
replacement.exampleZh: 我们需要一把新椅子来替换厨房里那把坏的。

reply.example: She did not reply to my email, so I called her.
reply.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

report.example: She wrote a short report about the school trip for the class.
report.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一篇关于学校旅行的简短报告。

reportedly.example: The small shop is reportedly closing next month because sales are very low.
reportedly.exampleZh: 据说这家小店下个月将关门，因为销售额非常低。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the man several questions about the accident.
reporter.exampleZh: 记者就那起事故问了那名男子几个问题。

represent.example: The five stars on the flag represent the five main groups of people.
represent.exampleZh: 旗帜上的五颗星代表五个主要的群体。

representative.example: She is a representative from our school at the city meeting.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们在市里会议上的学校代表。

repression.example: The government's repression of free speech made many people angry.
repression.exampleZh: 政府对言论自由的压制让很多人感到愤怒。

reproduce.example: Many small fish reproduce quickly in warm water.
reproduce.exampleZh: 许多小鱼在温暖的水中繁殖得很快。

republic.example: The country became a republic after the people voted for a new government.
republic.exampleZh: 人民投票选出新政府后，这个国家成为了共和国。

reputation.example: The old teacher has a good reputation at our school.
reputation.exampleZh: 这位老教师在我们学校名声很好。

request.example: She sent a request to the manager for more time.
request.exampleZh: 她向经理请求更多时间。

require.example: Most jobs require you to work well with other people.
require.exampleZh: 大多数工作要求你能与他人良好合作。

requirement.example: Water is a basic requirement for all life on this planet.
requirement.exampleZh: 水是地球上所有生命的基本必需品。

rescue.example: The firemen worked all night to rescue the family from the burning house.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员通宵工作，把那一家人从着火的房子里救了出来。

research.example: She did a lot of research on healthy food before writing her report.
research.exampleZh: 她在写报告之前，对健康食品做了大量研究。

researcher.example: The researcher asked many simple questions and wrote down all the answers.
researcher.exampleZh: 这位研究人员问了许多简单的问题，并记下了所有的回答。

resemblance.example: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
resemblance.exampleZh: 这两姐妹之间有很强的相似之处。

resemble.example: The little boy really resembles his father in both face and voice.
resemble.exampleZh: 这个小男孩在长相和声音上都很像他的父亲。

reservation.example: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant tonight.
reservation.exampleZh: 我预订了今晚餐厅的两个座位。

reserve.example: We reserve a table for two at the restaurant every Friday night.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上都在这家餐馆预订一张两人桌。

reside.example: They reside in a small house near the river.
reside.exampleZh: 他们住在河边的一栋小房子里。

residence.example: Their new residence is a small house near the river.
residence.exampleZh: 他们的新住宅是河边的一栋小房子。

resident.example: The new resident next door is a very friendly young doctor.
resident.exampleZh: 隔壁新来的居民是一位非常友好的年轻医生。

resign.example: He decided to resign from his job after ten long years.
resign.exampleZh: 在漫长的十年之后，他决定辞去这份工作。

resist.example: She could not resist the sweet smell of fresh bread.
resist.exampleZh: 她无法抵挡新鲜面包的香甜气味。

resistance.example: The small town showed strong resistance to the new factory plan.
resistance.exampleZh: 这个小镇对新建工厂的计划表现出强烈的反对。

resolution.example: Her New Year resolution was to read more books this year.
resolution.exampleZh: 她的新年决心是今年多读书。

resolve.example: We must resolve this problem before the meeting starts.
resolve.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前解决这个问题。

resort.example: The small town is a popular resort for families in summer.
resort.exampleZh: 这个小镇是夏天家庭度假的热门胜地。

resource.example: We do not have enough natural resources to waste water like this.
resource.exampleZh: 我们没有足够的自然资源来这样浪费水。

respect.example: We should respect our teachers and listen to them carefully.
respect.exampleZh: 我们应该尊敬老师，认真听他们讲课。

respective.example: After the game, the two teams went back to their respective rooms.
respective.exampleZh: 比赛结束后，两支球队回到了各自的房间。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email, so I called her.
respond.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

response.example: Her quick response to my email surprised me.
response.exampleZh: 她对我邮件的快速回复让我很惊讶。

responsibility.example: It is my responsibility to keep the kitchen clean and safe.
responsibility.exampleZh: 保持厨房干净安全是我的责任。

responsible.example: She is responsible for teaching the new students how to use the library.
responsible.exampleZh: 她负责教新生如何使用图书馆。

rest.example: After the long walk, we sat down to rest under a big tree.
rest.exampleZh: 走了很长一段路后，我们坐在一棵大树下休息。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near our hotel.
restaurant.exampleZh: 我们在酒店附近的一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

restless.example: The children were restless during the long car ride and kept asking when we would arrive.
restless.exampleZh: 长途车程中孩子们坐立不安，一直问我们什么时候到。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old house next year.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们明年会修复这座老房子。

restrain.example: She tried hard to restrain her anger during the meeting.
restrain.exampleZh: 她在会议中努力抑制自己的怒火。

restrict.example: My parents restrict how much time I spend playing video games at home.
restrict.exampleZh: 我父母限制我在家玩电子游戏的时间。

restriction.example: The new restriction on screen time helps children sleep better at night.
restriction.exampleZh: 新的屏幕时间限制有助于孩子们晚上睡得更好。

result.example: Hard work often produces a good result in the end.
result.exampleZh: 努力工作往往最终会产生好的结果。

resume.example: She will resume her work after a short break.
resume.exampleZh: 短暂休息后她将继续工作。

retail.example: She buys clothes at retail prices, but her brother works in retail.
retail.exampleZh: 她按零售价买衣服，但她弟弟在零售行业工作。

retain.example: I still retain many happy memories of my childhood in that small town.
retain.exampleZh: 我仍然保留着在那座小镇度过的童年许多快乐回忆。

retire.example: My father will retire from his job next year and move to the countryside.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲明年将退休，然后搬到乡下去住。

retirement.example: My father plans to travel a lot after his retirement next year.
retirement.exampleZh: 我父亲打算明年退休后经常去旅行。

retort.example: She retorted that his plan would never work.
retort.exampleZh: 她反驳说他的计划永远行不通。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat quickly when the enemy attacked from the left.
retreat.exampleZh: 当敌人从左侧进攻时，士兵们不得不迅速撤退。

return.example: Please return this book to the library by Friday.
return.exampleZh: 请在星期五之前把这本书还给图书馆。

reveal.example: The report revealed serious problems in the local school system.
reveal.exampleZh: 这份报告揭示了当地学校系统中的严重问题。

revenge.example: He waited many years to take revenge on the man who hurt his family.
revenge.exampleZh: 他等了很多年，只为报复那个伤害他家人的人。

revenue.example: The company's revenue grew a lot last year.
revenue.exampleZh: 这家公司去年的营收增长了很多。

reverse.example: The court decided to reverse its earlier decision after new evidence appeared.
reverse.exampleZh: 在新证据出现后，法院决定撤销其先前的判决。

review.example: I will review my notes before the test.
review.exampleZh: 我会在考试前复习我的笔记。

revise.example: I need to revise my essay before I give it to the teacher.
revise.exampleZh: 在把文章交给老师之前，我需要修改一下。

revolution.example: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in how people share information.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网的发明引发了一场人们共享信息方式的革命。

reward.example: She got a small reward for helping the old man find his way home.
reward.exampleZh: 她因为帮助那位老人找到回家的路而得到了一份小小的奖励。

rhythm.example: The drummer kept a steady rhythm while the band played.
rhythm.exampleZh: 乐队演奏时，鼓手保持着稳定的节奏。

rib.example: He fell off his bike and broke a rib.
rib.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来，摔断了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the gift box.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她在礼品盒上系了一条红色丝带。

rice.example: We eat rice with vegetables and fish every day.
rice.exampleZh: 我们每天吃米饭配蔬菜和鱼。

rich.example: This small town is rich in history and has many old buildings.
rich.exampleZh: 这个小镇历史悠久，有许多古老的建筑。

rid.example: He wants to rid his room of old toys today.
rid.exampleZh: 他想今天把他房间里的旧玩具清掉。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every day with my sister.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天和妹妹一起骑自行车去学校。

ridge.example: A narrow path runs along the ridge behind our village.
ridge.exampleZh: 一条狭窄的小路沿着我们村庄后面的山脊延伸。

ridicule.example: His strange idea met with ridicule from the whole class.
ridicule.exampleZh: 他的古怪想法遭到了全班同学的嘲笑。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to wear a winter coat on such a hot day.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 在这么热的天穿冬天的外套真是荒唐。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle before the long march.
rifle.exampleZh: 士兵在长途行军前擦干净了他的步枪。

right.example: You are right, and everyone has the right to choose.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，每个人都有选择的权利。

rigid.example: His rigid rules made the simple game less fun.
rigid.exampleZh: 他那些死板的规则让这个简单的游戏变得没那么有趣了。

ring.example: My phone will ring loudly if you call me after nine.
ring.exampleZh: 如果你九点以后给我打电话，我的手机会大声响铃。

riot.example: The city was quiet again after the riot ended last night.
riot.exampleZh: 昨晚骚乱结束后，城市又恢复了平静。

rip.example: He ripped the paper in half and threw it away.
rip.exampleZh: 他把纸撕成两半，然后扔掉了。

ripe.example: The apples are ripe and ready to be picked this week.
ripe.exampleZh: 苹果已经成熟，这周就可以采摘了。

rise.example: The sun will rise in the east tomorrow morning.
rise.exampleZh: 明天早上太阳会从东方升起。

risk.example: Driving too fast in the rain is a big risk.
risk.exampleZh: 在雨中开得太快是很大的风险。

rival.example: She works hard because her rival is very strong.
rival.exampleZh: 她努力工作，因为她的竞争对手很强。

river.example: The river runs through our small town and many children swim in it.
river.exampleZh: 这条河流经我们的小镇，许多孩子在里面游泳。

road.example: The road to the village is narrow and very bumpy.
road.exampleZh: 通往村庄的这条路又窄又非常颠簸。

roar.example: The old lion began to roar loudly when the strangers came near its cage.
roar.exampleZh: 当陌生人走近笼子时，那头老狮子开始大声吼叫。

roast.example: My mother will roast a chicken for dinner tonight, and the kitchen smells great.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈今晚要烤一只鸡当晚餐，厨房闻起来很香。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the bank early this morning.
rob.exampleZh: 今天一大早，两名男子试图抢劫那家银行。

robot.example: This robot can clean the floor quickly and quietly.
robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人能又快又安静地打扫地板。

robust.example: The old bridge is still robust enough to carry heavy trucks.
robust.exampleZh: 这座老桥依然足够坚固，能承载重型卡车。

rock.example: The children tried to rock the heavy stone, but it would not move.
rock.exampleZh: 孩子们试图摇动那块沉重的石头，但它纹丝不动。

rocket.example: The rocket flew high into the sky and everyone watched it.
rocket.exampleZh: 火箭飞向高空，每个人都看着它。

rod.example: He used a long wooden rod to reach the fruit on the tree.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆去够树上的果子。

role.example: She plays an important role in our team.
role.exampleZh: 她在我们团队中扮演着重要的角色。

roll.example: The ball began to roll slowly down the hill.

romantic.example: He planned a romantic dinner for his wife on their anniversary.
romantic.exampleZh: 他在结婚纪念日为妻子安排了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

roof.example: A bird landed on the roof of our house this morning.
roof.exampleZh: 今天早上，一只鸟落在了我们家房子的屋顶上。

room.example: There is enough room in this room for two beds.
room.exampleZh: 这个房间里放两张床的空间足够。

root.example: The root of the problem is a lack of trust between them.
root.exampleZh: 问题的根源是他们之间缺乏信任。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the dock with a long, thick rope.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根又长又粗的绳子把船拴在码头上。

rose.example: The red rose in the garden smells very sweet.
rose.exampleZh: 花园里的红玫瑰闻起来很香。

rot.example: The old fruit will rot quickly in the hot sun.
rot.exampleZh: 旧水果在烈日下很快就会腐烂。

rotate.example: Please rotate the tires on your car every six months.
rotate.exampleZh: 请每六个月轮换一次你车上的轮胎。

rough.example: My rough plan is to leave early and take the train.
rough.exampleZh: 我的大致计划是早点出发去坐火车。

roughly.example: The trip took roughly three hours by train.
roughly.exampleZh: 坐火车这趟行程大约需要三个小时。

round.example: The children sat in a round circle and sang songs together.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

rouse.example: The loud noise outside his window finally roused him from a deep sleep.
rouse.exampleZh: 窗外的巨大声响终于把他从沉睡中唤醒。

route.example: The quickest route to the station goes past the old market.
route.exampleZh: 去车站最快的路线要经过那个老市场。

routine.example: My morning routine helps me start the day with energy.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨日常安排帮助我充满活力地开始新的一天。

row.example: They sat in the front row and watched the boats row across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 他们坐在前排，看着船只划过湖面。

royal.example: The royal family lives in a large palace in the city.
royal.exampleZh: 王室家族住在城里一座很大的宫殿里。

rub.example: She rubbed her hands together to keep them warm in the cold wind.

rubber.example: The teacher used a rubber to erase the wrong answer on the paper.
rubber.exampleZh: 老师用橡皮擦掉了纸上错误的答案。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet place.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的场所大声打电话是不礼貌的。

rug.example: There is a soft rug on the floor in my room.
rug.exampleZh: 我房间的地板上有一块柔软的小地毯。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic, so we went home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐，所以我们早早回家了。

rule.example: The teacher explained the new rule to the class before the test.
rule.exampleZh: 老师在考试前向全班解释了新规则。

ruler.example: The ruler of this small country lives in a big old house.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国家的统治者住在一座古老的大房子里。

run.example: She runs a small shop and the business is running well.
run.exampleZh: 她经营着一家小店，生意运转得不错。

rural.example: Life in rural areas is often quieter and slower than in the city.
rural.exampleZh: 农村地区的生活往往比城市里更安静、更缓慢。

rush.example: I had to rush to catch the train this morning.
rush.exampleZh: 今天早上我不得不赶着去搭火车。

rust.example: The old gate has a lot of rust on it.
rust.exampleZh: 这扇旧大门上有很多锈。

sabotage.example: Someone tried to sabotage the plan by giving us false information.
sabotage.exampleZh: 有人试图通过给我们假信息来蓄意破坏这个计划。

sack.example: The workers put the potatoes in a large sack and carried it outside.
sack.exampleZh: 工人们把土豆装进一个大麻袋里，然后把它搬到外面。

sacred.example: The old temple is a sacred place for many people.
sacred.exampleZh: 这座古老的寺庙对许多人来说是一个神圣的地方。

sacredly.example: The old song was sacredly passed down from mother to daughter.
sacredly.exampleZh: 这首古老的歌被母亲神圣地传给了女儿。

sacrifice.example: Many parents sacrifice their free time to help their children learn.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 许多父母牺牲自己的空闲时间来帮助孩子学习。

sad.example: The sad movie made my little sister cry all night.
sad.exampleZh: 那部悲伤的电影让我妹妹哭了一整晚。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode away.
saddle.exampleZh: 他把马鞍放在马上，然后骑马走了。

safari.example: We went on a safari in Africa and saw many wild animals.
safari.exampleZh: 我们去非洲进行了一次野生动物园探险，看到了许多野生动物。

safe.example: Keep your money and passport in the hotel safe.
safe.exampleZh: 把你的钱和护照放在酒店的保险箱里。

safeguard.example: We must safeguard the children's personal data when they use the internet.
safeguard.exampleZh: 孩子们上网时，我们必须保护他们的个人数据。

saga.example: My grandmother told us a long saga about her family.
saga.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我们讲了一个关于她家族的长篇故事。

sail.example: We sail across the lake every summer with our small boat.
sail.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都乘小船在湖上航行。

sailor.example: The old sailor told us many stories about the sea.
sailor.exampleZh: 那位老水手给我们讲了许多关于大海的故事。

saint.example: My grandmother was a saint who always helped people in need.
saint.exampleZh: 我的祖母是一位圣人，总是帮助有需要的人。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, please stop smoking and rest more.
sake.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，请戒烟并多休息。

salad.example: I like to eat a fresh salad with tomatoes and lettuce for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 我午饭喜欢吃有西红柿和生菜的新鲜沙拉。

salary.example: My new job offers a good salary and a short commute.
salary.exampleZh: 我的新工作薪水不错，通勤距离也短。

sale.example: The store has a big sale on shoes this weekend.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店这个周末鞋子大促销。

salmon.example: We had fresh salmon for dinner at the restaurant last night.
salmon.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在餐厅吃了新鲜的三文鱼作为晚餐。

salon.example: She goes to a small salon near her home to get her hair cut.
salon.exampleZh: 她去家附近的一家小美发厅剪头发。

salt.example: Too much salt in your food is bad for your health.
salt.exampleZh: 食物中盐分过多对你的健康有害。

salute.example: The soldiers salute the flag every morning before they start their training.
salute.exampleZh: 士兵们每天早上开始训练前都会向国旗敬礼。

same.example: These two shirts are the same color and size.
same.exampleZh: 这两件衬衫的颜色和尺码相同。

sample.example: The lab will sample the water to check if it is safe to drink.
sample.exampleZh: 实验室将对水进行抽样，以检查它是否可以安全饮用。

sanction.example: The government decided to sanction the new trade deal with its neighbors.
sanction.exampleZh: 政府决定批准与邻国的新贸易协议。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand all afternoon.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们整个下午都在温暖的沙滩上玩耍。

sandwich.example: I ate a cheese sandwich for lunch today.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我今天午餐吃了一个奶酪三明治。

sardine.example: We ate bread and canned sardines for lunch by the sea.
sardine.exampleZh: 我们在海边午餐吃了面包和沙丁鱼罐头。

satellite.example: The satellite moves around the earth and sends weather pictures back to us.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星绕地球运行，并把天气图像传回给我们。

satisfaction.example: Her face showed deep satisfaction after she finished the difficult work.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 完成那项困难的工作后，她脸上露出深深的满足。

satisfy.example: A small friendly smile can satisfy even the most difficult customer.
satisfy.exampleZh: 一个友善的微笑就能让最难缠的顾客也感到满意。

saturday.example: We will go to the park this Saturday with our friends.
saturday.exampleZh: 这个星期六我们将和朋友们去公园。

sauce.example: I like to put tomato sauce on my pasta.
sauce.exampleZh: 我喜欢在意大利面上放番茄酱。

sausage.example: My mother likes to cook sausage with eggs for breakfast.
sausage.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢早餐时用鸡蛋炒香肠。

savage.example: The savage dog barked at every stranger who walked past the gate.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对每个经过大门的陌生人狂吠。

save.example: We must save water and money for the long hot summer.
save.exampleZh: 我们必须为漫长炎热的夏天节约水和钱。

say.example: People say this small shop has the best coffee in town.
say.exampleZh: 人们说这家小店有城里最好的咖啡。

scale.example: The scale of the project surprised everyone on the team.
scale.exampleZh: 这个项目的规模让团队里的每个人都感到惊讶。

scan.example: She scanned the page quickly to find the doctor's phone number.
scan.exampleZh: 她快速浏览了页面，以找到医生的电话号码。

scandal.example: The scandal was soon known by everyone in the small town.
scandal.exampleZh: 这桩丑闻很快被小镇上的每个人知道了。

scar.example: The scar on his arm reminds him of that old bike accident.
scar.exampleZh: 他手臂上的伤疤让他想起那次旧自行车事故。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in this dry area, so people save every drop.
scarce.exampleZh: 在这个干旱地区，干净的水很稀缺，所以人们节约每一滴水。

scare.example: The loud noise scared the little dog and it ran away.
scare.exampleZh: 巨大的响声吓到了那只小狗，它跑开了。

scarf.example: She wears a red scarf around her neck in the cold winter.
scarf.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬天，她在脖子上围了一条红色的围巾。

scatter.example: The wind began to scatter the dry leaves across the empty road.
scatter.exampleZh: 风开始把干枯的树叶吹散到空旷的路上。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene a few minutes after the accident.
scene.exampleZh: 事故发生后几分钟，警察赶到了现场。

scenery.example: The scenery along the river is very beautiful in autumn.
scenery.exampleZh: 秋天时，沿河的风景非常美丽。

scent.example: The scent of fresh flowers filled the whole room.
scent.exampleZh: 鲜花的香味充满了整个房间。

schedule.example: I will check my schedule and tell you the time tomorrow.
schedule.exampleZh: 我会查一下日程表，明天告诉你时间。

scheme.example: The police found a secret scheme to steal money from the bank.
scheme.exampleZh: 警方发现了一个从银行偷钱的秘密阴谋。

scholar.example: My father is a famous scholar who studies ancient Chinese history.
scholar.exampleZh: 我父亲是一位研究中国古代历史的著名学者。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study at a good university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得了一笔奖学金，去一所好大学学习。

school.example: My little sister walks to school with her friends every morning.
school.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和朋友们一起步行去学校。

science.example: Science helps us understand the world and solve everyday problems.
science.exampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界并解决日常问题。

scissors.example: I use scissors to cut paper for my art class.
scissors.exampleZh: 我用剪刀为美术课剪纸。

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 我妈妈因为昨晚回家晚了而训斥了我。

score.example: Our team scored twenty points in the last game and won easily.
score.exampleZh: 我们队在最后一场比赛中得了二十分，轻松获胜。

scorn.example: She looked at his poor excuse with scorn and walked away.
scorn.exampleZh: 她轻蔑地看了一眼他拙劣的借口，然后走开了。

scout.example: The scout walked ahead of the group and looked for a safe path.
scout.exampleZh: 侦察员走在小队前面，寻找一条安全的路径。

scratch.example: The cat will scratch the door when it wants to go out.
scratch.exampleZh: 猫想出去的时候会抓门。

scream.example: She screamed loudly when she saw the big spider on the floor.
scream.exampleZh: 她看到地板上的大蜘蛛时大声尖叫起来。

screen.example: The movie looked wonderful on the big screen at the cinema.
screen.exampleZh: 在电影院的大银幕上，这部电影看起来非常精彩。

screw.example: Please screw the cap on the bottle tightly and put it in the fridge.
screw.exampleZh: 请把瓶盖拧紧，然后把瓶子放进冰箱。

script.example: The writer finished the script for the new movie last week.
script.exampleZh: 编剧上周完成了这部新电影的剧本。

scrub.example: I need to scrub the dirty floor before my parents come home.
scrub.exampleZh: 我得在父母回家之前把脏地板刷洗干净。

scrutiny.example: The plan is under close scrutiny by the city council.
scrutiny.exampleZh: 该计划正受到市议会的密切关注。

sculpture.example: The museum has a beautiful sculpture of a horse in front of the door.
sculpture.exampleZh: 博物馆门前有一座漂亮的马雕塑。

sea.example: The sea is calm today, so we can go swimming.
sea.exampleZh: 今天海面很平静，所以我们可以去游泳。

seal.example: The worker will seal the box before it leaves the factory.
seal.exampleZh: 工人在箱子离开工厂前会把它密封好。

search.example: Police searched the whole building but found nothing.
search.exampleZh: 警察搜遍了整栋大楼，但什么也没找到。

season.example: Summer is my favorite season because the days are long and warm.
season.exampleZh: 夏天是我最喜欢的季节，因为白天又长又暖和。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the show begins.

second.example: This is my second cup of coffee, so please wait a moment.
second.exampleZh: 这是我的第二杯咖啡，所以请稍等片刻。

secondary.example: This is a secondary school, and most students here are twelve to fifteen years old.
secondary.exampleZh: 这是一所中学，这里大多数学生年龄在十二到十五岁之间。

secret.example: She kept her secret from everyone for many years.
secret.exampleZh: 她多年来对所有人保守着这个秘密。

secretary.example: My secretary will call you tomorrow morning about the meeting.
secretary.exampleZh: 我的秘书明天上午会打电话给你谈会议的事。

section.example: The first section of the book is easy to read.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的第一部分读起来很容易。

sector.example: The service sector creates many jobs in our city.
sector.exampleZh: 服务部门在我们城市创造了许多就业机会。

secure.example: Our new home is safe and secure for the whole family.
secure.exampleZh: 我们的新家对全家人来说既安全又稳固。

security.example: The airport uses cameras and guards to keep passengers safe and improve security.
security.exampleZh: 机场使用摄像头和警卫来保障乘客安全并提升安保水平。

see.example: I can see the tall trees from my window every morning.
see.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能从窗户看见那些高大的树。

seed.example: Every seed needs water and warm sun to begin growing.
seed.exampleZh: 每一颗种子都需要水和温暖的阳光才能开始生长。

seek.example: We seek a quiet place to study after class.
seek.exampleZh: 我们课后寻找一个安静的地方学习。

seem.example: You seem tired today, so maybe you should go to bed early.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，也许你应该早点睡觉。

segment.example: This segment of the road is closed to all cars today.
segment.exampleZh: 这段路上的这一部分今天对所有汽车封闭。

seize.example: The police seized the man's bag and asked him to stay.
seize.exampleZh: 警察夺过那个人的包，并让他留下。

seldom.example: My brother seldom eats breakfast because he wakes up late.
seldom.exampleZh: 我弟弟很少吃早饭，因为他起床很晚。

select.example: You can select any book you like from this small shelf.
select.exampleZh: 你可以从这个小书架上选择任何你喜欢的书。

self.example: Talking to friends helps me understand my true self better.
self.exampleZh: 和朋友交谈有助于我更好地理解真实的自己。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯和其他孩子分享玩具。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the small shop.
sell.exampleZh: 他们在那家小店里卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: I will study English and math in the new semester.
semester.exampleZh: 我将在新学期学习英语和数学。

seminar.example: I went to a seminar about climate change at my old school last week.
seminar.exampleZh: 上周我去了我的老学校参加一场关于气候变化的研讨会。

senate.example: The senate voted on the new law this morning.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院今天上午对这项新法律进行了投票。

send.example: I will send you the photos by email tonight after dinner.
send.exampleZh: 今晚晚饭后我会通过电子邮件把照片发给你。

senior.example: My senior colleague helped me learn the new computer system.
senior.exampleZh: 我年长的同事帮我学习了新的电脑系统。

sense.example: He has a good sense of humor and often makes us laugh.
sense.exampleZh: 他有很好的幽默感，常常让我们发笑。

sensitive.example: She is very sensitive to cold weather and always wears a warm coat.
sensitive.exampleZh: 她对寒冷的天气很敏感，总是穿着一件暖和的外套。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence him tomorrow morning in the city court.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将在市法院对他宣判。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.
separate.exampleZh: 洗衣服前请把白色衣服和彩色衣服分开。

sequence.example: Please put these numbers in the correct sequence before you start.
sequence.exampleZh: 开始之前，请把这些数字按正确的顺序排列好。

series.example: I watched the whole series last weekend with my family.
series.exampleZh: 上周末我和家人一起看完了整个系列。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must talk about it today.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须今天讨论它。

servant.example: The old servant opened the door and welcomed the guests warmly.
servant.exampleZh: 那位老仆人打开门，热情地迎接客人。

serve.example: These small cafes serve good coffee to students every morning.
serve.exampleZh: 这些小咖啡馆每天早上为学生供应美味的咖啡。

service.example: The bus service in our town runs every ten minutes.
service.exampleZh: 我们镇上的公交服务每十分钟一班。

session.example: The morning session starts at nine and ends at noon.
session.exampleZh: 上午的会议九点开始，中午结束。

set.example: Please set the book on the table and keep the set of keys.
set.exampleZh: 请把书放在桌上，并保管好那套钥匙。

settle.example: They decided to settle in a small town near the sea.
settle.exampleZh: 他们决定在靠近海边的小镇定居。

seven.example: My sister gets up at seven every morning before school.
seven.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上七点起床，然后去上学。

several.example: Several of my friends came to visit me last weekend.
several.exampleZh: 上周末我的几个朋友来看我了。

sew.example: My mother taught me how to sew a button on a shirt.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我怎样把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

sewage.example: The factory was fined for dumping sewage into the river.
sewage.exampleZh: 这家工厂因向河里排放污水而被罚款。

sex.example: Please write your name, age and sex on this form.
sex.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of the big tree and drank cold water.
shade.exampleZh: 我们坐在大树的阴凉处，喝着凉水。

shadow.example: The tall tree casts a long shadow on the grass.
shadow.exampleZh: 那棵高树在草地上投下长长的影子。

shake.example: She shook the bottle before drinking, and her hands began to shake from the cold.
shake.exampleZh: 她喝之前摇了摇瓶子，她的双手因寒冷而开始发抖。

shall.example: Shall we go to the park after lunch today?
shall.exampleZh: 我们今天午饭后去公园好吗？

shallow.example: The water is shallow here, so children can play safely.
shallow.exampleZh: 这里的水很浅，所以孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

shame.example: It is a shame that she felt such shame for a small mistake.
shame.exampleZh: 她因为一个小错误就感到如此羞愧，真是件遗憾的事。

shape.example: The cake has the shape of a heart, and she will shape the dough with her hands.
shape.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕呈心形，她将用手塑造面团。

share.example: I share my lunch with my friend every day at school.
share.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和我的朋友分享我的午餐。

shark.example: A big shark swims fast in the sea and eats small fish.
shark.exampleZh: 一条大鲨鱼在海里游得很快，吃小鱼。

sharp.example: Be careful with that sharp knife on the kitchen table.
sharp.exampleZh: 小心厨房桌子上那把锋利的刀。

shatter.example: The loud noise shattered the quiet morning and shocked everyone in the house.
shatter.exampleZh: 巨大的响声打破了安静的早晨，震惊了屋里的每个人。

shave.example: He shaves every morning before he goes to work.
shave.exampleZh: 他每天早上上班前刮胡子。

she.example: She is my sister and she likes to read books.
she.exampleZh: 她是我的姐姐，她喜欢读书。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small farm.
sheep.exampleZh: 这个农民在他的小农场里养了很多羊。

sheer.example: It was sheer luck that we found the small house.
sheer.exampleZh: 我们找到那所小房子纯属运气。

sheet.example: Please put a clean sheet on the bed before the guests arrive.
sheet.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，请把干净的床单铺在床上。

shelf.example: She put the book back on the top shelf.
shelf.exampleZh: 她把书放回了最上面的架子上。

shell.example: The child picked up a broken shell on the beach.
shell.exampleZh: 那个孩子在沙滩上捡起了一个破碎的贝壳。

shelter.example: The old church gave the family shelter during the storm last night.
shelter.exampleZh: 昨晚暴风雨中，这座古老的教堂为这家人提供了庇护。

shift.example: The workers shift to the night team every two weeks.
shift.exampleZh: 工人们每两周换到夜班。

shine.example: The sun began to shine brightly after the morning rain stopped.
shine.exampleZh: 早晨的雨停后，太阳开始明亮地照耀。

ship.example: They will ship the boxes to our store by boat tomorrow.
ship.exampleZh: 他们明天会用船把箱子运到我们的商店。
