shirt.example: He wears a white shirt to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 他每天穿白衬衫去上班。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind outside the old house.
shiver.exampleZh: 她在老房子外的寒风中开始颤抖。

shock.example: The news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: My new shoes are too small, so I will return them.
shoe.exampleZh: 我的新鞋太小了，所以我要把它们退掉。

shoot.example: He likes to shoot photos of birds in the park.
shoot.exampleZh: 他喜欢在公园里拍摄鸟类的照片。

shop.example: I often shop at the small store near my home.
shop.exampleZh: 我经常在我家附近的小商店购物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and watched the small boats come back.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着小船归来。

short.example: My hair is very short now, so it is easy to wash.
short.exampleZh: 我的头发现在很短，所以洗起来很方便。

shortage.example: There is a serious shortage of clean water in many dry countries.
shortage.exampleZh: 许多干旱国家存在严重的清洁水短缺。

shorthand.example: In our office, shorthand is used to take notes quickly during long meetings.
shorthand.exampleZh: 在我们办公室，速记被用来在漫长会议中快速记笔记。

should.example: You should go to bed early because you have school tomorrow.
should.exampleZh: 你应该早点睡觉，因为你明天要上学。

shoulder.example: He carried the heavy bag on his shoulder and walked home slowly.
shoulder.exampleZh: 他把沉重的包扛在肩上，慢慢走回家。

shout.example: The teacher told the children not to shout in the library.
shout.exampleZh: 老师告诉孩子们不要在图书馆里大声喊叫。

show.example: Please show me the pictures from your trip last week.
show.exampleZh: 请给我看看你上周旅行的照片。

shower.example: She took a quick shower before going to work.
shower.exampleZh: 她上班前快速冲了个澡。

shrewd.example: She is a shrewd businesswoman who always knows how to make a good deal.
shrewd.exampleZh: 她是一位精明的女商人，总是知道如何做成好买卖。

shrimp.example: We had fresh shrimp and rice for dinner last night.
shrimp.exampleZh: 昨晚我们晚餐吃了新鲜的虾和米饭。

shrine.example: Every year many people visit the old shrine on the hill.
shrine.exampleZh: 每年都有很多人来参观山上的那座古老神龛。

shrink.example: The new shirt will shrink if you wash it in hot water.
shrink.exampleZh: 这件新衬衫如果用热水洗会缩水。

shrug.example: She shrugs when I ask her about the plan.
shrug.exampleZh: 当我问她这个计划时，她耸了耸肩。

shut.example: Please shut the door quietly when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 离开房间时请轻轻关上门。

shutter.example: She closed the shutters to keep the hot afternoon sun out of the room.
shutter.exampleZh: 她关上百叶窗，挡住午后炎热的阳光，不让它照进房间。

shuttle.example: A free shuttle takes hotel guests to the airport every morning.
shuttle.exampleZh: 每天早晨有一辆免费班车送酒店客人去机场。

shy.example: The shy boy stood quietly behind his mother and did not say a word.
shy.exampleZh: 那个害羞的男孩安静地站在妈妈身后，一句话也没说。

sick.example: My little brother is sick today, so he cannot go to school.
sick.exampleZh: 我弟弟今天生病了，所以他不能去上学。

side.example: Please write your name on the left side of the page.
side.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面的左侧。

sideways.example: He turned his head sideways to look at the screen.
sideways.exampleZh: 他把头转向侧面去看屏幕。

siege.example: The old city was under siege for three long months.
siege.exampleZh: 这座古城被围困了整整三个月。

sieve.example: Pour the sand through a sieve to remove the small stones.
sieve.exampleZh: 把沙子倒进筛子里，去掉小石子。

sigh.example: She gave a deep sigh and closed the book slowly.
sigh.exampleZh: 她深深叹了口气，慢慢合上了书。

sight.example: After the long flight, I lost my sight for a moment in the bright sun.
sight.exampleZh: 长途飞行后，在明亮的阳光下我一时看不见东西。

sign.example: There is a sign on the door that says the shop is closed.
sign.exampleZh: 门上有一个标志，写着商店已关门。

signal.example: The red light is a signal to stop your car.

significance.example: The teacher explained the significance of the old letter.
significance.exampleZh: 老师解释了这封旧信的重要意义。

signpost.example: The signpost at the corner shows the way to the train station.
signpost.exampleZh: 街角的路标指明了去火车站的方向。

silence.example: The room was filled with a deep silence after the music stopped.
silence.exampleZh: 音乐停止后，房间里弥漫着深深的寂静。

silicon.example: This computer chip is made from silicon and other common materials.
silicon.exampleZh: 这块电脑芯片由硅和其他常见材料制成。

silly.example: It was silly of me to forget my keys again.
silly.exampleZh: 我又忘了带钥匙，真是愚蠢。

silver.example: She keeps her silver in a small box by the bed.
silver.exampleZh: 她把银器放在床边的一个小盒子里。

similar.example: My new bag is very similar to yours.
similar.exampleZh: 我的新包和你的非常相似。

simmer.example: The soup needs to simmer on the stove for twenty more minutes.
simmer.exampleZh: 这汤需要在炉子上再煨二十分钟。

simple.example: The rules of this game are simple, so everyone can learn them quickly.
simple.exampleZh: 这个游戏的规则很简单，所以每个人都能很快学会。

simulate.example: This computer program can simulate the weather in our city.
simulate.exampleZh: 这个电脑程序可以模拟我们城市的天气。

since.example: I have not seen him since he moved to another city last year.
since.exampleZh: 自从他去年搬到另一个城市后，我就没见过他。

sincere.example: She gave me a sincere smile and thanked me for my help.
sincere.exampleZh: 她给了我一个真诚的微笑，并感谢我的帮助。

sing.example: She likes to sing her favorite songs in the shower every morning.
sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上在淋浴时唱她最喜欢的歌。

singe.example: Be careful with the hot iron, or it will singe your shirt.
singe.exampleZh: 小心那个滚烫的熨斗，否则它会烫焦你的衬衫。

single.example: He is still single and lives alone in a small apartment.
single.exampleZh: 他仍然单身，独自住在一间小公寓里。

sink.example: The old boat began to sink slowly into the cold dark water.
sink.exampleZh: 那条旧船开始慢慢沉入冰冷黑暗的水中。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me where the train station is?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我火车站在哪里吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我和我姐姐每天早上一起步行去学校。

sit.example: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐下，等待叫到你的名字。

site.example: The site of the new school is near the river.
site.exampleZh: 新学校的地点靠近河边。

situated.example: The small hotel is situated near the river and the old bridge.
situated.exampleZh: 这家小旅馆位于河边和那座老桥附近。

situation.example: The situation in the small town is getting better every year.
situation.exampleZh: 这个小镇的情况一年比一年好。

six.example: My little sister is six years old and she starts school this year.
six.exampleZh: 我妹妹六岁了，她今年开始上学。

size.example: What size shoes do you wear?

skate.example: I like to skate on the ice with my friends in winter.
skate.exampleZh: 冬天我喜欢和朋友们在冰上滑冰。

skeptical.example: My parents are skeptical about my plan to travel alone.
skeptical.exampleZh: 我父母对我独自旅行的计划持怀疑态度。

sketch.example: He made a quick sketch of the old house before lunch.
sketch.exampleZh: 他在午饭前画了一幅那座老房子的速写。

ski.example: Every winter my family goes to the mountains to ski for a week.
ski.exampleZh: 每年冬天我们全家都会去山里滑雪一个星期。

skill.example: She learned a new skill in just a few weeks.
skill.exampleZh: 她只用了几周就学会了一项新技能。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker and can fix many old machines.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，能修好许多旧机器。

skim.example: I only skim the newspaper each morning before work.
skim.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前只是略读一下报纸。

skin.example: The baby's skin is very soft and warm.
skin.exampleZh: 这个婴儿的皮肤非常柔软温暖。

skip.example: The children skip happily in the park and sometimes skip their homework.
skip.exampleZh: 孩子们在公园里快乐地蹦跳，有时还会跳过作业。

skirt.example: She wore a long blue skirt to the party last night.
skirt.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条蓝色的长裙去参加聚会。

skull.example: The doctor pointed to a crack in the skull on the X-ray.
skull.exampleZh: 医生指着X光片上头骨的一处裂缝。

slab.example: The workers placed a heavy slab of stone on the ground.
slab.exampleZh: 工人们把一块沉重的石板放在地上。

slam.example: She slammed the door and walked away without saying a word.
slam.exampleZh: 她砰地关上门，一言不发地走了。

slap.example: She got angry and slapped him across the face.
slap.exampleZh: 她生气了，扇了他一记耳光。

slash.example: The company will slash its budget next year and cut many jobs.
slash.exampleZh: 公司明年将大幅削减预算，并裁掉许多工作岗位。

slaughter.example: The soldiers were ordered to stop the slaughter of innocent people in the village.
slaughter.exampleZh: 士兵们奉命停止对村中无辜民众的屠杀。

slave.example: The slaves worked all day in the fields without any rest.
slave.exampleZh: 奴隶们在田里干了一整天活，没有任何休息。

sleep.example: I usually sleep for eight hours every night after a long day.
sleep.exampleZh: 在漫长的一天之后，我通常每晚睡八个小时。

slice.example: She cut a thin slice of cake for each child at the party.
slice.exampleZh: 她在聚会上给每个孩子切了一片薄薄的蛋糕。

slide.example: The children like to slide down the long slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢从公园里长长的滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: There is a slight difference between the two answers.
slight.exampleZh: 这两个答案之间有轻微的差别。

slim.example: The slim young man ran quickly to catch the early bus.
slim.exampleZh: 那个苗条的年轻人快速跑去赶早班公交车。

sling.example: He put his arm in a sling after the fall.
sling.exampleZh: 摔倒后他把手臂吊在吊带里。

slip.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the door.
slip.exampleZh: 小心别在门附近的湿滑地板上滑倒。

slope.example: The children ran down the grassy slope behind the house.
slope.exampleZh: 孩子们从屋后的草坡上跑了下来。

slot.example: Put the coin into the slot and press the green button.
slot.exampleZh: 把硬币放进投币口，然后按下绿色按钮。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, so we walk to school.
slow.exampleZh: 这辆旧公共汽车很慢，所以我们走路去学校。

slum.example: Many poor families live in a crowded slum near the river.
slum.exampleZh: 许多贫困家庭住在河边一个拥挤的贫民窟里。

slump.example: The company's sales began to slump after the new tax policy.
slump.exampleZh: 新税收政策出台后，公司的销售额开始暴跌。

small.example: This small bag is easy to carry in one hand.
small.exampleZh: 这个小包很容易用一只手拿着。

smart.example: She is smart and always finds quick answers to hard problems.
smart.exampleZh: 她很聪明，总能很快找到难题的答案。

smash.example: The boy smashed the old box with a heavy stick.
smash.exampleZh: 男孩用一根重棍子把旧盒子砸碎了。

smell.example: I can smell the fresh bread in the kitchen.
smell.exampleZh: 我能闻到厨房里新鲜面包的气味。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said hello to everyone here.
smile.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑，并向这里的每个人问好。

smog.example: The thick smog over the city made it hard to breathe.
smog.exampleZh: 城市上空的浓重雾霾让人难以呼吸。

smoke.example: The smoke from the fire made everyone cough and leave the room quickly.
smoke.exampleZh: 火产生的烟让每个人都咳嗽，并迅速离开了房间。

smooth.example: The road is smooth and the car runs very well.
smooth.exampleZh: 这条路很平坦，汽车行驶得很好。

smother.example: She tried to smother the fire with a wet blanket.
smother.exampleZh: 她试着用一条湿毯子把火闷灭。

snack.example: I often have a small snack after school before I do my homework.
snack.exampleZh: 我放学后常常先吃点小吃，然后再做作业。

snail.example: The snail moves very slowly across the wet garden path.
snail.exampleZh: 这只蜗牛在潮湿的花园小路上移动得很慢。

snake.example: The snake moved quietly through the tall grass near the river.
snake.exampleZh: 那条蛇悄悄穿过河边的高草。

snap.example: He tried to snap the dry branch, and it broke easily.
snap.exampleZh: 他试着啪地折断那根干树枝，它很容易就断了。

snatch.example: The thief tried to snatch her bag and ran away quickly.
snatch.exampleZh: 小偷试图抢走她的包，然后迅速跑掉了。

sneak.example: He tried to sneak into the room without waking anyone.
sneak.exampleZh: 他试图不吵醒任何人地偷偷溜进房间。

sniff.example: The dog likes to sniff every tree on our morning walk.
sniff.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢在我们早晨散步时闻每一棵树。

snore.example: My father snores loudly every night and wakes up the whole family.
snore.exampleZh: 我爸爸每天晚上都打呼噜很大声，把全家人都吵醒了。

snow.example: When it snows, the children like to play in the soft white snow.
snow.exampleZh: 下雪时，孩子们喜欢在柔软的白雪里玩耍。

so.example: It is so cold today that we stay inside and drink hot tea.
so.exampleZh: 今天太冷了，所以我们待在家里喝热茶。

soak.example: She likes to soak her feet in warm water after a long day.
soak.exampleZh: 她喜欢在漫长的一天之后用温水泡脚。

soap.example: She washes her hands with soap and warm water every morning.
soap.exampleZh: 她每天早上用肥皂和温水洗手。

soar.example: The eagle soared high above the mountains in the clear blue sky.
soar.exampleZh: 那只鹰在晴朗的蓝天上高高地翱翔于群山之上。

sob.example: She began to sob quietly when she heard the sad news.
sob.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，她开始轻声啜泣。

soccer.example: My brother plays soccer with his friends every Saturday morning.
soccer.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六早上都和他的朋友们踢足球。

social.example: Social media helps people stay in touch with friends and family.
social.exampleZh: 社交媒体帮助人们与朋友和家人保持联系。

society.example: Every society needs rules to keep people safe and happy.
society.exampleZh: 每个社会都需要规则来保障人们的安全与幸福。

sociology.example: She studies sociology at a small university near her home.
sociology.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习社会学。

sock.example: He put a clean sock on his left foot this morning.
sock.exampleZh: 今天早上他把一只干净的袜子穿在左脚上。

soda.example: I drink a cold glass of soda with my lunch every day.
soda.exampleZh: 我每天午饭时都会喝一杯冰镇汽水。

sofa.example: We bought a new sofa for the living room last week.
sofa.exampleZh: 上周我们为客厅买了一张新沙发。

soft.example: Her voice was soft and gentle when she spoke to the child.
soft.exampleZh: 她对孩子说话时，声音又柔和又温柔。

software.example: The new software helps students finish their homework faster and more easily.
software.exampleZh: 这款新软件帮助学生更快、更轻松地完成作业。

soil.example: The soil in our garden is rich and good for growing vegetables.
soil.exampleZh: 我们花园里的土壤很肥沃，适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: Solar energy can turn sunlight into clean power for our homes.
solar.exampleZh: 太阳能可以把阳光转化为我们家里使用的清洁电力。

soldier.example: The young soldier wrote a letter to his family every week.
soldier.exampleZh: 那位年轻的士兵每周都给家人写一封信。

sole.example: The sole of my left shoe is very thin and needs repair.
sole.exampleZh: 我左脚鞋子的鞋底很薄，需要修补。

solid.example: The ice was solid and we could walk on it safely.
solid.exampleZh: 冰面很坚实，我们可以安全地在上面行走。

solution.example: We finally found a simple solution to this difficult problem.
solution.exampleZh: 我们终于为这个难题找到了一个简单的解决办法。

solve.example: Can you help me solve this math problem before the class starts?
solve.exampleZh: 你能在开始上课前帮我解出这道数学题吗？

some.example: Some of my friends like to play football after school.
some.exampleZh: 我的一些朋友喜欢放学后踢足球。

somebody.example: Somebody left an umbrella on the chair in the hall.
somebody.exampleZh: 有人把一把伞落在走廊的椅子上了。

somehow.example: Somehow, the little boy found his way home in the dark.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，那个小男孩在黑暗中找到了回家的路。

someone.example: Someone left a small bag on the table this morning.
someone.exampleZh: 今天早上有人把一个小包落在了桌子上。

something.example: There is something strange about the sound coming from the old house.
something.exampleZh: 老房子里传来的声音有些奇怪。

sometime.example: I will visit my grandparents sometime next week after the rain stops.
sometime.exampleZh: 下周某个时候雨停后我会去看望我的祖父母。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时会走路去学校。

somewhat.example: The test was somewhat difficult, but I finished it on time.
somewhat.exampleZh: 这次考试有点难，但我按时做完了。

somewhere.example: I left my keys somewhere in the house this morning.
somewhere.exampleZh: 今天早上我把钥匙落在房子里的某个地方了。

son.example: Their son is only five years old and he loves to play football.
son.exampleZh: 他们的儿子只有五岁，他喜欢踢足球。

song.example: The birds sing a happy song every morning outside my window.
song.exampleZh: 每天早晨鸟儿在我窗外唱着欢快的歌。

soon.example: We will see you again soon.
soon.exampleZh: 我们不久就会再见到你。

sophisticated.example: This is a sophisticated machine that can solve many hard problems.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 这是一台精密复杂的机器，能解决许多难题。

sore.example: My throat is sore, and my legs are sore from running.
sore.exampleZh: 我的喉咙疼，而且跑步后我的腿也酸痛。

sorry.example: I am sorry that I forgot your birthday yesterday.
sorry.exampleZh: 很抱歉，我昨天忘记了你的生日。

sort.example: This sort of book is easy to read and good for beginners.
sort.exampleZh: 这种书容易读，适合初学者。

soul.example: Music can touch your soul in ways that words cannot.
soul.exampleZh: 音乐能以言语无法做到的方式触动你的灵魂。

sound.example: The sound of the rain made the children feel calm and sleepy.
sound.exampleZh: 雨声让孩子们感到平静又困倦。

soup.example: My mother makes hot soup for us on cold winter evenings.
soup.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬夜，妈妈会给我们做热汤。

source.example: The reporter refused to name the source of the story.
source.exampleZh: 记者拒绝透露这条消息的来源。

south.example: My uncle lives in the south of the city near a big lake.
south.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在城市南部的一个大湖附近。

space.example: There is not enough space in this room for a big table.
space.exampleZh: 这个房间里没有足够的空间放一张大桌子。

spacious.example: The new living room is spacious and full of light.
spacious.exampleZh: 新客厅很宽敞，光线充足。

spade.example: He used a spade to dig a hole in the garden.
spade.exampleZh: 他用一把铲子在花园里挖了一个洞。

span.example: The bridge has a span of about two hundred meters.
span.exampleZh: 这座桥的跨度约为两百米。

spare.example: Can you spare a few minutes to help me with this?
spare.exampleZh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我做这个吗？

spark.example: A small spark from the fire started the dry grass burning.
spark.exampleZh: 火中迸出的一颗小火星引燃了干草。

speak.example: She can speak three languages very well.
speak.exampleZh: 她能非常好地说三种语言。

special.example: Today is a special day for my whole family.
special.exampleZh: 今天对我全家来说是一个特殊的日子。

species.example: This species of bird lives only on this small island.
species.exampleZh: 这种鸟只生活在这座小岛上。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example of how this works.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个关于这如何运作的具体例子。

speech.example: Her speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲简短但非常清晰。

speed.example: The car was moving at a very high speed on the highway.
speed.exampleZh: 那辆车在高速公路上以非常快的速度行驶。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me, please?
spell.exampleZh: 你能为我拼写一下你的姓吗？

spend.example: I spend about an hour reading English books every evening.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚上花大约一小时读英语书。

spin.example: The children love to spin around in the garden until they feel dizzy.
spin.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里转圈，直到感到头晕。

spine.example: The old book's spine was broken, so the pages fell out.
spine.exampleZh: 那本旧书的书脊坏了，所以书页都掉出来了。

spirit.example: Her spirit stayed strong even during the hardest days of the journey.
spirit.exampleZh: 即使在旅途中最艰难的日子里，她的精神依然坚强。

spite.example: She said those words out of spite, not because she meant them.
spite.exampleZh: 她说那些话是出于恶意，而不是因为真心。

split.example: The group split into two teams after a long and angry argument.
split.exampleZh: 经过一场漫长而愤怒的争论，这个小组分裂成了两个队。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
spoil.exampleZh: 雨水过多会在我们采摘之前就让水果腐烂。

spokesman.example: The company spokesman told reporters that the new factory would open next month.
spokesman.exampleZh: 公司发言人告诉记者，新工厂将于下个月开业。

sponge.example: He cleaned the dirty dishes with a wet sponge and some soap.
sponge.exampleZh: 他用一块湿海绵和一些肥皂清洗了脏盘子。

sponsor.example: The company will sponsor the school team and buy new shirts for the players.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家公司将赞助校队，并为队员们购买新球衣。

spoon.example: Please give me a clean spoon for my hot soup.
spoon.exampleZh: 请给我一把干净的勺子来喝热汤。

sport.example: Basketball is my favorite sport, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 篮球是我最喜欢的运动，我每个周末都和朋友一起打。

spot.example: I found a small spot on my shirt, but I could not recognize what it was.
spot.exampleZh: 我发现在我的衬衫上有一个小斑点，但我认不出它是什么。

spray.example: She sprayed water on the flowers in the garden.
spray.exampleZh: 她在花园里给花喷了水。

spread.example: The news spread quickly through the small village last night.
spread.exampleZh: 昨晚这个消息在小村庄里迅速传播开来。

spring.example: In spring, the kids like to jump on the old spring bed.
spring.exampleZh: 春天里，孩子们喜欢在旧弹簧床上跳。

spur.example: Her kind words spurred me on to keep trying.
spur.exampleZh: 她亲切的话语激励我继续尝试。

spy.example: The spy watched the old house from a dark car across the street.
spy.exampleZh: 那名间谍在街对面的一辆深色汽车里监视那栋老房子。

square.example: The old square is a good place for children to play.
square.exampleZh: 这个旧广场是孩子们玩耍的好地方。

squeeze.example: She had to squeeze the lemon to get a few drops of juice.
squeeze.exampleZh: 她不得不挤压柠檬，才挤出几滴汁来。

squirrel.example: A small squirrel ran up the tree and hid behind the leaves.
squirrel.exampleZh: 一只小松鼠跑上树，躲在了树叶后面。

stab.example: He stabbed the meat with a fork to see if it was cooked.
stab.exampleZh: 他用叉子戳了一下肉，看是否煮熟了。

stable.example: The old horse sleeps in a warm stable every night.
stable.exampleZh: 那匹老马每晚都睡在一间温暖的马厩里。

stack.example: Please stack the books on the desk before you leave.
stack.exampleZh: 请在离开前把书堆在桌子上。

staff.example: The hotel staff were very kind to us during our stay.
staff.exampleZh: 在我们入住期间，酒店员工对我们非常友善。

stage.example: She is still at an early stage of learning English.
stage.exampleZh: 她仍处于学习英语的早期阶段。

stain.example: The red wine left a dark stain on the white tablecloth.
stain.exampleZh: 红酒在白桌布上留下了一块深色污渍。

stair.example: The old man walked slowly up the stairs to his small room.
stair.exampleZh: 那位老人慢慢地走上楼梯，回到他的小房间。

stamp.example: He put a stamp on the letter and mailed it yesterday.
stamp.exampleZh: 他给信贴上邮票，昨天寄了出去。

stand.example: I can't stand the noise here, so let's stand outside the stand.
stand.exampleZh: 我受不了这里的噪音，所以让我们站到看台外面吧。

standard.example: The food in this small restaurant meets a very high standard.
standard.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆的食物达到了很高的标准。

star.example: The brightest star in the sky appeared just after sunset.
star.exampleZh: 天空中最亮的那颗星在日落之后刚刚出现。

stare.example: She stared at the painting for a long time.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那幅画看了很久。

start.example: We will start the meeting at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
start.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点开始会议。

startle.example: The loud noise outside the window startled the sleeping baby awake.
startle.exampleZh: 窗外巨大的响声把正在睡觉的婴儿吓得醒了过来。

starve.example: Many poor children still starve because they do not have enough food.
starve.exampleZh: 许多贫困儿童仍然挨饿，因为他们没有足够的食物。

state.example: Please state your name and address clearly for the official record.
state.exampleZh: 请清楚陈述你的姓名和地址，以便正式记录。

statement.example: The company's official statement explains why prices went up last month.
statement.exampleZh: 公司的官方声明解释了上个月价格上涨的原因。

statesman.example: The old statesman gave a short speech about peace and the future.
statesman.exampleZh: 这位年长的政治家就和平与未来作了简短的演讲。

static.example: The lake water looks static and never moves, even on windy days.
static.exampleZh: 湖水看起来是静止的，即使在有风的日子也从不流动。

station.example: We met at the train station near my house.
station.exampleZh: 我们在我家附近的火车站见面。

statistic.example: One statistic shows that most students walk to school every day.
statistic.exampleZh: 一项统计数值显示，大多数学生每天步行上学。

statistics.example: The teacher showed us statistics about how many students walk to school.
statistics.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了关于多少学生步行上学的统计数据。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue in the middle of the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园中央有一座大石雕像。

status.example: His status in the company has grown quickly this year.
status.exampleZh: 他在公司的地位今年提升得很快。

stay.example: I want to stay at home and read a book this evening.
stay.exampleZh: 今晚我想待在家里读一本书。

steady.example: Her steady hand kept the small boat moving straight across the lake.
steady.exampleZh: 她稳健的手让小船笔直地穿过湖面。

steak.example: My father likes to eat steak with potatoes for dinner.
steak.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢晚餐吃牛排配土豆。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bike outside the shop yesterday.
steal.exampleZh: 昨天有人在商店外面试图偷走我的自行车。

steam.example: Heat the water until steam rises from the pot.
steam.exampleZh: 把水加热，直到锅里冒出蒸汽。

steel.example: The bridge is made of strong steel and can hold heavy trucks.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢铁制成，能够承受重型卡车。

steep.example: The steep hill is hard to climb in winter.
steep.exampleZh: 这座陡峭的小山在冬天很难爬。

steer.example: She steered the small boat carefully around the rocks.
steer.exampleZh: 她小心地驾驶小船绕过岩石。

stem.example: The stem of this plant is strong and tall.
stem.exampleZh: 这株植物的茎又粗壮又高。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop at the door.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后在门口停下。

stereotype.example: People often have a stereotype about people from small towns.
stereotype.exampleZh: 人们常常对来自小镇的人抱有刻板印象。

stick.example: He used a stick to reach the ball stuck under the car.
stick.exampleZh: 他用一根棍子去够卡在车底下的球。

sticky.example: The weather is hot and sticky, so I want a cold drink.
sticky.exampleZh: 天气又热又闷，我想喝一杯冷饮。

stiff.example: My neck feels stiff after I sleep on the hard sofa.
stiff.exampleZh: 我睡在硬沙发上之后脖子感觉很僵硬。

still.example: She is still waiting for the bus in the quiet street.
still.exampleZh: 她仍然在寂静的街道上等公共汽车。

stimulate.example: These new games can stimulate children to think and learn faster.
stimulate.exampleZh: 这些新游戏能激发孩子们更快地思考和学‌习。

sting.example: A bee may sting you if you get too close to its hive.
sting.exampleZh: 如果你太靠近蜂巢，蜜蜂可能会蛰你。

stir.example: Please stir the soup slowly before you serve it.
stir.exampleZh: 上桌前请慢慢搅拌一下汤。

stock.example: The store has a large stock of winter coats.
stock.exampleZh: 这家商店有大量冬季外套的库存。

stomach.example: My stomach feels strange after I ate too much cold food.
stomach.exampleZh: 我吃了太多冷食后，胃感觉不舒服。

stone.example: The old stone wall stands at the back of our garden.
stone.exampleZh: 那道古老的石墙立在我们花园的后面。

stoop.example: She had to stoop to pick up the small toy from the floor.
stoop.exampleZh: 她不得不弯下腰，从地板上捡起那个小玩具。

stop.example: The bus stopped at the station so we could get off.
stop.exampleZh: 公交车在车站停下，好让我们下车。

storage.example: We keep our old books in storage under the stairs.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把旧书存放在楼梯下面的储藏室里。

store.example: Every winter we store our summer clothes in boxes under the bed.
store.exampleZh: 每年冬天，我们都把夏天穿的衣服收进床底的箱子里。

storm.example: The storm broke several windows and blew down a big tree.
storm.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨打破了几扇窗户，还吹倒了一棵大树。

story.example: Grandpa tells me a funny story before I go to bed.
story.exampleZh: 爷爷在我上床睡觉前给我讲一个有趣的故事。

stove.example: She put the soup on the stove and waited for it to boil.
stove.exampleZh: 她把汤放在炉子上，等着它烧开。

straight.example: Go straight down this street and you will see the bank.
straight.exampleZh: 沿着这条街直走，你就会看到那家银行。

strain.example: The long hours at work put a real strain on his health.
strain.exampleZh: 长时间工作给他的健康带来了真正的负担。

strange.example: It is strange that nobody answered the phone all morning.
strange.exampleZh: 整个上午没人接电话，这很奇怪。

strap.example: He pulled the strap of his bag over his shoulder and walked out.
strap.exampleZh: 他把书包的带子拉到肩上，然后走了出去。

strategic.example: The team made a strategic plan to win the game next week.
strategic.exampleZh: 团队制定了战略计划，以赢得下周的比赛。

strategy.example: Our team needs a new strategy to win the next game.
strategy.exampleZh: 我们队需要一个新的策略来赢得下一场比赛。

straw.example: The farmer put dry straw on the floor of the barn.
straw.exampleZh: 农民把干稻草铺在谷仓的地上。

stream.example: A small stream runs behind our house and never dries up.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们家后面流过，从不干涸。

street.example: The children are playing a game on our quiet street.
street.exampleZh: 孩子们在我们安静的街道上玩游戏。

strength.example: Her greatest strength is her patience with young children.
strength.exampleZh: 她最大的优势是对小孩子的耐心。

stress.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep at night.
stress.exampleZh: 压力太大会让人晚上难以入睡。

stretch.example: I stretch my arms every morning before I go to work.
stretch.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会伸展一下手臂。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and always checks every answer.
strict.exampleZh: 我们老师对作业要求很严格，总是检查每一道答案。

strike.example: The workers went on strike because they wanted better pay.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们举行了罢工，因为他们想要更高的工资。

string.example: The boy tied the old box with a long piece of string.
string.exampleZh: 男孩用一根长绳子把旧箱子捆了起来。

strip.example: She had to strip the old paint off the wooden door.
strip.exampleZh: 她不得不把木门上的旧油漆剥掉。

stripe.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but is healthy now.
stroke.exampleZh: 我祖父去年中风了，但现在很健康。

stroll.example: Every evening after dinner, my parents stroll along the river near our home.
stroll.exampleZh: 每天晚饭后，我父母都会沿着家附近的河边散步。

strong.example: He is strong enough to carry that heavy box upstairs.
strong.exampleZh: 他足够强壮，能把那个沉重的箱子搬上楼。

structure.example: The structure of the old building is very strong and simple.
structure.exampleZh: 这座旧建筑的结构非常坚固而且简单。

struggle.example: She had to struggle hard to finish the work on time.
struggle.exampleZh: 她不得不努力奋斗才按时完成工作。

student.example: The student asked her teacher a question after class.
student.exampleZh: 这名学生下课后问了老师一个问题。

studio.example: She records her songs in a small studio near her home.
studio.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一间小录音室里录歌。

study.example: I study English for an hour in my small study every evening.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在我的小书房里学一个小时英语。

stuff.example: My room is full of old stuff I never use.
stuff.exampleZh: 我的房间里塞满了我从来不用的旧东西。

stumble.example: She stumbled on the wet stairs but quickly caught her balance.
stumble.exampleZh: 她在湿漉漉的楼梯上绊了一下，但很快稳住了身体。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to forget my keys at home.
stupid.exampleZh: 我把钥匙忘在家里了，真是愚蠢。

style.example: Her style is simple, and many young people like it.
style.exampleZh: 她的风格很简单，许多年轻人都喜欢。

subdivide.example: We can subdivide the large garden into three smaller parts.
subdivide.exampleZh: 我们可以把大花园再分成三个更小的部分。

subject.example: Math is my favorite subject, but I am subject to the school schedule.
subject.exampleZh: 数学是我最喜欢的科目，但我必须服从学校的课程安排。

submarine.example: The submarine went deep under the sea to look for fish.
submarine.exampleZh: 潜水艇潜入深海寻找鱼群。

submit.example: Please submit your form to the office before Friday.
submit.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把表格提交到办公室。

subordinate.example: The manager asked his subordinate staff to finish the report today.
subordinate.exampleZh: 经理要求他的下级员工今天完成这份报告。

subscribe.example: I want to subscribe to a weekly magazine about science and nature.
subscribe.exampleZh: 我想订阅一本关于科学与自然的周刊。

subsequent.example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent ones were much easier.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次测试很难，但随后的几次测试容易多了。

subsidy.example: The government gives a subsidy to farmers to help them grow more food.
subsidy.exampleZh: 政府给农民发放补贴，帮助他们种植更多粮食。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that every living thing needs.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种简单的物质，每个生物都需要它。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit this year.
substantial.exampleZh: 公司今年获得了可观的利润。

substitute.example: You can substitute honey for sugar in this simple cake recipe.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个简单的蛋糕食谱中，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtract.example: Please subtract the cost of the broken cup from the total price.
subtract.exampleZh: 请从总价中扣除那个破杯子的费用。

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb because the city was too noisy.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们搬到了一个安静的郊区，因为城里太吵了。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你最终会成功。

success.example: Hard work and patience are the keys to success in any job.
success.exampleZh: 努力和耐心是做好任何工作的关键。

such.example: Such a small car is easy to park in the city.
such.exampleZh: 这样一辆小汽车在城市里很容易停放。

suck.example: The baby likes to suck milk from a bottle every morning.
suck.exampleZh: 这个婴儿喜欢每天早上从奶瓶里吸牛奶。

sudden.example: The sudden rain made everyone run back into the house.
sudden.exampleZh: 这场突如其来的雨让大家都跑回了屋里。

sue.example: She decided to sue the company for damages.
sue.exampleZh: 她决定起诉这家公司要求赔偿。

suffer.example: Many people suffer from headaches when they work too long.
suffer.exampleZh: 很多人工作时间过长时会头痛。

sufficient.example: We have sufficient food and water for the whole trip.
sufficient.exampleZh: 我们有足够的食物和水供整个旅程使用。

sugar.example: Too much sugar in your drinks is bad for your teeth.
sugar.exampleZh: 饮料里糖分太多对你的牙齿不好。

suggest.example: I suggest we take a short break before the next meeting.
suggest.exampleZh: 我建议我们在下次会议前短暂休息一下。

suicide.example: He was very sad after his wife died and thought about suicide.
suicide.exampleZh: 妻子去世后他非常悲伤，曾想过自杀。

suit.example: This dark suit fits him well, so he will wear it to the meeting.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装很适合他，所以他会穿着它去开会。

suitable.example: This movie is not suitable for young children.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看。

suitcase.example: I put my clothes in the suitcase and went to the airport.
suitcase.exampleZh: 我把衣服放进手提箱，然后去了机场。

sum.example: The sum of these numbers is easy to calculate.
sum.exampleZh: 这些数字的总和很容易计算。

summarize.example: Please summarize the main ideas of this article in a few sentences.
summarize.exampleZh: 请用几句话概括一下这篇文章的主要观点。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the meeting for the report.
summary.exampleZh: 请为报告写一份简短的会议摘要。

summer.example: We often swim in the river near our home every summer.
summer.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们常常在离家很近的河里游泳。

summit.example: They climbed to the summit before the sun went down.
summit.exampleZh: 他们在太阳下山之前登上了顶峰。

sun.example: The sun rose slowly behind the hills this morning.
sun.exampleZh: 今天早晨太阳从山后缓缓升起。

super.example: This phone is super fast and very easy to use.
super.exampleZh: 这部手机超级快，而且非常容易使用。

superb.example: The food at that small restaurant was superb, and the price was fair.
superb.exampleZh: 那家小餐馆的食物极好，价格也公道。

superficial.example: His superficial knowledge of the subject made the discussion rather shallow.
superficial.exampleZh: 他对这个主题的了解很肤浅，使得讨论变得相当浅薄。

superior.example: This phone is superior to my old one in every way.
superior.exampleZh: 这部手机在各方面都比我原来的那部好。

supply.example: The company supplies fresh water to all the small villages nearby.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司向附近所有小村庄供应淡水。

support.example: My parents always support me when I study hard at school.
support.exampleZh: 我在学校努力学习时，父母总是支持我。

suppose.example: I suppose you are right about this problem.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想你在这个问题上是对的。

supreme.example: The supreme court has the final say in this case.
supreme.exampleZh: 最高法院在此案中有最终决定权。

sure.example: I am sure that he will come to the party tonight.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信他今晚会来参加聚会。

surf.example: On weekends I like to surf, and I also surf the internet for news.
surf.exampleZh: 周末我喜欢冲浪，也会上网浏览新闻。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and bright in the morning sun.
surface.exampleZh: 清晨的湖面平静而明亮。

surge.example: There was a sudden surge in ticket sales after the band announced its tour.
surge.exampleZh: 乐队宣布巡演后，门票销量突然激增。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed his hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.exampleZh: 手术开始前，外科医生仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: The doctor said I need surgery on my knee next week.
surgery.exampleZh: 医生说我下周需要做膝盖手术。

surplus.example: The farm had a surplus of corn and sold the rest.
surplus.exampleZh: 农场玉米过剩，把剩下的卖掉了。

surprise.example: The birthday party was a big surprise for my mother.
surprise.exampleZh: 这个生日派对对我妈妈来说是个大惊喜。

surrender.example: The soldiers had to surrender after they ran out of food and water.
surrender.exampleZh: 士兵们在食物和水用尽后不得不投降。

surround.example: Tall trees surround the small lake near our school.
surround.exampleZh: 高大的树木环绕着我们学校附近的小湖。

survey.example: We did a survey to find out what students like to eat.
survey.exampleZh: 我们做了一项调查，了解学生喜欢吃什么。

survive.example: The small plants can survive in the desert without much water.
survive.exampleZh: 这些小型植物在没有多少水的情况下也能在沙漠中存活。

suspect.example: The police suspect the quiet man next door, but his wife does not.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑隔壁那个沉默的男人，但他妻子并不怀疑。

suspend.example: The school will suspend classes for two days because of the storm.
suspend.exampleZh: 因为暴风雨，学校将停课两天。

sustain.example: It is hard to sustain such a fast pace for the whole race.
sustain.exampleZh: 在整场比赛中保持这么快的速度是很困难的。

swallow.example: The little bird is a swallow, and it can swallow a small fish.
swallow.exampleZh: 这只小鸟是一只燕子，它能吞下一条小鱼。

swam.example: When I was young, I swam in that river every summer day.
swam.exampleZh: 小时候，我每个夏天都会在那条河里游泳。

swamp.example: The swamp behind our village is full of frogs and tall grass.
swamp.exampleZh: 我们村子后面的沼泽里到处都是青蛙和高草。

swap.example: I want to swap my old phone for a new one.
swap.exampleZh: 我想用旧手机换一部新手机。

swear.example: I swear I will never tell anyone your secret.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓我绝不会把你的秘密告诉任何人。

sweat.example: After a long run, sweat ran down his face and he felt tired.
sweat.exampleZh: 长跑之后，汗水顺着他的脸流下来，他感到很累。

sweep.example: She sweeps the floor every morning before she goes to work.
sweep.exampleZh: 她每天早上上班前都会扫地。

sweet.example: The sweet cakes on the table taste very good with hot tea.
sweet.exampleZh: 桌上的甜蛋糕配上热茶味道很好。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell off my bike.
swell.exampleZh: 我从自行车上摔下来后，脚踝开始肿了起来。

swim.example: My sister can swim very well in the cold lake.
swim.exampleZh: 我妹妹在冰冷的湖里游得很好。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the old rope in the garden.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里那条旧绳子上荡秋千。

switch.example: Please switch off the light before you leave the room.
switch.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The brave knight carried a sharp sword into the dark forest.
sword.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士带着一把锋利的剑走进了黑暗的森林。

symbol.example: The white dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 白鸽在许多文化中是和平的象征。

sympathy.example: She felt great sympathy for the old man and helped him.
sympathy.exampleZh: 她对那位老人深感同情，并帮助了他。

symptom.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this viral infection.
symptom.exampleZh: 高烧是这种病毒感染的常见症状。

system.example: The new computer system helps students learn faster and more easily.
system.exampleZh: 新的计算机系统帮助学生更快、更轻松地学习。

table.example: Please put the books on the table near the window.
table.exampleZh: 请把那些书放到窗边的桌子上。

tackle.example: We must tackle this problem before it gets worse.
tackle.exampleZh: 我们必须在这个问题变得更严重之前处理它。

tactic.example: Changing our plan was a good tactic to win the game.
tactic.exampleZh: 改变我们的计划是赢得比赛的一个好策略。

tadpole.example: The little tadpole slowly grew legs and became a small green frog.
tadpole.exampleZh: 小蝌蚪慢慢长出了腿，变成了一只绿色的小青蛙。

tag.example: The price tag on this shirt is hard to read.
tag.exampleZh: 这件衬衫上的价格标签很难看清。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw the food.
tail.exampleZh: 那只狗看到食物时摇了摇尾巴。

tailor.example: The tailor made a new coat and adjusted it to fit me.
tailor.exampleZh: 裁缝做了一件新外套，并做了调整使其合我的身。

take.example: It takes about twenty minutes to walk to the station from here.
take.exampleZh: 从这里走到车站大约需要二十分钟。

tale.example: My grandmother often tells a funny tale about her old village.
tale.exampleZh: 我奶奶经常讲一个关于她旧村庄的有趣故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for drawing and loves to paint.
talent.exampleZh: 她很有绘画天赋，也喜欢画画。

talk.example: We need to talk about the plan before Friday.
talk.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五之前谈谈这个计划。

tall.example: The tall man is my father, and he plays basketball very well.
tall.exampleZh: 那个高个子男人是我父亲，他篮球打得很好。

tame.example: The once wild horse is now tame and lets children ride it.
tame.exampleZh: 那匹曾经野性的马现在很温顺，让孩子们骑它。

tank.example: The old man keeps a large water tank behind his small house.
tank.exampleZh: 那位老人在他的小房子后面有一个大水罐。

tap.example: She gave the door a light tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人回应。

tape.example: I used tape to fix the broken box before moving it.
tape.exampleZh: 搬家前我用胶带把破了的箱子修好了。

target.example: Our team must hit the sales target by the end of this month.
target.exampleZh: 我们团队必须在本月底前完成销售目标。

task.example: My first task today is to answer all my emails.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是回复所有的邮件。

taste.example: This soup tastes very good, and I like its taste.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤尝起来很不错，我喜欢它的味道。

tax.example: The government will tax the rich to pay for new schools.
tax.exampleZh: 政府将向富人征税，以支付新建学校的费用。

taxi.example: We took a taxi to the airport very early this morning.
taxi.exampleZh: 今天一大早我们坐出租车去了机场。

tea.example: My mother drinks a cup of tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上班前都会喝一杯茶。

teach.example: She likes to teach young children how to read and write.
teach.exampleZh: 她喜欢教小孩子读书写字。

team.example: Our team works well together on every project.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队在每个项目上都合作得很好。

tear.example: The strong wind will tear the old flag and bring tears to my eyes.
tear.exampleZh: 强风会撕破那面旧旗，也会让我眼泪直流。

tease.example: The children tease their little brother about his new haircut.
tease.exampleZh: 孩子们取笑他们弟弟的新发型。

technical.example: The technical team fixed the machine in less than an hour.
technical.exampleZh: 技术团队不到一小时就修好了这台机器。

technology.example: Modern technology makes it easy to talk to friends far away.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让我们可以轻松地与远方的朋友交谈。

tedious.example: The long meeting was tedious and everyone wanted to go home.
tedious.exampleZh: 那场会议又长又乏味，大家都想回家。

teenager.example: As a teenager, she loved reading books and playing basketball with her friends.
teenager.exampleZh: 青少年时期，她喜欢读书，也喜欢和朋友们打篮球。

telephone.example: I called my mother on the telephone to tell her the good news.
telephone.exampleZh: 我打电话给妈妈，告诉她这个好消息。

telescope.example: We looked at the moon through a small telescope last night.
telescope.exampleZh: 昨晚我们用一架小望远镜看了月亮。

television.example: My family watches television together in the living room every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我家每天晚上一起在客厅看电视。

tell.example: Please tell me the truth about what happened last night.
tell.exampleZh: 请告诉我昨晚发生的事情的真相。

temper.example: My father has a calm temper and rarely gets angry with us.
temper.exampleZh: 我父亲性情平和，很少对我们发火。

temperature.example: The temperature outside is very cold today, so wear a warm coat.
temperature.exampleZh: 今天外面的气温很低，所以要穿一件暖和的外套。

temple.example: This old temple sits on the hill above our village.
temple.exampleZh: 这座古庙坐落在我们村庄上方的小山上。

temporary.example: We are living in a temporary apartment until our new house is ready.
temporary.exampleZh: 我们暂时住在一间公寓里，直到新房子准备好。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to stop and buy some.
tempt.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味吸引我停下来买了一些。

ten.example: I have ten fingers and ten toes on my body.
ten.exampleZh: 我身体上有十个手指和十个脚趾。

tend.example: People tend to eat more when they are tired and stressed.
tend.exampleZh: 人们在疲倦和压力大的时候往往会吃得更多。

tendency.example: She has a tendency to talk too much when she is nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 她紧张时总爱说太多话。

tender.example: The mother gave her baby a tender smile.
tender.exampleZh: 母亲给了她的宝宝一个温柔的微笑。

tennis.example: My sister and I play tennis in the park every Sunday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每周日早上都在公园打网球。

tent.example: We put up a tent near the river and slept there last night.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭了一个帐篷，昨晚就睡在那里。

term.example: The new term starts next Monday and lasts for ten weeks.
term.exampleZh: 新学期下周一开始，持续十周。

terminal.example: I waited for the bus at the terminal near my house.
terminal.exampleZh: 我在家附近的终点站等公交车。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed at home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们整天都待在家里。

territory.example: The small country lost much of its territory after the long war.
territory.exampleZh: 这个小国在长期战争后失去了大片领土。

terror.example: The children ran home in terror after hearing the loud noise.
terror.exampleZh: 孩子们听到巨响后惊恐地跑回家。

test.example: The teacher gave us a test on Friday and asked us to check our answers.
test.exampleZh: 老师星期五给我们做了一次测验，并要求我们检查答案。

testify.example: She agreed to testify in court about what she saw that night.
testify.exampleZh: 她同意出庭就那天晚上看到的事情作证。

testimony.example: Her testimony in court helped the police find the missing car.
testimony.exampleZh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助警方找到了那辆失踪的汽车。

text.example: The teacher asked us to read the text on page ten.
text.exampleZh: 老师让我们读第十页的课文。

than.example: She runs faster than her brother does.

thank.example: I want to thank you for all your help today.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你今天的所有帮助。

that.example: I know that he will come to the party tonight.
that.exampleZh: 我知道他今晚会来参加聚会。

the.example: The book on the table is mine, but the pen is hers.
the.exampleZh: 桌上的那本书是我的，但那支笔是她的。

theater.example: We went to the theater last night to watch a funny play.
theater.exampleZh: 我们昨晚去剧院看了一出有趣的戏。

their.example: The children put their books on the desk before they went home.
their.exampleZh: 孩子们回家前把他们的书放在了桌子上。

them.example: I gave the books to them yesterday.
them.exampleZh: 我昨天把那些书给了他们。

theme.example: The theme of today's class is how plants grow.
theme.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题是植物如何生长。

then.example: We ate dinner and then watched a movie at home.
then.exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，然后在家看了一部电影。

theory.example: In theory, the plan sounds good, but we need to test it.
theory.exampleZh: 从理论上讲，这个计划听起来不错，但我们需要测试它。

there.example: Please put the box over there next to the door.
there.exampleZh: 请把那个箱子放到门旁边的那个地方。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, and therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天都待在家里。

these.example: These books on the table are mine, not yours.
these.exampleZh: 桌子上的这些书是我的，不是你的。

they.example: They live in a small house near the river with their two dogs.
they.exampleZh: 他们和两只狗住在河边的一栋小房子里。

thick.example: The book is very thick, so I need two weeks to finish it.
thick.exampleZh: 这本书很厚，所以我需要两周才能读完。

thin.example: This book is very thin and easy to carry in my bag.
thin.exampleZh: 这本书很薄，很容易放进我的包里携带。

thing.example: I put my things on the table and went out.
thing.exampleZh: 我把我的东西放在桌上，然后出去了。

think.example: I think we should go home now.
think.exampleZh: 我想我们现在应该回家了。

third.example: My sister lives on the third floor of that old building.
third.exampleZh: 我姐姐住在那栋旧楼的三楼。

thirsty.example: After the long walk in the sun, I felt very thirsty and wanted cold water.
thirsty.exampleZh: 在太阳下走了很久之后，我感到非常口渴，想要喝冷水。

thirteen.example: My little brother is thirteen years old and he loves playing basketball.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我弟弟十三岁，他喜欢打篮球。

thirty.example: My sister is thirty years old and works in a small bookstore.
thirty.exampleZh: 我姐姐三十岁，在一家小书店工作。

this.example: This is my new book for the English class.

thorough.example: The doctor did a thorough check before she gave us the good news.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生在告诉我们好消息之前做了一次彻底的检查。

those.example: Those are my new books on the desk.
those.exampleZh: 那些是我放在桌子上的新书。

though.example: Though it was raining, we still went for a walk in the park.
though.exampleZh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是去公园散步了。

thought.example: Her thoughts were clear and simple, so everyone understood her idea.
thought.exampleZh: 她的想法清晰而简单，所以每个人都理解了她的意思。

thousand.example: There are about two thousand students in our school this year.
thousand.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有两千名学生。

thread.example: I lost the thread of the story and had to read the page again.
thread.exampleZh: 我丢掉了故事的思路，只好把那页再读一遍。

threat.example: Climate change is a serious threat to animals and plants around the world.
threat.exampleZh: 气候变化是对全世界动植物的严重威胁。

threaten.example: The dark clouds threaten rain, so we should go home now.
threaten.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以我们现在应该回家。

three.example: I have three books and two pens on my desk.
three.exampleZh: 我的书桌上有三本书和两支笔。

throat.example: I have a sore throat today, so I will drink warm water.
throat.exampleZh: 我今天嗓子疼，所以我会喝温水。

throne.example: The king sat on his throne and ruled the kingdom for many years.
throne.exampleZh: 国王坐在宝座上，统治这个王国很多年。

through.example: The train goes through a long tunnel before it reaches the city.
through.exampleZh: 火车在到达城市之前穿过一条长长的隧道。

throughout.example: The museum is free for students throughout the year.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家博物馆全年对学生免费。

throw.example: The boy likes to throw the ball to his dog in the park.
throw.exampleZh: 那个男孩喜欢在公园里把球扔给他的狗。

thumb.example: He cut his thumb while opening the box with a small knife.
thumb.exampleZh: 他用一把小刀打开箱子时割伤了拇指。

thunder.example: The thunder sounded very loud during the storm last night.
thunder.exampleZh: 昨晚暴风雨中雷声非常响。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we took a longer way home.
thus.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们走了一条更远的回家路。

ticket.example: I bought a train ticket to visit my grandmother this weekend.
ticket.exampleZh: 我买了一张火车票，这个周末去看望我的奶奶。

tide.example: The tide comes in twice a day and covers the rocks.
tide.exampleZh: 潮水每天涨两次，淹没了岩石。

tidy.example: She always keeps her desk tidy before she leaves the office.
tidy.exampleZh: 她离开办公室前总是把桌子收拾得整整齐齐。

tie.example: He wore a blue tie and tied his shoes before the meeting.
tie.exampleZh: 开会前，他系上一条蓝色领带并系好鞋带。

tiger.example: The tiger sleeps under a big tree in the zoo.
tiger.exampleZh: 那只老虎在动物园的一棵大树下睡觉。

tight.example: These shoes are too tight for my feet.
tight.exampleZh: 这双鞋对我的脚来说太紧了。

tile.example: The kitchen floor is covered with small white tiles.
tile.exampleZh: 厨房的地板上铺着白色的小瓷砖。

till.example: We waited till the rain stopped and then walked to the shop.
till.exampleZh: 我们一直等到雨停，然后步行去了商店。

timber.example: The old house was built with strong timber from the local forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用当地森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: We do not have much time, so please hurry up now.
time.exampleZh: 我们没有多少时间了，所以请快点。

tin.example: She opened a tin of soup and heated it for lunch.
tin.exampleZh: 她打开一罐汤，热了热当午饭。

tip.example: The waiter gave us a good tip about the best local food.
tip.exampleZh: 服务员给了我们一个关于当地最佳美食的好建议。

tire.example: Long hours of work can tire even the strongest people.
tire.exampleZh: 长时间的工作甚至会让最强壮的人也感到疲倦。

tissue.example: The doctor cleaned the cut with a soft tissue and warm water.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生用柔软的纸巾和温水清洗了伤口。

title.example: The title of her new book is very long and hard to remember.
title.exampleZh: 她那本新书的标题很长，也很难记住。

to.example: She walked to the store to buy some milk for her family.
to.exampleZh: 她走到商店去给家人买些牛奶。

toast.example: She likes toast with butter and a cup of hot coffee for breakfast.
toast.exampleZh: 她早餐喜欢吃涂了黄油的烤面包配一杯热咖啡。

tobacco.example: The farmer grows tobacco on a small field near his house.
tobacco.exampleZh: 农民在房子附近的一小块地上种植烟草。

today.example: Today is a good day to start learning English.
today.exampleZh: 今天是开始学英语的好日子。

toe.example: She hurt her toe while playing football in the park yesterday.
toe.exampleZh: 她昨天在公园踢足球时伤到了脚趾。

together.example: My sister and I often cook dinner together on Friday evenings.
together.exampleZh: 我和姐姐常在周五晚上一起做晚饭。

toilet.example: Our new apartment has a small toilet next to the kitchen.
toilet.exampleZh: 我们的新公寓在厨房旁边有一个小洗手间。

token.example: Please give this token to the teacher at the front door.
token.exampleZh: 请把这张礼券交给前门的老师。

tolerance.example: Her tolerance for noise helped her live near the busy road.
tolerance.exampleZh: 她对噪音的耐受力让她能住在繁忙的马路附近。

toll.example: The death toll from the earthquake has risen to over two hundred.
toll.exampleZh: 地震造成的死亡人数已上升至两百多人。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 今天午餐我在沙拉里放了一个红番茄。

tomorrow.example: I will finish my homework tomorrow and then we can play outside.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 我明天会完成作业，然后我们就可以到外面玩了。

ton.example: This box weighs a ton, so we need help to move it.
ton.exampleZh: 这个箱子重达一吨，所以我们需要帮忙才能搬动它。

tone.example: Her tone of voice told me she was not happy.
tone.exampleZh: 她的语气告诉我，她不太高兴。

tongue.example: The hot soup burned my tongue and I could not taste anything.
tongue.exampleZh: 热汤烫到了我的舌头，我什么味道都尝不出来。

tonight.example: Let's have dinner together tonight because I have good news for you.
tonight.exampleZh: 今晚我们一起吃晚饭吧，因为我有好消息要告诉你。

too.example: This coffee is too hot for me to drink right now.
too.exampleZh: 这杯咖啡太烫了，我现在喝不了。

tool.example: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things at home.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是家里修理东西时有用的工具。

tooth.example: The little boy lost a baby tooth and put it under his pillow.
tooth.exampleZh: 这个小男孩掉了一颗乳牙，把它放在了枕头下面。

top.example: She put the book on the top shelf so the children could not reach it.
top.exampleZh: 她把书放在最上层的架子上，这样孩子们够不到。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is very interesting to me.
topic.exampleZh: 今天课上的话题对我来说非常有趣。

torch.example: The farmer carried a burning torch across the dark field at night.
torch.exampleZh: 农夫夜里举着燃烧的火把穿过黑暗的田野。

torment.example: The memories of that long war still torment him every single night.
torment.exampleZh: 那场漫长战争的回忆至今每晚仍在折磨他。

torture.example: The prisoners said the guards used torture to make them talk.
torture.exampleZh: 囚犯们说，警卫用酷刑逼他们开口。

toss.example: She tossed the keys to me and ran out the door.
toss.exampleZh: 她把钥匙扔给我，然后跑出了门。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was higher than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用比我们预期的要高。

touch.example: Please do not touch the wet paint on the wall.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要触摸墙上未干的油漆。

tough.example: The old rope is strong and tough enough to hold the heavy boat.
tough.exampleZh: 这根旧绳子足够结实坚韧，能拉住那条沉重的船。

tour.example: We took a tour of the old city with a friendly guide.
tour.exampleZh: 我们在一位友好的导游带领下参观了这座老城。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old city during his trip.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位游客在旅行期间拍了很多老城的照片。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door and smiled at me.
toward.exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝门口走去，并对我微笑。

towel.example: She dried her hands with a clean towel after washing them.
towel.exampleZh: 她洗完手后用一条干净的毛巾擦干了手。

tower.example: The old tower stands at the top of the hill.
tower.exampleZh: 那座古老的塔矗立在山顶上。

town.example: I live in a small town near the river and the mountains.
town.exampleZh: 我住在一个靠近河流和山脉的小镇上。

toy.example: The little boy got a new toy car for his birthday.
toy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩在生日时得到了一辆新的玩具汽车。

trace.example: The police traced the lost dog to a small park near the river.
trace.exampleZh: 警方追踪那只走失的狗，一直追到河边的一个小公园。

track.example: The train runs along the track past our small town every morning.
track.exampleZh: 火车每天早上沿着轨道经过我们的小镇。

trade.example: My father works in the trade of fresh fruit and vegetables.
trade.exampleZh: 我父亲从事新鲜水果和蔬菜的贸易。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat dinner together on Sundays.
tradition.exampleZh: 星期天一起吃晚饭是家里的一个传统。

traffic.example: The traffic is very heavy on this road every morning.
traffic.exampleZh: 每天早上这条路上交通都非常拥堵。

tragedy.example: The fire was a great tragedy for the whole small town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 这场火灾对整个小镇来说是一场巨大的悲剧。

trail.example: We followed a narrow trail through the forest and found a small lake.
trail.exampleZh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过森林，发现了一个小湖。

train.example: She takes the train to work every morning and trains new staff in the afternoon.
train.exampleZh: 她每天早上坐火车上班，下午培训新员工。

transfer.example: I need to transfer to another train at the next station.
transfer.exampleZh: 我需要在下一站换乘另一趟火车。

transform.example: The small team hopes to transform the old factory into a modern art center.
transform.exampleZh: 这个小团队希望把旧工厂改造成现代艺术中心。

transit.example: The goods are still in transit and will arrive next week.
transit.exampleZh: 这批货物仍在运输途中，下周到达。

translate.example: She likes to translate English songs into Chinese for her friends.
translate.exampleZh: 她喜欢为朋友们把英文歌曲翻译成中文。

transport.example: The company uses trucks to transport food to small towns every day.
transport.exampleZh: 这家公司每天用卡车把食物运送到小城镇。

trap.example: The fox was caught in a trap near the old tree.
trap.exampleZh: 狐狸在旧树附近被陷阱困住了。

travel.example: I want to travel around the world after I finish school.
travel.exampleZh: 我想在完成学业后环游世界。

tray.example: She carried the cups and plates on a large wooden tray.
tray.exampleZh: 她用一个大木托盘端着杯子和盘子。

treason.example: He was put on trial for treason after helping the enemy.
treason.exampleZh: 他因帮助敌人而被以叛国罪受审。

treasure.example: She keeps her old letters as a treasure and reads them often.
treasure.exampleZh: 她把旧信件当作珍宝珍藏，并经常拿出来读。

treat.example: The doctor will treat her leg and then we can have a small treat.
treat.exampleZh: 医生会先治疗她的腿，然后我们可以吃点小零食。

treatment.example: The doctor said my treatment will take about two weeks.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生说我这个疗程大约需要两周。

tree.example: The old tree in our garden is very tall and gives good shade.
tree.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老树很高，能提供很好的阴凉。

tremble.example: Her hands tremble a little when she speaks in front of the class.
tremble.exampleZh: 她在全班面前讲话时，双手有点发抖。

tremendous.example: The film was a tremendous success and everyone loved it.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这部电影取得了巨大的成功，大家都很喜欢。

trend.example: There is a growing trend of people working from home.
trend.exampleZh: 在家办公的人越来越多，这是一个日益增长的趋势。

trial.example: The new drug will go on trial next month.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药下个月将进行试验。

triangle.example: She drew a small triangle on the paper with a red pen.
triangle.exampleZh: 她用红笔在纸上画了一个小三角形。

trick.example: The old man taught me a trick to open the door quickly.
trick.exampleZh: 那位老人教了我一个快速开门的诀窍。

trifle.example: Don't worry about such a trifle and just enjoy your day.
trifle.exampleZh: 别为这种小事担心，好好享受你的一天。

trim.example: She will trim the tall bushes in the garden this afternoon.
trim.exampleZh: 她今天下午会修剪花园里高高的灌木。

trip.example: We took a short trip to the mountains last weekend.
trip.exampleZh: 上周末我们去山里做了一次短途旅行。

troop.example: A large troop of soldiers marched slowly through the quiet mountain village.
troop.exampleZh: 一大队士兵缓慢地穿过这个安静的山村。

trophy.example: She won a gold trophy for her excellent work in the school race.
trophy.exampleZh: 她因在学校比赛中表现出色而赢得了一座金奖杯。

trouble.example: I had some trouble finding your house, but I got here at last.
trouble.exampleZh: 我费了点劲才找到你家，不过最后还是到了。

trousers.example: These black trousers are too long for me, so I need a smaller size.
trousers.exampleZh: 这条黑裤子对我来说太长了，所以我需要小一号的。

truck.example: The truck is carrying boxes of fruit to the market.
truck.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正把一箱箱水果运往市场。

true.example: It is true that she works very hard every day.
true.exampleZh: 她每天工作非常努力，这是真的。

truly.example: She was truly happy to see her old friends again.
truly.exampleZh: 再次见到老朋友，她真的很高兴。

trumpet.example: He plays the trumpet in the school band every Friday afternoon.
trumpet.exampleZh: 他每周五下午在学校乐队里吹小号。

trunk.example: The elephant picked up the branch with its long trunk.
trunk.exampleZh: 大象用长长的鼻子捡起了那根树枝。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always tells me the truth.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他总是对我说真话。

truth.example: She always tells the truth, even when it is hard to do.
truth.exampleZh: 她总是说实话，即使这样做很难。

try.example: Let me try to fix the old bike myself.
try.exampleZh: 让我自己试着修一下这辆旧自行车。

tube.example: The water flows through a long plastic tube into the garden.
tube.exampleZh: 水流经一根长长的塑料管，流入花园里。

tune.example: She hummed a sweet tune while walking home in the evening.
tune.exampleZh: 晚上走回家的时候，她哼着一首甜美的曲子。

tunnel.example: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过了一条长长的山底隧道。

turkey.example: My mother cooks a big turkey for our family every Thanksgiving.
turkey.exampleZh: 每年感恩节我妈妈都会为我们家烤一只大火鸡。

turn.example: Please turn left at the next corner and you will see the bank.
turn.exampleZh: 请在下一个路口左转，你就会看到那家银行。

tutor.example: My tutor helps me with math after school every Tuesday.
tutor.exampleZh: 我的家庭教师每周二放学后帮我学数学。

twelve.example: My little sister is twelve years old and she loves to read books.
twelve.exampleZh: 我妹妹十二岁，她喜欢读书。

twenty.example: My sister is twenty years old and she studies English at school.
twenty.exampleZh: 我姐姐二十岁，她在学校学英语。

twice.example: I read the letter twice before I answered it.
twice.exampleZh: 我在回复之前把那封信读了两遍。

twin.example: My twin and I look the same, so our friends often get confused.
twin.exampleZh: 我和我的双胞胎长得一样，所以朋友们常常把我们弄混。

twist.example: She twisted the wet towel to get the water out.
twist.exampleZh: 她拧了拧湿毛巾，把水挤出来。

two.example: I have two brothers and one sister in my family.
two.exampleZh: 我家里有两个哥哥和一个姐姐。

type.example: What type of music do you like to listen to?
type.exampleZh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

typical.example: This is a typical day in my life at school.
typical.exampleZh: 这是我学校生活里典型的一天。

tyre.example: The front tyre of my bike is flat, so I must walk home.
tyre.exampleZh: 我自行车的前轮胎瘪了，所以我只能走回家。

ubiquitous.example: Smartphones are ubiquitous in big cities today, even among young children.
ubiquitous.exampleZh: 如今在大城市里，智能手机无处不在，甚至在幼童中也一样。

ulcer.example: The doctor said the ulcer in his stomach would heal with rest and medicine.
ulcer.exampleZh: 医生说，他胃里的溃疡通过休息和药物就会愈合。

ultimate.example: Winning the gold medal was the ultimate goal of her long training.
ultimate.exampleZh: 赢得金牌是她长期训练的最终目标。

ultraviolet.example: Too much ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your eyes and skin.
ultraviolet.exampleZh: 来自太阳的过多紫外线会伤害你的眼睛和皮肤。

umbrella.example: I always take an umbrella with me when the sky looks dark.
umbrella.exampleZh: 天色暗下来时，我总是随身带一把伞。

unacceptable.example: The noise from the street is unacceptable at night.
unacceptable.exampleZh: 街上的噪音在夜间是不可接受的。

unaccountable.example: The sudden power cut was unaccountable, and nobody could find the cause.
unaccountable.exampleZh: 这次突然停电无法解释，没有人能找到原因。

unaffected.example: The village was unaffected by the storm and life went on as usual.
unaffected.exampleZh: 这个村庄没有受到暴风雨的影响，生活照常进行。

unaided.example: She found the lost keys unaided and felt very proud of herself.
unaided.exampleZh: 她独立找到了丢失的钥匙，为自己感到非常自豪。

unaltered.example: The room looked exactly the same, and everything in it was unaltered.
unaltered.exampleZh: 房间看起来完全一样，里面的每样东西都没有被改动。

unanimous.example: The group was unanimous in its decision to start the meeting early.
unanimous.exampleZh: 全体成员一致同意提前开始会议。

unarmed.example: The police found that the man was unarmed and very frightened.
unarmed.exampleZh: 警方发现那名男子没有武器，而且非常害怕。

unashamed.example: He was unashamed of his mistake and told everyone the truth.
unashamed.exampleZh: 他对自己的错误毫不羞愧，并把真相告诉了所有人。

unassuming.example: He is an unassuming man who never talks about his success.
unassuming.exampleZh: 他是个谦逊的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

unattached.example: She is still unattached and happy to live alone.
unattached.exampleZh: 她仍未结婚，乐于独自生活。

unattainable.example: That goal is unattainable for us right now.
unattainable.exampleZh: 那个目标对我们现在来说是达不到的。

unattended.example: Do not leave your bags unattended in the busy train station.
unattended.exampleZh: 在繁忙的火车站里不要让你的包无人看管。

unattractive.example: The old hotel looked unattractive from the street, so we chose another place.
unattractive.exampleZh: 那家旧旅馆从街上看上去很难看，所以我们选了另一个地方。

unauthorized.example: Anyone found using this computer without permission will be considered unauthorized.
unauthorized.exampleZh: 任何未经许可使用这台电脑的人都会被视作未经授权的使用者。

unavailable.example: The book you want is unavailable because someone else borrowed it.
unavailable.exampleZh: 你想要的那本书无法借到，因为别人已经借走了。

unavoidable.example: Some mistakes are unavoidable when you learn something new.
unavoidable.exampleZh: 学习新事物时，有些错误是不可避免的。

unaware.example: She was unaware of the danger and walked into the dark room.
unaware.exampleZh: 她没有察觉到危险，走进了那间黑暗的房间。

unbearable.example: The heat in the small room was unbearable, so we opened all the windows.
unbearable.exampleZh: 小房间里的热气令人难以忍受，所以我们把窗户都打开了。

unbeatable.example: Her cooking is unbeatable, and everyone in the family loves it.
unbeatable.exampleZh: 她的厨艺无可匹敌，家里每个人都喜欢。

unbounded.example: The desert seemed unbounded, stretching far beyond the eye could see.
unbounded.exampleZh: 沙漠似乎无边无际，一直延伸到眼睛看不到的地方。

uncertain.example: I am uncertain about the right answer to this question.
uncertain.exampleZh: 我对这个问题的正确答案不确定。

uncertainty.example: There is still some uncertainty about the date of the meeting.
uncertainty.exampleZh: 关于会议的日期仍有一些不确定性。

uncomfortable.example: I feel uncomfortable in this small chair.
uncomfortable.exampleZh: 坐在这把小小的椅子上让我觉得不舒服。

uncommon.example: It is uncommon to see snow here in May.
uncommon.exampleZh: 这里五月下雪是罕见的。

unconscious.example: She lay unconscious on the floor for a few minutes.
unconscious.exampleZh: 她在地板上失去意识了几分钟。

unconventional.example: Her unconventional ideas made the whole team think in a new way.
unconventional.exampleZh: 她那些不落俗套的想法让整个团队以全新的方式思考。

unconvincing.example: His excuse for being late sounded unconvincing to everyone in the room.
unconvincing.exampleZh: 他迟到的借口在房间里的每个人听来都不令人信服。

uncover.example: The police worked hard to uncover the truth about the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方努力查明那笔失踪钱款的真相。

undemanding.example: This undemanding job lets me finish work early every day.
undemanding.exampleZh: 这份要求不高的工作让我每天都能早点下班。

underdeveloped.example: This country is still underdeveloped and needs more schools and hospitals.
underdeveloped.exampleZh: 这个国家仍然不发达，需要更多的学校和医院。

underestimate.example: Do not underestimate the time you need to finish this work.
underestimate.exampleZh: 不要低估你完成这项工作所需的时间。

undergo.example: Many students undergo great stress before important exams each year.
undergo.exampleZh: 每年许多学生在重要考试前都会承受巨大的压力。

undergraduate.example: My sister is an undergraduate at a small college in the north.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 我姐姐是北方一所小学院的大学本科生。

underground.example: The underground train is faster than the bus in this big city.
underground.exampleZh: 在这个大城市里，地铁比公交车快。

underhand.example: He won the game by underhand tricks that nobody noticed.
underhand.exampleZh: 他靠没人察觉的狡诈伎俩赢了比赛。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this sentence.
underline.exampleZh: 请在这个句子里给重要的词画下划线。

underlying.example: The underlying problem is that we do not have enough time.
underlying.exampleZh: 根本问题是我们没有足够的时间。

undermine.example: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence over time.
undermine.exampleZh: 不断的批评会随着时间逐渐削弱孩子的自信心。

underneath.example: There is a small box underneath the table in the corner.
underneath.exampleZh: 角落里的桌子下面有一个小盒子。

understand.example: I do not understand this question, so please explain it again.
understand.exampleZh: 我不明白这个问题，请再解释一遍。

understandable.example: It is understandable that she felt tired after such a long trip.
understandable.exampleZh: 在那么漫长的旅程之后她感到疲惫，这是可以理解的。

understanding.example: Her understanding of the problem helped the whole team find a simple answer.
understanding.exampleZh: 她对这个问题的理解帮助整个团队找到了一个简单的答案。

undertake.example: We agreed to undertake the new project together next month.
undertake.exampleZh: 我们同意下个月一起承担这个新项目。

undo.example: She had to undo the knot in her shoelace before she could take off the shoes.
undo.exampleZh: 她得先解开鞋带上的结，然后才能脱下鞋子。

undoubted.example: Her undoubted talent made the whole team better.
undoubted.exampleZh: 她无可置疑的才华为整个团队带来了提升。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best person for this job.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是这份工作的最佳人选。

unease.example: There was a growing sense of unease among the workers after the news.
unease.exampleZh: 听到这个消息后，工人们心中越来越感到不安。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy about walking home alone in the dark.
uneasy.exampleZh: 她一个人走夜路回家感到不安。

uneducated.example: He was uneducated and could not write his own name.
uneducated.exampleZh: 他未受过教育，连自己的名字都不会写。

unemployed.example: He has been unemployed for six months and is looking for a new job.
unemployed.exampleZh: 他已经失业六个月了，正在寻找一份新工作。

unemployment.example: The unemployment rate in our city has gone up this year.
unemployment.exampleZh: 今年我们城市的失业率上升了。

unequal.example: The two teams are unequal in size and strength.
unequal.exampleZh: 这两支队伍在规模和实力上是不相等的。

uneven.example: The floor is uneven, so the table rocks when we eat.
uneven.exampleZh: 地板不平，所以我们吃饭时桌子会晃。

unexpected.example: The sudden rain was unexpected, so we ran back to the car.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场突如其来的雨出乎意料，所以我们跑回了车里。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame the child for the mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为这个错误而责怪那个孩子是不公平的。

unfaithful.example: He was unfaithful to his wife and lied about it for years.
unfaithful.exampleZh: 他对妻子不忠，并为此撒了多年的谎。

unfasten.example: She began to unfasten the buttons of her coat at the door.
unfasten.exampleZh: 她在门口开始解开外套的扣子。

unfit.example: He is unfit for this hard job because of his poor health.
unfit.exampleZh: 由于身体不好，他不适合这份辛苦的工作。

unfold.example: As we walked along the river, the story began to unfold.
unfold.exampleZh: 当我们沿着河边散步时，故事开始逐渐展开。

unforgettable.example: The trip with my best friends was truly unforgettable.
unforgettable.exampleZh: 那次和最好的朋友们一起的旅行令人难忘。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that we lost the game on the last minute.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 我们在最后一分钟输掉了比赛，真是令人遗憾。

unfortunately.example: Unfortunately, I forgot my umbrella at home this morning.
unfortunately.exampleZh: 不幸的是，我今天早上把伞忘在家里了。

unhappy.example: She felt unhappy because her best friend forgot her birthday.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她感到不快乐，因为她最好的朋友忘了她的生日。

unharmed.example: Luckily, everyone in the car was unharmed after the small accident.
unharmed.exampleZh: 幸运的是，那次小事故后车里的每个人都安然无恙。

unhealthy.example: Eating too much fast food is unhealthy for your heart.
unhealthy.exampleZh: 吃太多快餐对你的心脏有害。

unheard.example: Her small voice went unheard in the noisy room.
unheard.exampleZh: 她微弱的声音在嘈杂的房间里无人理会。

uniform.example: The students wear a blue uniform to school every day.
uniform.exampleZh: 学生们每天穿蓝色校服去上学。

unify.example: The new leader wants to unify all the small teams into one group.
unify.exampleZh: 新领导想把所有的小团队统一成一个整体。

unimportant.example: This detail is unimportant, so we can ignore it.
unimportant.exampleZh: 这个细节不重要，所以我们可以忽略它。

unimpressed.example: She was unimpressed by the movie and fell asleep halfway through.
unimpressed.exampleZh: 她对这部电影毫无兴趣，中途就睡着了。

uninformed.example: An uninformed guess is often worse than no answer at all.
uninformed.exampleZh: 不知情的猜测往往比没有答案更糟糕。

unintentional.example: His rude comment was unintentional, but it still hurt her feelings.
unintentional.exampleZh: 他那句粗鲁的评论并非有意，但还是伤害了她的感情。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立工会，要求更好的报酬。

unique.example: Each person has a unique way of thinking and solving problems.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人都有独特的思考方式和解决问题的方式。

unit.example: Each unit in this book has a short story and some easy exercises.
unit.exampleZh: 这本书的每个单元都有一篇短故事和一些简单练习。

unite.example: The workers united to ask for better pay and safer jobs.
unite.exampleZh: 工人们联合起来，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作。

unity.example: The team showed great unity when they worked together to solve the problem.
unity.exampleZh: 当团队齐心协力解决问题时，他们表现出了极大的团结。

universal.example: Music is a universal language that everyone can enjoy.
universal.exampleZh: 音乐是一种人人都能享受的普遍语言。

universe.example: Scientists believe the universe is still growing and changing every day.
universe.exampleZh: 科学家认为宇宙仍在每天生长和变化。

university.example: My sister studies math at a big university near our home.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我们家附近的一所大型大学学习数学。

unjust.example: It is unjust to blame him for a mistake he did not make.
unjust.exampleZh: 把不是他犯的错误归咎于他是不公平的。

unknown.example: The old letter came from an unknown person far away.
unknown.exampleZh: 这封旧信来自远方一个不为人知的人。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则你不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike my sister, I do not like cold weather at all.
unlike.exampleZh: 与我姐姐不同，我一点也不喜欢寒冷的天气。

unlikely.example: It is unlikely that he will come to school today.
unlikely.exampleZh: 他今天不太可能来学校。

unlimited.example: The internet gives us unlimited access to information and new ideas.
unlimited.exampleZh: 互联网让我们能够无限地获取信息和新的想法。

unlock.example: She used the key to unlock the old front door.
unlock.exampleZh: 她用钥匙打开了那扇旧前门。

unlucky.example: It was an unlucky day for us because we lost the game.
unlucky.exampleZh: 那天对我们来说是很倒霉的一天，因为我们输了比赛。

unnatural.example: It feels unnatural to smile when I am really sad.
unnatural.exampleZh: 当我真的很伤心时，微笑让我觉得不自然。

unnecessary.example: It is unnecessary to buy a new bag when yours still looks fine.
unnecessary.exampleZh: 你的包看起来还好好的，就没必要买新包了。

unpaid.example: He still has several unpaid bills on his desk.
unpaid.exampleZh: 他的桌子上还有几张未付的账单。

unpleasant.example: The weather was cold and unpleasant, so we stayed inside all day.
unpleasant.exampleZh: 天气又冷又令人不快，所以我们整天都待在室内。

unpopular.example: The new rule is unpopular with most of the students in our class.
unpopular.exampleZh: 这条新规定在我们班大多数学生中不受欢迎。

unpredictable.example: The weather in this city is unpredictable, so we always carry an umbrella.
unpredictable.exampleZh: 这座城市的天气难以预测，所以我们总是带着伞。

unprejudiced.example: An unprejudiced judge listens to both sides before making any decision.
unprejudiced.exampleZh: 无偏见的法官会在做出任何决定前听取双方的意见。

unproductive.example: The long meeting was unproductive, so we stopped it early.
unproductive.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议没有成效，所以我们提前结束了。

unprofessional.example: It is unprofessional to answer personal calls during a meeting.
unprofessional.exampleZh: 在会议期间接私人电话是不专业的。

unrealistic.example: It is unrealistic to think you can learn a language in a week.
unrealistic.exampleZh: 认为一周就能学会一门语言是不现实的。

unreasonable.example: It is unreasonable to expect a child to work all day.
unreasonable.exampleZh: 指望一个孩子整天干活是不合理的。

unreliable.example: This old car is unreliable and often breaks down on the road.
unreliable.exampleZh: 这辆旧车不可靠，经常在路上抛锚。

unrest.example: There was serious unrest in the city after the sudden price increase.
unrest.exampleZh: 物价突然上涨后，这座城市发生了严重的动荡。

unsatisfactory.example: The service at that hotel was unsatisfactory, so we asked for our money back.
unsatisfactory.exampleZh: 那家酒店的服务令人不满意，所以我们要求退款。

unstable.example: The old bridge is unstable, so nobody is allowed to walk on it.
unstable.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不稳定，所以不允许任何人走上去。

unsuccessful.example: His first try was unsuccessful, but he did not give up.
unsuccessful.exampleZh: 他的第一次尝试没有成功，但他没有放弃。

unsuitable.example: This movie is unsuitable for young children because it has some scary scenes.
unsuitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看，因为里面有一些吓人的场景。

untidy.example: His room is always untidy because he never puts his clothes away.
untidy.exampleZh: 他的房间总是不整洁，因为他从不把衣服收起来。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达为止。

unusual.example: It is unusual for him to be late for school.
unusual.exampleZh: 他上学迟到是不寻常的。

unveil.example: The company will unveil its new phone next week in Beijing.
unveil.exampleZh: 公司下周将在北京推出它的新手机。

unwilling.example: She was unwilling to speak in front of the whole class.
unwilling.exampleZh: 她不愿意在全班同学面前发言。

update.example: Please update your address in the system before Friday.
update.exampleZh: 请在周五前在系统里更新你的地址。

upgrade.example: We plan to upgrade our old computers next month.
upgrade.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月升级我们的旧电脑。

uphold.example: We must uphold the law and treat everyone fairly.
uphold.exampleZh: 我们必须维护法律，公平对待每一个人。

upright.example: Please stand upright and keep your back straight during the whole test.
upright.exampleZh: 请在整个测试过程中挺直站立，保持背部笔直。

uproar.example: The whole class was in an uproar when the teacher forgot the test.
uproar.exampleZh: 老师忘了考试，全班一片哗然。

upset.example: The bad news upset her, and she looked upset all day.
upset.exampleZh: 这个坏消息让她心烦，她一整天看起来都很难过。

urban.example: More and more people move to urban areas to find good jobs.
urban.exampleZh: 越来越多的人搬到城市地区寻找好工作。

urge.example: My friends urge me to study harder before the final exam.
urge.exampleZh: 朋友们催促我在期末考试前更努力学习。

urgent.example: We need an urgent answer from the doctor before noon today.
urgent.exampleZh: 今天中午之前我们需要医生给出紧急答复。

utility.example: The utility of this simple tool saves us a lot of time.
utility.exampleZh: 这个简单工具的实用性为我们节省了大量时间。

utilize.example: We can utilize the old boxes to store our books.
utilize.exampleZh: 我们可以利用这些旧箱子来存放我们的书。

utmost.example: She tried her utmost to finish the work on time.
utmost.exampleZh: 她竭尽全力按时完成工作。

utter.example: She was too tired to utter a word after the long trip.
utter.exampleZh: 长途旅行后她累得一句话也说不出来。

vacant.example: That seat is still vacant, so you can sit down there.
vacant.exampleZh: 那个座位还空着，你可以坐在那里。

vacation.example: We are planning a long vacation to the beach this summer.
vacation.exampleZh: 我们正计划今年夏天去海边度一个长假。

vaccinate.example: Doctors vaccinate children against many serious diseases before they start school.
vaccinate.exampleZh: 医生在孩子上学前为他们接种疫苗，预防许多严重疾病。

vaccine.example: The doctor gave the child a vaccine to keep her healthy.
vaccine.exampleZh: 医生给孩子打了疫苗，让她保持健康。

vacuum.example: The scientists used a pump to remove all the air and create a vacuum.
vacuum.exampleZh: 科学家用泵抽走所有空气，制造出一个真空。

vague.example: His answer was vague and did not tell us the real plan.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，没有告诉我们真正的计划。

vain.example: All his efforts to fix the old car were in vain.
vain.exampleZh: 他修理那辆旧车的所有努力都是徒劳的。

valid.example: Your ticket is still valid for two more days.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票还有两天有效期。

valley.example: A small river runs through the green valley near our village.
valley.exampleZh: 一条小河穿过我们村庄附近的绿色山谷。

valuable.example: This old ring is very valuable to my family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这枚旧戒指对我的家人来说非常珍贵。

value.example: She values her family more than money or success.
value.exampleZh: 她把家庭看得比金钱或成功更重要。

valve.example: The doctor said a small valve in his heart was not working well.
valve.exampleZh: 医生说他的心脏里有一个小瓣膜工作不正常。

van.example: The driver parked his van in front of the small shop.
van.exampleZh: 司机把他的面包车停在了那家小店门前。

vanish.example: The magician waved his hand and the rabbit vanished from the box.
vanish.exampleZh: 魔术师一挥手，兔子就从箱子里消失了。

vanity.example: Her vanity made her spend hours looking in the mirror every day.
vanity.exampleZh: 她的虚荣心让她每天花好几个小时照镜子。

variable.example: The results are variable because the weather changes so often.
variable.exampleZh: 结果多变，因为天气经常变化。

variation.example: There is a small variation in the price each week.
variation.exampleZh: 价格每周都有小小的变动。

variety.example: This shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The shop sells various kinds of fruit, such as apples and oranges.
various.exampleZh: 这家店卖各种各样的水果，比如苹果和橙子。

vary.example: Prices vary from store to store, so check before you buy.
vary.exampleZh: 价格因商店而异，所以购买前要核对一下。

vast.example: The vast forest is home to many wild animals and tall trees.
vast.exampleZh: 这片广阔的森林是许多野生动物和高大树木的家园。

vector.example: The mosquito is a vector that carries malaria from one person to another.
vector.exampleZh: 蚊子是一种载体，会把疟疾从一个人传播给另一个人。

vehicle.example: A car is a common vehicle for traveling to work every day.
vehicle.exampleZh: 汽车是每天上班通勤的常见交通工具。

veil.example: The bride wore a white veil over her face at the wedding.
veil.exampleZh: 新娘在婚礼上脸上戴着白色面纱。

venture.example: Starting a new business is a risky venture for young people.
venture.exampleZh: 对年轻人来说，创业是一项有风险的冒险事业。

verdict.example: After a long talk, the group reached a clear verdict on the plan.
verdict.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，小组对该计划得出了明确的结论。

verge.example: She stood on the verge of tears after hearing the bad news.
verge.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息后，她站在了流泪的边缘。

verify.example: Please verify your email address before you log in to the new system.
verify.exampleZh: 请先验证你的电子邮箱地址，然后再登录新系统。

versatile.example: She is a versatile teacher who can teach many different subjects.
versatile.exampleZh: 她是一位多才多艺的老师，能教许多不同的科目。

verse.example: She wrote a short verse about the moon and the sea.
verse.exampleZh: 她写了一首关于月亮和大海的短诗。

version.example: I like the new version of this game better than the old one.
version.exampleZh: 比起旧版本，我更喜欢这个游戏的新版本。

versus.example: Tonight's debate is about nature versus nurture in child development.
versus.exampleZh: 今晚的辩论是关于儿童成长中先天与后天的对立。

vertical.example: The tall pole stands vertical in the middle of the field.
vertical.exampleZh: 那根高高的杆子垂直立在场地中央。

vessel.example: The small vessel carried fresh water across the wide river.
vessel.exampleZh: 这艘小船载着淡水穿过宽阔的河面。

veteran.example: My grandfather is a veteran who served his country for many years.
veteran.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位老兵，为国家服役多年。

via.example: We flew to Rome via Paris and stayed there for one night.
via.exampleZh: 我们经由巴黎飞往罗马，并在那里住了一晚。

viable.example: The plan looks viable, so we will start it next week.
viable.exampleZh: 这个方案看起来可行，所以我们下周就开始。

vibrant.example: The city has a vibrant music scene that young people love.
vibrant.exampleZh: 这座城市有着充满活力的音乐氛围，年轻人很喜欢。

vice.example: He wants to leave his old vices behind and start a better life.
vice.exampleZh: 他想改掉旧恶习，开始更好的生活。

vicinity.example: There are several small shops in the vicinity of our new house.
vicinity.exampleZh: 我们新房子附近有几家小商店。

vicious.example: The vicious dog scared the children and they ran away quickly.
vicious.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗吓到了孩子们，他们很快就跑开了。

victim.example: The victim asked the police for help after the accident.
victim.exampleZh: 事故发生后，受害者向警方求助。

victorious.example: The victorious team ran happily around the field after the final game.
victorious.exampleZh: 决赛结束后，获胜的队伍在球场上开心地奔跑。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍全年努力训练，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about animals with my sister last night.
video.exampleZh: 昨晚我和妹妹看了一个关于动物的短视频。

view.example: From the top of the hill you get a wonderful view of the city.
view.exampleZh: 从山顶上你可以看到城市的美丽景色。

vigilance.example: Good parents always keep vigilance over their children near deep water.
vigilance.exampleZh: 好父母在深水附近总是对孩子保持警惕。

vigorous.example: My grandfather is still vigorous and takes a long walk every morning.
vigorous.exampleZh: 我的祖父依然精力充沛，每天早上都去散步很久。
