village.example: The small village is quiet and beautiful in the morning.
village.exampleZh: 这个小时庄在早晨安静而美丽。

villain.example: In the story, the villain tries to steal the magic stone from the village.
villain.exampleZh: 在故事中，反派试图从村子里偷走魔法石。

violate.example: Drivers who violate the traffic rules will get a fine.
violate.exampleZh: 违反交通规则的司机将会被罚款。

violence.example: The school teaches children to solve problems without violence.
violence.exampleZh: 学校教导孩子们不用暴力解决问题。

violent.example: The violent storm broke many windows in the old house last night.
violent.exampleZh: 昨晚那场猛烈的暴风雨打破了老房子里的许多窗户。

violet.example: She planted a small violet in the garden near her house.
violet.exampleZh: 她在房子附近的花园里种了一株小紫罗兰。

virtual.example: The students use a virtual classroom to attend classes online.
virtual.exampleZh: 学生们使用虚拟教室在线上课。

virtue.example: Honesty is an important virtue that we should all learn to value.
virtue.exampleZh: 诚实是一种重要的美德，我们都应该学会珍视它。

virus.example: The virus made many people sick last winter.
virus.exampleZh: 去年冬天，这种病毒让很多人病倒了。

visible.example: The mountains are clearly visible from our hotel window in the morning.
visible.exampleZh: 早上从我们旅馆的窗户可以清楚地看到那些山。

vision.example: Good vision helps you read small words on a screen.
vision.exampleZh: 良好的视力能帮你读懂屏幕上的小字。

visual.example: The visual effect of the bright colors makes the room feel larger.
visual.exampleZh: 明亮色彩的视觉效果让房间显得更大。

vital.example: Clean water is vital for the health of every living thing.
vital.exampleZh: 清洁的水对每一种生物的健康都至关重要。

vivid.example: She gave a vivid description of her trip to the mountains last summer.
vivid.exampleZh: 她生动地描述了去年夏天去山区的旅行。

vocabulary.example: Reading English books every day helps you build a large vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天读英文书能帮助你积累大量词汇。

voice.example: She has a soft voice and always speaks kindly to children.
voice.exampleZh: 她的嗓音很轻柔，对孩子们说话总是很温和。

volume.example: The volume of this box is too large for the shelf.
volume.exampleZh: 这个盒子的体积太大，放不进架子。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every Saturday morning.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每个星期六上午在动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: My sister works as a volunteer at the local animal shelter every weekend.
volunteer.exampleZh: 我姐姐每个周末在当地动物收容所做志愿者。

vote.example: I will vote for her because she is kind and honest.
vote.exampleZh: 我会投票给她，因为她善良又诚实。

voyage.example: The voyage across the ocean took three weeks by ship.
voyage.exampleZh: 这次横渡大洋的航行乘船花了三个星期。

wage.example: His wage is low, but he likes the job.
wage.exampleZh: 他的工资很低，但他喜欢这份工作。

waist.example: She tied a red belt around her waist before going out.
waist.exampleZh: 她出门前在腰上系了一条红腰带。

wait.example: Please wait here for a few minutes while I call your teacher.
wait.exampleZh: 请在这里等几分钟，我去叫你的老师。

wake.example: I usually wake up at seven and eat a quick breakfast.
wake.exampleZh: 我通常七点醒来，然后快速吃个早餐。

walk.example: I walk to school with my sister every morning.
walk.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起步行去学校。

wall.example: There is a big picture on the wall in my room.
wall.exampleZh: 我房间的墙上有一张大画。

wallet.example: I left my wallet at home, so I cannot pay for lunch today.
wallet.exampleZh: 我把钱包忘在家里了，所以今天没法付午饭钱。

wander.example: We wander through the quiet park after lunch every day.
wander.exampleZh: 每天午饭后我们都在安静的公园里漫步。

want.example: I want a cup of tea after work today.
want.exampleZh: 今天下班后我想要一杯茶。

war.example: The country finally ended the long war and began to rebuild.
war.exampleZh: 这个国家终于结束了漫长的战争，开始重建。

ward.example: The nurse checked every patient in the ward this morning.
ward.exampleZh: 护士今天早上检查了病房里的每一位病人。

warm.example: Her warm smile made everyone in the room feel welcome and happy.
warm.exampleZh: 她温暖的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到受欢迎和开心。

warn.example: The teacher warned the students not to run in the hall.
warn.exampleZh: 老师警告学生们不要在走廊里跑。

warrant.example: The police had a warrant to search the house.
warrant.exampleZh: 警方有搜查那栋房子的授权令。

wash.example: Please wash your hands with soap and warm water before you eat.
wash.exampleZh: 吃饭前请用肥皂和温水洗手。

waste.example: We should not waste food because many people still need it.
waste.exampleZh: 我们不应该浪费食物，因为许多人仍然需要它。

watch.example: I watch the birds in the park every morning, and my watch tells me the time.
watch.exampleZh: 我每天早上在公园里观鸟，而我的手表告诉我时间。

water.example: Please give me a glass of water before I water the flowers.
water.exampleZh: 请在我浇花之前给我一杯水。

waterproof.example: You need a waterproof jacket for hiking in the rain.
waterproof.exampleZh: 你雨天徒步需要一件防水夹克。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave before she got on the bus.
wave.exampleZh: 她上公交车前友好地向我挥了挥手。

way.example: Can you show me the way to the train station, please?
way.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去火车站的路吗？

we.example: We go to the park with our friends every Saturday morning.
we.exampleZh: 我们每周六早上都和朋友们一起去公园。

weak.example: After the long illness, he felt weak and could not walk far.
weak.exampleZh: 久病之后，他感到虚弱，走不了多远。

weakness.example: His greatest weakness is that he cannot say no to sweets.
weakness.exampleZh: 他最大的弱点是无法拒绝甜食。

wealth.example: His great wealth did not bring him a happy life.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的巨额财富并没有给他带来幸福的生活。

wealthy.example: The wealthy man bought a big house for his family.
wealthy.exampleZh: 这个富有的男人为他的家人买了一栋大房子。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon in the man's car.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方在那个人的车里发现了一件武器。

wear.example: I wear a warm coat when it is cold outside.
wear.exampleZh: 外面冷的时候我会穿一件暖和的外套。

weary.example: After the long trip, the weary children went to bed early.
weary.exampleZh: 长途旅行后，疲倦的孩子们早早上床睡觉了。

weather.example: The weather is very nice today, so we can go outside and play.
weather.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以去外面玩。

weave.example: She learned to weave baskets from her grandmother last summer.
weave.exampleZh: 去年夏天她跟奶奶学会了编篮子。

web.example: The spider made a web between two trees in the garden.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在花园里两棵树之间结了一张网。

website.example: I found a useful website that helps me learn new English words every day.
website.exampleZh: 我发现了一个有用的网站，它每天帮助我学习新的英语单词。

wedding.example: My sister's wedding will be in a small garden next month.
wedding.exampleZh: 我姐姐的婚礼下个月将在一个小花园里举行。

week.example: I will visit my grandmother next week for a few days.
week.exampleZh: 下周我会去看望我的祖母几天。

weekday.example: I usually get up early on every weekday to catch the bus.
weekday.exampleZh: 我通常每个工作日都早起去赶公交车。

weekend.example: I often visit my grandparents on the weekend.
weekend.exampleZh: 我周末经常去看望我的祖父母。

weep.example: The little girl began to weep when her dog ran away.
weep.exampleZh: 小女孩的狗跑掉时，她开始哭泣。

weigh.example: We need to weigh the box before we send it.
weigh.exampleZh: 我们需要在寄出箱子前称一下它的重量。

weight.example: The doctor says my weight is now normal for my height.
weight.exampleZh: 医生说我现在的体重相对身高是正常的。

weird.example: It is weird that my cat sleeps in the sink every day.
weird.exampleZh: 我的猫每天睡在水槽里，这很奇怪。

welcome.example: You are always welcome to visit our home and have dinner with us.
welcome.exampleZh: 你随时都欢迎来我们家和我们一起吃晚饭。

welfare.example: The government should spend more money on the welfare of poor families.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应该在贫困家庭的福利上投入更多资金。

well.example: She sings very well and her brother is well again.
well.exampleZh: 她唱歌很好，她哥哥也恢复健康了。

well-being.example: Regular exercise and good sleep are important for your well-being.
well-being.exampleZh: 规律锻炼和良好睡眠对你的安康很重要。

west.example: The sun goes down in the west every evening.
west.exampleZh: 太阳每天晚上从西边落下。

western.example: Many people in western countries enjoy coffee in the morning.
western.exampleZh: 许多西方国家的人喜欢在早上喝咖啡。

wet.example: The ground is wet because it rained all night.
wet.exampleZh: 地面是湿的，因为下了一整夜雨。

whale.example: The whale swam slowly through the deep blue sea.
whale.exampleZh: 那头鲸在深蓝色的海中慢慢游动。

wharf.example: The small boat is waiting at the old wharf near the river.
wharf.exampleZh: 小船正在河边的旧码头等候。

what.example: What do you want to eat for lunch today?

whatever.example: You can choose whatever you like from the menu today.
whatever.exampleZh: 你可以从今天的菜单里选任何你喜欢的东西。

whatsoever.example: I have no doubt whatsoever that she will finish the work today.
whatsoever.exampleZh: 我丝毫不怀疑她今天会完成这项工作。

when.example: I will call you when I get home from work today.
when.exampleZh: 我今天下班回家后给你打电话。

where.example: I know where you left your keys on the table.
where.exampleZh: 我知道你把钥匙放在桌子上的哪里了。

whereas.example: I like tea, whereas my brother prefers coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，而我弟弟更喜欢咖啡。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party today.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今天是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which of these two books do you want to borrow from the library today?
which.exampleZh: 你今天想从图书馆借这两本书中的哪一本？

whichever.example: You can take whichever book you like from the shelf.
whichever.exampleZh: 你可以从书架上拿任何一本你喜欢的书。

while.example: I read a book while my sister played in the garden.
while.exampleZh: 我看书的时候，妹妹在花园里玩。

whisper.example: She leaned close and began to whisper a secret in my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她凑近我，开始在我耳边低声说一个秘密。

whistle.example: The boy used a whistle to call his dog from the yard.
whistle.exampleZh: 男孩用哨子把狗从院子里叫了回来。

white.example: She has a white cat and two small dogs at home.
white.exampleZh: 她家里有一只白猫和两只小狗。

white-collar.example: My father has a white-collar job in a big city office.
white-collar.exampleZh: 我爸爸在大城市的一间办公室里有一份白领工作。

who.example: Who is the man standing near the door and waiting for you?
who.exampleZh: 站在门边等你的那个男人是谁？

whole.example: She ate the whole cake by herself after dinner last night.
whole.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后她一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。

wholly.example: I wholly agree with your simple plan for the school trip.
wholly.exampleZh: 我完全同意你为学校旅行制定的简单计划。

whom.example: The teacher whom I met yesterday was very kind to us.
whom.exampleZh: 我昨天遇到的那位老师对我们非常和善。

whose.example: Whose bag is this on the table by the door?
whose.exampleZh: 门边桌子上的这个包是谁的？

why.example: I do not know why he is late for school today.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道他今天为什么上学迟到。

wicked.example: That wicked old man often lies to children in the village.
wicked.exampleZh: 那个邪恶的老头经常对村里的孩子们撒谎。

wide.example: The river is very wide, so we cannot swim across it today.
wide.exampleZh: 这条河很宽，所以我们今天无法游过去。

widely.example: This book is widely read by students in many countries.
widely.exampleZh: 这本书在许多国家被学生广泛阅读。

widespread.example: The use of smartphones is widespread among people today.
widespread.exampleZh: 如今智能手机的使用在人们中很普遍。

width.example: The width of the river is about twenty meters here.
width.exampleZh: 这条河在这里的宽度大约是二十米。

wife.example: My wife makes good coffee every morning before we start work.
wife.exampleZh: 我妻子每天早上在我们开始工作前煮好咖啡。

wild.example: The wild flowers grow along the small road near my house.
wild.exampleZh: 野花生长在我家附近的小路旁。

wildlife.example: Many people visit the forest to see the wildlife.
wildlife.exampleZh: 许多人去森林看野生动物。

will.example: She will help you if you ask her nicely.
will.exampleZh: 如果你好好问她，她会帮你的。

willing.example: She is willing to help us with the project after school today.
willing.exampleZh: 她愿意今天放学后帮助我们做这个项目。

willpower.example: She used her willpower to finish the long race.
willpower.exampleZh: 她用意志力跑完了这场长跑。

win.example: Our team will win the game if we practice hard every day.
win.exampleZh: 如果我们每天努力训练，我们队就会赢得这场比赛。

wind.example: The cold wind blew through the trees and made everyone feel chilly.
wind.exampleZh: 冷风吹过树林，让每个人都感到寒冷。

window.example: She opened the window to let some fresh air into the room.
window.exampleZh: 她打开窗户，让一些新鲜空气进入房间。

wine.example: My father bought a bottle of red wine for dinner last night.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲昨晚买了一瓶红葡萄酒配晚餐。

wing.example: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly home.
wing.exampleZh: 这只鸟伤了左翅，无法飞回家。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and thanked all his friends.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着感谢了他所有的朋友。

winter.example: Many people like to stay inside and drink hot tea in winter.
winter.exampleZh: 很多人喜欢在冬天待在室内喝热茶。

wire.example: The worker used a thin wire to tie the boxes together.
wire.exampleZh: 工人用一根细金属丝把箱子捆在一起。

wisdom.example: My grandmother often shares her wisdom with us when we have problems.
wisdom.exampleZh: 当我们遇到问题时，我的祖母常常和我们分享她的智慧。

wise.example: It is wise to save some money for a rainy day.
wise.exampleZh: 存些钱以备不时之需是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck with your new job next week.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在下周的新工作中好运。

with.example: I went to the park with my best friend yesterday.
with.exampleZh: 我昨天和最好的朋友一起去了公园。

withdraw.example: The army had to withdraw from the city after a long fight.
withdraw.exampleZh: 经过长时间战斗，军队不得不从这座城市撤退。

within.example: Please finish the report within three days and send it to me.
within.exampleZh: 请在三天内完成报告并发送给我。

without.example: We cannot finish the work without your help today.
without.exampleZh: 没有你今天的帮助，我们无法完成这项工作。

withstand.example: Our small house can withstand strong winds and heavy rain.
withstand.exampleZh: 我们的小房子能经受住强风和暴雨。

witness.example: The witness told the police what she saw that night.
witness.exampleZh: 那位目击者告诉了警察她那天晚上看到的事情。

wolf.example: The gray wolf lives in the forest and hunts small animals at night.
wolf.exampleZh: 灰狼住在森林里，夜晚捕食小动物。

woman.example: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers in her small garden every spring.
woman.exampleZh: 隔壁的那位妇女每年春天都在她的小花园里种美丽的鲜花。

wonder.example: I wonder why the sky is blue and the grass is green.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道为什么天空是蓝色的，而草是绿色的。

wonderful.example: We had a wonderful time at the park with our friends yesterday.
wonderful.exampleZh: 昨天我们在公园和朋友们度过了美好的时光。

wood.example: The old table is made of strong wood from the forest.
wood.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子是用来自森林的结实木材做成的。

wooden.example: The old man sat on a wooden chair beside the window.
wooden.exampleZh: 老人坐在窗边的一把木椅上。

wool.example: My grandmother made a warm wool sweater for me last winter.
wool.exampleZh: 去年冬天我奶奶给我做了一件暖和的羊毛毛衣。

word.example: I do not know the meaning of this new word.
word.exampleZh: 我不知道这个新单词的意思。

work.example: I work in a small office near my home every day.
work.exampleZh: 我每天在我家附近的一间小办公室工作。

worker.example: The worker starts his job early every morning and finishes before dark.
worker.exampleZh: 这位工人每天早上很早就开始工作，天黑前就完成了。

workforce.example: The company plans to train its workforce for the new jobs next year.
workforce.exampleZh: 公司计划明年为新工作岗位培训员工。

workplace.example: Safety rules are very important in every workplace and all workers should follow them.
workplace.exampleZh: 安全规则在每个工作场所都非常重要，所有工人都应遵守。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world and see new places.
world.exampleZh: 她想环游世界，看看新的地方。

worldwide.example: The company sells its products worldwide and has offices in many countries.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这家公司在全世界销售产品，并在许多国家设有办事处。

worm.example: A small worm crawled slowly across the wet ground after the rain.
worm.exampleZh: 雨后一条小虫子慢慢爬过潮湿的地面。

worried.example: My mother was worried when I came home very late last night.
worried.exampleZh: 昨晚我很晚才回家，妈妈很担心。

worry.example: Please do not worry about the test because you studied hard.
worry.exampleZh: 请不要担心考试，因为你学习很努力。

worship.example: Many people worship at this old temple every morning.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人每天早上都在这座古老的寺庙里敬奉。

worst.example: This is the worst day I have had in a long time.
worst.exampleZh: 这是我很久以来过得最糟的一天。

worth.example: This old book is worth much more than you think.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书比你想象的更有价值。

worthwhile.example: Learning a new language is worthwhile even when it feels difficult at first.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 即使一开始觉得困难，学习一门新语言也是值得的。

worthy.example: She is worthy of our respect because she always helps others.
worthy.exampleZh: 她值得我们尊敬，因为她总是帮助别人。

would.example: I would like to drink some water after the long walk.
would.exampleZh: 长途步行后我想喝点水。

wound.example: The doctor cleaned the wound and put a clean bandage on it.
wound.exampleZh: 医生清洗了伤口，并在上面缠了干净的绷带。

wrap.example: She will wrap the gift in colorful paper for her friend.
wrap.exampleZh: 她会用彩纸把礼物包起来送给朋友。

wreck.example: The storm left a wreck on the beach near our small town.
wreck.exampleZh: 暴风雨在我们小镇附近的海滩上留下了一艘失事船只的残骸。

wrestle.example: He had to wrestle with his fear before he gave the speech.
wrestle.exampleZh: 他不得不在演讲前与恐惧搏斗。

wretched.example: The wretched dog sat in the rain and waited for its owner.
wretched.exampleZh: 那只可怜的狗坐在雨里等它的主人。

wrinkle.example: She has a small wrinkle near her left eye.
wrinkle.exampleZh: 她左眼附近有一条小皱纹。

wrist.example: She hurt her wrist when she fell off her bike yesterday afternoon.
wrist.exampleZh: 她昨天下午从自行车上摔下来时伤到了手腕。

write.example: I write a short letter to my friend every week.
write.exampleZh: 我每周给我的朋友写一封短信。

writer.example: The writer spent many years working on her first novel.
writer.exampleZh: 这位作家花了很多年写她的第一部小说。

writing.example: Her writing is clear and easy to understand for most readers.
writing.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰易懂，大多数读者都能理解。

wrong.example: It is wrong to cheat your friends and lie to them.
wrong.exampleZh: 欺骗朋友并对他们撒谎是错误的。

x-ray.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my left arm after the fall.
x-ray.exampleZh: 摔倒后，医生给我的左臂拍了一张X光片。

xenophobia.example: Xenophobia can make people afraid of others who come from different countries.
xenophobia.exampleZh: 排外心理会让人们害怕来自不同国家的人。

yacht.example: They sailed their new yacht along the coast on a sunny day.
yacht.exampleZh: 在一个阳光明媚的日子里，他们驾着新游艇沿着海岸航行。

yard.example: The children are playing in the yard behind our small house.
yard.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们小房子后面的院子里玩耍。

yawn.example: I yawned during the long meeting because I was very tired.
yawn.exampleZh: 我在漫长的会议上打了个哈欠，因为我非常累。

year.example: She will start her new job next year after she finishes school.
year.exampleZh: 她完成学业后明年将开始新工作。

yearly.example: We have a yearly meeting to talk about our plans.
yearly.exampleZh: 我们每年开一次会来讨论我们的计划。

yearn.example: Many young people yearn for a peaceful life in the countryside.
yearn.exampleZh: 许多年轻人向往乡村里平静的生活。

yeast.example: My mother uses yeast to make soft bread at home every Sunday.
yeast.exampleZh: 我妈妈每周日在家用酵母做松软的面包。

yell.example: When the team scored, I heard my brother yell with joy.
yell.exampleZh: 球队得分时，我听到我弟弟高兴地大喊。

yellow.example: The yellow sun is very bright in the clear blue sky today.
yellow.exampleZh: 今天晴朗的蓝天中，黄色的太阳非常明亮。

yes.example: Yes, I would like a cup of tea after lunch today.
yes.exampleZh: 是的，我今天午饭后想喝一杯茶。

yesterday.example: I saw my old friend yesterday, and we talked for a long time.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天见到了老朋友，我们聊了很久。

yet.example: I am tired, yet I still want to finish my work.
yet.exampleZh: 我很累，但是我仍然想完成我的工作。

yield.example: The farm yields enough corn to feed all the animals here.
yield.exampleZh: 这个农场出产的玉米足够喂养这里所有的动物。

yoga.example: My sister does yoga every morning before she goes to work.
yoga.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上上班前都会做瑜伽。

yogurt.example: I eat yogurt with fresh fruit every morning before I go to work.
yogurt.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都会吃酸奶配新鲜水果。

yoke.example: The farmer put a heavy wooden yoke on the two strong oxen.
yoke.exampleZh: 农夫给两头强壮的公牛套上了沉重的木轭。

yolk.example: The yellow yolk of a boiled egg is very easy to see.
yolk.exampleZh: 煮鸡蛋的黄色蛋黄很容易看见。

young.example: The young girl likes to play with her dog in the park.
young.exampleZh: 那个年轻女孩喜欢在公园里和她的狗玩。

youngster.example: A young youngster played football with his friends in the park after school.
youngster.exampleZh: 一个年轻少年放学后和朋友们在公园里踢足球。

youth.example: The youth in our town often play basketball after school.
youth.exampleZh: 我们镇上的年轻人经常在放学后打篮球。

zeal.example: His zeal for the project inspired the whole team to work harder.
zeal.exampleZh: 他对这个项目的热情激励整个团队更加努力地工作。

zebra.example: We saw a zebra at the zoo and took many photos.
zebra.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到一只斑马，还拍了很多照片。

zero.example: The temperature fell to zero during the night.

zinc.example: Zinc is a metal that helps our body stay healthy.
zinc.exampleZh: 锌是一种有助于我们身体保持健康的金属。

zip.example: I need to zip my jacket before we go outside in the cold wind.
zip.exampleZh: 外面风很冷，我需要在出门前拉上外套的拉链。

zodiac.example: Many people read their zodiac sign in the newspaper every morning.
zodiac.exampleZh: 许多人每天早上在报纸上读自己的星座运势。

zombie.example: The zombie walked slowly through the dark street looking for food.
zombie.exampleZh: 那个僵尸在黑暗的街道上慢慢走着寻找食物。

zone.example: This area is a safe zone for children to play.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域是孩子们玩耍的安全地带。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo and saw many interesting animals there.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去了动物园，在那里看到了许多有趣的动物。

zoom.example: Prices zoomed up quickly after the storm and people were surprised.
zoom.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后物价迅速猛涨，人们感到惊讶。
